metas.description: While caring for her terminally ill mother, a young artist battling depression believes acceptance into her dream school will finally give her life meaning, only to discover that the person she needed to believe in her was herself.

metas.name: Coming Down The Road: The Summer Blockbuster Tour
metas.description: A documentation of Cleveland artists Puma Thurman, DoHM, Meladite, and Irewyrm as they go on their first ever tour across the United States.

metas.name: The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer
metas.description: Filmed over 25 years, acclaimed photographer Alessandra Sanguinetti traces the lives of two inseparable cousins in the Argentine farmlands, beginning as a childhood game of fantasy and evolving into a profound collaborative study of time, memory, and womanhood.

metas.name: Khufu
metas.description: At the Giza Pyramids, 14-year-old Saeed and his mother Ekram face the fate of their dying camel, Khufu.

metas.name: Absolutely Devoted to You
metas.description: An ambitious TV producer devises a brilliant plan to reunite a 90's boy band for an annual summer beach bash, but her idea is derailed when she falls for the band's reluctant lead singer.

metas.name: In the Silence After
metas.description: A son returns home to care for his mother, filming the last year they will spend together.

metas.name: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 13
metas.description: The thirteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 8, 2026, at Yokohama Budokan in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between OSKAR and Callum Newman.

metas.name: Plane Film
metas.description: In an effort to continue using filmmaking as exposure therapy (after conquering her fear of the Tube in Tube Film), filmmaker Orla Smith tackles an even bigger fear: planes. On a trip to Porto, the camera is wielded as a shield against panic attacks. But this time, things don’t go exactly to plan.

metas.name: Sawdust
metas.description: To afford an attorney for their immigrant father in detention, a former construction worker must perform as a femme fatale and seduce a wealthy client.

metas.name: Kiri and Lou Go Raaa!
metas.description: The movie follows Lou, a gentle purple creature with an embarrassingly stretchy trunk, as he rescues Kiri, an ungrateful little dinosaur, from a flood — sweeping the pair into the greatest adventure in prehistory. Along the way, they discover that you can find friendship in the wildest places.

metas.name: André Rieu's 2026 Summer Concert: Viva Maastricht!
Stupid Children
metas.description: A man ends up seeking a violent solution to his relationship issues after encountering an aggressive dog.

metas.name: Going Under
metas.description: Depression feels like drowning from the inside. Welcome to the aftermath of a mental breakdown.

metas.name: Самая лёгкая лодка в мире
metas.description: A feature film based on the novella by Yuri Koval, recounting a whimsical and humorous journey aboard a homemade boat through the Vologda region. The picture consists of two parallel storylines. The first follows the adventures of the novella’s protagonist, whose absurd escapade unexpectedly transforms into a mystical experience amidst the rivers, marshes, and villages of the countryside. The second centers on a theatrical production based on Koval’s book — staged by a group of students — which reveals the backstory: how the book’s hero came to yearn to break free from Moscow and retreat far away from everyone — including his friends — deep into the heart of nature.

metas.name: AORTA
metas.description: Late night house parties with friends who can't understand and ephemeral conversations with an unnaturally familiar face.  AORTA is a film of teenage identity, discovery, emptiness and the hope for a future not yet lived.

metas.name: Ghost of Ueno
metas.description: In 2023, over 80,000 people went missing in Japan, with 30,000 dying alone. Ten percent remained unidentified, known as “muenbotoke” (buddhas without connections).  Satsuki works part-time at an NGO near Ueno Park, indifferent to her job and the faces of those seeking help, until she stumbles upon the diary of a deceased homeless man. Toshi, a fellow drifter in the park, tells her that her encounter with the man’s ghost is no accident. Guided by the diary, they embark on a journey into the past to uncover the man’s identity, which is deeply intertwined with Ueno’s post-war history. Along the way, they meet those whose lives the ghost touched, each revealing a story of a man who willingly cut ties with his family. Satsuki’s dreams and memories lead her astray, uncovering a bitter truth. Her search for answers about the vanished finds resolution in Toshi, who waits for the third reincarnation of his late wife.

metas.name: Mystery of Chang'an
metas.description: The fantastical and magnificent city of Chang'an, a city woven with gears and mechanisms, is home to both humans and demons living side by side beneath its upturned eaves. Di Shao, a genius young man aspiring to become "Chang'an's Number One Detective," possesses exceptional crime-solving skills and a sharp tongue; while Asa, a rookie wolf demon constable, is formidable in martial arts yet kind-hearted. A bizarre murder case forces these two adversaries to team up, embarking on a hilarious and bickering detective journey. As clues point to the heart of the city, can this unreliable duo protect the joyful daily life of this fantastical city? And what earth-shattering secret lies hidden behind the bustling and prosperous Chang'an?

metas.name: The Assassin
metas.description: A man guided by his job begins to question his world.

metas.name: Barm IV: Tracks of Blood
metas.description: Recently widowed barm goes on a wild train ride full of suspense and intrigue.

metas.name: Nobody's Violence
metas.description: Mira is a solitary woman of few words. She travels around meeting desperate people with whom she seems to have forged strange death pacts. With no apparent destination, she comes across Madeleine and Ludo, two free-spirited hedonists living deep in the forest.

metas.name: Treasure Island
metas.description: Summer 1993. Marthe, 12, convinces her brother to run away from home and from the Haitian heritage they both reject. Joined by their cousins in a park, they debate what their future might hold. But as the hours pass, the children begin to realize that what they’re trying to escape is also what binds them together most deeply.

metas.name: Времена любви
metas.description: Artem and Tanya are a young couple who separated a few weeks ago. Despite the breakup, they continue to live together in a rented apartment, unable to separate. Despite the chasm of disappointment and misunderstanding that has arisen, strong feelings remain between the couple. Another argument shatters the unbearable circumstances of their protracted separation. However, the question of "how to be together" hangs over the lovers like an unsettling shadow of indecipherability. Trying to answer it, they spend a long night in the confined space of their apartment. Recalling a past they can no longer return and imagining a future that frightens them with its uncertainty, Tanya and Artem wish to grasp the present, where they can live happily together.

metas.name: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
metas.description: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds with authentic‑tasting Chinese food. But war breaks out, and local conditions take a drastic turn for the worse. No one can remain unaffected. What lies ahead for them? And how will the Dragon Restaurant hold on amid the war?

metas.name: At Night
metas.description: After an abortion, a woman roams the streets, engaging in a sequence of understated encounters bathed in the glow of neon lights.

metas.name: Monstrous Me
metas.description: When Ariel was a disabled and disfigured child of three years old, a bad babysitter brought over a bag of weed, her boyfriend, and a VHS of A Nightmare on Elm Street. From under the coffee table, through the railings, Ariel saw themselves in that Zenith television, in the face of Freddy Krueger, and decided there was agency in being a monster rather than a martyr.

metas.name: We Are Not Dreaming
metas.description: Ciro, an overworked medical student and pole dance instructor, loses stability as Brazil’s university system collapses. Forced out of his home, he finds refuge with Antônio, a reclusive DJ, a meeting that reshapes both their survival and intimacy.

metas.name: Farol
metas.description: The day before the lantern festival, a bearcub lost her mother along the way, he met a cynical and sleezy merchant in a sticky situation, will the bearcub ever find his mother before the festival ends?

metas.name: Like Mom
metas.description: Sammy is a child born into a post-apocalyptic world. Curious and eager, she dreams of following her mother's footsteps as a ""Scout"" for their settlement. On the night before Sammy's 8th birthday, her mother is called to handle a perimeter breach. Worried for her mother's safety, Sammy leaves the house against her mother's wishes, braving the dangers that may lie ahead.

metas.name: Dilaw
metas.description: Unica, a young sand artisan, wants to build towering masterpieces like the others, but as her sculptures crumble, so does her confidence. With each failure, something shifts, not just in the sand, but in her.

metas.name: Stonewalling
metas.description: After experiencing the classic meet-cute, Dean discovers an unexplainable force that keeps him from making contact with Anika. As each creative attempt to bypass the barrier takes a physically depleting toll on him, Dean must realize the unchangeable nature of their fate.

metas.name: Letter to Sirius
metas.description: A film by Kelley Dong.

metas.name: Zomala2 | Fathy Abdel Wahab | Ma3 Kamel E7teyaty
metas.description: (X : hm0z0) In this episode of Ma3 Kamel E7teyaty, Egyptian actor Fathy Abdel Wahab joins the host for a candid conversation about humorous moments from his everyday life, his views on the impact of social media, and his personal and professional experiences.

metas.name: PERFECTIONIST
metas.description: A creative artist falls into obsession and overwhelming determination for an art final as she simultaneously looks back on another artistic sibling of hers.

metas.name: For Boredom
metas.description: The director plays with the camera, creating a short experimental film.

metas.name: Yamudu
metas.description: Yamudu follows Lord Yama's descent to earth to unleash brutal Garuda Purana punishments on the guilty. A police investigation and intertwining fates build toward a shocking revelation about who Yama truly is and the trauma behind his wrath.

metas.name: Osees Live in Los Angeles
metas.description: We had agreed to do a 6 show residency at the Teragram in Los Angeles in 2025. Tried to mix it up for the kiddos so I brought on the big guns…BRIGID DAWSON. And boom goes the dynamite! The missing key component to all of this middle era Garage Punk junk. Culled from the last 3 shows here are the creme de la creme of the tunes. Some long bloated fliers and some short sweet friers.

metas.name: Bottled Up
metas.description: Simon decides to declare his love to his boss, Melanie, by hosting a romantic dinner at his mom's house. Over the course of the night, a number of unexpected guests show up leading to an onslaught of confusion.

metas.name: Peregrine Falcon
metas.description: Two young female serial killers take refuge in an abandoned warehouse to plot their next move. As one of the girls struggles with her role as the de facto leader, the other strives to prove her devotion as a follower.

metas.name: The Corner
metas.description: Follows youth boxing coach Daysi Garcia as she fights to give her kids a path to a better future.

metas.name: Baltimore Heirs: The Last Deed Undone
metas.description: This powerful documentary examines the hidden crisis of heirs' property and the lasting impact of systemic displacement on Black families in Baltimore. Through deeply personal stories and historical analysis, the film explores how tangled titles, predatory property systems, tax sales, and generations of inequitable housing policies have contributed to the loss of family homes, land, and wealth in historically Black communities.

metas.name: Murder Him in Your Mind
metas.description: On her search for love, a neurodivergent woman is led by divine female rage to purge her psyche of the wrong man.

metas.name: In the Kitchen
metas.description: In an Upper Manhattan townhouse, a Man and Woman work to get dinner on the table as a playdate downstairs threatens to go horribly wrong.

metas.name: I modi di dire non significano niente per un pollo
Gambling Problem
metas.description: A man wagers more than he can handle.

metas.name: Keepsake
metas.description: A teen girl, Maeve, opens a box of memories and looks at meaningful objects from the past. In the end, one object reminds us that some memories are worth keeping.

metas.name: A Good Man 3
metas.description: Ethan uses a secret dating app for married people looking for affairs. A new romantic link makes him doubt his choices while the police close in on him.

metas.name: The Final Fork
metas.description: When her beloved fifth fork mysteriously disappears, an obsessive woman embarks on an increasingly absurd journey to find it, slowly rediscovering the world she’s been too distracted to notice.

metas.name: Awake
metas.description: A corrupt police officer investigates his best friend's murder, getting involved in an underground drug ring in Southern Rhode Island.

metas.name: Picture
metas.description: Picture is an upcoming Kannada romantic comedy-drama that celebrates dreams, love, and family relationships with a wholesome entertainer.

metas.name: Mekenet 2026
metas.description: A Film by Serkadis Megabiw

metas.name: The Secret Lives of Suburban Housewives
metas.description: When one couple moves to suburbia, they realize their neighbors are hiding more than a few scandals. After a shocking death rattles the neighborhood, lies and revelations come to surface as a killer races against time to keep their secret buried for good.

metas.name: ST☆R (Stella Marie's Superstar Lookalike)
metas.description: An obsessed fan literally grafts their idol's standee onto their own skin, only to find their truest self in the friend who stayed to watch them fall apart.

metas.name: Vizionz
metas.description: Every frame feels wrong. Every detail raises new questions. The camera captured something he never saw.

metas.name: The Day You Begin
metas.description: On their first day of school, four imaginative kids feel like they don’t belong, until they learn that everyone has a unique story to share. The Day You Begin is a journey of self-acceptance, courage, and the magic that comes when we connect with others. Bursting with color, laughs, and compassion, this animated adaptation brings Jacqueline Woodson’s beloved book to life, reminding kids that every voice matters and every difference is a strength.

metas.name: Amader 7 Kahon
metas.description: A SSR Cinemas Pvt Ltd production.

metas.name: Photographer
metas.description: Photographer follows Veera, a troubled and obsessive photographer determined to prove his worth in a world that has long dismissed him. Driven by ambition and haunted by a painful past, he ventures deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious reserve forest, to capture a rare and elusive natural phenomenon that could change his life forever.

metas.name: You Want a Mint?
metas.description: In a city where the rich start to die with their mouths mysteriously filled with mints, Don- a celebrated detective- follows the mints to their source, unaware that his curiosity and class has already made him part of the killer’s target.

metas.name: Мастер
metas.description: The documentary "Master" is dedicated to one of the most prominent figures in the history of Russian cinema—the brilliant film scholar, Chairman of the Russian State Cinematography Committee, professor at VGIK, and longtime president of the Window to Europe film festival—Armen Nikolaevich Medvedev. The film's central focus is the 1990s, a turning point for the country and a pivotal moment in Medvedev's career. Separate chapters are devoted to VGIK and the Vyborg Film Festival, the film's subject's beloved creative outlets. The film draws on the recollections of colleagues, friends, and students, who speak with sincere warmth and gratitude about the master's role in their lives and the life of Russian cinema.

metas.name: Из глубин
metas.description: Sixteen-year-old Nadya runs away into the forest after an argument with her deaf mother. In a fit of rage, she smashes trees, awakening the spirit of the forest, the Apple Tree. It takes Nadya to the Upside Down—a world where people who have failed to cope with their pain are transformed into soulless driftwood. The Apple Tree takes Nadya's heart. To get it back and avoid being turned to stone forever, Nadya must endure despair, confront the weeping driftwood, and make a choice: continue to fight or accept her fate. The film is a metaphorical parable about how hatred destroys the soul, while forgiveness and acceptance restore it to life.

metas.name: Дарующая счастье
metas.description: In the dense forests of the Ramon region, where even the echoes recall ancient legends, three brave brothers set out on a journey in search of a winged miracle—a bird that grants wishes. But she has no magic wand, and every wish she makes drains her powers. The brothers must navigate secret paths and understand: happiness is not a trophy. It can only be shared. A new life for the fairy tale by Voronezh storyteller Anna Kupriyanovna Baryshnikova for those who believe in miracles.

metas.name: Todos Os Meus Amigos Estão Vivendo Um Amor Adolescente
Get Set Go
metas.description: A wild adventure where one pedal stroke could change everything.

metas.name: Сказка
metas.description: 70-year-old Larisa and 65-year-old Oleg are lonely members of an amateur "Theater of Honor" for the elderly, where neither is taken seriously. Larisa is denied roles and is made fun of, while Oleg also remains invisible to those around her. At some point, they notice each other, and a romantic connection develops between them, which may be their last attempt to escape their loneliness and feel needed.

metas.name: January News
metas.description: Based on the “Today” series by painter On Kawara, we follow a series of transcribed data and news that occurred during the days of January.

metas.name: no one has seen me naked in a long time
metas.description: A reflection on the intimacy of being seen and our perception of time.

metas.name: Afterpiece
metas.description: Owen, a once prestigious and acclaimed stage director, has fallen into depression after more than a decade of creative drought. His ex-lover Su Manling comes back into his life leveraging their old romance, whereas his wife Tracy hovers on the verge of crossing the marital line. Eager to reclaim his dignity, he resolves to write, direct and perform in a brand-new play. However, while holding open auditions for the leading actress, he is powerfully drawn to amateur newcomer Hannah, slowly slipping into a dangerous grey area where stage drama intertwines with real life.

metas.name: Dog Day Evening
metas.description: A hostage situation occurred at a TV station. The kidnapper K was not after money, he just wanted to terminate the monthly subscription to the TV station.

metas.name: Charli's on the Run
metas.description: Charli, a runaway from a highly limiting family, must discover her true identity after meeting Emma, a dancer.

metas.name: Heartstopper Forever
metas.description: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

metas.name: Me Before Me
metas.description: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

metas.name: My Name
metas.description: South Korea, 1998: While the country moves closer towards democracy, Young-oak remains at odds with his female-connotated name while attending a boy's school where the air is thick with testosterone. The young man is struggling to fit in and find a new name among corrupt teachers and the teenagers' violent power games, which are as subtle as they are extreme. Behind his mother Jeong-sun's seemingly unflappable exterior, a past long repressed is reemerging, which she is reluctant to face. Yet confrontation is unavoidable – and it leads back to the national tragedy surrounding the Jeju Uprising of April 3rd, 1948.

metas.name: When I Draw...
metas.description: “Giant, Giant, can I be your friend?”  Conceived with drawings by people with autism and intellectual disabilities between 2016 and 2025, provided by World of Art Brut Culture, the film touches upon the act of drawing, archival materials, and their relation to storytelling.

metas.name: Obsession Unleashed
metas.description: Go behind the scenes with in-depth interviews featuring Curry Barker and the cast

metas.name: Young, Thick Blood
metas.description: A fashion film that blends digital and camcorder footage to capture the beauty and fragility of a love story.

metas.name: National Theatre at Home: London Road
metas.description: Autumn, 2006. The everyday life of the Suffolk town of Ipswich is shattered by the discovery of the bodies of five women. The occupant of No. 79 London Road is arrested, charged and finally convicted of the murders. Caught in the headlines and the invasion of their quiet road, the community grapples with what it means to be at the epicentre of the tragedy. Using their own words set to an innovative musical score, London Road is a moving story of ordinary people coming together during an extraordinary time. Director Rufus Norris, writer Alecky Blythe, and composer Adam Cork reunite for this highly anticipated return of the remarkable, award-winning verbatim musical.

metas.name: Venus
metas.description: An 8mm film work created from the perspective of "perceiving film as a body".  By re-examining the elements that constitute film and their relationships, this viewpoint naturally extended not only to film as a material but also to the projector, light, and the human body.  ⁡Additionally, images of life emerging from the sea, as well as Nirai Kanai in Okinawa and the Eternal World or Land of the Dead as depicted in the Kojiki, overlapped naturally during the creation process—worldviews "bounded by the sea.  ⁡This work does not depict mythology itself.  ⁡Through the boundary of the sea, it expresses inner transformation and rebirth, as well as the process of moving toward light, using 8mm film as its material.

metas.name: That Ain’t Him
metas.description: When a young man and is buddy try to set up a spooky prank for a friend, he soon realizes his buddy may not actually be whom he thinks he is after all.

metas.name: People Magazine Investigates: The Cosmic Intelligence Cult
metas.description: A deep dive into the cult and its prophet, Rashad Jamal, who established the cult during the Covid-19 pandemic

metas.name: Rooks For Crooks
metas.description: Four crooks aim to score big time with a home invasion, but complications soon set in.

metas.name: The Real Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: This three-part documentary reveals the explosive true story that inspired The Wolf of Wall Street.

metas.name: When did we start using passports?
metas.description: As the world becomes increasingly global for some, and increasingly divided for others, the question remains: Should lines on a map be what determine a person's rights and freedoms?

metas.name: When The River Rose
metas.description: A deeply moving documentary revealing the social and economic impacts of the 2022 Lismore floods through intimate, character driven storytelling

metas.name: REALITY
metas.description: Sam struggles trying to distinguish reality and his hallucinations

metas.name: Boring Guys
metas.description: Gary and Garry live a tedious life of TV and rigatoni. Until jealousy strikes...

metas.name: Cadu: Cin Çıxarma
metas.description: This is a mockumentary-style project that humorously and satirically explores the themes of exorcism and family drama.

metas.name: The Light of Bulgaria
metas.description: Filmed during Great Lent, Great and Holy Week, and the joyous celebration of Pascha in 2025, “The Light of Bulgaria” combines historical research, firsthand interviews, and footage from across Bulgaria to tell a story largely unknown outside that country.  Although the Old Calendar Orthodox Church of Bulgaria finally obtained legal registration after many years of efforts, recent legislative changes supported by the Patriarchate of Bulgaria have once again placed its future in jeopardy. As renewed legal efforts seek to dissolve the Church, this documentary offers an opportunity to understand both the history that led to this moment and the Faithful who continue to endure opposition.

metas.name: How FIFA Chooses the World Cup Final Referee
metas.description: See how the process works and who Jonas Eriksson thinks will get the chance to referee the 2026 World Cup final.

metas.name: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic
metas.description: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.

metas.name: Oracle of the Dragon
metas.description: During Empress Wu's reign, the court is in turmoil, and a strange drug-related mystery emerges in Zhaoling. Detective Di Renjie teams up with Sima Xiaodao, cracking mechanism puzzles, exposing nobility impersonators, and seizing the Dragon Copper to foil the court conspiracy.

metas.name: Model Home
metas.description: A housewife in 60s America goes about her daily housework, while pining for her absent Husband.

metas.name: COULDN'T AFFORD A JOINT SO I PRETEND
metas.description: I couldn't afford to buy marijuana. Then I pretend to smoke any.

metas.name: From Somebody That You Used To Know
metas.description: A young man has trouble finding the right greeting card for his estranged cousin.

metas.name: Throwback
metas.description: A woman reflects on her past while coming to terms with her life through the reflection of her younger self.

metas.name: Kleptomaziiip
metas.description: Two friends meet after long years of separation over a nice meal... just to find out that one has become an uncontrollable kleptomaniac.

metas.name: Yagón
metas.description: In the sterile silence of a morgue, a woman is asked to identify a body.

metas.name: TeeVoo Static Tic
metas.description: Two ladies seem interested in a familiar face across the street.

metas.name: When the Message Ends
metas.description: While packing away pieces of his past, a young man discovers an unheard voicemail from someone he lost years ago. As the message slowly unfolds, he is forced to confront grief, and the silence left behind.

metas.name: Song of no
metas.description: Song of No is a short animated documentary that traces people’s stories of street protests as vital spaces for learning, invention, and collective exchange.

metas.name: Find Me, Okay?
metas.description: Saturday morning, Eden Yerushalmi and her best friend, Arbel, are dancing at the Nova Festival. Hours later, Eden is taken to Gaza while her sisters listen helplessly on the phone. What begins as a desperate hope for her return, becomes a journey through uncertainty, public struggle, and devastating loss. Through intimate access to Eden’s mother, sisters, and her best friend Arbel, Find Me, Okay?, follows the fight to bring Eden Yerushalmi home, the moment hope collapses, and the painful attempt to rebuild life afterward. A two-year portrait of love, grief, resilience, and the impossible task of moving forward after trauma.

metas.name: Heart Of Gold
metas.description: Mali Azulai (38), a bus inspector in Ashkelon, is on the verge of losing her job after a violent altercation with a teenage passenger. When she returns to an empty bus to retrieve the body camera she left behind, she finds an abandoned baby on the floor and decides to take him home. Her brother Shimon (32), a prison guard struggling through a marital crisis, joins her, and the two shut themselves away with the child. His presence stirs the siblings’ shared wound of abandonment, as long-buried secrets come to light. When the baby falls ill and a hospital visit becomes unavoidable, Mali is forced to choose, hold on or let go and face the cost.

metas.name: Go On, Have Another One
metas.description: David is tormented by Ciggi as he is pressured into smoking

metas.name: Angel (ii.4) PROCESS REMINISCENCE
metas.description: ANGEL PROJECTed. Companion film to ANGEL (iii).

metas.name: Return to a Strange Land
metas.description: In this nostalgic and yet dramatic documentary, choreographer Jiří Kylián creates a final work for his lifelong partner Sabine, a deeply personal performance that celebrates love, creation, and the ephemeral nature of life.

metas.name: The Cocaine Diaries
metas.description: Two incompetent teenagers, Sammy and Tim, are entrusted with a bag of cocaine to keep safe for the day. To them it seems simple, that is until they begin to realise that everyone and everything seems to be trying their best to get in their way.

metas.name: A casa que levo no peito
Better Days
metas.description: Feature film directed by Hamza Pool, currently in post-production, style and plot kept under wraps.

metas.name: WIRED
metas.description: The abstract short film "Wired" tells the story of two sisters who live their entire lives in a run-down house, physically connected to one another by a cable. Trapped in this toxic relationship—metaphorically visualized by the cable—one of the sisters wishes to escape this destructive bond and sever their connection.

metas.name: The Sea Is Blue!
metas.description: The story of Gvantsa, a young displaced writer from Abkhazia whose play, As a Token of Love, carries the memory of the home she was forced to leave behind. From the page to the stage, the film is a moving journey through displacement, love, loss, and the resilience of keeping memory alive through art.

metas.name: one in a million
metas.description: Liz is suffering from leukemia and has lost all hope and joy in life. While she lives only from day to day, her mother tries to lift her spirits, but constantly encounters resistance. When Liz sees happy, vibrant videos of a deceased girl, she begins to reconsider her own fate. This shortfilm is inspired by the story of Zuza Beine.

metas.name: NIGHTOWL: Volume 1
metas.description: Abhyuday Kian, a criminology student haunted by insomnia, lives in a city gripped by a series of execution-style murders. But what if his sleepless nights are more than a coincidence?

metas.name: Me and My Friends
metas.description: After gathering on Arístides to watch Argentina take on Switzerland in the World Cup, a group of young friends set off for an afterparty—only for a series of bizarre detours, drunken mishaps, and ridiculous drama to turn their simple walk home into an unforgettable, chaotic odyssey.

metas.name: Strange Tales of Bangjia Town
metas.description: In the early years of the Republic of China era, there are multiple cases of the Clam God killing people in Bangjia Town. The provincial police send Ji Hechuan and a team to investigate, and they acquire the help of Cheng Yueyao, who does not believe in the Clam God curse. They learn from a local, Xiu, that a ghost marriage with Young Master Cheng, who is said to be the reincarnation of the Clam God, fell through, because the bride Lu Mingyue escaped seven days ago. The Clam God is enraged...

metas.name: Hinemihi: The House with the Golden Eyes
metas.description: After saving Jim Schuster's ancestors in the 1886 Tarawera eruption, the ancestral whare Hinemihi spent 130 years in an English garden. Now Jim and his whānau journey to bring the revered ancestress home to Tūhourangi and Te Arawa.

metas.name: Lale Müldür and All the Nightclubs of Istanbul
metas.description: Brought to life from the outtakes of director Deniz Yüksel’s long-running Lale Müldür documentary, "Lale Müldür and All the Nightclubs of Istanbul" brings to light a memory of the poet alongside a previously unpublished piece of her writing. The music for the documentary, edited for Postbellek, was produced by Atonal Sounds.

metas.name: The Agonizer: Saigon Savagery
metas.description: Derby, 1965. After the murder of his wife (Ursula), "The Agonizer" seeks revenge on her killers, only to uncover a conspiracy that reveals Derby to be Ho Chi Minh's hiding place from war-stricken Vietnam. If there's anything he hates more than his wife getting murdered, it's his wife getting murdered by communists.

metas.name: Deep End
metas.description: In early-2000s China, two kids take their first swimming lesson - a moment that will change their lives forever.

metas.name: Here, there was a park
metas.description: The IOR Park from Bucharest, one of the biggest green spaces of the city, is being threatened with destruction under the autorities watch. The documentary presents the impact of illegal deforestation on the community through the stories of activists and locals, from the perspective of 17 animation directors.

metas.name: The Good Boy Report
metas.description: A young girl named Bunny hosts, edits and narrates a hard-hitting journalistic exposé about all the dogs in her neighborhood.

metas.name: Fallen From Olympus
metas.description: Following the Trojan War, a soldier facing death encounters Thanatos and is drawn into a mythological confrontation about life, fate, and the meaninglessness of war.

metas.name: How to Trick Your Way onto the Property Ladder
metas.description: Oobah masterminds a range of stunts and tricks designed to get two young first time buyers onto the increasingly elusive first rung of the property ladder – eventually achieving just that.

metas.name: Plötzlich Schwester
metas.description: Two sisters who couldn't be more different are unaware of their father's double life with two families and the existence of the other until his sudden death. While stuffy Sandra has no need for such a relationship, chaotic Sandy never leaves her new-found sister's side.

metas.name: The Names We Long to Call
A Walk in the Park
metas.description: A secret agent faces unexpected obstacles during a time-sensitive mission.

metas.name: All We Do Is Watch Movies
metas.description: A documentary short about Portland’s iconic Hollywood Theatre and Movie Madness video store.

metas.name: The Last Great Chippy of Slough
metas.description: A very serious and heartfelt short film about the Rambling Stranger, his friends Herbiey and The Burger King’s Evil Servant, and his arch nemesis Hedge Person. Watch them journey to the last great chippy in Slough during the zombie apocalypse.

metas.name: Cause of Death
metas.description: When their target dies of natural causes just hours before they arrive, two incompetent hit-men scramble to stage a convincing murder before their employer figures out they didn't do their job.

metas.name: Standby
metas.description: Set in a retro-futuristic world, a lonely household robot grows weary of his daily chores until an unexpected encounter with a chaotic yet cute alien turns his quiet existence upside down.

metas.name: The Sands Won't Tell
metas.description: Kifah, a Bedouin healer, must find her daughter’s body and bury her before the mourning ends. Alone against a male code of silence, rooted in femicide, she fights for justice, not only for her daughter, but for all the other women who have been silenced.

metas.name: Summer Night Concert: 2026 - Vienna Philharmonic
metas.description: World-renowned Welsh bass-baritone Sir Bryn Terfel brings star quality to the Schönbrunn Palace Gardens with arias from Falstaff, Das Rheingold and a song from Fiddler on the Roof.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100 10th Anniversary Special Movie
metas.description: A short animation for Mob Psycho 100 to commemorate the anime series’ tenth milestone that debut at the “Mob Psycho 100 10th Anniversary Reunion Event" in Fukagawa Mirai Hall.

metas.name: The Tech Billionaire Takeover
metas.description: A new breed of tech billionaires are building their own countries, replacing democracy as we know it and targeting the global financial system. Matt Shea goes inside their world.

metas.name: Oru Vadakkan Velicham - A Northern Light
metas.description: When a young man is taken in for questioning about the disappearance of a woman, a seemingly routine interrogation slowly unravels into something far more personal. As hidden relationships, buried secrets, and long-suppressed truths begin to surface, the lines between justice, guilt, and revenge become increasingly blurred. Set against the backdrop of Canada, Oru Vadakkan Velicham is a Malayalam investigative thriller that explores deception, trauma, and the consequences of the past.

metas.name: Your Ash & My Bone
metas.description: An artist’s memoir navigating the scars of his own past through the lens of Thailand’s fractured political history and surreal contemporary art. The film traces nearly four decades of growth—from a boy with a meaningless name to a young man awakening amidst the smoke and blood of history. It is a profound exploration of grief, intertwining personal loss with the death of an internal patriarch, the cost of freedom, and the lingering aesthetics of the soul.

metas.name: Autorretrato - El Acto de Creación es Ir En BUS
metas.description: Self-portrait by Sebastian Botero inspired by bus journeys and their connection to creativity.

metas.name: 「信号Signal」洛天依十四周年·共鸣之夜生日会
Battle For the Bid
metas.description: Battle For The Bid is a documentary series that chronicles the journey of the Boston University men's basketball team as they attempt to reclaim a dream interrupted by the COVID-19 pandemic. Through intimate storytelling and unprecedented access, the series explores perseverance, leadership, identity and the realities of life beyond college athletics.

metas.name: Dean
metas.description: Jack moves into a share house. Things quickly spiral.

metas.name: Bad Cop, Bad Cop
metas.description: Bad Cop, Bad Cop is a crime comedy short film about two big-hearted police officers, Eddie and Joel, who believe they've caught the ultimate villain...or just a guy in for a parking ticket. Through their interrogation of Hunter, a guy in for a parking ticket, can they prove to the Chief that they were meant to be police officers? Or are they onto the wrong hunch?

metas.name: Bloody Nose
metas.description: A nosebleed in the bathroom sink.

metas.name: Chrysalis Within
metas.description: 'Chrysalis Within' is an experimental short film about a woman tormented by a hostile mirror reflection that distorts her sense of safety, forcing her to choose between control and surrender on her path to metamorphosis.

metas.name: To A Flame
metas.description: A couple feels their relationship break down when one of them becomes devoted to a paranormal fire that demands to be fed.

metas.name: Сергій Ліпко: Триста двадцять чотири сорок один сімдесят два
The Other Place
metas.description: Sent to the Connemara Gaeltacht against his will, Liam tries to escape, only to find himself trapped in an old fairy fort.

metas.name: Happy Hauntings
metas.description: Spirits must pay up with screams to keep their haunting privileges, and Ghost is in arrears.

metas.name: Kova’s Courage
metas.description: In a treacherous Arctic landscape, two Inuit teenagers orbit each other on small, floating icebergs, their love for each other just beyond reach.

metas.name: Lullaby
metas.description: A young girl and her cat come to confront grief as a haunting lullaby lures them into the depths of a night-time mansion.

metas.name: Escape from the Deadly Town
metas.description: In the desolate village with dilapidated houses, dead trees, and gloomy winds, a revenge kidnapping unfolds. All this is actually a bloodshed caused by an astonishing scam. Wang Yantao, whose family is destroyed, is bent on killing the enemy with his own hands. In the house an interrogation goes on, in the unfinished building hides a huge sum of stolen money, and former accomplices turn against each other. When Wang raises his butcher's knife, who will get out unscathed in the dark? The media's dark secrets will be unveiled in horror.

metas.name: Raajinaama
metas.description: A random Wednesday. A routine office Zoom call. A life forced to start over.

metas.name: Razaa
metas.description: Razaa and her mother Sabeen spend a tense afternoon in a gynecologist's clinic, awaiting an abortion. As they argue over the morality of their decision, Razaa's father suddenly calls they must ensure he never finds out about the pregnancy.

metas.name: Deadly Sign-In
metas.description: When recorded audio from a murder starts playing on the speakers from an unknown device, Kate doesn’t know if it’s real or a prank.

metas.name: Bótharín
metas.description: With his beloved older sister in the throws of Alzheimer's and on her deathbed, an elderly man pieces together an uncertain truth which tosses their whole relationship into question.

metas.name: Minland Empire
metas.description: Ex-cons Bob and Kevin navigate the challenges of modern life when an old nemesis unexpectedly returns and threatens their retirement.

metas.name: The Badger of Ballybog
metas.description: The Badger of Ballybog is a comedy mockumentary following the contestants of Ireland’s premier men’s beauty pageant, including five-time reigning champ Little Johnny, legacy entrant Mícheál Milk, competition bad boy Big Daddy, the young and eager Declan Dweeb, international man of mystery Nakamura Ozu, English pariah Paddy Maguire and American folk singer Duke Davis. It’s like the Rose of Tralee, but for lads.

metas.name: Shot 4 Shot 2026: Cowboy Christ
metas.description: Poet Punch's submission to the Shot4Shot film festival in 2026

metas.name: “NOISE”
metas.description: A soldier’s memory of his first kill unravels into noise, static, and silence - until he’s forced to ask you the same question war asked him.

metas.name: The Last Closet
metas.description: Why the AFL was the last major sports league without an openly queer male player; explores inclusion in Australian football culture.

metas.name: Queering Sydney
metas.description: Poetic doc on young queer people of colour navigating identity, freedom, and nighttime sanctuary in Sydney.

metas.name: Ruby Red - But Better!
metas.description: "Ruby Red - But Better!" is a parody of "Ruby Red" Luise Motsch made with her friends for her 26th birthday over 3 days.

metas.name: Let Sleeping Cats Lie
metas.description: Unlike a cat you only get one life so sometimes it's better to let sleeping cats lie.

metas.name: Amal
metas.description: Amal (Hope) is a film co-directed by Arab and Jewish filmmakers and inspired by true events. Amal is a mother who sets out to rescue her son Samer from his preordained fate. When her son is involved with a shooting incident in the village, Amal acknowledges that if the warring clan is not stopped, her son will become the next victim. She fights with all her might for a “Sulha” (reconciliation). But the threat of chaos looms large, and Amal faces powerful forces that tear her apart and engulf the entire village. In the end, fate proves stronger, and Amal is swept into the bloodshed she has fought so hard to prevent.

metas.name: Autosave
metas.description: Bintang, who had lost his father, embarks on a new in-game adventure alongside his father after he gathers the courage to play it again. It’s their favourite console game that they haven’t finished yet.

metas.name: Glass Saints
metas.description: A group of young men ranging from the ages of 18 to 24 live their bizarre eccentric lives in a world that doesn't understand them. They navigate life's course one day at a time.

metas.name: Girl Talk
metas.description: Over an extended period, a director engages in an ongoing conversation with Yu, a teenage girl trying to come out of her experience of sexual trauma. A dialogue built on trust, the film follows Yu as she gradually learns to assert herself while the director remains present and open in the process. Through her social encounters, her words, and the short films she makes, Yu reflects on how she has been seen and defined, and begins to reclaim control of her own story. Resisting the label of “victim,” she moves forward with a firm step into the world.

metas.name: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker
metas.description: Artist. Innovator. Teacher. Inspiration.  From his humble beginnings as a modeling assistant in 1958 to his acclaimed directorial debut, Brush of the God in 2024, the legendary Keizo Murase spent his career dedicated to the art of monster making, bringing life to many of Japan’s most iconic and beloved kaiju characters. But behind every rampaging monster and transforming superhero were the hands of a dedicated artist, whose contributions to the Japanese film industry might have been forgotten, if not for a dedicated group of close friends, longtime admirers, and fans from every corner of the globe. For the first time in the English-speaking world, the life and career of this singular creative visionary is revealed and celebrated in a feature-length tribute that sheds detailed light on the accomplishments of Japan’s last great monster maker, and preserves the stories of those who knew and loved him best.

metas.name: Early Saturday Morning
metas.description: Public rosary prayer in Zagreb’s main city square has become one of the focal points of social tensions in Croatia. This observational documentary film juxtaposes two groups and their messages: men gathered in prayer and protesters who consider the intentions of those praying socially dangerous. Comments on social media reflect broader public opinion, further deepening the conflict. The film captures the dynamics of the city square, from the quiet of early morning to the culmination of tension, allowing viewers to become participants in the events and draw their own conclusions.

metas.name: Richard the Dream Cowboy
metas.description: Richard goes on a cycling trip filled with freedom, fantasy and love.

metas.name: Portrait of Grief
metas.description: A small excerpt from the scenes of a complicated relationship between a mother and her daughter.

metas.name: Between Us
metas.description: Marina and David, two young artists, no longer feel the same passion that they've had for one another upon the early stages of their relationship. As time goes on, tensions grow and it all reaches a powerful breaking point.

metas.name: The Salisbury Poisonings: A Spy Next Door
metas.description: The story begins in March 2018, when former Russian intelligence officer Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia collapse on a park bench in Salisbury, England – a quaint, historic city where nothing normally happens. But what starts as a local incident explodes into a geopolitical crisis, which exposes the covert espionage war being raged between Russia and the West. A cinematic portrait of loyalty and betrayal and a story that resonates amid ongoing tensions with Russia, the documentary explores the collision of two men: Sergei Skripal and Vladimir Putin, the dictator determined to settle an old score by sending assassins to Salisbury armed with the deadly nerve agent Novichok.

metas.name: Calling Their Names Again: Yangdeok-dong, Memorie
The Freezer
metas.description: In the devastated lands of the Madre de Dios mining exploitation in the southeastern Peruvian Amazon, a girl manages to escape the mafia holding her hostage. After escaping, she begins her search for justice, which will lead her to share her case with the entire nation, attracting the attention of politicians, prosecutors, judges, and police officers.

metas.name: Hans Werner Henze: Komponist, Kommunist, Dandy
Join the Haaland Safari in Norway
metas.description: A few miles south of Stavanger lies the small farming community of Bryne – the place that raised one of the world’s most talked-about people right now: Erling Braut Haaland. SVT follows in his footsteps to uncover what has shaped the world’s best striker. What’s really in the milk in Bryne? An intimate journey to the football phenomenon’s roots and the small village that made him.

metas.name: STUCK
metas.description: Ambitious journalist Simon is drawn into a bitter rural feud involving one dead dog, two angry men, and three slain sheep. Against his editor's advice, he attempts mediation. However, brokering a peace will be no easy task.

metas.name: Finding Solace
metas.description: When two adopted siblings lose their mother, they struggle to come to terms with their own grief while keeping the family together.

metas.name: Illusion
metas.description: A young man and a stranger smoke some psychedelic squids and experience a fantastical journey amidst hallucinations.

metas.name: The Content Trilogy
metas.description: After her shift, a pharmacist heads back to her residence behind the hospital, documenting the ordinary moments of her walk with her brand new phone-unaware that something extraordinary is about to unfold.  The footage unfolds into three stories: content-the walk back to the flats (content ทางกลับแฟลต), content-the walk back from the crematorium (content ทางกลับเมรุ), and cats sniffing each other's butts (แมวดมตูด).

metas.name: FALL/DREAM
metas.description: Two young friends throw down the mask of humanity at the peak of Heybeliada and face of with their own beings along with all the truth

metas.name: The Tale of Ronin: Final Chapter
metas.description: Ronin faces off against Red King's army in the animated finale of The Tale of Ronin.

metas.name: Ayura
metas.description: An ayu sweetfish mutates into a giant monster, dubbed Ayura, and attacks the Gifu prefecture of Japan. Kaoru, an unassuming government worker, is suddenly tasked to pilot the giant robot "Meka-U" as an emergency effort to stop Ayura.

metas.name: Left ın the Dark
metas.description: On a dark night, Uncle Sabi, an elderly motorcyclist, offers a ride to a young woman he encounters by chance. When she disappears at the end of the journey, leaving behind an abandoned baby, the situation blurs the boundaries between compassion and responsibility. And leads to an unexpected confrontation.

metas.name: Lewis Capaldi: Live at American Express Presents BST Hyde Park
metas.description: Watch night one of my biggest ever headline shows live in London this coming Saturday!

metas.name: Christmas Uncorked
metas.description: A sophisticated sommelier returns to her small hometown for Christmas and must work with the local tavern chef to put on the best holiday feast the town has ever seen.

metas.name: Chunks
metas.description: An anthology film of six unique comedy shorts threaded together with your host, faded Hollywood starlet Ruby, and taking inspiration from the glamourous by-gone era of late nite public access weirdness.  With live action shorts featuring originals from Podcast About List, Sandy Honig, Nate Fisher & Will Senett, and two animated segments from Episode 1 & Jim Soper, and Nick Mullen & Saul Crinier.

metas.name: "dust particles dancing in the sunbeams"
metas.description: an elderly woman living alone in her apartment experience the process of her daily routines losing meaning throughout the course of two days.

metas.name: bùhay
metas.description: After Peter's mother Mara dies in a tragic accident, his life unravels as he struggles with grief and loses his sense of direction. Seeking peace, he goes to a place that gave him comfort, hoping to escape the pain. There, he meets Tasha, whose presence gently encourages him to face his emotions, rediscover purpose, and slowly begin opening himself to healing and finding a way forward in life once again.

metas.name: Why do you Cry, Perceval?
metas.description: A sad movie about love and dying.

metas.name: Determination
metas.description: An avant-garde exploration of the themes of high-art vs. low-art conflict. The film begins with the bleak slideshow of Almaty architecture with the robotic french voice narrating something in the background. After that, the director begins to dance while the texts suggests its own analysis and theories. Finally, the film closes with a visual collage blending footage from indie web series, french new wave films, archival footage of Cannes, and personal footage of milk being microwaved.

metas.name: Birdboy
metas.description: Set against the neon-lit streets of Kuala Lumpur, Birdboy follows Calvin, the youngest son in a traditional Chinese family, as he struggles to conceal his sexuality while searching for connection in a city suspended between religious conservatism and modern desire. There, he meets Jerry, a Vietnamese massage boy working illegally, and together the pair drift through the city’s shadows dreaming of futures that always feel just out of reach.

metas.name: Displacement and Replacement: A Remixed Narrative of Western Australia
metas.description: In this accumulating remix of 12 films (commissioned by the state of Western Australia in the 1960s and 70s) in 12 chapters phrases from the film’s original narration have been pulled on to highlight the ideological and material violence of the colonial project — unfolding through the banality of things like roads, railways, mines, agriculture, farming and the weaponisation of things we commonly hold dear, like “community” and “home”.

metas.name: J.
metas.description: David keeps seeing his ex in other people's faces.

metas.name: Munawar Faruqui: Dhandho
metas.description: In this special, Munawar Faruqui shares his side of the story about being jailed.

metas.name: Deconstructing Guilherme
metas.description: A brief yet exciting journey through the most memorable moments in the life of Guilherme Gomes - creator of  "A Psique de Guilherme" - during the celebrations of its 4th anniversary.

metas.name: 2026 VERNON THE 8 [V8] LIVE in GOYANG
metas.description: V8 LIVE was held both offline and online through live streaming at Kintex Hall 1 on July 11-12 2026.

metas.name: Board
metas.description: A teenage boy decides to pick up skateboarding as a means of making friends.

metas.name: Docu-Mental: Eres tú y mi mente
Maybe Yes or Maybe Not
metas.description: Joan, a mature businessman obsessed with youth, and Víctor, a young singer full of dreams, live a relationship that defies conventions and the passage of time. Everything seems stable until Sara, Víctor’s mother, enters the scene – a free, funny and unpredictable woman – who drags a past full of secrets. An apparently chance meeting between her and Joan will unleash a series of revelations that will shake the foundations of their love story.

metas.name: Dongamohan
metas.description: Mohan is a thief attempting to steal from a wealthy household. Will he get caught or get away?

metas.name: Una isla donde solo sopla buen viento
Un jove escriptor
metas.description: Set in a rural Catalan village during the Spanish Civil War, Un jove escriptor tells the story of a summer romance between two young people and reflects on the importance of art through writing.  Bernat, a young writer, spends his days observing the people around him and writing in his notebook. One day, he meets Aliena, a girl who hates writing. Little by little, he shows her the beauty of writing, and together they experience an intense summer where a love as passionate as it is fleeting blossoms.

metas.name: The One Where I Filmed All My Friends
I Am Neo
metas.description: Neo was three and a half years old when a devastating car accident left him with a severe brainstem injury. After five days suspended between life and death, he wakes up unable to breathe, speak, walk, or eat on his own. In the hospital, his parents, Lior and Galit, pick up a camera and never put it down. Shaped from hundreds of hours of intimate footage, 'I Am Neo' is a portrait of a child and his family slowly rebuilding their lives, revealing both the fragility of life, and the strength of the human spirit.

metas.name: I Can't Say No to Myself
metas.description: Zohar, a young dancer, arrives in Berlin to visit her best friend Shira. She meets Gillen, an insecure German poet, and together with Shira’s boyfriend, the four form a friendship that, for a moment, makes anything seem possible. But as the bond between Zohar and Gillen deepens, the bubble they have built around themselves begins to unravel. When a violent incident reveals sides of each other, they had never seen before, the two refuse to let go. What begins as an attempt to repair their relationship, culminates in an intimate and extreme event that will change them both. An intimate portrait of young people searching for belonging and meaning in the world, struggling with the gap between fantasy and reality.

metas.name: Speaking Dead
metas.description: When a massive terror threat paralyzes downtown Seoul, former forensic scientist Jang Jae-wook arrives trailing a mysterious suitcase—containing a dead body instead of explosives. The dark shadow of a decade-old military incident comes to light, revealing a massive web of corruption spun by a deeply entrenched cartel of power. As the dead begin to speak, the buried truth is finally dragged into the light.

metas.name: Dante: 500 Miles on Psychedelics
metas.description: A man embarks on a grueling 500 mile run through the desert using psychedelics to push his physical and mental limits. While he battles his inner demons and the harsh terrain, he seeks redemption, aiming to prove that human potential is limitless and to challenge the stigma surrounding unconventional healing.

metas.name: Epiphany
metas.description: A disoriented patient awakens in a silent hospital corridor and journeys through fragments of memory, confronting the selves she left behind as she slowly finds her way back to herself.

metas.name: Acropolis Cats and Other Wondrous Creatures
metas.description: Exploring the lives of stray cats in Athens and beyond, ACROPOLIS CATS AND OTHER WONDROUS CREATURES examines the tenderness and tragedies in human-animal relationships. It reflects on love, cruelty, compassion, and what we can learn about freedom in a rapidly changing world.

metas.name: Wedding Flowers
metas.description: A begrudgingly adept, family outcast and her overbearing mother struggle to find connection as their Vietnamese American family reunites for a wedding celebration.

metas.name: There'll Likely be Michael Jackson Vigils Throughout the Night
metas.description: Through nearly a thousand found footage videos from the early internet, filmmaker Marcus Batto recreates the day of Michael Jackson's passing, assembling a vast, fragmented portrait of the cultural earthquake. Equal parts elegy, musical, and excavation into the death of the King of Pop from the lens of strangers, critics and bystanders.

metas.name: Asymptotes
metas.description: ASYMPTOTES is a Bengali feature film that explores distance, memory, and missed connections. It follows lives that come close but never truly meet, reflecting on a haunting question—what if you could get back the things you’ve lost in life?

metas.name: Wildman
metas.description: An aloof young man escapes to the wilds of Yosemite in the throes of a depressive episode. His only companion is a camera.

metas.name: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 1
metas.description: The first night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 11, 2026, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, marking the first time since 2019 that New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) opened its annual round-robin heavyweight tournament in the United States, and was headlined by an A Block match between Konosuke Takeshita and Yota Tsuji.

metas.name: The Train to Nowhere
metas.description: Following the success of Dude, Where's My Bus? (2024), Gio Petti's new documentary The Train to Nowhere shifts focus from buses to rail, centring on the Line 2 expansion of Ottawa’s Light Rail Transit (LRT), a project that many commuters hoped would mark a turning point for transit in the city. The documentary follows Petti as he documents the circumstances surrounding the expansion, the project's transition to a hot-button political issue, and the broader impact on riders who depend on the various systems every day. It also explores themes of retaining optimism and taking charge for change in the transit system in the face of cynicism.

metas.name: O Little Christmas Market
metas.description: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

metas.name: Last Words
metas.description: Vivian and Joshua, who haven’t seen each other for a long time, separately seek out Tien in private to ask for advice about whether they should break up with the other. As Tien listens to them talk on and on, she also begins to have some thoughts of her own.

metas.name: Small Things
metas.description: A stormy winter approaches and a small Dalmatian island soon becomes more and more deserted. A typical Croatian family featuring members from across the generational pool gathers in a small dilapidated household in order to discuss inheritance. However, the discussion quickly takes a snappy twist as new questions begin to pop up that start bringing the crumbling tradionalist family structure down. One of them, a woman named Anica, is determined to keep the situation afloat, no matter what risks it may pose.

metas.name: DETAIL THE HUMAN OPERA
metas.description: Ramiel is on the subway with his girlfriend when he sees someone from his past on an adjacent running train. He decides to get some closure.

metas.name: Kung Fu Soccer
metas.description: The "Supreme Invincible Cup" is about to begin, and a host of top teams are about to engage in an unprecedented showdown! But the Kung Fu Women's Soccer Team has been dealt a hellish script right from the start?! Their opponents are all highly skilled, and external pressure is mounting. The schemes on the field are one after another... Can they use their kung fu to turn the tide on the green field?

metas.name: Golden Fingers
metas.description: Three friends are sitting on a beach, practicing for a coming out.

metas.name: The Heart of Nachu
metas.description: In the quiet village of Nachu, a small dispensary is transforming lives by bringing essential healthcare closer to the community, proving that even the smallest facilities can make a lasting impact.

metas.name: Sonali Danar Shankhachil
metas.description: On the evening of their wedding anniversary, Anuradha prepares chai and firni for two; a quiet ritual she holds sacred every year. In the warmth of their drawing room, she and her husband Abhishek revisit the small, luminous moments of eight years lived together. It is a night of memory, laughter, and unspoken grief; and the tender, impossible weight of a love that refuses to let go.

metas.name: The Return of Omotara Johnson
metas.description: Haunted by her criminal past, Omotara Johnson has built a quiet life around her son. But when he's accused of murder, old enemies resurface and hidden betrayals explode. From a lover's double life to a best friend's deadly secret.

metas.name: Accelerator
metas.description: Accelerator digitally reconstructs the first linear particle accelerator built in colonial Taiwan by physicist Bunsaku Arakatsu and later dismantled by the United States after World War II. Through unstable 3D models, the work traces Taiwan’s scientific infrastructure, secret weapons research, and Cold War nuclear development, linking computational imaging to the lingering specter of the island’s unfinished nuclear history.

metas.name: Slow Rain
metas.description: A slow rain drips on a small railway station while the rhythms of everyday life progress unchanged.

metas.name: Dialogue With Nature
metas.description: Sadness and longing being in between worlds, (urban and rural) Constant dialogue inside oneself about loss from the ancient soul, whispering in a modern world.  Living in this time of the world, out of touch, where slowness feels like a punishment rather than peace and attentive. Dreamlike atmosphere, floaty feeling and longing in between, feeling cast away from both worlds and feeling rootless while admiring the beauty of small details.  A sense of euphoria and a sense of timeless peace, a connection to the ancient world.

metas.name: Simon Boccanegra – Dutch National Opera and Ballet
metas.description: The former corsair Simon Boccanegra has risen to power in Genoa but carries the burden of personal loss and old rivalries. He is unexpectedly reunited with his long-lost daughter, and their renewed bond becomes entangled with conflicts involving noble families, love and revenge. Simon struggles to preserve peace in the city while protecting those closest to him. Can he overcome betrayal and reconcile the forces tearing his world apart before it is too late?

metas.name: Deadbeat
metas.description: When a soon-to-be father has a crisis of confidence, thinking of running from his family, his own deadbeat dad appears.

metas.name: Shit Happens
metas.description: Desperate for a lover, Billy starts seeing Carrie who hides a bizarre secret.

metas.name: 永遠・弐
metas.description: Video trailer for the album 《永遠。》by mossheilys.

metas.name: Misfortune in Life, of a man who suffers in silence
metas.description: In a vast empty parking garage that seems to stretch without end, Lennart, an aging bank employee, discovers that he can no longer find his car.  What begins as a minor inconvenience slowly transforms into an absurd journey through identical floors, quiet reflections and strange encounters. As he searches the concrete maze, reality starts to bend around him. A mysterious figure appears and disappears, offering riddles instead of answers, while the outside world waits for his return.  Trapped in a cycle of repetition and frustration, Lennart is forced to confront a growing sense of hopelessness. As the search continues, the missing car becomes more than a lost vehicle. It becomes a reflection of a man struggling to regain his control in a world that seems to move forward without him.  Misfortune in Life, for a Man Who Suffers in Silence is an absurdist drama about hopelessness, loss of control, and the quiet fear of being left behind.

metas.name: Landscape as Landscape - 30
metas.description: Part of a series of found landscapes, filmed on a single 8mm roll.

metas.name: Forever
metas.description: A girl recounts a fleeting summer love in a poetic memory.

metas.name: Cecilia Is Only Eight Years Old
metas.description: Cecilia is about to turn 68 and has never been creative in her life. Spurred on by her curmudgeonly and competitive best friend, she enters a talent competition.

metas.name: A Dream Like a Dream
metas.description: A man finds his soul lingering in the remnants of daily life. Unaware of his own death, he feels no particular concern for his destination. An unexpected phone call forges a brief connection to the living world—a bond as fleeting as his mortal existence, where genuine engagement always eluded him.

metas.name: God's work
metas.description: Set on the streets of Durban, where absurdity and hope walk hand-in-hand, God's Work is a surreal journey into the lives of four homeless friends who face a daily struggle to exist, live, and survive on the margin of society.

metas.name: A Remedy for a Dying Friend
metas.description: Jo’s friend is dying, she must find a remedy to save her.

metas.name: Epiphany
metas.description: A small cat watches an eclipse from the window of its home.

metas.name: The Death of Vincent
metas.description: The filmed archival of the Bengali theatre “Vincent-er Mrityu” by the theatre group Arghya inspired by Antonin Artaud's "Van Gogh: the man suicided by society"

metas.name: Lucky Liam
metas.description: Taken to a forest to be killed, Lucky Liam sees a chance to survive when a rookie hitman awkwardly interrupts the execution.

metas.name: SOCAPA THE CAMP THE FILM THE MOVIE
metas.description: Two Camp Counselors prove they can make a movie!

metas.name: Shit Story
metas.description: Sid Silver spirals from existential dread to the best way to battle mosquitoes, questions a breakup cliché that makes no sense, revisits the Telegram ban through a corporate analogy, and reflects on the demise of a man on his way to work, only to inevitably end up in a story involving literal shit.

metas.name: Protozoa
metas.description: Protozoa, a lonely fluke of nature, faces Earth's evolutionary winner, the mussels, to stop their evil plot of devolving all other life on Earth into complete extinction.

metas.name: Critical Path
metas.description: Critical Path offers an exclusive, behind-the-scenes look at the engineering marvel that is the SpaceX Starship program. The documentary details the iterative design philosophy, the high-stakes testing, and the relentless drive to build the largest and most powerful rocket ever flown. From the first conceptual sketches to the atmospheric re-entry and landing attempts, this film chronicles the single, complex path of innovation required to make life multi-planetary.

metas.name: NOXIOUS
metas.description: Created as his HKU graduation project, Kay Hilman’s animated short film, NOXIOUS, is a haunting exploration of a world reclaimed by nature. Created in Blender with a hand-drawn illustrative style, it imagines a impressive but terrifying new lifeform that has decided to claim our planet for itself. The music and sound design by Mikael Umarov helps set the mood.

metas.name: The One Next Door
metas.description: When a mysterious stranger moves in next door to Robert and Tabitha, boundaries are tested, loyalty is questioned, and danger comes for all.

metas.name: Rakky
metas.description: Rakky (2026), Action Crime Thriller released in Kannada language

metas.name: El Dayera - Ma3 Kamel E7teyaty
metas.description: (X: @hm0z0)  In this standalone special of Ma3 Kamel E7teyaty, rapper Ziad Zaza joins the host for a candid conversation about friendship, childhood memories, and the moments that shaped their lives. Blending humor with honest storytelling, the episode explores youthful experiences, personal growth, and unforgettable life stories.

metas.name: Landscape as Landscape - 27
metas.description: Part of a series of found landscapes, filmed on a single 8mm roll.

metas.name: The Publish Documentary
metas.description: A documentary about a rock band, exploring passion, friendship, and the pursuit of doing what they love

metas.name: Phutaniganjer Mahesh
metas.description: Arunava Bagchi, a young government officer and thespian risks everything to cast a real bull, inspired by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay's Mahesh, proving true art demands uncompromising passion and sacrifice.

metas.name: पाखंड [The Facade]
metas.description: "Who made the humans?  AMBITION ..."  An experimental short film by ShubHankar.

metas.name: The Sunken Sahara: ERI-TV
metas.description: Found on forgotten cassette tapes and long-lost duplicate VHS recordings, ERi-TV The Sunken Sahara airs once, on a late December night in 1998. An objective relic of the Eritrea-Ethiopia war, some call it a propaganda piece, some call it protest art, some say something deeper.  Allegedly "brainwashed" witnesses described what they saw as "magic".  The original writers and those associated with the broadcast are unknown and their words are misremembered and misheard.

metas.name: All For You
metas.description: A short film inspired by the albums Preacher’s Daughter and Willoughby Tucker, I’ll Always Love You by Ethel Cain.

metas.name: Help Wanted!
metas.description: An unclear job listing and loads of miscommunication make for a comedic interview between these three characters.

metas.name: i wear the cross free movie
metas.description: movie collage about rape, from the perspective of a bipolar woman in her 20s made in half a day, using media found on the internet and art made by anjimiki this past year

metas.name: Brace for Oblivion
metas.description: BRACE FOR OBLIVION is a vérité portrayal of 7 male and female Ukrainian citizens-turned-soldiers, exploring the horrors and normalization of open-ended combat. Filmed over 3 years, the film portrays what resistance does to ones soul.

metas.name: Love Monster
metas.description: "Love Monster", the opening chapter of FENDI Couture Fall/Winter 2026-2027, a sensuous journey from Villa Borghese through Galleria Nazionale d’Arte Moderna e Contemporanea, extending the collection’s exploration of sensuality, freedom, and pleasure.

metas.name: Tesztpálya
metas.description: Short film directed by Lydia Cornett.

metas.name: Dread
metas.description: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.

metas.name: Samayama
metas.description: Prashanth finds himself trapped in the day his girlfriend decides to end their relationship, forcing him to relive the same 24 hours in search of a way out. Does he break out of the loop?

metas.name: Pornochanchada: A Brief History of Desire
metas.description: Among bodies, jokes, eye-catching posters, and packed movie theaters, pornochanchada became one of the most popular- and contradictory- phenomena in Brazilian cinema. This documentary delves into a cinema of excess and irreverence to investigate how, during the military dictatorship, films apparently considered “minor” became box-office successes and exposed the fractures of a conservative, unequal, and closely watched country.

metas.name: The Kidon Man - The final cut
metas.description: An Ex agent of the Israeli international intelligence service from the unit known as Kidon, seeks his identity after loosing his memory in an accident. Now he is followed by his enemies.

metas.name: The Night Everything Changed
metas.description: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

metas.name: aunque solo 1 fuera
metas.description: Something in Cata has changed. Yet she drifts through the nights alongside her partner Rocco and his neo-rock band. But a positive pregnancy test forces her to face a reality she doesn't know how to handle. They escape to the countryside for the weekend, where her inability to communicate grows under the weight of guilt and fear. Back at their usual venue, everything reaches a breaking point, causing Cata to explode and Rocco to lose control on stage.

metas.name: Jonás
metas.description: Jonás, a teenager about to become a father, has secretly decided to escape.

metas.name: Intrusive Thought
metas.description: two friends are walking when they see a button and argue if they should press it

metas.name: Siping
metas.description: A gripping story about a woman wagered in a high-stakes card game. But the stakes get even hotter when she’s won by the man who’s long been obsessed with her.

metas.name: Léon : Au-delà de l’Or
metas.description: For one year, Léon Marchand allows cameras to follow him through competitions, studies, family life, and growing fame. Through an intimate perspective, the documentary reveals the man behind the champion as he searches for purpose after achieving so much at such a young age.

metas.name: RESONANCIAs
metas.description: Deaf, withdrawn and isolated, a man spends his days running along the same rural road in preparation for a local race. After a serious injury, a magnetic resonance scan allows him to experience sound in an unexpected way through its noises and vibrations. The discovery encourages him to reconnect with the world he once left behind, but perhaps his place is no longer there.

metas.name: Running Man Vietnam 2026: The Lord Of Time
metas.description: Humanity races endlessly, dreaming of becoming the Lord of Time—believing that only by mastering time can they find true freedom in a relentless world. Yet even the divine beasts who govern the flow of time are trapped by the very power they possess, as their greatest gift has become an inescapable burden. Now, a breathtaking battle of supernatural abilities is about to unfold. But does the crown of the Lord of Time truly exist?

metas.name: Utopia Air
metas.description: Welcome aboard Utopia Air! Please pay close attention to the following safety instructions.

metas.name: Hong Kong Crime Story
metas.description: Four interconnected stories reveal the crime, corruption, and everyday struggles hidden beneath the glamorous surface of 1990s Hong Kong.

metas.name: A Self-Love Story
metas.description: After two consecutive heartbreaks, Felipe begins a quiet journey of self-discovery that forces him to confront his emotional dependence and the fantasies he projects onto the people he falls in love with. A Self-Love Story is a drama about loneliness, identity, and the difficult realization that the most important love story begins within ourselves.

metas.name: Bhagdaud
metas.description: The relentless rat race of life, exploring the struggles and ambitions of individuals navigating the complexities of their modern existence.

metas.name: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
metas.description: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

metas.name: GLADIO: Monster Battles in the Alternate Dimension
metas.description: After a sudden accident during a date, a young man awakens in a desolate alternative dimension alongside his childhood sweetheart. Forced into a brutal monster battle against the terrifying Kaiju Gladio, they must uncover the mystery of their arrival and fight for their survival to return to the real world.

metas.name: Sartorial
metas.description: After swimming in the lake, a woman begins to clothe herself in a most peculiar manner.  Sartorial is a film about how fashion can define us, how clothes can liberate or restrict our physical expression. We are an all female, international crew, hoping for the chance to tell our story.

metas.name: Storm
metas.description: A drifting beach ball must avoid an incoming storm.

metas.name: Here I Am
metas.description: Abandoned in South Korea as a child, Huy Hoàng (Lee Yi Kyung) returns to Vietnam carrying the ashes of his late adoptive mother, Diễm Hạnh (Minh Hà), in search of his roots. There, he unexpectedly rescues Diễm My (Hoàng Yến Chibi), a struggling young singer trying to make ends meet.
