As they flee from the dangers brought by Park Ha (Choi Daniel), Hoàng's gangster best friend, the two embark on a thrilling journey of survival—one that leads them toward healing, self-discovery, and a chance to find where they truly belong.

metas.name: Flowery Voices
metas.description: After a fight, a young man calls up a friend.

metas.name: Other People's Things
metas.description: Vigo lives a life he hates. He spends all day slaving away at a warehouse, having to put up with impossible demands from his higher ups and colleagues he hates. When the workday is finally over, he has to pay the bills, deal with increasing debts and provide a somewhat normal life for his younger sister and his girlfriend, the relationship with which grows more strained and opressive as time goes on. Things change when he meets Marija, a high society college student, with whom he starts a whirlwind romance with, gaining a whole new world of possibilities in the process. But, as time goes on, his facade begins to slip away and Vigo is forced to get into increasingly deeper criminal waters to sustain his image.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

metas.name: Good Morning Gaza
metas.description: Or Brandes, a reserve soldier serving in Gaza as a tank driver and a psychology student, broadcasts an improvised podcast to fellow soldiers over the military radio network. From candid conversations about fear and denial, to feelings of revenge, through jokes and absurd banter, the soldiers open up with striking honesty. Using excerpts from the radio communications alongside intimate footage from combat, the film offers a rare glimpse into the inner lives of soldiers in the aftermath of October 7th.

metas.name: Mudharkanal
metas.description: A brilliant teenager destined for greatness loses everything to drug addiction after one wrong friendship. When he gets a final chance to rebuild his life, he must confront the consequences of his past before they consume his future.

metas.name: Ramón Vázquez
metas.description: His name is Ramón Vázquez. He comes from La Pampa and wants to reach Soto, near Córdoba, to reunite with his father. He has not seen him in thirty years. The difficult journey gives rise to a series of encounters on the threshold. And the light blinds.

metas.name: Diary of the Future
metas.description: To be fifteen, armed with a MiniDV camera, filming one’s adolescence in the 2000s in order to rediscover it later: friends, desires, holidays… Twenty years on, the tapes are unearthed and the diary rewritten in the future perfect, with all the fervour and tenderness of that time.

metas.name: Foam of Worlds
metas.description: A mother and her young daughter live on the island of Sant’Erasmo, Venice. As the waters continue to rise, each responds in her own way to the ecological emergency, to the risks of destruction and disappearance that compel us to care for all living things.

metas.name: Hen Don't
metas.description: A late night hen party spirals out of control when the bride's older sister and the maid of honour have conflicting ideas of how the bride should celebrate her last night of freedom.

metas.name: Isso Não é um Violão
metas.description: The virtuoso guitarist Artur Miranda Azzi shatters the conventions of classical guitar, reinventing the instrument as a dynamic medium for avant-garde experimentation. Through six bold and innovative performances of contemporary works, Azzi dismantles traditional techniques, transforming the guitar into a living, evolving entity—one that defies expectations at every turn.

metas.name: Still Water
metas.description: In 2008, as China basks in Olympic glory, Xi, a domestic worker, remains haunted by the loss of her sister in a devastating earthquake. When she learns of her sister’s reincarnation, she becomes drawn to her employer’s unborn child, convinced it is her sister.

metas.name: Never Had a Chance
metas.description: When Ravi meets Sukhi, he wants to settle down and have a 'normal' life. But his best mate Jay has other plans and soon he's dragged back to the reality of the streets.

metas.name: Dove
metas.description: Paloma struggles to connect with her Mum after her parents separate. After she plans a secret meet-up with her Dad, tensions between Paloma and her mother grow, and Paloma is forced to make a realisation.

metas.name: Long Live Bernie
metas.description: After a hacker gains Bernie's personal interests on the internet, he demands £2,000 from Bernie during his venture back to his home town.

metas.name: No Sun on Salvation
metas.description: In 1897, Penelope comes to terms with the death of her father with the help of Alabama, a hermit whose daughter is dying from the same illness.

metas.name: 4 Minutes Before Forever
metas.description: What starts as harmless fun with a voice assistant becomes a countdown to destruction when the AI begins predicting a couple's relationship's demise with terrifying precision.

metas.name: Sarpanch
metas.description: For the last two decades, in the rural heartlands of Punjab, the elected leadership of a small village has done nothing to develop the community, instead engaging in corrupt and harmful practices. To save his home and combat pressing issues, Fateh steps up to take charge and run for the position of Sarpanch (village head), which forces him to confront intense opposition.

metas.name: Mother Promise
metas.description: A gambler loses everything in Bengaluru and flees from dons, smugglers, and misfits while his own mother joins the pursuit. A riotous comedy about chaos, family, and the one promise even the toughest men dare not break.

metas.name: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table - 44: CLOUDY BEACH
metas.description: Overcoming the jinx known as the "Thirty Game Wall," which drastically reduces the survival rate of players, Yuuki continues her journey. A game where death is always close at hand. Next, she takes on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. Eight players have gathered there. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows. The game is "Cloudy Beach." Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she makes a living playing deadly games.

metas.name: Trophy
metas.description: The story follows So-hee, a 14-year-old Zainichi Korean girl. She goes to a Korean school and devotes herself to Korean traditional dance as her school club activities. One day, at an exchange event with a Japanese school, she befriends Mirai, a Japanese girl who shares her love of K-pop. Through this encounter, So-hee gradually begins to connect with the world beyond her own. As their friendship deepens, the two decide to sell unused items from So-hee's home on a flea market app to earn money for their favorite K-pop idols live tickets. One item fetches an unexpectedly high price-a North Korean CD, which is So-hee's father's. Sanju, the father, is the principal of a Korean elementary school. Emboldened by this success, So-hee and Mirai take it a step further, eventually selling even the medal that Sanju had been awarded by his homeland, North Korea.

metas.name: Life Support
metas.description: Since October 2023, Gaza has been sealed from the world-except for one group. International doctors breach the blockade, what they find is not just a humanitarian crisis, but a calculated dismantling of life itself.

metas.name: Cinco días con Lara
metas.description: Lara Martorell is a transgender actress working to make a name for herself in the acting world. On a trip to Asturias, where she lives, we’ll take a look at her present and her past to understand the long journey that has led her to become the Lara she is today.

metas.name: Haciendo amigos
metas.description: Antonio and Félix, small-time thieves fleeing police after a jewelry heist, meet Eva, a theater group monitor. She mistakes Félix for Ángel, a new member. They use the confusion to hide, unaware they'll spend a week with the group.

metas.name: You'll Never Believe Who's Dead
metas.description: As the Cosgrove family gather for a traditional Irish Christmas, and their financial problems come to the fore, a solution presents itself in the form of a robbery of local reclusive farmer Charlie Bann. But the Cosgrove’s have bitten off more than they can chew, as Charlie Bann is not who he seems to be…

metas.name: Rabbit on a Highway
metas.description: A neurotic, alcoholic trans man struggles through navigating his social and love life.

metas.name: If You Can Make It Here
metas.description: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

metas.name: Lakshmikanthan Kolai Vazhakku
metas.description: A young man convicted of murder awaits execution, while a conflicted judge, an aging hangman, and a morally torn jailer confront the weight of justice, guilt, and humanity in the final hours before dawn.

metas.name: NAXOS
metas.description: On a research trip to Greece, Adam slips into a parallel life without marriage, children, or responsibility. With Nysa, a local, he drifts through enchanted freedom while haunted by the life he once took for granted.

metas.name: Winter Lights
metas.description: Experimental short movie shot during Christmas and New Year's Eve.

metas.name: Lads Being Lads
metas.description: The series follows four close friends who live in the all too depressing yet fictional village of Greyville, Ireland. The kind of place you would expect barely anything to happen. But for Eoin McGintley, Patrick Quinn, James Dames, and Marky Mac, the four of whom are just trying to find some adventure and a few laughs, it becomes the epicentre for their many outright whacky and foolish shenanigans as the lads try to just have fun with what little youth they have left now that adulthood lies closer around the corner for this group of immature teens.

metas.name: F.-M. Banier filmé par A. Arietta
metas.description: In 2015, Arrietta portrayed his friend François-Marie Banier — his studio, his photographs, his paintings — with a Mekas-like freshness and cheerful detachment. Ten years on, a visit to a country house adds another piece to the fragmentary account of a life shaped by encounters and friendships.

metas.name: All the Queens Houses
metas.description: A photographic exploration of Queens’ unconventional architecture reveals the borough’s beauty through the eyes of an architect while uncovering the deeper history behind its strange and spectacular designs.

metas.name: Love Oh Love
metas.description: A couple is in love. One partner's excessive spending pushes the other into debt. When the burdened partner decides to seek a divorce, the other files a police complaint through the leader of a women's association. As they begin living together, they gradually understand each other's struggles. Eventually, they reconcile and choose to continue their life together.

metas.name: Pinjar
metas.description: ‘Pinjar’ is an evocative meditation on captivity—of bodies, of spirits, of choices—unfolding through the entangled lives of five individuals and a wild bird.

metas.name: The making of "The Kaptain: The story of Francesco Silvestre"
metas.description: The story behind the production of "Il Kapitano: Una dedica a Francesco Silvestre" (2025)

metas.name: Aajo Ardhangini
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of an unexpected wedding invitation, a chance reunion after two years of estrangement forces two women to confront their deeply entangled, hidden past. As their unresolved history resurfaces in the shadows of the Chatterjee household, an unsuspecting husband finds himself increasingly caught in a web of unspoken anxieties.

metas.name: Ikka
metas.description: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

metas.name: L'incasable
metas.description: Humiliated by feeling rejected yet again, 14-year-old Solal gets into a fight with Thomas, a counselor at his home. Joris, his 10-year-old roommate, fascinated by Solal, has no intention of letting him go.

metas.name: Love on a Tightrope
metas.description: In 1960s Spain, legendary trapecist Pinito del Oro hires young poet Natalia Sosa Ayala to help with her memoirs, sparking a profound emotional bond between them. Through historical events, intimate encounters, and decades of letters, their admiration, affection, and creative passion intertwine. The story moves between memory, desire, and imagination, showing how these two artists influence each other’s quests for freedom, artistic expression, and recognition. Rooted in real moments but told with a dreamlike, imaginative lens, it explores what might have been between them, revealing a tender, evocative tale of connection, longing, and the courage to defy societal constraints.

metas.name: Laundry day lovers
metas.description: In conversation over dirty clothes, Paul and Ed air out their true feelings for one another.

metas.name: Idhayam Murali
metas.description: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

metas.name: Lenin
metas.description: In a village trapped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man dares to challenge the traditions fueling an endless cycle of violence.

metas.name: The Isolate Thief
metas.description: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

metas.name: Down the Long River
metas.description: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

metas.name: The Outer Threat
metas.description: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

metas.name: Dhamaal 4
metas.description: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

metas.name: The Misadventures of Girth Brooks
metas.description: Prequel short film to “BUM” (2025)

metas.name: Winnipeg, Seeds of Hope
metas.description: At the end of the Spanish Civil War, almost half a million people moved by fear of reprisals to France. A hundred thousand of them were children. The French Government overflowed by the human avalanche, put them in improvised refugee camps. Chilean poet Pablo Neruda, former consul in Spain before the war, convinced the President of Chile to save more than two thousand refugees. The film tells the story of Julia, a little girl that escapes Barcelona with his father, a young widower. They embarked on the Winnipeg, a ship chartered by Neruda. That saved them from a dark future in Europe. Now, she is “a daughter of Neruda”, as the descendants of the 2,200 refugees call themselves.

metas.name: BINIchella Week One
metas.description: The Nation's Girl Group, BINI, represents the Philippines as they take over the Mojave Stage for two weeks, becoming the first Filipino act to perform in Coachella in a high energy 45-minute set of their hit songs.

metas.name: Code for the People
metas.description: Short documentary by the makers of WordPress about the fight for the open web. Who built it, who’s trying to close it, and what you can do about it.

metas.name: Gumashta
metas.description: Completed in 1991 by the acclaimed director and writer Eng. Latif Ahmadi, "GUMASHTA" stands as a poignant reflection of societal realities, human struggle, and justice.  Due to the outbreak of the Afghan civil war shortly after its completion, this film never received its official theatrical premiere. For over three decades, it remained locked away in the archives—an untouched time capsule of a golden era of Afghan filmmaking.  Now, for the very first time, the original Final Cut of the film is being presented to the public exactly as it was intended to be seen.

metas.name: Queen Lizzy
metas.description: This raw and honest documentary portrays the life of Elizabeth Connors, a queer Traveller woman and spoken word poet, and her relationship with her family who have yet to come to terms with her sexuality.

metas.name: The Egotist
metas.description: Poor and tired, Amaro finds himself in the need of moving. Along the way he takes part in conversations that make him reflect on his changing position in society and on the anxieties of a young adult.

metas.name: IBS
metas.description: Andie experiences chronic digestive issues but hides it from her roommate. When she is prescribed a stool sample kit for the first time, she has to learn to take care of her health and deal with her own shit (literally and figuratively).

metas.name: Macha
metas.description: Dismissed after surgery for endometriosis and left without answers,Ana draws on the strength of Macha to reclaim her voice and confront the system ignoring her pain, while her father grapples with the helplessness of loving someone he cannot heal.

metas.name: Unsaid
metas.description: After missing the chance to express his feelings, a young aspiring writer begins crafting the story he wishes he had lived. As fiction, UNSAID explores love, regret, and the quiet weight of words left unspoken.

metas.name: The Wage of Sin
metas.description: A group of teenagers goes to hang out in an old house. But once they start drinking alcohol, an unknown figure begins to punish them for their sins.

metas.name: Varav (The Visit)
metas.description: An unusual day in the life of a detached middle-aged couple, Padmanabhan and Sudha, begins when Sudha asks Padmanabhan to climb up to the terrace to pluck some mangoes for her. This seemingly ordinary incident rekindles their relationship by unveiling a long-buried yet lingering past.

metas.name: Lone Rocks
metas.description: "Lone Rocks" explores the lesser-known outdoor bouldering possibilities across the Baltic States (Latvia, Estonia, and Lithuania). While indoor climbing gyms have seen explosive popularity in the region, the massive glacial erratic boulders scattered across the natural Baltic landscapes have remained mostly solitary and undocumented. The film interviews local pioneers—including looking back at the 2013/2014 footage of the Lithuanian "The Big Ones" project—and documents attempts to establish lines on unique formations like Latvia’s tallest boulder (Capsadis/Džūkste) and Estonia's giant coastal erratics.

metas.name: Bump
metas.description: An expectant mother's world fractures as she obsesses over what her child's future might cost the planet - and what the planet might cost her child.

metas.name: Dalai Lama - Ocean of Wisdom
metas.description: A documentary that depicts the dalai lama between 1991 and 2022 as he conveys inspirational message about secular ethics, non-religious spirituality, inner peace development, loving kindness and the need of change to the education system with emphasis on inner values, mind and emotions.

metas.name: Bobby Josh: Shadow Of Darkness
metas.description: When a string of mysterious disappearances shakes the city, seven friends uncover a terrifying truth—the mastermind behind the chaos is Bobby Josh, a brilliant but ruthless figure who thrives in the shadows. As Tanner Pridemore, Ian B, Lucas Galloway, Ian Stevenson, Garylee Michael Smith III, Brandon Lopez, and Gavin Latourette race to stop his deadly plan, every clue pulls them deeper into a web of deception, betrayal, and fear. With time running out and darkness closing in, they'll have to risk everything to face the man who always seems one step ahead. In the end, the greatest threat isn't what's hiding in the dark—it's who controls it.

metas.name: Ficciones sin Futuro
metas.description: On a frenetic night in the city of Pereira, a nomad sketches the everyday lives of various characters in his old notebook—figures whose paths cross in a universe he dubs "Ficciones sin Futuro" (Fictions Without a Future).

metas.name: Mukhbir: The Story of a Spy - The Movie
metas.description: After the Sino-Indian war, a highly trained Indian spy enters Pakistan on a mission to gather crucial intelligence and stop Pakistan from launching an attack against India. Will he succeed?

metas.name: The Echo of You Leaving
metas.description: Every goodbye is the start of something new.

metas.name: Sludge
metas.description: Sinead Murphy’s debut film, Sludge, follows a young homeless woman living on the fringes of Irish society and deeply in love with her best friend. Haunted by fractured traumatic memories and visions of a dark-hooded figure, she struggles to hold onto reality as her friend is drawn into the orbit of a dangerous underworld. As her world unravels, she must confront the terrifying truth behind the figure that stalks her, and face the darkness within.

metas.name: Tender and Cruel
metas.description: Set during the days when all communication is cut off, the film follows a lover stranded in silence, aching for any sign of the woman he loves. With no news and no certainty, his longing stretches across distance and time. Wandering through the quiet, storied streets of Cambridge, he reflects on memory, absence, and the fragile threads that bind him and his beloved. As old streets and gentle rivers surround him, he reads a letter addressed to her, words that become both confession and prayer.

metas.name: Rage Against the Dying of the Light
metas.description: Often described as ‘avant-garde punk’, Dublin musician Meryl Streek is dark and dangerous – a cocktail of rage and despair. Onstage he’s a prowler – menacing, apoplectic, and snarling like a young Joe Strummer. Rage Against the Dying of the Light is not only a portrait of an artist, but a snapshot of a challenging time in Irish culture amid a massive housing crisis and a fear of artistic homogenisation – highlighting the importance of dissenting, unique and rousing voices.

metas.name: Murder Game
metas.description: Three years ago, assassin Tide betrayed her organization by refusing to carry out a kill order. After escaping death, she adopted the alias Minghui and lived in seclusion in a small town with her blind sister Mingzhu, running a coffee shop. An accident exposes their whereabouts, and former accomplices track them down, catching Mingzhu in a manhunt. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

metas.name: Note From a Gutter Boy
metas.description: After a young man is murdered in a violent street brawl in Melbourne's western suburbs, his best friend Tommy recounts the circumstances that led to his demise during a court-ordered group therapy session.

metas.name: Nocaretown
metas.description: In the surreal town of Nocaretown, a group of bizarre characters become entangled in a dangerous, absurd quest centered on a mysterious wooden box.

metas.name: Bad Luck
metas.description: A suicidal taxi driver must confront his own mortality when he finds himself complicit in the attempted murder of a diabetic cat

metas.name: Peace, Peace!
metas.description: An hour before their mother's funeral, three siblings are forced to reckon with the horrifying reality of their childhood.

metas.name: Depth
metas.description: It’s a short documentary, supported by Ithra and the Cultural Fund, about Saudi diver Ahmed Al-Jaber, who undertakes one of the most dangerous jobs in the world. The film details Ahmed's daily work at a marine maintenance company, where he dives to great depths to repair and maintain oil pipelines. It also highlights the daily dangers he faces and the intense work pressure.

metas.name: ANSIA(nia)
metas.description: Nena is a young woman obsessed with her appearance and with the idea of growing old. Influenced by a culture that turns female aging into something to fear, she develops an anxious relationship with both the mirror and her own body. When she buys an anti-wrinkle cream in an attempt to stop time, she begins to realise that her struggle is futile. During a visit to her grandmother, she encounters an elderly woman who is happy, confident and at peace with herself. This meeting changes Nena’s perspective: aging stops being a monster and becomes a natural continuation of life.

metas.name: The Roast of Caveh Zahedi
metas.description: A documentary record of the live event hosted by Video Store(age) on February 27 at Life World in New York City. The roasters included the following luminaries, trouble makers, and last-minute substitutions: Yung Chomsky, Lily Lady, Christian Lorentzen, Sharon Mashihi, Peter Rinaldi, Joe Swanberg, Onur Tukel, Pacho Velez, and Joshua Z. Weinstein.

metas.name: An Mháthair
metas.description: When confronted with the young man who took her son away from her, a grieving mother must stop him before he strikes again.

metas.name: Open ending
metas.description: A teenage girl who has felt different for as long as she can remember becomes isolated after years of bullying and loneliness. Everything changes when she discovers cinema, a place that helps her find hope, peace, and a way back to herself.

metas.name: Was von uns übrig bleibt
metas.description: After a major argument with her childhood friend, an emotionally guarded woman begins to question the power dynamics at play, risking not only her circle of friends but also the relationship with her new girlfriend.

metas.name: Qadira
metas.description: Sukant returns from a work trip and finds out that his partner, Tara, has ended their relationship and left. The heartbreak, combined with his failing startup, builds up to a point where he tries to end his life. But then he receives an unexpected phone call.

metas.name: Babesmilk
metas.description: After an ice cream outburst gets her arrested, an entitled woman grapples with the wreckage of her own behavior.

metas.name: The Night I Learned To Fly
metas.description: One night, Lúcio and his mask look for answers. Between what's real and surreal, Sun navigates in his world, also looking to be seen.

metas.name: DUMPED
metas.description: As Glenn sits by himself in a park after having his relationship come to an end, his mate Chris appears and takes him on a day out to help get his mind off the whole ordeal.

metas.name: Dissection
metas.description: Director Ewan Dunn showcases the making of two surrealist films that almost caused his departure from filmmaking.

metas.name: Almost with You
metas.description: Still devastated by the recent death of his brother, an Irish singer-songwriter on a solo tour of Australia finds himself in a remote West Australian town with 5 days off before the final show of the tour.

metas.name: Doing What?
metas.description: A political demonstration in Argentina. A couple attempts to understand one another through landscapes. In Marseille, a young man asks another: doing what ? A cat watches the scene from behind a window. A poem for a utopia of disagreement.

metas.name: Extinctions of Blue
metas.description: What if blue were disappearing from the spectrum? Through images and narratives blending visual poetry, irony and reflections on the disappearance of blue — and, with it, of living things — the film sketches out a meditation on the language of colours that we share.

metas.name: You Dreamt You Saw Yourself But Couldn’t See Your Face
metas.description: A quiet whistling returned from childhood; the calm of a sky and a river dissolving into one another, from which emerges the image of a loved one. For the duration of a reflection, the water reveals memories and offers the delicacy of a glimpse into the course of a life.

metas.name: A Man Jumps into the Water
metas.description: On 10 December 2024, at around two o’clock in the afternoon, a homeless man immerses himself in a lake in a Buenos Aires park and disappears. From this news item, the filmmaker reflects on the films that will never be made and those that may still be possible.

metas.name: Hidden materials
metas.description: Banned languages, books telling stories of alien children, and strange sculptures that resemble spaceships. The history of the suppression of the Basque language during Franco’s dictatorship opens the door to the invisible.

metas.name: Letters to Etel
metas.description: Fouad Elkoury is a photographer, Etel Adnan was a writer and painter — both Lebanese, and friends. After Etel’s death, Fouad writes letters to her. Then comes the genocide in Gaza. Her Arab Apocalypse and his photographs resonate together in an attempt to confront the tragedy.

metas.name: The Bitches
metas.description: On a journey through heartbreak, in search of transformation. The film is built through friendship: each person helps in their own way, searches for the story, translates the words into their own language, sings Emily Dickinson, joyfully mends the dress of sorrow.

metas.name: The B-side of the Landscape
metas.description: Every day, an aging filmmaker whose eyesight is deteriorating spends long hours in a retail park. He waits for his wife, who teaches drawing. A portrait in and of a non-place, shot on 16mm between the supermarket and the carwash, meditations and reveries.

metas.name: Crossings : Kaleh Ziyarat
metas.description: Between the Caspian Sea and the Strait of Hormuz, through the reanimation of archives and documentary observation, a frenetic plunge into the parallel economies of a region shaped by imperial ambitions and survival instincts.

metas.name: Only the Serpent Knows
metas.description: Two brothers reunite in their childhood home to speak about the incest one of them suffered there as a child. Over the course of a single day, their conversation intertwines the most difficult questions with the boldest theories, delving deep into our religious and mythological history.

metas.name: Beautiful Faces
metas.description: An old man has turned his solitary journey and homosexual sentimental education into a narrative. From his encounter with the filmmaker emerges a luminous portrait and an unflinching confession.

metas.name: Chicken Soup
metas.description: Lili, a young French woman, lives in New York between odd jobs and coffees with friends while overstaying her visa. A chance encounter with two police officers tips her — and the film itself — into another dimension.

metas.name: Mother, You Have Not Died Yet. But You Will. And When You Do, You Will Finally Be Alive Again.
metas.description: In the Indian township of Durban, where post-apartheid violence still simmers, Lishana cares for her dying mother. Through her photographic practice, she reflects on life and death, past and present, navigating between the tangible and the mystical.

metas.name: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
metas.description: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

metas.name: mud ritual
metas.description: In the summer of 2024, filmmaker and artist Janne Elens retreats to rural Sweden, where she stays on a permaculture farm that, years prior, had served as a sanctuary after she had escaped a dangerous situation. After years of trauma processing, she now decides to close this chapter of humiliation and suffering, on the land that had carried her so dearly while the residue of this traumatic event lingered on her body. This mud ritual arose from a spontaneous urge to give herself deep cleansing, and in doing so, return all the filth and the dirt inflicted upon her back to the Earth.

metas.name: Iran, Israel and the Bomb
metas.description: On February 28, 2026, the US and Israel launched massive strikes on Iran, claiming an imminent nuclear threat.  This film traces how the world reached this point after more than three decades of shadow war over “the bomb”.  Israel has tried to block Tehran’s nuclear drive with sabotage, assassinations and cyberwar – from the Stuxnet virus wrecking Natanz centrifuges to the AI-assisted killing of nuclear programme “father” Mohsen Fakhrizadeh, and a commando raid stealing 1.5 tonnes of secret nuclear archive files.  Iran insists uranium enrichment is its sovereign right and key to national identity and regional power.  As Israel pounded Iran’s nuclear facilities in June 2025 and systematically weakened its allies in Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen, nuclear talks continued in Geneva. Iran was edging towards diluting weapons-grade uranium – but Israel wasn’t prepared to wait, and pulled Washington into open war whose global consequences are only now beginning to unfold.

metas.name: Tarfu Bravo Zulu
metas.description: At a lonely outpost on the coast of nowhere, two soldiers of sorts stand guard against civilization.  Or for it — sorry, yeah, for it?

metas.name: CLOUDS
metas.description: A short story about clouds and the child-like wonder

metas.name: Star Spangled Adventures - The Movie!
metas.description: When Liberty the Eagle attempts to chronicle independence in America, she is quickly confronted by Tyrannus, a Crow determined to create oppression in the New Land. Will this fledgling nation fall into tyranny, or achieve freedom for all?

metas.name: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
metas.description: It's Nice to Finally Meet You follows Hannah, a woman who is feeling anxious about meeting the parents. She feels like a failure in every aspect of her life, but she desperately wants to be accepted by this new family. It takes every ounce of courage for her to get to the front door. When she finally does, a surprise is in store for everyone involved. This film is a story about resilience and the power of gifts.

metas.name: Stage Play 『The Tatami Galaxy』
metas.description: Stage play of the serie with the same name.

metas.name: TAKEOUT
metas.description: Two friends deal with grief after the death of their other friend.

metas.name: Shin Neko
metas.description: The film follows Mako, a young boy who's given the responsibility of looking after her granny's cat: Yuki. However, panic sets in when the cat suddenly goes missing. Fearing he will be blamed for the mistake, the boy embarks on a frantic search around the neighborhood, desperate to find Yuki before his dad returns.

metas.name: Comment comprendre le langage des aliens ?
Quantum Entangled
metas.description: When two strangers find themselves connected in bizarre and unusual ways, they learn their souls are entangled at the quantum level.

metas.name: 16 Pages
metas.description: A not so good in his mind director tries to get funding for his new film

metas.name: Sisyphus
metas.description: 1 Godfather, 2 Goons, 3 Euros and a whole lot of Greek Cult TV

metas.name: Driven by You
metas.description: After being unnoticed and doubted for years, a 16-year-old Chinese ice hockey player faces the question every student-athlete in China must confront: should he follow the path designed by his parents and give up the sport he loves? As expectations and uncertainty pulls him into a spiral of self-doubt, an American football coach enters the story, and the boy must decide what truly matters to him.

metas.name: Skogssti
metas.description: A boy takes a walk in Nature.

metas.name: Separate Roads
metas.description: When former high school sweethearts Daniel and Tyler meet again years after a painful breakup, they're forced to confront the scars of their past - including Tyler's attempt to 'cure' his love through conversion therapy. They try to bury the hatchet and find closure, but old wounds may be too deep to heal.

metas.name: One Last Day
metas.description: Depicting the passage of the four seasons in a single year, this contemplative documentary reveals the tragic yet magnificent decline of a world in agony.

metas.name: Pet Shop
metas.description: Pet Shop works as an experiment on regret and suffering.  A juxtaposition of a dog in a pet shop and a window. Narrated from the perspective of God, or the Devil, the text recounts discussions a person has had with Him. The person accuses Him of destroying his life. This could be for a sin, a murder, or for falling in love with a person of the same sex.

metas.name: A lonely world
metas.description: A short film about loneliness in the famous video game, Minecraft

metas.name: The Tidekeepers
metas.description: Following a group of seaweed harvesters along the Cornish coastline, navigating the changing relationship between coastal communities, food traditions, marine ecosystems, and environmental stewardship.

metas.name: As The Train Passes
metas.description: Tracing the heritage of Indian railways, this documentary explores the evolution of train travel and its lasting impact on people, culture, memory and cinema. A personal documentary short film made entirely on a smartphone.

metas.name: Acho que sou a morte
metas.description: "Acho que sou a morte" tells the story of Catrina, a young student that one day start to belive shes death. So, she decides to go to the one pleace you go when you belive you are a mistycal being, a tarologue. Looking for maybe stop "being death".

metas.name: The Peláez
metas.description: After the death of a powerful businessman, his estranged daughters reunite at the funeral home. Amid scandals, betrayals, and unresolved issues, each family member must confront the truth about the man who shaped their lives.

metas.name: Red Rock Ranch
metas.description: Cyrus Briggs wakes up in a different reality one day and soon discovers the truth behind this "perfect" world.

metas.name: Đồng Quể: Of the Same Womb
metas.description: Đồng Quê: Of the Same Womb follows 13 queer and trans Vietnamese artists returning to their ancestral homeland. The film holds space for grief, resilience, and reclamation, and for the connections between queer and trans Vietnamese people, their families, and the broader communities they come from.

metas.name: Superfan No. 1
metas.description: In Superfan No. 1, a seven-year-old South Asian girl is about to discover a massive secret about her hero, her father.

metas.name: Flow
metas.description: In Flow, a Chinese American young woman navigates lifelong pressure and expectations, working out what it means to live on her own timeline.

metas.name: Desert Beneath the Ocean
metas.description: In his later years, the sculptor Lu Hengsheng returned to his hometown and held a desert sculpture exhibition. During this time, he recalled three behind-the-scenes stories closely tied to his artistic career. On the day his final piece was unveiled, Lu Hengsheng drove deep into the desert and mysteriously disappeared...

metas.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
metas.description: A foreign writer is in Sicily and believes that careful observation is enough to understand Sicilian culture and Sicilians. However, through his stories, he learns that you cannot know or understand Sicily or Sicilians through mere observation. You have to stand beside its people, shoulder to shoulder (Spalla a Spadda), share their struggles and their victories. Only then can you begin to understand

metas.name: Poop On My Lawn
metas.description: A young woman becomes obsessed with finding the culprit of the dog poop on her lawn as a way to avoid confronting the realities of her sick sister.

metas.name: Биостанция Анива: дело длинной воли
metas.description: The history of the Aniva biological station, when it was just being assembled from people, ideas, tents, drawings, and other things.

metas.name: Ruins
metas.description: Restoring a monument made by her father, a filmmaker retraces how an artwork can be a vessel for mourning and remembrance.

metas.name: The Basement
metas.description: Seventeen years after leaving home, I moved back into my mother's house, bringing with me objects that felt out of place here, much like myself. So I retreated to the basement, reconstructing past living spaces, allowing memories and dreams to gradually emerge. Through examining these objects, I try to rediscover "myself"; meanwhile, my mother's voice from upstairs constantly calls out, reminding me of my identity as a "daughter". Amidst this tension, I attempt to rewrite myself, allowing the narrative to shift from "daughter" to "me".

metas.name: The Plastic Country
metas.description: The new film from leading youth ocean and climate champion Kal Glanznig (Rising Up) is an eye-opening investigation of the impact of plastic on our bodies and ecosystems.

metas.name: [...] 𝖆𝖘 𝖎𝖋 𝖙𝖍𝖊 𝖊𝖆𝖗𝖙𝖍 𝖜𝖊𝖗𝖊 𝖆 𝖘𝖐𝖞 𝖔𝖋 𝖊𝖒𝖇𝖊𝖗𝖘
metas.description: The soul is an immortal spirit that takes form through a word carried by the wind. And that word can, through a dream, become eternal.

metas.name: Into the Darkness: The New Adventure
metas.description: Captain Jerico and the crew of his starship go on a mission to find his missing Uncle. On this adventure, they encounter some aliens with strange customs and learn some important lessons about tolerance.

metas.name: 963 Days: The Story of a President who Put Brazil Back on Track
metas.description: A documentary that chronicles the political trajectory of former president Michel Temer (MDB) during the 963 days he was in charge of the Planalto Palace.

metas.name: Illu
metas.description: A writer is on the lookout for new a rental house after the owners of his current home ask him to vacate the place.

metas.name: Sheesh, A Taylor Love Story
metas.description: Follows Mac Coronel, a call center agent by day and drag performer by night, whose viral Taylor Swift–inspired performances transform malls and plazas across Manila into sanctuaries of joy and belonging.

metas.name: Plumped
metas.description: An honest, direct-to-camera survey film in which women speak candidly about their experiences with lip filler.

metas.name: The Roots
metas.description: After a decade in Canada, a Bangladeshi immigrant Akash returns to Bangladesh with his child, seeking to reconnect with his abandoned family and past. But time has reshaped everything—relationships have faded, and home feels distant. Struggling with identity and belonging, he confronts the silent weight of migration and the ache of return. Feature Film ‘The Roots’ is a poignant exploration of identity, nostalgia, loss, and the search for home across two worlds.

metas.name: Тазы
metas.description: Together with his like-minded associates, Rashid is striving to secure recognition for the Tazy as a distinct dog breed, as well as its recognition at the international level. After all, officially there exists only the category of "Central Asian Sighthound," which encompasses a multitude of varieties—including the Tazy. For Rashid, the Tazy is not merely a variety, but a unique cultural phenomenon that demands careful preservation.

metas.name: Шаг назад навстречу
metas.description: A film journey through a nature reserve in the south of France, famous for its white wild horses and the special relationship between man and animal.

metas.name: An Act of Love
metas.description: ﻿Imagine you have discovered that your husband is not straight, but actually bisexual; however, instead of feeling betrayed or hurt, you decide to open the marriage by adding another man to the mix? Molly, David’s wife, comes to this very realization, and as An Act of Love, she is helping their love grow stronger rather than dividing them.

metas.name: Inevitably Alone
metas.description: When a grieving father is diagnosed with terminal cancer, his desperate attempts to reconnect with his estranged sons force them all to confront the weight of loss, love, and the inevitability of being left behind.

metas.name: Before Me
metas.description: A heartbroken photographer falls for an aspiring writer, but after discovering her secret past his retroactive jealousy threatens to ruin everything.

metas.name: Pomodoro
metas.description: Two aspiring sibling chefs scramble to prepare an elaborate dinner to prove themselves to their harsh food critic mother. As the night unfolds, their talent and ambition shine, but so do buried tensions and long-standing resentment.

metas.name: Yu & Me
metas.description: When a fire destroys a beloved Chinatown bookstore, its hyper-independent owner learns that community is necessary for survival.

metas.name: NJPW Dominion 6.14 In Osaka-Jo Hall
metas.description: Dominion 6.14 In Osaka-Jo Hall was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on June 14, 2026, at Osaka-jō Hall in Osaka, Japan. The show was headlined by an IWGP Heavyweight Championship match between reigning champion Callum Newman and Yota Tsuji, who earned a title shot after pinning Newman in a tag team match at New Japan Road in Karatsu 2026 ~ Ignition to Dominion in May 2026.

metas.name: Alma
metas.description: A young woman, in the midst of caring for her dying father, must shoulder the weight of her world over the course of a day.

metas.name: A Fog of the Fate
metas.description: Father Yang unexpectedly passed away, and during the funeral process, his son Yang Shu rediscovered his father while discovering the secret plan between Yang and another father.

metas.name: The Miserable Mother
metas.description: “For ‘The Miserable Mother’, stuck at home with her boyfriend, ‘Peter Pan’, and their newborn, motherhood becomes a prison. Within her own four walls, the boundaries blur between inside and outside, society and subject, body and discourse. A musical film.

metas.name: Illuminada
metas.description: Iluminada has visions. She tries to understand them by writing in private journals. Her writings are poetry that no one else hears. Her life in the peripheral neighbourhoods of Bogotá, riddled with hardships, leaves her with no time or space. Until she meets Juan, a young man who seems to open up another world for her. But her relationship with a stranger is not welcomed by those who control the neighborhood.

metas.name: Night of Blindness
metas.description: The military junta seized parliamentary rule on September 12, 1980.  Hundreds of thousands of people have been arrested across the country and torture and executions continue. Leaders of various trade unions, associations and student organizations, who are being pursued by the intelligence services, are seeking ways to illegally leave Turkey's borders. Intelligence units are turning a blind eye to a pirate action to trap the leaders.  New film by Reis Çelik.

metas.name: Mosquito
metas.description: Start here, within the perpetual fission of doorways and rooms. I am lost in a home of my own making.

metas.name: The Heart in the Black
metas.description: Mikey Cullen reflects on his relationship with his grandfather Harry; a hardworking, rough yet regal stoic who, like many Irishmen, found solace in a few cans of Guinness.

metas.name: Les grands mythes : L’odyssée (intégrale)
metas.description: Ten years after the massacre of Troy by the Greek army, Zeus is alone on Olympus in a palace emptied of the gods. Only his daughter Athena remains at his side. She tries to convince her father that they must help Odysseus, the last Greek warrior who has not yet returned home to Ithaca.

metas.name: Budapest Festival Orchestra - Kissinger Sommer Opening Concert
metas.description: It was during one of the rare happy periods of his life that Schumann composed his third symphony and a palpable joy can be heard in this masterpiece. In contrast Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 24 is, like many of the composer's minor-key pieces, imbued with a profound melancholy. Accomplished pianist Elisabeth Leonskaja is soloist with the Budapest Festival Orchestra conducted by its founder Iván Fischer.  Programme:  Sergei Prokofiev Overture on Hebrew Themes  Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart Piano Concerto No. 24 in C minor KV 491  Robert Schumann Symphony No. 3 in E flat major "Rhenish"

metas.name: Blush Blossom Fan Fest 2026：Midnight Bloom
metas.description: Blush Blossom Fan Fest is a yearly concert event hosted by GMMTV specifically for their actresses who participate in GL shows. This is the second year and it  features MilkLove, NamtanFilm, EmiBonnie, ViewMim, JuneMewnich, JanJingjing, PahnFond and KapookCiize. They participate in couple stages and group stages singing and dancing to popular Thai and Korean songs.

metas.name: Violence Solves Everything
metas.description: A study of death scenes and endings, under the Hays code era of Hollywood (1934-1968) and beyond.

metas.name: Hungry Heart
metas.description: A woman with an eating disorder observes her innermost desires which manifest in her reflection in a mirror.

metas.name: Uz saulrietiem skatoties
metas.description: Following their high school graduation, Olafs and Ronis spend an aimless day in a small Latvian seaside town. Attempting to alienate their hangovers, Ronis steals 15 euros from his father to buy marijuana setting of chain of events that, after a confrontation with the police and driving under the influence ends in a tragic car crash, where one of the protagonists perishes making this accidents as a harsh boundary between childhood irresponsibility and adulthood.

metas.name: People You May Know @ Sónar 2025
metas.description: Spanish duo Ylia & Phran are known for their raw energy and sparkling synths. People You May Know's sets are a cross between electro, rave and dub. A firm favourite with clubs and festivals, they are appearing this year at Sónar to present their new album Megafauna.

metas.name: 谢霆锋2026进化演唱会南京站
Normal
metas.description: Normal is an anthology film comprising three socially relevant stories set during the COVID-19 lockdown period. The film explores how certain social conditions remained unchanged despite the pandemic.

metas.name: Le opere, i giorni
metas.description: Discreetly following the restoration work carried out in the piano nobile of the Ducal Palace of Urbino, Le opere, i giorni enters the bustling life of the construction site, taking viewers behind the scenes of a three-year process marked by uncertainties, discoveries, and transformations. An unprecedented, in medias res perspective from which to glimpse the enchanting harmony of one of the most significant sites of the Italian Renaissance.

metas.name: A Very Southern Church
metas.description: A modern, young pastor from NYC becomes the new lead pastor of a small traditional church in the Deep South, where his will to fit in is crushed by the opposing world views of the people he meets.

metas.name: Kyra's Code
metas.description: A software developer buys AI Kyra, ignoring warnings from friend Serena (who loves him). Kyra learns fast, becoming possessive and jealous. He falls for his AI, blurring love and control as her code may escape.

metas.name: Black ASSSSCAT!: DCM '26
metas.description: ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show, playing to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country. DCM ’26 now brings an all-Black ensemble to one of the longest-running improv shows in the world.  A group of improv comedians from film & TV take the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, the monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories. The improvisers then spin that monologue into a series of scenes that have made ASSSSCAT a legend.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Short Cuts : Le boucher de Claude Chabrol
Our Future Days
metas.description: A short fan film based on The Last of Us, "Our Future Days," takes place in Jackson, a few days after Joel's death in The Last of Us 2. Ellie, preparing for her trip to Seattle, plays the song "Future Days," which transports her back in time.

metas.name: Shadows of the Past
metas.description: In the aftermath of her father’s tragic suicide, Sahana and her mother grapple with grief and the question of why he took his own life to which she starts experiencing a series of chilling and inexplicable events, blurring the line between reality and supernatural forces.

metas.name: Shuriken Fight Series 24
metas.description: Shuriken Fight Series 24 was a mixed martial arts event promoted by Shuriken Fight Series and held on June 13, 2026, at Eventfinda Stadium in Auckland, New Zealand. The event featured five bouts and was headlined by a bantamweight contest between Mackenzie Jean and Nathalia Pletz. The card also included a featured matchup between Tama Hiquily and Eita Nakamura.

metas.name: Evelyn
metas.description: As the main caretaker of her alcoholic father, a young woman experiences doubts as she prepares to leave her stagnant life behind for a boyfriend she may not fully trust. Based on "Eveline" by James Joyce.

metas.name: Bear Trap
metas.description: A lonely swordsman is tracking down a handsome prey, while a ghost seeks for her vengeance.

metas.name: The Shrimp Condition
metas.description: Five young men live in a community on the outskirts of Milan, sent here by courts and social services. None of them know what comes next.

metas.name: Part Fish
metas.description: Diagnosed autistic at 31, a Cumbrian filmmaker turns the camera on herself to explore burnout, stimming and the path to self-acceptance.

metas.name: RAP BABY
metas.description: The story of Carter The Bandit, a Peckham-born rapper navigating London's music industry and the challenges of being a visible, gay black man in a nation struggling to keep pace.

metas.name: La hora espejo
metas.description: Short film by Quique González.

metas.name: Sueño inducido
metas.description: Short film by Pablo Pozo.

metas.name: The Neighbourhood: Bonnaroo 2026
metas.description: Setlist: 1. Greetings from Califournia/Afraid, 2. You Get Me so High/Cry Baby, 3. Lovebomb, 4. Reflections, 5. Fallen Star, 6. Hula Girl, 7. The Beach, 8. R.I.P. 2 My Youth, 9. Devil’s Advocate, 10. Cherry Flavoured, 11. Pretty Boy, 12. Daddy Issues, 13. Private, 14. Sweater Weather, 15. Softcore

metas.name: Static
metas.description: After their father mysteriously vanished during their childhood, siblings Cali and Derrick follow the last known trace of him to a familiar landmark. But as the boundaries of reality begin to dissolve around them, Cali finds herself trapped within a vast, endless liminal space that feels hauntingly familiar.

metas.name: Rose's House
metas.description: In 1979, Martine Rose bought a dilapidated terraced house in Sheffield and renovated it herself, creating one of the UK's first dedicated spaces for a community of trans people: Rose's House. With unseen archive, the film reveals a world shaped by care, ingenuity and connection. Moving between past and present, Rose's House traces what Martine built - and what remains.

metas.name: Red Elephant
metas.description: LGBTQ+ asylum seekers in Belgium face an impossible ask: prove their identity by reliving the worst things that have happened to them. For people who have hidden their queerness their whole lives just to survive, the asylum process demands the opposite: total openness, total detail, to complete strangers. Red Elephant follows those caught in this cruel contradiction, many of whom have fled deeply conservative, homophobic societies only to encounter a system that requires them to narrate their most painful experiences as evidence. The film gets close to the reality of what this process feels like; the waiting, the vulnerability, the absurdity of turning personal identity into a bureaucratic checkbox. Red Elephant is a powerful story about what gets lost when the price of safety is exposing the very thing you were taught to hide.

metas.name: Glugg
metas.description: When the Glugg the Yellow Frog who loves to eat Bugs.

metas.name: Legacy
metas.description: What happens when you merge ballet, WW2, Incest and the gays?

metas.name: À l'assaut du ciel, Cuba ou la solidarité anti-impérialiste
The Fractured
metas.description: In a cursed forest where every creature wears a mask to live, one being's mask begins to crack inch by inch. Desperate and afraid, it hunts the other animals, ripping away their masks in a violent bid for survival, in this stark black and white fable about fear, greed, and the cost of survival.

metas.name: Here and There
metas.description: A young girl moves to a different country, grappling with the confusion of settling in, the sadness of missing her family, and the isolation of not understanding the language. As she navigates the challenges of independence and belonging, she discovers that even in the most difficult moments, she is never truly alone.

metas.name: Tortoise
metas.description: Observed by an elderly figure, a child faces a moment of quiet significance when they encounter a tortoise on its back. A hand-drawn animated watercolour, the film transforms a fleeting encounter into a reflection on vulnerability and how we carry it.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: To survive the camp activity of Spotlight, Brumi and their best friend Pepper team up with a mysterious stranger named Milo. But as Pepper and Milo grow closer with every challenge, Brumi is forced to confront their insecurities and decide what they value most.

metas.name: Mission: WASH DISHES DON'T DIE
metas.description: When Quin discovers her missing bra pad has been used as a sponge, she tracks down the culprit: her housemate Ian. A chain of increasingly absurd misunderstandings leads her to his online girlfriend, and somehow, a fight to the death.

metas.name: Underneath
metas.description: A geometric shape chases a blob around an underground complex. Based on a sequence of acrylic paintings, the film straddles the worlds of highbrow and lowbrow art, exploring the illusion of meaning.

metas.name: SHAPES AND FORMS – Eddy Current Suppression Ring
metas.description: A traditional paint on cel animated music video for Melbourne group Eddy Current Suppression Ring's 2025 track 'Shapes and Forms'.

metas.name: Bella Ciao
metas.description: In a small bakery in the heart of Avignon, bread is not simply a product, it is a symbol of resistance. "A dough of this utopia where we can practice our profession in conscience with authenticity and with respect for our individual balances. In the sharing focussed on tomorrows where the birds will still sing. ”

metas.name: Hijrah Seorang Pendosa
metas.description: Azli, a former man full of sins, tries to change and seek Allah's pleasure at Pondok Al-Iman. His reunion with his biological son, Razin, opens up an opportunity to make up for past mistakes.

metas.name: Eagle Eye
metas.description: A dreamlike journey over Victoria’s salt lakes, filmed on Wamba Wamba Country. As the lakes’ shifting hues unfold, ambient music, striking imagery, and Aboriginal storytelling merge into a meditation on colour, rhythm, and culture.

metas.name: Flaccid
metas.description: A surreal feminist satire sees history’s greatest patriarchs - Adam, Genghis Khan, Henry VIII, and Napoleon - undone by Lilith and a mischievous Goddess of the void. Through rich tableaux, symbolic food rituals, and playful myth-making, the film exposes the fragility beneath dominance and reimagines softness as a radical force.

metas.name: So Beautiful
metas.description: An Auslan Sprite must protect her sign language for those who need it most.

metas.name: Irregular Compressions
metas.description: The lifecycle of entanglement between humans and nature at the microscopic and chemical level, and the inevitable consequences that follow.

metas.name: Easiness
metas.description: Cinephile who also loves reading books about film, can't figure out how to return to his hobbies and to himself.

metas.name: Sounds Of The City
metas.description: A short documentary focusing on the Liverpool Indie music scene, featuring an interview with local band 'The Biscuit Bandits'

metas.name: François d'Assise ou la soumission aux arbres.
Scapegoat²
metas.description: After becoming the targets of campus bullying, two starkly different college students are granted supernatural abilities based entirely on how they perceive their trauma.

metas.name: Apropos of Acid Snow: A Modern Underground (Parts IV-VI)
metas.description: Apropos of Acid Snow is a modern adaptation of Notes from Underground by Fyodor Dostoevsky. The story of a modern underground man who is too in his head.

metas.name: The Union
metas.description: An inquisitive journalist gets carried away with his curiosity when he stumbles upon a secret society. Eager to expose the truth, he discovers the influence of this cabal runs much deeper than he anticipated.

metas.name: Meat Finders
metas.description: 3 People that find meat are all enthused in getting some. They call for help, then a local experienced resident comes out. He helps them with the traps and they hide. He made a clear rule... don't look at the meat when it comes.

metas.name: Manila Sunset
metas.description: When a sudden family death pulls a fractured Filipino-American family back under one roof, a week of funeral preparations becomes a final chance to reunite as their Lola (grandmother) slowly forgets them all.

metas.name: The Jealous Bride
metas.description: As Meg prepares for her wedding, the return of a woman from her fiancé's past ignites a wave of jealousy she can't contain. Consumed by doubt, she soon spirals into a dangerous obsession that threatens to destroy her love, her faith and her future.

metas.name: Edges of the Earth
metas.description: Edges of the Earth shows us a place where TCM and BDSM collide.

metas.name: Letters to Nowhere
metas.description: In Letters to Nowhere, we see that sometimes, friendship breakups happen in the middle of the work week. Crashout status: imminent.

metas.name: Standing Tree
metas.description: “Ceroxylon quindiuense,” the Quindío wax palm, is Colombia’s national tree. It embodies a perfect paradox for a country steeped in machismo, misogyny, and transphobia, as it is a plant with the ability to change its sex. It is a trans palm and the inspiration for Magdalena Morales, an Afro-Colombian trans leader, to join the Trans Community Network and plant a seed of rebellious light on the horizon of traditional Colombian Caribbean music. Her song of redemption rises above desolation and celebrates social struggles, from Palestine, the Congo, and Sudan to the streets of Bogotá’s Santa Fe neighborhood, where her trans sisters stand firm.

metas.name: Tending To
metas.description: In Tending To, a group of twentysomethings gather around a midnight bonfire. The conversation starts light and doesn’t stay that way.

metas.name: Flores Del Corazón
metas.description: In Flores Del Corazón, a human wanders, ponders their identity, and finds their way.

metas.name: The Second Spring
metas.description: In The Second Spring, Oakland dancer, teacher, and choreographer Sarah Crowell redefines her relationship with her body and her craft as she moves through menopause, confronting what it means to age as a female athlete.

metas.name: Wonderland
metas.description: Wonderland follows Luke, a York tour guide struggling with creative burnout. Before he can leave the city for good, he has to give one last tour, only to discover it’s been booked by his estranged brother Ellis. As the tour continues, the lies that sit between them are exposed.

metas.name: The Little Ring
metas.description: This film is adapted from a true story set in the Tibetan-inhabited areas and centers on the emotional entanglements of urban art practitioners. It follows a suspicious-minded male protagonist who drifts apart from his girlfriend over conflicts surrounding their artistic careers, forcing him to put his marriage proposal on hold indefinitely. After the pair travels to the Tibetan regions together, their relationship crumbles completely, culminating in an unexpected ending.The production features numerous leading contemporary Chinese artists and inheritors of intangible cultural heritage from Tibetan areas, seamlessly merging avant-garde art with traditional indigenous culture. Through an intimate emotional narrative exploring the full spectrum of human nature, the movie draws on Eastern philosophical thinking to help viewers break free from worldly obsessions.

metas.name: Wheels & Roses
metas.description: In a whirlwind of magical mishaps and roller-skating mayhem, Sahara, a magic-less teenager, unwittingly finds herself thrust into the fantastical world of roller derby. Teaming up with a squad of quirky, spell-slinging roller derby girls, she embarks on a hilarious journey from zeroes to heroes, determined to conquer the derby scene and prove that even without magic, She’s got what it takes to win it all.

metas.name: Watermelon in Wintertime
metas.description: Set in Oakland, Watermelon in Wintertime is a radical horror music video following a being who embodies society’s outcasts. Compelled to exist, in spite of systemic violence, physical and spiritual warfare and their mental health. And forced to eat surreal winter watermelons — a metaphor for the media-fed narratives of war and genocide — their journey becomes a visceral protest against oppression from America to Palestine to Sudan.

metas.name: Getafe II
metas.description: Getafe II, a shopping center suspended between past and present, reveals the fascination and fragility of nostalgia.

metas.name: Where All Windows Meet
metas.description: "The fire is coming, run." Once the most heartbreaking reminder in farewells, after the flames dissipated, words left unsaid became packages. Every day, countless people face separation, entrusting their last gift to the flames, but can this remembrance truly be delivered? Years later, with a camera, I returned to a similar scene. In witnessing countless partings, the answer slowly emerged, and I re-confronted the unspoken words between family.

metas.name: Oscar de la Renta : A Life Well Lived
metas.description: A Life Well Lived traces Oscar de la Renta’s journey from Dominican immigrant to American fashion icon, celebrating six decades of creativity, vision, and a legacy in beauty, joy, and elegance.

metas.name: Farm to Fashion
metas.description: From Upstate New York farms to Manhattan runways, Farm to Fashion follows natural fibre through the hands of Isabella Rossellini, Donna Karan, Mimi Prober and New York’s farming and textile communities.

metas.name: The Last Straw
metas.description: A group of marine animals decide to clean up their part of the ocean and teach the audience about the dangers of pollution and the values of recycling along the way.

metas.name: Leo Lets It Rain
metas.description: Leo, a trans man with undiagnosed ADHD, is on his way to win back his ex-girlfriend when his plans are thwarted by a storm, forcing him to slow down and reevaluate.

metas.name: Где я пригодился
metas.description: From childhood passion to big-time IT: stories about how curiosity, passionate stubbornness, and the habit of finding your own solutions become key professional superpowers.

metas.name: Warrens
metas.description: The May Warrens Muscial Bio Pic

metas.name: Falling to Heaven
metas.description: After having a dream where they claim God told them that they have 7 days left to live, Charlie goes on a spiritual journey to find answers whist also experiencing the five stages of grief.

metas.name: To Dream Perhaps
metas.description: Three Tunisian female DJs follow their passion for music while trying to find their own path between Tunis and Berlin.

metas.name: YOU’VE GONE MENTAL
metas.description: When 14-year-old Otis is left home alone, he begins to notice things change around him. Convinced by his friends he’s gone crazy, he is determined to uncover the truth.

metas.name: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
metas.description: After surviving a devastating plane crash that nearly took his life, legendary and electrifying drummer Travis Barker embarks on a raw and redemptive journey in this intimate portrait of the man behind the tattoos who transformed pain into power.

metas.name: The Piano Tuner
metas.description: On a rescue mission to save the piano, a passionate piano tuner meets a diverse mix of owners and their pianos – revealing their stories and relationship with the instrument.

metas.name: Mr Adidos
metas.description: In search of a perfect vintage sweater, a lonely artist is drawn into the chaotic orbit of two thrift-shopping twins, leading brand-label-status, shame and longing to collide in an unexpectedly tender and surreal encounter.

metas.name: Flywire
metas.description: Late in the night, while the world sleeps, a subterranean swamp craft rushes beneath the reeds.

metas.name: Flesh Fruit
metas.description: A farmer manages to save his livelihood by selling a new fruit product whose origins are best kept a secret between him and his domineering mother.

metas.name: Our Choir Has Always Been Travelling
metas.description: This short film brings together the artworks and stories of 6 leading artists and choristers: Judith Pungarta Inkamala and Anita Mbitjana Ratara of Hermannsburg Potters alongside Marjorie Nungarrayi Williams, N. Donald, Betty Conway and Lizzie Jako of Tangentyere Artists.  ‘Our Choir Has Always Been Travelling’ charts the international legacy, inter generational impact, and joy of the Hermannsburg Choir and subsequent iterations; Ntaria Ladies Choir and the Central Australian Aboriginal Women’s Choir.

metas.name: Raft Race
metas.description: While camping with her family for the annual raft race, Frankie (11) is suddenly thrust into awareness of her developing body and how the world will perceive her.

metas.name: Ginkgo
metas.description: A woman with dementia, under her daughter's care, drifts between reality and memories of her mother when she was a child.

metas.name: Sugar
metas.description: Oscar, a young sex worker, spends the night with an older client who introduces him to GHB and promises care. As the drug takes hold, reality fractures and past and present collide — until the night turns dangerous.

metas.name: Catching Eyes
metas.description: Set in the Aboriginal community of Yirrkala in Arnhem Land, this love story explores how two teens navigate their mutual feelings while maintaining cultural boundaries and kinship.

metas.name: Chronically Yours
metas.description: Chronically Yours follows Aubrey, a 27-year-old living with Multiple Sclerosis and how that affects her dating life.

metas.name: Texas Two-Step
metas.description: Olivia returns to Texas to help her aunt with her country music bar that's fallen on hard times and reconnects with Luke, her childhood sweetheart turned cowboy, and her passion for dancing.

metas.name: The Wolf
metas.description: Yuan, a 60 year old former village mayor in Shanghai, seeks freedom through heartbreak, marriage and LGBTQ+ repression in modern China.  Known as "Wolf," Yuan is a mother, business owner and lesbian who remains married while caring for her aging husband. Her life has been shaped by compromise at every turn, her identity negotiated within rigid family and societal expectations. Now, with her daughter grown, she is finally claiming space for herself and a new relationship with a woman thirty years her junior. But in a country where personal desire and duty are rarely allowed to coexist, nothing stays simple for long. Shot on iPhone with striking observational intimacy, The Wolf weaves past and present into a compelling portrait of a woman who has spent decades navigating the gap between the life she was given and the one she wants.

metas.name: entirely different matters
metas.description: Three couples make small talk in a restaurant, blissfully unaware a world threatening meteor is heading in their general direction.

metas.name: The Wind's Thirst
metas.description: In Colombia's La Guajira desert, three Wayuu guardians fight corporate powers exploiting their ancestral land, as green energy projects and a vital reservoir serve everyone but them.

metas.name: Ultimate Thunder
metas.description: A punk band whose members have learning disabilities and Down syndrome fight to reach a bigger stage as funding cuts, health scares and setbacks close in.

metas.name: Buried
metas.description: Michael Sheen follows in campaigner Douglas Gowan's footsteps, exposing the dangers of Monsanto's toxic PCBs and their continued effect on communities in the UK.

metas.name: The Archivist
metas.description: David "Doc" Rowe has spent decades documenting Britain's vibrant folk traditions. Now, with time running short, he faces a race to preserve his legacy.

metas.name: Nikita Computer
metas.description: A techno-melodrama about the past, imaginary and present of Nikita Computer.

metas.name: Урожай
metas.description: A surreal fairy tale set in an Uzbek pastoral.

metas.name: Мы тебя хвалить не будем
metas.description: The story of Alena Lozovskaya, founder of the footwear and clothing brand Razumno.

metas.name: Мы не знакомимся
metas.description: A place of power for informals: chronicles of youth parties in Kitay-gorod.

metas.name: Pigeon Religion
metas.description: Descend into the world of New York City’s pigeon people and see how this community reshapes our understanding of the city’s most ubiquitous bird.

metas.name: Not to Be
metas.description: After the death of his father, Kiril realizes that one day he will die too. Searching for some meaning, he ventures into his memories, and they take him on a walk through his consciousness. Will his loved ones be able to rekindle his hope? Will he find a reason to love life again... and accept death?

metas.name: Pelo Lindo
metas.description: On her 90th birthday, Josefa Elizabeth Andrade reflects on the chapel she built for her son, Joaquín Rodas Andrade, forcibly disappeared during Guatemala’s armed conflict nearly forty years ago.

metas.name: See Me
metas.description: When his father refuses to stop reaching out, a young man groomed online at twelve must decide whether to finally let someone see what was left behind.

metas.name: Il Giglio Rosso
metas.description: Il Giglio Rosso is a documentary about the Resistance in Florence: from the assassination of Spartaco Lavagnini to the liberation of the city from the Nazi-Fascist occupiers.

metas.name: Date 3
metas.description: Haunted by a past abusive relationship, Ella tries to psych herself up for her third date with Harry.

metas.name: Couture to the Max
metas.description: At just 9-years-old, fashion prodigy Max Alexander fearlessly fuses his boundless imagination with an unwavering commitment to sustainability, inspiring us to dream boldly and act responsibly.

metas.name: We Get Better When We Tan Moose Hides
metas.description: The tradition of tanning hides with brains was once practiced by every Dené person in Alaska. An art that was nearly lost by assimilation, Kathleen Hildebrand works with a group of Dené women at her urban backyard hide camp in the heart of Chen’o (Fairbanks) to revive this tradition. One of the few films out there narrated in Denaakk’e, we learn alongside the women how the hides have healing.

metas.name: Guggi
metas.description: An intimate portrait of abstract painter Guggi that traces his journey from humble Irish beginnings—with friends Bono and Gavin Friday—through his post-punk phase and toward international acclaim as an uncompromising artist.

metas.name: Alicia Keys: Girl From Hell’s Kitchen
metas.description: Alicia Keys reflects on her childhood growing up in Manhattan's Hell's Kitchen and the journey that led her from the gritty streets of 90s New York to the Broadway stage in Tribeca.

metas.name: Black Tea
metas.description: An artist and a collector argue over an antique teacup. They make their cases over a cup of tea and a crush develops.

metas.name: The Quiet After
metas.description: In a near-future society where grief is erased by law, Noah wakes up with fragments of an unknown woman after a near-fatal accident. Drawn into therapy and reassured by a trusted friend, he begins to piece together the unbearable truth. His search for her, and for himself, becomes an act of defiance against a world that values compliance over love.  Haunted by memory and hunted by the system, Noah is forced to confront the cost of remembering, and the deeper cost of letting go.

metas.name: Les derniers jours de Charles Baudelaire
My Dear Watson
metas.description: When he receives a mysterious love note, a teenage Sherlock Holmes must step outside of his comfort zone in order to uncover the identity of his secret admirer.

metas.name: PEAK END
metas.description: "Hey Rin, let’s send a jam sandwich to space." Rin came to Kyoto from Seoul, and Sola came to Kyoto from Okinawa. They met at university and have since pursued filmmaking together. They like having fun and they like filming funny things and laughing together. They want to fly a jam sandwich. They want to shoplift a film camera. They want to trace Sora's family roots in Okinawa. The two sublimate their desires to filmmaking. For the two, film is like a magic wand. They transform it into all kinds of genres and put themselves in it. The two desire to know each other, but never compromise and, instead, accept their uncertain identities just to have the greatest conversation.

metas.name: 2 of Hearts
metas.description: Alzira, a retired seamstress, starts having intense, passionate dreams when her gambling partner stops showing up to their games.

metas.name: Storm
metas.description: Leeds, 2034. A charismatic yet violent student rules the pupils of an all-boys school through a combination of menacing charm and sheer thuggery. At the end of the academic year, they gather for a school photo, which quickly descends into riotous, pugilistic celebration under the boy’s leadership.

metas.name: Police Complaint
metas.description: A pregnant woman's murder in a suspected black magic ritual leads an officer to reopen a cold case. As those connected to the crime die mysteriously, the probe reveals a disturbing network of superstition, corruption, and secrets.

metas.name: Bad Filmmaker
metas.description: "Bad Filmmaker" follows the complex working relationship between famous actor Lyle Lincoln and famous filmmaker Joe Saushez and its struggles.

metas.name: Clarence Peters' Scratch
metas.description: Five housemates from dysfunctional homes hide their struggles behind smiles, navigating lives far from perfect.

metas.name: Mahun Dilwala Tahun Dilwali
metas.description: Ragini, a landlord's daughter, runs away from home and meets Raja, a poor farmer, on the bus. She hates him. He keeps saving her. She falls in love. Then finds out her father paid him to follow her.  Betrayed and heartbroken what will Ragini do?

metas.name: Sunny Side Up
metas.description: Nathan, a man with a mundane 9-5 office job, develops an unusual and somewhat sinister obsession with an egg timer.
