metas.name: 48H DI FOLLIA
metas.description: A group of students struggles with the production of a short film during the university competition "DAMS in 48H".

metas.name: VERISMO
metas.description: In a near future where artificial intelligence dictates art and human creativity is long forgotten, an introverted university student discovers a neglected guitar hidden in the school’s storage. What begins as mere curiosity soon drives him to create an authentic voice in defiance of the system.

metas.name: You’ll never meet your father again
metas.description: Ivo (26) is in a fragile psychological state. In search of much-needed support, he turns to his father. However, their meeting is not what Ivo had hoped for, and he leaves to make his appointment with his therapist, Lotte. Despite Lotte’s efforts, Ivo avoids talking about his father. Meanwhile, without Ivo’s knowledge, something is being constructed in the neighboring room. Led by the mysterious therapist Robert and his assistant Isa, they prepare a decisive confrontation they believe Ivo must have with his father.

metas.name: Demian
metas.description: Ágata has lived in complete isolation for years. The arrival of an abandoned dog at her doorstep forces her out of her seclusion. Caring for him confronts her, without meaning to, with the fears that have kept her hidden from the world.

metas.name: AS QUEER AS FASHION - Drag, Moda e Criações QUEER
On Different Grounds
metas.description: A divorced billionaire couple are forced to reunite for their eldest daughter's wedding, only to face hilarious complications when the daughter hatches a secret plan to get them back together.

metas.name: Sonhos de uma noite de São João
metas.description: Inspired by the work of Albemar Araújo, the film blends popular culture, music, and fantasy to tell a story full of charm, emotion, and a festive June atmosphere.

metas.name: Ruleta
metas.description: As Christmas time approaches, an old man is forced into a game of roulette to answer for his sins.

metas.name: [redacted]
metas.description: Part of installation of Klein's exhibit Rack It!

metas.name: The Entwinement of Fate
metas.description: Su Kinadsusumpat nu Bagi (The Entwinement of Fate) follows siblings Aisha and Ali as they navigate grief and survival within their Moro community after the death of their parents. The only inheritance left behind is their father’s small tinagtag business—a Maguindanaon delicacy that becomes both their livelihood and their last connection to home.  Determined to preserve her father’s legacy, Aisha continues making and selling tinagtag. But as a young lady forced to take her mother’s roles, the burden of keeping the business alive slowly wears on her.  Meanwhile, Ali struggles with the weight of their circumstances. Torn between keeping his father’s memoir and moving forward with his dreams, he began to question whether holding onto tradition is worth the cost. As circumstances deepen, the siblings are forced to confront the grief they have long avoided, the fractures within their identity, and the fragile bond that continues to entwine them together.

metas.name: Chupa Chupi
metas.description: A harmless prank by four mischievous boys sparks panic and fear in a remote village haunted by decades-old superstitions. This movie become a major success movie in 2026 and collected over 10 crore Indian rupees in Assamese box office

metas.name: So Much Fun
metas.description: So Much Fun is a sprawling, deeply personal film that chronicles the bittersweet transition between youth and adulthood. What begins as a globe-trotting escape through the towering skylines of Tokyo, Singapore, and Hong Kong slowly transforms into a raw examination of isolation, nostalgia, and growing up. The film wrestles with shifting relationships, changing identities, and the feeling of constantly evolving. It serves as both a cinematic travelogue and a rhythmic, music-driven diary. Fueled by a heavy, genre-blending soundtrack, So Much Fun is a beautiful, melancholic farewell to the past and an embrace of whatever comes next.

metas.name: John-Luke Roberts Builds a Monster
metas.description: John-Luke Roberts is too anxious to leave the house, so a figment from a nightmare called “The Monarch” has to perform his show for him.  The Monarch doesn’t know how to perform a comedy show, but does it anyway.  This is that show. An anxiety dream performed live on stage; or a comedy show about anxiety.

metas.name: Queen James: Passion, Plots and Power
metas.description: ‘Elizabeth was king, then James was queen.’ – Unknown English author (1623)  Gareth Russell, the author of Queen James: The Life and Loves of Britain’s First King, tells James’ story, focusing on a sensational murder trial that threatened to shake the monarchy to its core.

metas.name: improv4humans with Matt Besser: DCM '26
metas.description: improv4humans is a comedy platform from one of the founders of modern improv, Matt Besser. Together with longtime producer and engineer Brett Morris, i4h is dedicated to presenting the very best in improvised comedy, supporting performers, and teaching the craft to the next generation.  Besser is a founding member of the groundbreaking sketch group and Comedy Central series The Upright Citizens Brigade, and co-founder of the world-renowned UCB Theatre and training center — which has launched the careers of countless household names in comedy. He also co-authored The Upright Citizens Brigade Comedy Improv Manual, the definitive book on long-form improv.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Queezy visits the Races
metas.description: Wearing a sparkly mini-dress and heels, performance artist Queezy Babaz enters a bustling Cape Town car racing space and interacts with attendees, offering an intimate observation into queer identity and acceptance within the Coloured community.

metas.name: Baby Wants Candy: DCM '26
metas.description: World renowned musical improv ensemble Baby Wants Candy (“Truly Amazing! Critics Pick!” New York Times) makes up a musical based on your title. Some recent titles we’ve liked: “Project Hail Mary Poppins”, “Sweeney Toddler” and the seminal “Hotuncles.com…the Musical”.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Big Grande: DCM '26
metas.description: Big Grande has been bringing their brand of rapid, honest, and wild live shows to sold-out crowds around the country — hell, the continent — for over a decade. Now they’re hopping onto the UCB stage for a DCM26 show that’ll leave you laughing (hopefully) and them sweating (definitely).  Their podcast, The Teachers Lounge, gained a fervent following on The Earwolf Network before they began selling it directly to fans. Find it — along with their four-episode live improvised comedy special, sketches, animated content, merch, and more — at biggrandewebsite.com.  Individually, you’ve seen them on The Other Two, Brooklyn 99, Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin, Superstore, Comedy Bang Bang, Son of Zorn, Bless the Harts, Playing House, and Last Call with Carson Daly — as well as behind the camera on Lights Out with David Spade and Netflix: After Party.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Studying Under the Barrel of a Gun
metas.description: In the late 1980s, the University of the North in Limpopo is militarily occupied by the Apartheid government. As soldiers patrol lecture halls, raid residences and suppress political activity, students are drawn into underground resistance movements to fight for their education.

metas.name: The Maharashtra Files
metas.description: The story follows a woman from the Banjara community who battles bureaucratic corruption and a political nexus to secure fair compensation for land acquired by the government

metas.name: Bubbe & Tal
metas.description: A stoner buddy-dramedy between a Jewish grandmother and her trans grandchild on a day trip to Cape Cod during the off-season.

metas.name: Budaixi
metas.description: Wayang Potehi is a cultural heritage that has long been part of Indonesia's diversity, yet it remains little known in Surabaya. Through regular performances, preservation efforts, and the sharing of knowledge, dalang Sukar Mudjiono and fellow practitioners work to ensure this traditional art form survives for future generations.

metas.name: I KNOW THE SCORE
metas.description: I KNOW THE SCORE investigates, within the central idea that reality is not entirely entropic and is somehow following a perceivable score, ways in which a person could experience alternate realities with different scores. The first section, GAS & AIR, explores inhalants as a means to perceive and experience altered reality scores. The second section, PARANOILIA, explores the paraphernalia used and created by those who may internally experience an altered reality score, the objects made and utilised by paranoid or psychoaffective individuals that represent or channel a different perceived reality. The third and final section, EXOCONSCIOUSNESS, explores spirituality as a vehicle to altered realities. In it, a god-like figure watches over the movements of people, having been given secret knowledge by the girl from the website in OPERANDI, who becomes ‘real’ after its user gets sufficiently high.

metas.name: The Offspring: SMASH 30th Anniversary Concert
metas.description: Watch The Offspring celebrate the 30th anniversary of SMASH with a full live performance from Honda Center in Anaheim, California on June 1, 2024, featuring the landmark album played in full plus fan favorites from across their catalog. Originally released on April 8, 1994, SMASH became one of punk rock’s defining albums, peaking at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 and earning 6x Platinum certification from the RIAA.

metas.name: A Man Walks Into A Bar With A Chainsaw
metas.description: In order to reclaim his mental health checks, Pat Meyer decides to stage a public outburst in a pub.

metas.name: Hinata
metas.description: This mystery film, directed and conceived by Yukihiko Tsutsumi, features 20 up-and-coming actors. Written by Yusuke Moriguchi ("Beautiful Dreamer," "Kohaku"), the film unfolds at the funeral of a person named "Hinata Okimura," depicting a deepening mystery as the eulogies of the 20 attendees contradict each other, unfolding in an unpredictable manner.  Twenty men and women attend Hinata Okimura's funeral. According to the deceased's wishes, all attendees must deliver a eulogy. Standing before an unusual altar without a portrait, some speak as friends, others as devoted fans, and still others as fellow members of an idol group, each beginning to recount their memories of the deceased. However, the image of "Hinata Okimura" becomes increasingly distorted, even differing in gender from the person they describe, plunging the funeral into chaos.

metas.name: Cheese Dreams
metas.description: Two rival cheese makers go head-to-head at their annual county village cheese fest.

metas.name: Sing Sing
metas.description: A frustrated singer fights against life and himself to achieve greatness, but when he reunites with an old friend he will soon realize it's not what he always wanted.

metas.name: Heer Sara
metas.description: Two women embark on a rebellious motorcycle odyssey to Pondicherry - one seeking her lost mother, the other racing to uncover the truth behind a wedding. Laughter, chaos and sisterhood spark freedom, self-worth and eco-conscious living.

metas.name: Cannes 2026 With Anton Dolin
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes glimpse into the daily routine of Russian film critic Anton Dolin at the Cannes Film Festival. Screenings, lunch breaks, interviews, along with chance encounters with colleagues, fans, and renowned directors.

metas.name: Suzan & Freek: We Vieren Het Leven
metas.description: Exactly one year after everything came to a standstill, Suzan and Freek celebrate life. Bigger than ever before. In the lead-up to their ten sold-out GelreDome shows, we follow Suzan and Freek through an intense month full of rehearsals, tension, and also reflective moments. Together with 400,000 fans, they pause to reflect on what truly matters.

metas.name: Repor-TFM (Arbeitstitel)
metas.description: In search of the genre-specific nature of student life, the intrepid reporter Marie Behles sets out to find answers. Through her investigative reporting, she gathers insights into life at the Institute of Theater, Film, and Media Studies in Vienna and asks the questions no one else dares to ask. We report on an optimism that is cruelly shattered.

metas.name: In The Closet
metas.description: Before a friend's birthday, a group of friends notices one of them is acting weird.

metas.name: La Soupe de Cagouilles
metas.description: Anis, a ten years old orphan picks up a photo in a park in Belleville. The image of a happy mother and daughter standing before a magnificent blue sea sparks in him the idea of a better life.

metas.name: THRESHOLD
metas.description: A young man finds himself at a crossroads between the familiar and the unknown. As ordinary moments take on unexpected meaning, he is forced to confront change, identity, and the quiet transformations that define a life. Threshold is a contemplative short film about transition, self-discovery, and becoming.

metas.name: The Dastardly Desecration of Dame
metas.description: Returning to the pod - a new skit! The Western Wonder recently had a "rap battle" between his Discord buddy Damon, and the results were... well... you be the judge.

metas.name: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
metas.description: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

metas.name: When The Lights Brighten
metas.description: History repeats itself, as a mother watches her daughter become enveloped in the world of theatre, causing a rift to grow between the two.

metas.name: Deserving
metas.description: A short movie about a mans life loss and missed opportunities

metas.name: Technicolor Dream
metas.description: A street musician dreams of a livelier world.

metas.name: Shikar
metas.description: Prakash, a simple family man, hires young advocate Parimita to secure bail for his friend Samir, who is accused of murdering his wife Asha and seven-year-old son Tanmay. As Parimita digs deeper into the case, hidden secrets and unexpected suspects begin to emerge. Every clue reveals a new layer of deception, turning the investigation into a dangerous maze of lies, betrayal, and mystery. With the truth becoming harder to uncover, Parimita must risk everything to expose the real culprit before she herself becomes trapped in the deadly conspiracy.

metas.name: One more chance
metas.description: Ronnie a drug addicted debt ridden loser with a heart tries to make a deal with Dennis a high profile dealer who has loaned Ronnie money in the past when Dennis wants Ronnie to do something. he doesn't want to Ronnie has to make a choice

metas.name: The Cross of Scotland
metas.description: About a Young wrestler talking about his experiences in wrestling and his future.

metas.name: Huli Jeevagalu
metas.description: Suri, a reclusive man, attempts to reconnect with his grandmother through her favourite recipe, only to run into unexpected visitors.

metas.name: Tour De Mesa '26
metas.description: Tour De Mesa '26 follows a group of friends as they taste the foods that fed them all year long throughout their senior year of high school.

metas.name: Archived: Australia's UFO Files
metas.description: Expanding into Australia's rich UFO heritage through interviews and reconstructions, the film culminates in recent investigations of extraordinary encounters.

metas.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream - An Excerpt
metas.description: Taking scene 1 of Act 3 and transforming it into a new interpretation.

metas.name: Kotha Malupu
metas.description: Set in a lively village, a budding romance takes unexpected turns as love, secrets and misunderstandings collide. What begins as a light-hearted journey soon spirals into a suspenseful tale filled with twists, emotions and surprising revelations

metas.name: Sunday Nights
metas.description: An adaptation of Paul Thomas Anderson's 1997 film Boogie Nights. Sports mastermind and high school student Lance gets involved in a gambling scheme which leads to a change in personality and a new found obsession of money told in a documentary style.

metas.name: Drowning Fish
metas.description: A girl begins to look behind the curtain of a strange world, discovering the people who control it, and learning to remain earnest to herself while everyone around her blends together as one.

metas.name: Kikirot Kirot
metas.description: A married couple’s life unravels when the wife’s cousin moves in. The husband realizes she’s the stripper he secretly met before, sparking temptation, deception, and fear of exposure.

metas.name: Our Way
metas.description: Forced onto a suffocating road trip with the father who abandoned him, 17-year-old Nat wants nothing more than to escape. But when their car breaks down, a confrontation explodes, unearthing years of buried trauma and painful family secrets. As the true, heartbreaking purpose of their journey is revealed, both father and son must face the ghosts of their past to see if a broken bond can ever be healed.

metas.name: Lipstick
metas.description: When her lipstick goes missing, Rose embarks on a quest to find the person responsible.

metas.name: Have you seen any fireflies?
metas.description: Have you seen any fireflies?

metas.name: Trevlig midsommarhelg!
metas.description: The highlight of the summer in Västerköping! Gunnar and Marianne celebrate traditionally with the children, herring, schnapps and Gunnar's own kubb rules. At Tom and Yvonne's the celebration risks being canceled while Präst-Björn is intoxicated by the summer and Vino Tinto. For Terese, "7 kinds of flowers under the pillow" brings unexpected consequences and opportunities.

metas.name: THANG
metas.description: 'THANG' a slasher pop thriller, that delves into the sacrifice of ambition that young female musicians undertake in an industry dead-set on sucking them dry.  Pop idol sensations BATSEYE retire to their dressing room after an exhilarating sold out show. High off the thrill of live performance, Larissa, Claudia, and Chelsea dance together, on top of the world. In the midst of their celebrations, a loud knock at their door threatens to tear them apart, in more ways than one...

metas.name: Bye Bye Marnie
metas.description: Unable to let go of Johan after years together, Marnie finds herself drawn back to the night their story began. As she retraces the memory of their first encounter, she embarks on an intimate journey through the past, hoping to finally find the strength to say goodbye.

metas.name: Time Flies
metas.description: A snail is crushed by a car, a dog defecates while a tourist jumps from the tallest skyscraper in the world. A series of slices of everyday life spirals into chaos.

metas.name: DISTANCE
metas.description: A chronically online, awkward young man has an unhealthy addiction of watching a small content creator every single day, disregarding vital tasks and isolating himself, but when his favorite icon misses a video upload one day, he finds himself in a sequence of psychologically conflicting events.

metas.name: Keira the Forest Guardian
metas.description: Keira, a young orphan girl, must go on a dangerous quest to save the land from a terrible darkness.

metas.name: I imagine your ashes in my cigarettes
metas.description: After the death of her close friend Sierrah, Cyal decides to ignore her last wish and commit suicide.

metas.name: Wet Bride
metas.description: Two partners are spending a pleasant evening on a bench in Cassina De Pecchi (MI) when something truly unusual happens.

metas.name: Beyond the Terminal
metas.description: Bus driver Chuang spends the entire day at work with his lively young daughter, Evonne. Their interactions reveal the deep bond they share, while also hinting at an issue that Chuang is reluctant to confront.

metas.name: Hidote
metas.description: A film by Samuel Teshager

metas.name: Nizhal
metas.description: NIZHAL follows twin sisters Ramya and Saranya. Saranya is a trainee doctor, and Ramya helps their vendor parents. Tragedy strikes when Saranya’s friend Lakshmi is brutally murdered in the hospital lab by Guna, the CEO's son, and his gang. Ramya witnesses the crime and narrowly survives a deadly attack by them. Driven by fury, Saranya seeks vengeance and puts the killers on their deathbeds. Ironically, her lover Raghu takes charge as the sub-inspector for this very case. When Raghu uncovers the truth, a gripping battle begins between law, love, and ultimate justice.

metas.name: Missing Pieces
metas.description: This story follows our protagonist Henry's battle with grief and depression. Trying to use faith and forgiveness to move on with his life.

metas.name: Something, Something, Seventh Street
metas.description: Brooke picks up a table on Facebook Marketplace and brings it home.

metas.name: The Orange Umbrella
metas.description: Stuck in a monotonous, black-and-white existence, a lonely romantic becomes captivated by a mysterious woman whose orange umbrella brings color to his world—and uncertainty to his reality.

metas.name: Delay 1/2-4
metas.description: A story about a man and a camera.

metas.name: Git-Gel
metas.description: A walking-themed film directed by the legendary leftist director Ali Yaşar Nalcı.

metas.name: Sunspots
metas.description: Jack, a young adult living in The Entrance, feels lonelier than ever. Consumed by his own overthought narrative, he releases an outburst on Instagram Live, declaring that he would leave town to never be seen again. Through his actions, the potential last day in The Entrance provides the challenges required to change his perspective.

metas.name: Telharmonium
metas.description: A generative film exploring the automation of culture through one of the earliest electronic instruments: the Telharmonium. As in much of Menick’s work, the film links the history of technology with contemporary anxieties about artificial intelligence and the mechanization of creative labor.

metas.name: Operació iperita. La trama civil de la guerra química
Roberto Zucco
metas.description: One night, Roberto Zucco escapes from the prison where he was incarcerated for the murder of his father. Thus begins a dizzying escape, punctuated by encounters that illustrate a quest for identity.

metas.name: Scuffle in the Lou
metas.description: A lunch, a bathroom, a brawl, and a wallet.

metas.name: Chi Mangia Solo
metas.description: On the night before selling their childhood home, an estranged brother and sister reconnect while cooking their late mother’s favorite recipe. They find their grief simmering just beneath the surface.

metas.name: SPEKTRUM
metas.description: Linea has autism and she hasn't told her new boyfriend Kasper. Now he's coming over for the first time, which pushes her into unknown waters.

metas.name: Chalien Kahin
metas.description: Two parallel life. living in same city, going through Same problems and have Same desire - To go back HOME.

metas.name: Hum Angrezon Ke Zamane Ke Jailor Hai
metas.description: A murder investigation reveals that one family's dark secrets run deeper than anyone imagined. Two determined officers must piece together the truth before more lives are destroyed by lies and vengeance.

metas.name: Deadly Destination Wedding
metas.description: After flying to a secluded island resort ahead of a friend's destination wedding, a recently single lawyer begins a passionate fling with a charming stranger. When her passport disappears, she realizes the man she trusted may have trapped her in paradise.

metas.name: Frank Takes a Break!
metas.description: After being released from prison, a young man is sent to track down his old friend while drifting through an existential journey that forces him to choose between his past and a chance to change.

metas.name: Clay
metas.description: Emerging from a plaster egg in Central Park, a baby embarks on a lyrical voyage through the city’s pulse, uncovering her true form.

metas.name: Territory
metas.description: Girl is kidnapped by her own body. In the labyrinth of her inner self, the girl must face the obsessions and desires of a person who is doomed to food—ever-present and painfully tempting. The film explores a toxic relationship with one's body. It shows the illness from an internal perspective, emphasizing confusion, loneliness, and of loss of control—emotions that are often invisible but deeply embedded in the everyday lives of people struggling with eating disorders.

metas.name: Mnema
metas.description: In a world of obstacles and labyrinths, Mnema tries to find her way into each level of what resembles a video game. Between reality and fantasy, Mnema hears the voices of women who once were in her place.

metas.name: This Land Carries Us
metas.description: This Land Carries Us is a short experimental doc that centers Tewa presence, voice, and memory across ancestral homelands in northern New Mexico. Guided by the voice of the filmmaker’s grandmother, who recites a story written by the filmmaker’s late younger brother in the Tewa language, the film unfolds as a sensory meditation on land, family, and intergenerational connection.

metas.name: The Last Bateau
metas.description: In the quiet woods of East Texas, producer Brittani Mathis uncovers a wooden bateau built by her great-grandfather, Wyatt Moore, and a box of cassette tapes where his voice still lingers. Nearly fifty years after he recorded them, she returns to Caddo Lake to restore the last bateau he built. In doing so, she reconnects with the craft, memory, and lineage that shaped then both. Anchored around archival audio and quiet observation, this lyrical documentary moves like memory.

metas.name: Buffalo Spirit
metas.description: Fleeing from a troubled home life, a young Blackfeet woman finds refuge on the buffalo ranch of her Auntie and, in learning to care for the buffalo, begins to heal from the wounds that led her there.

metas.name: Everything Must Go
metas.description: EVERYTHING MUST GO is a comedy short filmed in real time as a cis/trans lesbian couple gets married, gives away their possessions, sells their house, and flees the US to escape anti-trans legislation.

metas.name: Close Friends
metas.description: Lauren had a transformative year. Her friends on the internet helped her through it.

metas.name: My Lover
metas.description: After choosing love over privilege, Yuan Xinyi and Liang Jingtian begin a life together without the support of her family. But as financial pressures mount and reality sets in, their once-unshakable romance is put to the ultimate test.

metas.name: New Toy Story
metas.description: When a new action figure accidentally knocks a princess doll over the backyard fence, a group of mismatched toys must work together to bring her home before dark.

metas.name: Ensaio Geral Para Um Futuro Ausente
Magazine Dreams
metas.description: When Mia gets offered the chance of a lifetime to become the cover star of a magazine by Pierre, she thinks all of her dreams are finally coming true. But when she arrives on set, she quickly realises it's not the glamorous life she thought it would be.

metas.name: A Fistful of Feathers
metas.description: Divorced father Borko shows up at his daughter Anja's birthday party dressed as a cowboy. After making a fatal mistake, his already fragile relationships unravel, and the line between his western fantasies and reality begins to tear.

metas.name: The Endless Frontier
metas.description: An urgent portrait of three scientists working to solve some of the most pressing challenges of our time, from disease to climate change, while revealing the growing threat to the American research engine and what is at stake for us all if it falters.

metas.name: EQUITY 6928
metas.description: At the dawn of cinema and the notion of a moving image, a fierce battle commenced between inventors Louis Le Prince and Thomas Edison to conceive and design a machine capable of projecting multiple frames a second, thus taming light and shadow. EQUITY 6928, slips back in time through the archives and spins a tale of intrigue, murderous intent and nefarious corporate interests.

metas.name: Oye Bhole Oye 2
metas.description: A simple village boy refuses to sell his land when a powerful company offers big money, even as his own family gives in. As he stands alone, his fight turns from a personal struggle into a larger battle to protect his roots and expose the truth behind the project.

metas.name: Flora & Airto: O Som Revolucionário
metas.description: A feature-length musical documentary about the history of the celebrated musician couple Flora Purim and Airto Moreira, who helped shape the global music scene from the 1970s onward as pioneers of jazz fusion. Set against a present-day recording session, the film interweaves the artists’ personal and professional lives, past and present.

metas.name: We Loved You, Now
metas.description: An Armenian funeral meal takes an unexpected turn.

metas.name: Labyrinthine
metas.description: Jesse finds herself in a strange, dream-like Labyrinth after a relationship ending argument with her girlfriend. In order to escape, she must confront her own faults.

metas.name: bird's nest (the mourning dove and the cardinal)
metas.description: An animated retelling of the directors personal journey with his body as a transgender man from Texas.

metas.name: Moondram Kan
metas.description: Follows the investigation of a factory general manager's murder, where four workers—a mechanic, assistant manager, owner, and new recruit—become the primary suspects.

metas.name: MKO
metas.description: Moshood Abiola wins Nigeria's freest election, only for the military to jail him. When U.S. diplomats arrive to negotiate his release, he is served tea, and dies.

metas.name: Heaven 17: The Last Temptation
metas.description: Sheffield synth legends Heaven 17 hit the road for what might be their final tour, facing up to age, loyalty and unfinished business with the past.

metas.name: Диайвай
metas.description: An inspiring and sometimes sad story about the saving power of skateboarding.

metas.name: 99 писем обо всём
metas.description: An online love story before the invention of the internet.

metas.name: Your Face is a Landscape
metas.description: A film-journey through fleeting and tender dreams, shot with a “loving” video camera.

metas.name: Jazzystan
metas.description: Film about one of Russia's most unusual indie bands, Dagestani jazz band "No, you're kidding".

metas.name: Your Name Means I Love You
metas.description: A guy becomes infatuated with a girl named after a French pop song.

metas.name: Disciples
metas.description: On the banks of the Ganges in Varanasi, two boys enter a revered Hindu school where lessons in ancient scripture blur into something more troubling.

metas.name: To Live and Die in AlHamadaniyyah
metas.description: And a father sets out to inspect a new house in alhamadaniyyah. What follows drifts into his son's inner world where absence , ,unease , and unanswered questions beginning to take shape. Something about the decision doesn't sit right but no one sees it

metas.name: Talos
metas.description: In a time of loneliness, a father finds peace through his love for his daughter.

metas.name: Whipple’s World
metas.description: Attorney by day and beloved entertainment journalist by night, George Whipple has been a staple on NY1 for three decades, including his eponymous show "Whipple's World." Juggling many different hats with aplomb, this documentary debut shows just how fascinating Whipple’s eccentric life is.

metas.name: House of Criticism
metas.description: Roberta Smith and Jerry Saltz are both rockstars in the world of art criticism. They’re also madly in love. Reflecting on their relationship, careers, and the ever-evolving New York City art scene, this unlikely power couple invites us into their surprisingly humble world.

metas.name: Born Melo
metas.description: This new, official documentary takes an intimate look into the life and legacy of Carmelo Anthony as he is inducted into the Hall of Fame and sees his son, Kiyan, launch his collegiate basketball career.

metas.name: Mumford & Sons: The House Band
metas.description: Mumford & Sons invite the camera onto the train for one of the most purely pleasurable concert docs in years. Featuring Noah Kahan, Darius Rucker, Lainey Wilson, Maggie Rogers, and several other special guests along for the ride, the journey captures the intimacy and camaraderie between all the performers both onstage and off.

metas.name: Taarkata
metas.description: A former police officer returns to his hometown to probe a puzzling death connected to his history.

metas.name: Beyond Files
metas.description: Case files document encounters with alien forces and altered realities, uncovering a pattern beyond human understanding.

metas.name: Corpus
metas.description: Diane loves coding, but her dream is to become a journalist at the prestigious Nowgazine. When her boyfriend lands the job for himself, war is declared.

metas.name: Habeebi
metas.description: Follows a boy and girl in a Muslim neighbourhood in southern Tamil Nadu whose romance divides their community.

metas.name: Morals & Status
metas.description: Three Venezuelan teenagers Rodrigo, Marcelo, and Alexa, get profiled at a store which leads to an altercation with immigration.

metas.name: Gemini
metas.description: As a career-defining performance approaches, a young composer becomes unsettled by a piece of music that seems to surface unbidden, drawing him into a confrontation with his own self-doubt.

metas.name: Kagi
metas.description: Another adaptation of Tanizaki's novel The Key.

metas.name: Flag Day
metas.description: Set in the small farming community of Three Oaks, Michigan — home to the nation’s largest Flag Day parade — FLAG DAY is a verité portrait of ritual, identity, and belonging in an era of deep political division. Somewhere between tradition and transformation lies this village, whose annual parade has become a pageant of American aspiration and memory. Over the course of Flag Day weekend, the film immerses viewers in the lives of a diverse cross-section of townspeople: veterans, local business owners, marching bands, and volunteers who, for one weekend each June, create an event that is at once nostalgic and reflective of the tensions of our time. Their stories reveal both the beauty and the fragility of community life in a time of polarization. FLAG DAY was filmed in an observational, verité style, capturing moments of humor, conflict, and grace as the community prepares for its defining ritual.

metas.name: Chhaki Suna
metas.description: Each victim holds a piece of the puzzle, but solving this deadly game could make the investigator the final player.

metas.name: Valluvan
metas.description: When a string of high-profile murders rocks the city, investigators uncover a dark secret linking the victims to an unspeakable crime. But even after the alleged killer is caught, the killings don’t stop—revealing a far deeper conspiracy where justice comes at a deadly price.

metas.name: 映画 おそ松さん 人類クズ化計画!!!!!?
Presenting: The End of the World
metas.description: During a self-taped audition for a film about the apocalypse, 15-year-old Tyler realizes that the end might not be fiction after all.

metas.name: Double Occupancy
metas.description: Rajini transforms between woman by day and man by night, hiding this gender swap from partners creating tangled complications.

metas.name: The End of the World
metas.description: During a self-taped audition for a film about the apocalypse, 15-year-old Tyler realizes that the end might not be fiction after all.

metas.name: Like a Limbless Tree
metas.description: When retired engineer Refik learns that he’s terminally ill, he gives his Syrian refugee carer, Nesrin, money to flee to Europe with her two boys. As he is preparing for the upcoming Eid to announce his diagnosis to his children, Nesrin vanishes, leaving the boys behind with Refik. He struggles to find the woman in İzmir, the city of hope.

metas.name: MOUTH FULL OF GOLDS
metas.description: This is the definitive documentary of grillz (gold teeth) as told through the life and times of the artforms creator Famous Eddie Plein - one of the most inventive fashion icon you’ve never heard of, an entrepreneur who changed the face of hip-hop, one gold tooth at a time.  Simultaneously developing the aesthetic of grillz as the sound of hip-hop evolved across the country giving each city their moment in the spotlight. The story of a man who found him self at the epicentre of the hip-hop, Miami bass, Southern Rap and Chopped and Screwed music scenes.  A natural born hustler whose customer base comprised of rap superstars, millionaire drug dealers, gangsters and fashion focused teenagers. An icon that built and then lost an empire after the world went digital and moved on-line without him.

metas.name: Swamped
metas.description: A 19 year old college student named Rowan lives through a day in her life, which means constant agony in her own brain. Rowan is trapped in a battle with herself, dealing with her obsessions and compulsions, as well as trying to adjust to a new social life.

metas.name: The Call
metas.description: A young actress comes face to face with a volatile composer at the biggest callback of her career.

metas.name: Iván & Hadoum
metas.description: Iván (33), a trans man, and Hadoum (30), a Spanish-Moroccan woman, fall in love at the industrial greenhouse they work in. While facing the opposition from their families and co-workers, Iván realizes he doesn’t need to be the man he is expected to be.

metas.name: Una pistola, una bala y un oso panda
Still Sexy
metas.description: Maddalena has it all: a job she loves, the perfect fiancé, and a dream wedding ahead. Yet in the bedroom, something feels wrong. Urged on by her inner voice, embodied by pornstar Valentina Nappi, she begins to question her life. Meeting Bruno, a gardener with a troubled past, leads her to rediscover herself and realize the only path worth following is her own.

metas.name: Flying Colors
metas.description: Belén, a 17-year-old who uses a wheelchair, feels she is being left behind as her friends plan their futures outside of school. Her rebelliousness leads her to an adapted athletics club, where she meets Laura, a Paralympic athlete who inspires her to reconnect with her body and confidence. Belén will discover that growing up is not about following the path of others, but about building her own, even if in a different way.

metas.name: Charukesi
metas.description: A Carnatic musician with Alzheimer's grapples with his prodigal son's lifestyle choices, exploring the intersection of music, memory, and family relationships.

metas.name: 49 Miles More
metas.description: On their way to an annual reunion with university friends, Max—an unlucky insurance salesman struggling to find his place in life—and his carefree best friend Doug hit an unexpected roadblock when their car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.

metas.name: A Family of Bastards
metas.description: After the death of his father, Mohamed discovers the living of a step-brother and a step-sister. Together, they must manage the suspicious bar they inherited of linked to criminality, drug traffic and prostitution.

metas.name: The Intimacy Coordinator
metas.description: Kate is an intimacy coordinator. She is also a sex addict.

metas.name: Governor
metas.description: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

metas.name: The Fall of Sir Douglas Weatherford
metas.description: In the Scottish village of Arberloch, Kenneth, a grieving tour guide, is devoted to preserving the legacy of the town's sole historical figure—eighteenth-century inventor Sir Douglas Weatherford. But when a fantasy series chooses Arberloch as its filming location, and the town turns its back on Weatherford in favour of fan culture, Kenneth descends into madness.

metas.name: Learning to Eat Cake
metas.description: An outgoing young woman reframes a strange and coercive sexual encounter as a comical tale to her friends in order to make light of the violation.

metas.name: Double Trouble
metas.description: Once upon a time in a Polish village in Romania, Hanka and Bronka, left behind by their deceased husbands and their children who have emigrated for work, face everyday life with humour and persistence. Fighting to stay independent, they will soon need to make a life-changing decision.

metas.name: Another League
metas.description: Spain, the 1970s. Although Francoist ideology remains deeply entrenched in society, a group of young trailblazers and an ambitious promoter are about to change the history of women’s football.

metas.name: The Great Skull
metas.description: Gu Liyan, on the verge of graduating from university, suddenly faced her father's death and had to assist her sharp-witted mother in navigating the tedious funeral arrangements. Unexpectedly, the 'Funeral Affairs Committee' secretly organized by her father before his death suddenly arrived at their doorstep... With unanticipated guests, absurd situations, and ridiculously dramatic events, the mother-daughter duo urgently needed to gather their strength to confront it all.

metas.name: Adrenal
metas.description: CHAI Ya-hui returned to Taiwan after getting married in Japan. Since her husband committed suicide, she lived alone with her daughter Xiao-xiao. They were chased by gangsters. One day, Xiao-xiao and her classmate Ya-hoo were kidnapped, Ya-hui asked the police for help but was troubled, so she decided to save her daughter herself. The kidnappers use high-tech methods to torture her and Xiao-xiao, and unravel mysteries related to past dismemberments, organ trafficking, and historical trauma. As clues are intertwined, Ya-hui discovers the key to solving the case, and finally reveals the truth behind the obsession and trauma, and brings an unexpected ending.

metas.name: The Memory of Butterflies
metas.description: A photo of two indigenous boys brought by force to Europe opens an investigation of the past with meditations on the filmmaker’s own family using roughly textured analogue footage. A monument for the indigenous victims of the rubber trade in Peru.

metas.name: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
metas.description: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.

metas.name: Badland Rising
metas.description: An ordinary bloke embarks on a 19-hour drive home, unaware of being pursued by two unhinged criminals. Once he discovers their motive, his journey turns into a brutal fight for survival.

metas.name: Magma
metas.description: Searching for answers about her Algerian family's ties to both sides of the Independence war, a filmmaker uncovers a tangle of contradicting buried histories.

metas.name: Gonâve
metas.description: The 1920s, Gonâve, a small Haitian island in the Caribbean Sea. The invasion of colonial investment is progressing. A former miner of Polish descent - Faustin Wirkus - the administrator of the island, befriends its inhabitants. Named king by the local community, he tries to help the island. However, his plan to publicize the situation on Gonâve brings unexpected results. The film is inspired by the true story of Faustin Wirkus.

metas.name: Abar Hawa Bodol
metas.description: Two old friends, a rock star and an NRI, swap lives for fun, but the magical twist forces them to confront deep personal challenges, testing their bond and changing their perspectives on life and friendship.

metas.name: In the Hand of Dante
metas.description: A Vatican priest discovers Dante's original Divine Comedy manuscript. When asked to authenticate it, writer Nick Tosches steals it, while a parallel story follows Dante's quest to create his masterpiece.

metas.name: Noga
metas.description: Fearless alternative pop singer Noga Erez is on the brink of superstardom with a unique, captivating sound and a major studio album on the way. But when war erupts and cracks appear in her relationship, Noga must redefine her role as an artist on a global stage.

metas.name: Memorizu
metas.description: After his father-in-law Makoto fractures his leg, young professional Yuta travels from his home in Tokyo to a rural town in Kyushu to take care of the older man and help out in his old-fashioned photo studio.

metas.name: Sad Girlz
metas.description: La Maestra and Paula are the best swimmers in their team and best friends, until an incident at a party changes everything. La Maestra, intense and unstoppable, realises that something in her best friend has changed, making her sad. When the truth comes to light, the two are faced with an impossible decision: Paula wants to keep quiet about it, while La Maestra wants revenge. Their friendship, previously unbreakable, will be put to the test as never before.

metas.name: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
metas.description: During the golden age of aviation, a young airplane enthusiast and his mother embark on a cross-country journey to Hollywood—and their simple flight transforms into the trip of a lifetime.

metas.name: Kattalan
metas.description: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

metas.name: Snippets
metas.description: Two young adults are confronted by compulsory heterosexuality and the gender binary, feeling pressured into conforming. Through self-reflection and mutual support, they find their own paths and break free from the expectations that were imposed on them. Together they find the courage to be themselves in a world that doesn’t seem ready for them.

metas.name: Small Hours
metas.description: Struggling with alcohol addiction and mental illness, an artist reaches out to an old friend.

metas.name: Stop! That! Train!
metas.description: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

metas.name: The Story of Documentary Film: 1970s
metas.description: From Mark Cousins, creator of the groundbreaking The Story of Film: A New Generation & Women Make Film, comes the definitive history of documentary. Tracing the evolution of documentary film across time, encompassing landmark works and hidden treasures, while revealing how the form has helped us see and make sense of our world.

metas.name: The scream painting
metas.description: A documentary about the true nature of humans

metas.name: GENESIS
metas.description: A widowed father unravels his conviction after being plagued with recurring nightmares of sacrificing his beloved daughter.

metas.name: Two Drops of Blue
metas.description: The complexity of friendship through a platonic bond that runs deep enough to blur love, dependence, and identity. Moving between light and shadow, memory and presence, a mirror of the emotional contrast of connection and loss, when the absence of one person leaves a void that shifts what you once knew about yourself.

metas.name: Superbloom
metas.description: Visual album of the sixth studio release by the English singer Jessie Ware.

metas.name: Loser
metas.description: A heartbroken teen, Jared, stumbles to find new love and messes up along the way.

metas.name: The Princess Who Forges the Sun
metas.description: The Tinkerer Princess and her Mysterious Retainer to find a way to make light return to a sunless world.

metas.name: Love Football, Hate Pollution
metas.description: A look at the links between the Saudi oil industry and FIFA.

metas.name: Dooradarshini
metas.description: Follows Hari and Vani in a 1990s village as they navigate an emotional love story influenced by relationships, memories, and difficulties that test their bond.

metas.name: Foot Finders
metas.description: Embark on a wild adventure as Kyle Evans, a Sasquatch-hunting reality TV star, goes all in on a last ditch effort to save his failing show.

metas.name: John-Luke Roberts Distracts You From A Murder
metas.description: An hour of esoteric comedy performed to distract you from the murder John-Luke Roberts commits during the show.

metas.name: The Last Pack
metas.description: Anxious soon to be father, Jackson, promises his pregnant girlfriend, Dylan, he’s done smoking for good. But after a quick trip to the gas station spirals out of control, he finds himself dragged back into old habits with old company on the night everything is supposed to change.

metas.name: Squatch
metas.description: After discovering a Sasquatch in the Smoky Mountains, park rangers Robert and Sam find themselves in over their heads when tech giant Alphazon plans to destroy its habitat. With no real authority and even less of a plan, they decide to relocate the creature themselves, driving it cross-country to the Pacific Northwest. Watch as Robert and Sam try to do one small, wildly impractical good thing.

metas.name: THE IDOLM@STER Gakuen The 2nd Period
metas.description: THE IDOLM@STER Gakuen The 2nd Period (学園アイドルマスター The 2nd Period) was a live concert event that took place in the following locations and dates:  The 2nd Period H.I.F Senbatsu Shiken (Selection) (The 2nd Period H.I.F 選抜試験（セレクション）): Makuhari Messe Event Hall in Chiba, on May 15th and 16th, 2026.  The 2nd Period Hatsuboshi IDOL FESTIVAL: Yokohama Arena in Yokohama on June 6th and 7th, 2026.  The former will feature the characters performing (as 3D-CG models), and the latter will feature their voice actresses performing.

metas.name: Innu Muthal Maranam Vare
metas.description: Innu Muthal Maranam Vare

metas.name: The Last Duel
metas.description: Two geniuses destined to define an era collided on the same stage. This documentary explores the origins of the rivalry between Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi-the moment their confrontation transformed Spanish football and forever redefined greatness in the modern game.

metas.name: The Light-Bringer
metas.description: Nick Cash, a lifelong musician, spends most of his Tuesdays along with the band, SIDETRACKED, playing at assisted living centers to bring light into the lives of those who are lonely and tired! His love of music is contagious, and he truly loves all those around him! This documentary chronicles how he fell in love with music and how that led him to performing every week.

metas.name: Dear Father
metas.description: Separated by distance, a father watches helplessly as his son’s aggression tears his family apart, until a brutal assault and a police investigation expose secrets that challenge everything they believed about love, guilt, and protection.

metas.name: La Goccia - Il bosco nella città, la città nel bosco
Gabriel Rutledge: A Reasonable Hour
metas.description: Gabriel Rutledge performs a comedy special in Tacoma Washington, filmed at Tacoma Comedy Club.

metas.name: Alice
metas.description: After meeting what seems to be the man of her dreams on a website, Alice gets involved into a deep scheme which she can't seem to escape from.

metas.name: Lo Naveena
metas.description: A rustic village boy and his wild friends embark on a chaotic, heartwarming quest to win the heart of his beloved Asha.

metas.name: Chandarege Wife
metas.description: 'Chandarege Wife' is a Sinhala drama focusing on a wife trying to sustain her marriage to a filmmaker while facing hidden truths and a crumbling relationship.

metas.name: CLIMB
metas.description: PLEASE KEEP USING OUR ESCALATORS! A young individual who travels by subway realizes that the exit of their station is further than they expected. They can take the long stairs or, as suggested, use the escalators. They just have to decide what they're willing to sacrifice: their time and energy, or..?

metas.name: The Stepbrother I Hate to Love
metas.description: Noah is a straight, nerdy student whose stepbrother, Liam—a charming, playboy ice hockey captain—keeps stealing his girlfriends and messes with him both at home and school. A drunken threesome setup turns to a bet that changes everything.

metas.name: White Wasteland
metas.description: On a snowy wasteland a body awakens with no memories. By following a trail of footprints in the snow he reaches a car, where he finds a diary and driver's license with a name: Eerik Traat. From the last diary entry, Eerik reads about eye drops that help visualize memories and memory-erasing tablets. In the hope of restoring his memories and identity, Eerik decides to recreate the memories by using the eye drops. At first, everything seems normal, but gradually inconsistencies and distortions begin to arise.

metas.name: Small Steps
metas.description: After settling in with her roommates Charlyne and Sophie, mute alien Stacey happily joins them on a trip from the Riverwest neighborhood in Milwaukee to Charlyne’s dear old dad in Chicago. If figuring out how best to take care of an alien lifeform wasn’t enough, the rogue CIA agent on their take might just make things worse. Whatever the case, the sheer independence of Stacey might be at stake.

metas.name: Adui
metas.description: When Lagum, a game ranger, is blamed for the death of a notorious poacher's son, he must navigate treacherous jungle terrain and village accusations to survive the wrath of Badan and his warriors.

metas.name: 2 Bro's Ideas
metas.description: With their Prod 2. due next week, Daniel and Logan can't decide on what to make. Daniel wants something classic and simple, while Logan wants . . . laptops to get stolen?

metas.name: Far End of the Sea
metas.description: Washed ashore on a small island in the Pacific, shipwrecked Scottish sailor, Hamish MacKay, is quickly taken captive by local islander Adiben. On route back to Adiben’s village where an ill fate certainly awaits him, Hamish must figure out a way to escape his captor. At the same time, Adiben must make an impossible choice: to fulfil his responsibility to his people or to help a stranger lost at the far end of the sea.

metas.name: Sword
metas.description: A captive prince falls asleep; in his dreams, his doppelgangers multiply—some imprisoned, some free—and they are all searching for the magnificent Sexcalibur, which could give new meaning to their lives.

metas.name: An Inconvenience
metas.description: An Inconvenience is a short film about a depressed guy who sees something he shouldn't.

metas.name: Lara Ricote: Little Tiny Wet Show (baptism)
metas.description: Stand up comedy performance of Lara Ricote's show "Little Tiny Wet Show (baptism)"

metas.name: Unfinished Business
metas.description: Two ghosts are forced together in a seemingly endless eternity, and they find themselves at their wits' end as they fail to make any meaningful connection.

metas.name: Enter Gustaffson
metas.description: The legendary anonymous painter known as Gustaffson reveals his identity in a groundbreaking documentary.

metas.name: Une Fraise
metas.description: Only one strawberry left. Who will get it ?

metas.name: Medusa
metas.description: Poseidon demands Medusa’s submission. Hoping to protect her, her sisters send her to live with the priestesses of Athena’s temple. But the god of the sea emerges from the waves and rapes the young woman, defiling the temple. To punish her for this desecration, Athena turns Medusa into a monstrous creature: her hair becomes a nest of snakes and her gaze turns anyone who looks at her to stone. This terrifying power arouses the lust of heroes, who pursue her in her exile…

metas.name: Philippe-Audrey Larrue-St-Jacques: Enfant du siècle
metas.description: Philippe-Audrey's solo show: his deadpan humor, sometimes scathing, and his slightly offbeat, funny dandyish appearance prove to be a unique offering that lives up to expectations.

metas.name: The Last Laugh: Stephen Colbert
metas.description: For more than a decade, Stephen Colbert has sat at the center of late night, where comedy, politics and culture collide. As he prepares to take the desk for the final time, The Last Laugh turns its lens on both the show and the man, exploring what audiences stand to lose when one of satire’s sharpest and most thoughtful voices signs off. The hour also examines the broader cultural and political forces surrounding the end of Colbert’s late-night run and the future of outspoken comedy in an evolving landscape.  Anchoring the hour is a dynamic lineup of interviewees spanning comedy, journalism and cultural criticism. The special features appearances from CNN Anchor and Chief Washington Correspondent Jake Tapper and comedians Jordan Carlos and Gianmarco Soresi, alongside key creative voices from The Colbert Report including Allison Silverman and Richard Dahm, each offering insight into the scope and lasting influence of Colbert’s work.

metas.name: Ophira Eisenberg: I Used To Be Nicer
metas.description: Ophira Eisenberg gives a Canadian middle finger to toxic positivity, parenting, marriage maintenance, aging, therapy, and the goddamn cost of eggs.

metas.name: GCW: Guilty Conscience 2026
metas.description: The lawless energy of Game Changer Wrestling returns to the Motor City! GCW takes over the legendary Harpos Concert Theatre for "Guilty Conscience 2026." Known for its gritty atmosphere and die-hard fans, Detroit becomes the epicenter of independent wrestling as the promotion brings its unique blend of high-octane athleticism and ultraviolent chaos back to one of its favorite haunts.  Tag Team Warfare: The Pillars vs VNDL48  Women's Showcase: Allysin Kay vs Vipress  Singles Grudge Match: Dr. Redacted vs Anakin Murphy

metas.name: Karaa
metas.description: A series of bizarre, comical crimes spirals into chaos, taking a dark turn when characters become trapped in crocodile-infested floodwaters, leading to a deadly encounter with the predators.

metas.name: Last Night In..."Hollywood"
metas.description: A determined young actress takes on a mysterious errand for a manipulative casting director, crossing paths with a disgraced former actor. As their worlds collide, she’s forced to question how far she’s willing to go to make it in Hollywood.

metas.name: The Janitor
metas.description: After a confusing accident, 3 high school theater students are forced to deal with very.... serious cops.

metas.name: The Great Indian Illusion
metas.description: ‘The Great Indian Illusion’ is an unsettling journey through India’s banking system, unravelling the invisible machinery of debt, power, and privilege shaping the nation. As promises of growth collide with scams, collapsing trust, and widening inequality, the film peers into the fragile myth sustaining modern India.

metas.name: Театр в кино: Принцесса цирка
metas.description: Early 20th century, Paris. Mr. X, a mysterious circus performer never seen without a mask, stirs hearts and stirs rumors in Parisian society. The beautiful Theodora, a young, wealthy widow, is the envy of all high society. To win the heart of this brilliant socialite, circus talent alone is not enough. And does her love really matter to someone who has chosen solitude and decided to hide their face forever behind a mask?

metas.name: Damnation Empire
metas.description: A man is about to be executed. Before, during, or after his death, he remembers fragments of his past, and navigates to find and save himself.

metas.name: Helden und Herzen: Bayern, Schalke und das unmögliche Tor
Strong
metas.description: Lami Sawa, a radiant spiritual mentor and accomplished architect, appears to live an idyllic life with her devoted husband, Sota. Rooted in love and faith, their marriage is shattered when Sota is accused of infidelity and the murder of a woman, plunging Lami into doubt, scandal, and a fight for truth.

metas.name: Inside The Works
metas.description: In 1974, an eccentric millionaire by the name of Alexander Schure founded the New York Inistitute of Technology's Computer Graphics Lab. Housed in a one hundred year old pink mansion in Long Island, the lab made large advances in digital paint, animation, and attempted to create the first computer animated film twice in its lifetime. Kickstarting Pixar, creating the alpha channel, and creating art with every new tool they could lay their hands on, this is the story of the forbidden pink house in Long Island.

metas.name: The Boy Who Gave
metas.description: After the death of their parents, an older brother must make sacrifices to care for his younger siblings.

metas.name: Sam Pauly: A Documentary
metas.description: The film, created and directed by acclaimed celebrity photographer and artist Jasper Soloff, traces the highs and lows of Sam Pauly’s career as she sits down in her Broadway dressing room recalling the sudden cancellation of a planned world tour which forced her to confront the possibility of walking away from the profession she had fought so hard to build a place in. With work disappearing overnight and the future of theater uncertain, Pauly wrestled with burnout, financial pressure, and painful questions faced by many performers.

metas.name: Julian Gałek drinks Matcha Oat Milk 2026
metas.description: Crazy story about this guy named Julian Gałek who drinks Matcha Oat Milk

metas.name: Chatterbox
metas.description: The movie Gaduły was made by students from V LO in Dąbrowa Górnicza. Their inspiration was the movie Talking Heads by the one and only Krzysztof Kieślowski. They asked other students and teachers three simple questions. What were their responses?

metas.name: Beyond Norm
metas.description: A reporter follows a small community of dropouts as she seeks the true reasons behind their new life in the wild.

metas.name: The Three Scoundrels 2
metas.description: The day after their disastrous escapade, our three scoundrels, although publicly forgiven, face the persistent bad mood of their wives. One idea emerges: to offer them a dream weekend by the sea in Côte D'ivoire. The plan goes as planned in Assinie, until... the charming delegation of the Miss O'Tentik pageant arrives to rehearse their ceremony.

metas.name: 4 Corners
metas.description: In July 2025, alongside the official launch of Olduvai Production, filming took place for 4 CORNERS: a project initially conceived as a documentary that, during post-production, evolved into a series of intimate and profound conversations about the life of Tenuun Gantushig, a young man originally from Mongolia.  Through four chapters (like the four corners of the ring, symbolizing Muay Thai), the project tells the different facets of his life and personal journey.

metas.name: The Fisherman
metas.description: A retired traditional fisherman from Ghana. His life takes a whimsical turn when he is forced into retirement and partnered with a sarcastic talking fish, leading him on an adventure to Accra. Joined by his three quirky "Associates," they pursue their dream of owning a boat. Filled with laughter, magic, and the vibrant culture of Ghana, The Fisherman is a delightful tale of family, dreams, and the enduring spirit of a true fisherman.

metas.name: Ghosts
metas.description: A study of a flock of pigeons living in Bergen, Norway.

metas.name: The Conspicous Condiment Case
metas.description: Rookie detective is sent on a new daring case to solve the case of missing condiments across cereal county.

metas.name: Telescope
metas.description: Stumbling on the mythical House of Lost Things, an explorer must choose between her missing childhood stuffed animal and a future-telling telescope with the answer to all her fears.

metas.name: You knew, I know
metas.description: The first month of Spring in the past and the present. A follow-up to “You Are Here”.

metas.name: "LEMON-HEAD!"
metas.description: A colorfully dressed hit-man (Breccan Conroy), haunted by his darker thoughts (DeChi Peterson), faces a life-altering choice: remain loyal to his violent career or risk everything for the girl who might save him (Lola Bazile). No matter what he decides, his past will soon follow.

metas.name: Hilom nga Tubig
metas.description: When two divergent brothers reconcile after their father’s death, a buried confession surrounding their childhood trauma pulls them into a submerged reckoning where guilt, memory, and brotherhood begin to collapse.

metas.name: Deacon Blues
metas.description: On the morning of his best friend’s wedding, Edwin goes on a strange journey deciding whether to speak his mind or forever hold his peace.

metas.name: Automaton
metas.description: The Indigoing on the Streets finale culminates in a surrealist moving picture.

metas.name: The Right Way is the Wrong Way
metas.description: Roy is heading to a job interview but keeps getting lost. Along the way, he meets two characters who change his perspective on life.

metas.name: Fossilized
metas.description: Linnie lives with her Nana in the unincorporated territory of Villegreen, Colorado - notable only for a nearby paleontological site. When Nana’s memory begins to fail, Linnie goes looking for evidence of the past.

metas.name: Bug Behind Schedule
metas.description: Bug stayed up late procrastinating and fell asleep, only to find itself running late for film class. Waiting anxiously for it's pick-up and desperate for a solution, it finds a mysterious object behind the computer that might just be the key to getting to class on time. Time travel mishaps ensue.

metas.name: Death at the Dinner Party
metas.description: When a star psychology student dies during a faculty party, Andrea Gibbs and her son Ethan are drawn into the dangerous manipulations of renowned professor Alan Jackson, a man determined to bury the truth at any cost.

metas.name: Kubler
metas.description: The Campbell family is grieving the loss of their daughter and sister after a fatal accident in the midst of the holiday season. The family is sent into ethical turmoil, however, when the father brings her back in the form of a robot replacement that shares her personality and memories. Due to some technological complications and the nature of their situation, she is totally unable to live her life as she once did.

metas.name: Vacant Aisles
metas.description: Vacant Aisles follows Thomas and Annie who are trying to navigate through their uneventful lives, trying to make the most of the small things while being confronted with the fact they need to make a change.

metas.name: letter to a dead bird
metas.description: blue. glitches. writing letters. duplicities. strings and synths. In this is a shortfilm a dead bird recalls all of his past lives, from the dissapointment of a mother to the venom in the blood. The past and present intertwine to create a psychodelic portrait of a bird's soul when he's on his deathbed.

metas.name: 19 MART: ÜNİVERSİTE AYAKTA
metas.description: A documentary that tells the story of the youth struggle that spread throughout in Turkey after the police barricade in Beyazıt was torn down… We are once again telling that they cannot intimidate the youth with detentions, arrests, and oppression!

metas.name: Ken Zerafi
metas.description: A film by Mulualem Getachew

metas.name: The Classic Masterpiece
metas.description: DIRECTOR'S NOTE: I want to do a cinematic experiment. I invite the audience of Thessaloniki, the city that discovered me cinematically in 1997, to come see my new film without knowing anything other than the title and the fact that it is a romantic, Gouldian comedy. The "CLASSICAL MASTERPIECE" then, somewhere in mid-May, at the legendary Cine APOLLON. I will be there with great emotion and curiosity.

metas.name: Transit in Flamingo
metas.description: Under the vast, open sky of Uda City in Nara, three young strangers meet by chance - Sae, who has just been abandoned by her boyfriend who moved with her, Akari, who has come to find the infamous flamingos her best friend Kyon-chan once spoke of, and Ryutaro, who has never once left his hometown and spends his days living in tedium. Koe and Ryutaro decide to join Akari on her journey. The hearts of these three strangers mingle for only a day; a brief but memorable encounter that will follow them for life.

metas.name: Don't Shoot The Messenger
metas.description: A pickup man and a small-time criminal both face a moral dilemma.

metas.name: Raunchy Round Up
metas.description: A struggling actress juggles her pretentious ex-boyfriend, rekindling an old flame, and the steamy film that might just be her big break.

metas.name: 70 ans d'Eurovision : La Grande Histoire du Concours
Елена Новикова: Часики
metas.description: According to Elena Novikova, from birth, every woman hears this infernal mechanism: "the ticking clock." This ticking dictates when to get married, when to have children, how to look, and where to be. By 30, this sound becomes deafening, by 45, it becomes background noise, and by 56, Novikova claims, zen finally sets in. Elena dissects every stage of the female "obstacle course": from beauty standards, ageism, maternal exploits, to menopause.

metas.name: The Hurdy-Gurdy Man
metas.description: Two plumbers arrive at the house of a hypnotherapist with extremely inconvenient timing.

metas.name: Dance For Me
metas.description: It is what it is.

metas.name: The Knock
metas.description: Philip, living a monotonous life, has an entity develop over him when he fails to reach out to his mom and can't get it to go away.

metas.name: Ranma vs Ryoga: duelo del elixir prohibido
Chasing Utopia
metas.description: Chasing Utopia is a feature documentary asking the question everyone should be asking: will AI be humanity's greatest achievement or its greatest downfall? Mo Gawdat spent two years travelling the world - from Shanghai to Riyadh, New York to London - to find out, engaging with the leading minds shaping our future including Yoshua Bengio, Fei-Fei Li, Geoffrey Hinton, Max Tegmark, Elon Musk and Sam Altman. The result is a film that might change the way you see everything

metas.name: Power Slap 20
metas.description: Power Slap 20: Trujillo vs. Johnson takes place on Friday, May 15, 2026, live from The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan in Las Vegas. The event features a Lightweight Championship main event and streams for free on the Power Slap YouTube channel at 9 PM EST / 6 PM PST.

metas.name: A Rock Without a Role
metas.description: Beau is in search of his purpose. Everyone else around him seems to know theirs. But with the help of his friends, Beau finds his true purpose was right beside him all along.

metas.name: Hayok
metas.description: A feisty thriller about a fiercely independent woman who becomes the obsession of a contractor desperate to possess her. But when betrayal turns violent, she strikes back with a revenge that destroys his pride and control.

metas.name: Iceland for Dummies
metas.description: What happens when you put two Cornish fools in a Dacia Duster on a volcano and tell them to keep themselves busy for a week?

metas.name: Apollo and I
metas.description: An awkward college student catches the gaze of an intriguing girl, unaware that she’s secretly a bloodthirsty vampire.

metas.name: Ultimate Spider-Man: Origins
metas.description: After the horrific death of Peter Parker, a new Spider-Man emerges. 17-year-old Miles Morales, bitten by a radioactive spider, becomes the new wall-crawler the city of New York needs. All the while, on his journey meets an unlikely ally.

metas.name: ACTUAL HOMICIDE PICTURE
metas.description: The 'Film' follows a murderous teenage couple as they go about committing atrocious killings and document them on a video camera.

metas.name: Jacob's Savings
metas.description: Jacob is hit with a financial crisis that he tries to resolve through the teachings of his idol, Rick Alton.

metas.name: The End?
metas.description: The main character wants to go to a place named “The End”, but he can’t exactly locate it. Therefore, he depends on other people to find it.

metas.name: Daniele Gatti & Gautier Capuçon Wagner, Saint-Saëns, and Debussy
metas.description: A concert where German and French Romanticism engage in a dialogue, revealing as many differences as they do similarities. Wagner invites the listener into a contemplative state bordering on ecstasy, while the sensuality of Saint-Saëns’s Cello Concerto and Debussy’s Impressionist evocation of nature unfold.

metas.name: Purple Summer
metas.description: Connell Byrne, an idealistic coal miner who sees the way the world could be, wants nothing more than to leave his small Appalachian hometown with his best friend Lee. However, Lee sees the way the world is, and there’s one obstacle that stands between them.

metas.name: That Sinking Feeling
metas.description: Misty awakes with a cold in a bed unfamiliar to her. At the foot of the bed, the owner of the place, Ashton, obsessively attends to her. He claims to have saved Misty from an accident in which she drove her car into a lake. Misty has no memory of this event and questions why she would act in such a way in the first place. Instead of easing her worries, Ashton leaves Misty alone so she can rest, but promises to check back in later. While trapped alone in the room, increasingly strange occurrences happen to Misty, and glimpses of the accident begin to surface. What truly happened at the lake? Who is Ashton, and does he know more than he lets on?

metas.name: Bride of the Year
metas.description: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

metas.name: Dharpakad
metas.description: Arjun sets out to find the scammers who duped his father, but the deeper he digs, the more complicated things become.

metas.name: Aliens
metas.description: Two members of a foreign species crash land near a prep school dormitory, invading it and attacking the students within. But nothing is quite as it seems.

metas.name: Behind the 8 Ball
metas.description: A financially troubled high school senior bets her future on a pool tournament, only to discover that the real game is deciding what kind of life she wants to live.

metas.name: A15
metas.description: No one knows what happened to West Point—only that it never let go.

metas.name: Open Taxi
metas.description: Jessie and Margot meet by chance encounter at a house party the night of their high school graduation. What follows is a summer of adventure, and a year that will reveal their feelings towards relationships and the futures that will get in the way of theirs.

metas.name: Short Cuts: Mississipi Burning d'Alan Parker
Gipsy Kings, le temps des gitans
Dad Lifestyle
metas.description: Carter embarks on a profound journey through the world of fatherhood.

metas.name: Scene of the Mime
metas.description: A wily group of criminals must return to the scene of their last crime to cover their tracks.

metas.name: Gravemente insano
metas.description: Through diary entries, unsettling monologues, and fragmented conversations, a young woman tries to figure out whether love is a form of salvation or simply another way to lose oneself.

metas.name: Murmur
metas.description: In a shifting, dreamlike world, a young girl begins to experience a changing body and the strange feelings it brings along.

metas.name: My Share of Sky: Ek Mutthi Badal
metas.description: A family drama exploring relationships, expectations, and changes across generations.

metas.name: Life Dyamage
metas.description: In a world where gender roles are suddenly reversed due to a divine mistake, three individuals navigate relationships, identity, and societal expectations.

metas.name: Among the Smoke
metas.description: A grandmother recounts her childhood experiences living in wartime London.

metas.name: Cantona
metas.description: Told largely in his own words, the remarkable story of Eric Cantona's journey from volatile French prodigy to Manchester United legend.

metas.name: Matrescence
metas.description: A woman sends a voice memo to a friend about the unexpected upheavals of her transition to motherhood. Matrescence blends visual exploration with scientific insight to examine the neurological, identity and cellular transformations that occur during pregnancy. A bold, intimate short film that illuminates the immense power of this journey.

metas.name: Once Upon A Time, We Loved
metas.description: In 2006, 18-year-old Bảo spends the final summer of his youth with his closest friends in a quiet coastal town, surrounded by unfinished dreams and endless possibilities. The arrival of Quỳnh—a worldly and emotionally complex woman—awakens feelings he has never experienced before, pulling him out of the safe orbit of his ordinary life. Their passionate romance soon triggers a chain of irreversible events, beginning with a death that changes everything. Twenty years later, the echoes of that summer still linger in silence. Can Bảo truly understand love—and finally forgive himself?

metas.name: Shera
metas.description: A high-energy action drama centered on strength, loyalty, and confrontation. The story unfolds through intense moments and gripping action as the protagonist faces powerful forces and personal challenges.

metas.name: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
metas.description: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

metas.name: Chaser Game W: A Match Made in Heaven
metas.description: Seven years after the events of “Chaser Game W2: The Beautiful Celestial Maidens”—Itsuki and Fuyu now live in Ito City, Shizuoka Prefecture, with their daughter Tsuki, who is in middle school. Amid their busy daily lives filled with housework, parenting, and work, the time they spend together has gradually become something they take for granted. Over the course of those seven years, their relationship has shifted from “lovers” to “family,” and subtle emotional distance has begun to emerge between them. Though their hearts are shaken by each other’s casual words and actions, they continue to maintain the appearance of a peaceful household. However, their daughter Tsuki senses the growing unease between her parents. One day, after getting caught up in trouble, Tsuki is helped by a taxi driver named Kozue. This encounter becomes a turning point, prompting Itsuki and Fuyu to finally confront their true feelings and reexamine the form their love has taken as it drifted apart.

metas.name: Northern Soul: Still Burning
metas.description: An exploration of the cultural phenomenon that is Northern Soul, charting how this movement has weaved and transformed itself musically and culturally through the decades.
