Northern Soul continues to re-invent itself more than any other music genre, remaining as vibrant and relevant today as when it first evolved.  Features exclusive interviews with Richard Searling, Paul Mason, Elaine Constantine, Kev Roberts, Russ Winstanley, David Nathan, Wayne Hemingway, Dave Evison, Keith Gildart, Levanna McLean, Tony Blackburn and many, many more.

metas.name: The Accidental Renaissance of Steven Porter
metas.description: A man at the brink of existence. To be reborn. To become undone.

metas.name: Fairy Tale: Fairy School
metas.description: The world has become aware of the existence of all fairies. Due to the ensuing chaos, the Fairy Queen uses magic to erase the memories of mortals. Furthermore, the training of young fairies will no longer take place on Earth, but at the Fairy School in the Fairy Realm. Dudu, Betüş, Perihan, and Pakize take up positions at the school; however, other magical forces await them there.

metas.name: Disco Hall Commitments
metas.description: "(...)the most important event of my day has been remembering the improbable adventure of H.K: 5000 years after the first kalaallit expedition, renowned and reviled archaeologist Herbjørg Kristofferson tries to lift up an ambitious budget for a reckless expedition to the Secret Pavilion of Monk Ko-Hu, near the Russian Arctic"

metas.name: Sandcastle
metas.description: High school senior Tommy Kyle decides he wants to be president of the English Society. All that stands in his way? The most popular girl in school, and a political campaign to last the ages.

metas.name: STREAKERS
metas.description: An exclusive behind-the-scenes featurette giving a look into the production of STREAKS (2025). Deleted scenes, outtakes and never-before-seen media all wrapped up in one killer package.

metas.name: Sugar Boy
metas.description: A short documentary film on the trials and triumphs of a young man's obesity journey.

metas.name: As We Burn
metas.description: It begins at the margins of power: a few teenagers protest outside parliament, cardboard signs in hand and an unyielding determination in their eyes. From there, Helena Molin’s long-term portrait unfolds—of a generation forced early on to confront the ruthlessness of politics. Their fight for the climate and for justice runs parallel to a life that should be about friendship, play, and future dreams, but is repeatedly interrupted by the failures of the adult world. The result is an intimate and powerful depiction of what happens when moral responsibility is placed in the hands of those still searching for their place in the world.

metas.name: Patlabor EZY: File 1
metas.description: Patlabor EZY: File 1 is the first of a 3-part theatrical series taking place in 2036, 38 years after the events of Patlabor on Television and The New Files.

metas.name: THE A-CARE -Disusebody-
metas.description: At the "Ijinzaka Clinic" day service, a revolutionary treatment devised by Director Urushihara is secretly spreading among the elderly. Aiming for the ultimate cost-effective care, the amputation of "Disusebody" (limbs with no hope of recovery) has reportedly led to unexpected positive side effects, such as patients feeling "lighter in body and mind" or "developing a gentler personality." Yagura, an editor who hears these rumors, senses a potential revolution in geriatric medicine and proposes a book deal to Urushihara. However, an internal whistleblower leak about the daycare center soon surfaces in a weekly magazine. Following a shocking incident at a patient's home, everything begins to spiral into darkness.

metas.name: Kartavya
metas.description: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.

metas.name: 映画『正直不動産』
metas.description: An elite real estate agent who lost the ability to lie due to a curse must navigate the cutthroat industry using only the honest truth.

metas.name: Baapya
metas.description: In coastal Konkan, an ordinary family and their tight-knit town face change, identity, and buried emotions when an unexpected return from the past upends their settled lives.

metas.name: Perfume - "Cold Sleep" –25 years Document-
metas.description: As 2026 heralds the start of technopop group Perfume's 'cold sleep' hiatus, this documentary traces the first 25 years of their career, and is expected to go behind the scenes of their latest album, Nebula Romance, and their latest tours.

metas.name: Aakhri Sawal
metas.description: Vicky, a brilliant but volatile scholar who ignites a national firestorm when he publicly accuses his legendary mentor, Professor Gopal Nadkarni, of institutional bias. What begins as a faculty dispute is quickly hijacked by a sensationalist news anchor and an ambitious political activist, turning a private disagreement into a televised "intellectual trial" watched by millions.

metas.name: A GOOD DAY TO VOMIT HARD
metas.description: The anticipated follow up in the iconic improvised anthology series.

metas.name: Angkinin Mo Ako
metas.description: Cess Garcia and VMX’s next big thing Dara Lima star in a steamy drama about two sisters and the man who sparks their sensual awakening. A female lawyer hires a young man as tutor for her younger sister but unknown to her, their review sessions are becoming wild

metas.name: LA PALOMA
metas.description: Known as ‘Pa Nana’, a celebrated Latin singer in 1950s–60s Taiwan, Kao Chu-hua supported her family through nightclub performances after her father’s execution during the White Terror. Drawing on family testimonies and newly declassified archives, the film reconstructs her life under state surveillance, revealing survival beneath authoritarian rule and enforced silence.

metas.name: Tokyo In 33 RPM
metas.description: A musical journey through Tokyo's Jazz Cafes.

metas.name: Sattendru Maarudhu Vaanilai
metas.description: When a carefree orphan and a runaway minister's daughter marry on impulse, their love is tested by financial struggles and powerful enemies — from corrupt politicians to jealous rivals. Together, they uncover hidden truths and prove that love can survive even the darkest threats.

metas.name: Hugo 24
metas.description: Hugo is 23 and still hasn't grown up. On the eve of his 24th birthday, he faces adulthood: he's unemployed, but goes to an interview at a real estate agency, a dream job that would allow him to wear a suit, something that reminds him of his absent father. He carries a deep fear of abandonment: his mother is in prison, his girlfriend is leaving, and his family is falling apart. When his landlord threatens to evict him in 24 hours, he begins a race against time that will mark his definitive step into adulthood.

metas.name: Atonement
metas.description: Based on Dexter Filkins’ resonant New Yorker article of the same name, about Marine Lu Lobello, haunted by memories of a deadly incident in Baghdad, whose journey of guilt and remorse leads him to reach out to Nora, the sole surviving member of the family he believes he may have harmed.

metas.name: John Lennon: The Last Interview
metas.description: “John Lennon: The Last Interview” captures an extraordinary and intimate moment in music history – the final in-depth conversation John Lennon ever gave. On December 8, 1980, Lennon and Yoko Ono sat down with a small radio crew in their New York apartment to promote the release of their album Double Fantasy. What followed was an unfiltered, wide-ranging discussion about music, politics, fatherhood, and life. Just hours later, Lennon was killed. Directed by Steven Soderbergh, the documentary presents the complete interview for the first time, framed by reflections from those who were present, revealing a man at the height of his creative and personal powers, openly looking toward the future he would never see.

metas.name: Rainy Summer Days
metas.description: It's summer. Three friends meet. They will spend a few days in the mountains, camping, walking, chatting. As the days go by, so do their relationships, their misgivings, their affections. And when they return, nothing will be the same.

metas.name: Saptadingar Guptodhon
metas.description: Subarna Sen, along with Abir and Jhinuk, go on a dangerous treasure hunt in the Sundarbans. The trio seeks the legendary treasure of Raja Pratapaditya, facing increased risks in a new adventure that blends history, folklore, and suspense

metas.name: Agatha's Almanac
metas.description: Defying modernity, 90-year-old Agatha forges a solitary existence on her ancestral farm preserving heirloom seeds.

metas.name: I Don't Speak English
metas.description: Dave Evans, Phoenix’s most famous conservative radio personality is a man very strong opinions. He´s got a privileged "perfect" little life. The girlfriend, the car, the job, the friends—until a fortuitous car accident flips his whole world upside down. Dave wakes up in the hospital with a rare form of amnesia. His ability to speak English is replaced by Spanish, a language he learned in his childhood and which he’s spent years trying to forget.  Unable to change his fate, Dave´s career fizzles; his fiancé leaves him, his friends and family turn on him. With no medical cure in sight, Dave befriends the lovely Marielena, his resilient Mexican housekeeper, and the only one who now understands him.

metas.name: A Son
metas.description: Maria, an inexperienced school psychologist, senses that behind the apparent happiness of an eight-year-old boy, who has just arrived at the school, lies a secret, the consequences of which are unpredictable. If she is to find out, she will have to decipher what Guille’s mind translates into drawings, as well as overcoming his father’s intransigence.

metas.name: Four days of Mateusz Wilczek
metas.description: Mateusz, a Polish Border Guard, takes part in an operation to push migrants camping in a border forest back to Belarus. Among them is a family with children who claim to have lost important belongings. Returning to the site the next day, Mateusz finds their bag containing a phone number, which he impulsively calls. Over the next days, he receives unsettling messages and wrestles with what to do with the items in his possession. A story about the nature of forgetting in the European borderlands.

metas.name: 8v40
metas.description: A quirky, unlucky-in-love bachelor volunteers for a secret teleportation experiment, only to find himself transported across the world to the Philippines, where he accidentally disrupts the life of a woman he's been trying to woo online.

metas.name: 500 Miles
metas.description: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

metas.name: A Guardian's Heart
metas.description: Jake Bishop has been an exemplary Executive Protection Medic with a distinguished career but life hasn't always been that way for him. There have been miscues, failures, wrong turns and one day he just decides to walk away from it all. His ex boss wants to hire him for one final mission together and when Jake senses redemption for all life's twist and turns, will they survive and can the thought of love save him just in time from a path of destruction. Only time will tell.

metas.name: Better Together
metas.description: Jesse, a broken-hearted high school senior, leads his best friends on a quest left by his father. Their search for the mysterious Zion Point and a legendary meteor shower becomes a journey of friendship, identity, and rediscovering hope.

metas.name: Kaïros
metas.description: After a year of filming abroad, Manu, a once prominent actor, returns to his hometown. But getting back into the business isn't as easy as he thought. After several unsuccessful auditions, he's no longer sure of anything. Against all odds, he lands a job hosting a nighttime call-in radio show. His listeners are mainly newcomers, refugees and exiles with varied life experiences, working graveyard shifts. Manu gradually appropriates this space, this gathering of mixed voices, to launch philosophical questions into the night. His words are engaging. He becomes an anchor for many listeners. His life takes on new meaning.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

metas.name: Goodbye, Eri
metas.description: This film is a fan-made doujin work, created independently without the use of AI.  It is entirely non-commercial, and all copyright belongs to Tatsuki Fujimoto.  Hope everyone likes it.

metas.name: Reflection
metas.description: Amidst a conflict between a student and a teacher, a story from the past gradually comes to light, revealing that sometimes the pain is passed on by those who once suffered it themselves.

metas.name: Drive On, Mr Otter!
metas.description: Timid Mr Otter is given one final chance to evict an elderly couple from their rural village home, or risk losing his own company issued housing.

metas.name: A Last Look at the Glen Cove Taco Bell
metas.description: Jimmy Mullen looks back on his childhood at the Taco Bell in Glen Cove, NY, as it gets ready for renovations, reminiscing about memories of coming to this spot after school and how lots of modern architecture is losing a lot of its character. This Taco Bell stands as one of the final locations on Long Island that had not been given a recent makeover.

metas.name: Strays
metas.description: When a teenage girl and a black cat find themselves living on the streets, they have to get past their differences to get out of a dangerous situation.

metas.name: Enough Square
metas.description: Upon settling into a new town, an investigator encounters strange villagers, and a series of peculiar events unfold.

metas.name: Identity V STAGE Episode 6 [The Abyss of Art]
metas.description: A recurring four-against-one game of “tag” at the manor.  It was a stage with no final act, where neither survivors nor hunters could escape,  each carrying their past and their desires.  Edgar, a painter newly invited to the manor, finds himself in the midst of this life-or-death game, where he encounters raw inspiration that shakes him to his core.  Facing him is Galatea, a sculptor who ceaselessly seeks her “perfect self” and is obsessed with a maddening ideal.  The encounter between these two artists shines an even deeper light on the darkness within each of them.  Will they ultimately seize what they desire?  Or— will they sink into the abyss of art?

metas.name: The Love You Make
metas.description: 'The Love You Make' explores the life of the LGBT community in the Forth Valley area of Scotland. Director and Presenter Iris Savage interviews both members of her local LGBT group as well as the general public to get an idea of what struggles those in the community deal with and what needs to change.

metas.name: Teen Gay Fairytale
metas.description: It's the height of promposal season and everyone at Small Town High School is dying to know which lucky lady will get asked by star lax bro Jax McCauley. But when the school gossips out him as gay, Jax finds himself peer pressured into dating the only other gay kid in school... even though they have nothing in common, and Jax is secretly in love with his best friend, Miller. This coming-of-age satire pokes fun at the way queer characters and romances are typically presented in mainstream media, while also aiming to normalize rather than sensationalize coming out.

metas.name: Everything that can remind you of, is
So Far Away, So Close
metas.description: Naoto is given one day to reunite with Mio, his deceased lover, through an AI reconstructed from her brain data. Installed on his smartphone, Mio speaks with the same voice, memories, and mannerisms she once had—yet her existence is limited to just 24 hours. As they spend the day together in Tokyo, visiting familiar places, meeting Mio’s mother, and preparing for Naoto’s art exhibition, their conversations oscillate between the ordinary and the profound. While Naoto struggles between holding on to the past and continuing to live in the present, the countdown to their inevitable farewell draws closer.

metas.name: no way to say goodbye
metas.description: A documentary about the conflicting feelings of home that are ever so familiar to queer folk. Emerging from the hazy intersection between a place you love and one that loves you back. Shot on a camcorder across Delhi and London, this documentary is an attempt to reconcile with the version of yourself you had to leave behind — and a confrontation with the one you're becoming.

metas.name: اميرة قلبي زين
metas.description: the classic cinderella story wrapped in the magic of the kuwaiti theatre Zain

metas.name: Candidates
metas.description: Nadia, a young adult grappling with loneliness, goes on a string of dates after her roommate and best friend, Lorelei, downloads a dating app to solve that problem, leading to a series of "bad dates." Until she meets Jack.

metas.name: Hope For The Guadalupe
metas.description: On July 4th, 2025, catastrophic flash flooding swept through the Texas Hill Country. The river rose more than 37 feet in a matter of hours, and entire communities along its banks were forever changed. In the days that followed, an extraordinary response unfolded. Search and rescue teams, volunteers, and organizations from across the state and the nation converged on the Guadalupe. As the land and river begin to recover, so too do the people who call it home.

metas.name: الذيب
metas.description: sequel to the 1988 generational classic ( laila wa altheeb) with the orignal wolf ( mohamed alAjaime)

metas.name: العيارين
metas.description: A group of upper-class and powerful people in an ancient time use their power against the poor and the simple folk until one person decides to challenge this social system through cunning methods in this darkly comedic play.

metas.name: منتزه الخيران
metas.description: A musical revue about a group of characters spending their vacation at Al Khiran Park in Kuwait with the musical group al-njoom band, but events quickly take a turn after villains invade the park.

metas.name: هرقل
metas.description: An exciting theatrical adventure inspired by the legend of the brave hero Hercules, taking the audience on a journey full of thrilling challenges, superhuman strength, comedic situations, and humanistic messages.

metas.name: Hörande, hörande - vi har drömmar precis som ni
Dead Zones
metas.description: How does the abundance of HAB-forming phytoplankton species correlate with environmental and biological variables along the California Coast?

metas.name: Best Cinematography
metas.description: An experimental picture by lawson saby.

metas.name: Chet Rockwell & The Milky Mob
metas.description: Kipp Norman and his best friend, Margie sell black market margarine.  When Margie gets kidnapped during a deal, Kipp must enlist the help of the Midwest's most famous private investigator, Chet Rockwell to find his friend and expose the secret corruption of Wisconsin's dairy industry.

metas.name: Taanu Nenu
metas.description: Kishore, a slightly dyslexic young lad, finds his long-lost love (Kriti) through a mischievous act done by his younger sister(Siri). The act translates into a date with the girl he once adored as a child. What follows next is a sequence of events that finally leads him to win over the love of his life.

metas.name: Atvara. Ēnas otrā pusē
metas.description: For years, she stayed in the background—writing, creating, and searching more than she was seen. Music has been her companion since childhood, guided by a mother whose presence encouraged her even when confidence faltered. She wrote for others, quietly present in the industry but never at its center. Then came two transformative years, when years of work finally came to light. This Latvian Television documentary follows Liene Atvara’s journey from her first musical steps to the grandest European stage: Eurovision Song Contest.

metas.name: Todos los Fitos
metas.description: The audiovisual piece shows us the interaction and philosophical conversation between Fito from '63 - played by Juan Cottet -, the one from Circo Beat - embodied by his own daughter Margarita Páez -, the one from 2014, corresponding to the album Rock and Roll Revolution - in charge of Pablo Sigal - and the current one, played by himself.

metas.name: Vera
metas.description: Vera is an experimental film that combines drawn-on-film and digital animation. The images unfold to the rhythm of music played by Vera Guilaroff, a pianist from Quebec that has now been forgotten by history. Guilaroff accompanied numerous silent films in Montreal movie theaters during the 1910s and 1920s. To our knowledge, this is the first time in nearly 100 years that her music has been used again in a film.

metas.name: Le bruit des nuages
metas.description: Because animals also dream. All birds, all mammals dream.

metas.name: N/A
metas.description: Emmy winner Holland Taylor and Broadway's Ana Villafañe star as two U.S. Representatives, generations apart, who couldn't be more different. Inspired by real people and events, the play N/A is a battle of wills and wits between N, the first woman Speaker of the House, and A, the youngest woman ever elected to Congress.  Filmed from Lincoln Center's Off-Broadway theater in August 2024, N/A is part of Theater Close-Up, a collaboration between THIRTEEN and New York City-area Off-Broadway and regional theaters, shining a primetime spotlight on a diverse mix of innovative theater productions.  Go behind closed doors as these two formidable women debate power, ambition, and change. N/A is written by Congressional aide turned playwright Mario Correa and directed by Tony Award-winning director Diane Paulus (“Jagged Little Pill”).

metas.name: Scissor Slasher
metas.description: Sapphic Horror Short Film

metas.name: I Created...
metas.description: Young woman has a epiphany after an hospital stay and feels compelled to live her dream.

metas.name: Alikabok
metas.description: After her father's passing, a young woman attempts to sell his record collection but ends up spending the day at a local record store, where she reconnects with her dad's memory through music and the community.

metas.name: Death Dance
metas.description: In the evening after a funeral, a grieving young man is lured away from his friends by the haunting echoes of a distant, lone saxophone.

metas.name: Bowling Bruce
metas.description: During a first date, a young man must try not to embarrass himself while introducing a girl to his best friend: Bruce, the bowling ball.

metas.name: Two Sides
metas.description: A woman enters her house and witnesses the worst thing possible: herself dead!

metas.name: Why is Nathan Missing?
metas.description: When his friend, Nathan, goes missing, Ellis tries to find him but only finds his answers making less and less sense.

metas.name: Wish That You Were Here
metas.description: Ilyse and Ella's love for each other endures despite the distance between them -- but are text messages and shared memories enough to sustain them through an uncertain future? Set in the backdrop of a rural and urban Philippines, Wish That You Were Here is a love letter to those in the closet.

metas.name: Good Omens - Season 3: An Ineffable Goodbye
metas.description: Take a look behind the scenes of the finale. Hear from Michael Sheen and David Tennant on their journey, celebrating the fans and all involved, with an ineffable goodbye.

metas.name: Anjali
metas.description: A man's emotional & psychological breakdown caused by a toxic relationship descends into chaos, panic, and mayhem when every attempt to end it fails.

metas.name: Archaeology of Self
metas.description: A girl longs for an escape so deeply that she seemingly dreams about confronting the layers of bottled emotions caged behind her facade, clawing her way out of this life. A film adaptation of a poem by Cyril Wong from his book Oneiros.

metas.name: La Tarde Noche #4: Postales de Amaranta
metas.description: Formed at the heart of Caracas' alternative scene, Postales de Amaranta is a band that articulates its identity through post-hardcore textures. Their sound is distinguished by an introspective narrative and a sonic construction that evokes urban everyday life through melancholy and experimentation.

metas.name: Dinner at Eight-Seventeen
metas.description: On their anniversary night, a couple sits down for dinner and confronts what the future of their relationship may look like after receiving news.

metas.name: The Busby Entanglement
metas.description: A film noir following a morally ambiguous French thief escaping the police.

metas.name: DOG DOG DOG
metas.description: A scarecrow and a pirate wander the desert looking for a boat before a cataclysmic flood wipes them out.

metas.name: The Sharp Edge
metas.description: After his father’s death, a young man continues to live under the weight of impossible expectations, questioning if he was ever truly enough for the man he tried so hard to impress.

metas.name: Summer Cruisin'
metas.description: Eddie Summers, the lead singer of Summer Cruisin', has been missing for 38 years until his hit song, “Midnight Knows My Name,” is rediscovered on social media. Looking for a way to online fame, Sean Campbell takes it upon himself to find Eddie and put on a show that will bring him back to the top.

metas.name: Kanto
metas.description: Kanto by Mary Francis Cheeseman is a 3D animated short film for The University of New Mexico

metas.name: Snowfall
metas.description: A lone gunslinger wanders a snow covered forest in search for something.

metas.name: Plastic Cups
metas.description: A group of masked men make it their mission to take part in the biggest painting heist in history. While they prepare for this extravagant feat, they are challenged with keeping their identities hidden while being hunted down by well trained detectives, with unorthodox, corrupted practices. Will they succeed in their mission?

metas.name: The Bug
metas.description: Director Colby Schoetz makes an observation about the world around him only to have it shut down by a bug.

metas.name: Wishlist
metas.description: A man walks around a mall creating a wishlist made of various items.

metas.name: Acrophobia?
metas.description: A college-aged couple reaches a breaking point over his irrational fear of marginal heights.

metas.name: raindrops
metas.description: A boy finds a bench to wait out a gloomy rain storm.

metas.name: Algumas Partes de Mim Ainda Estão Secando no Varal - Introdução
To the Moon
metas.description: A coming-of-age comedy, Jace tries to find his dream aspiration in life.

metas.name: Haye Ni Bebe Meriye
metas.description: A fierce family rivalry sparks a desperate plan to go abroad, but lies, love, and chaos soon reveal that true happiness lies back home.

metas.name: How to be Loved
metas.description: Through the lens of a 1950's educational video, we follow Oscar, a lonely yet romantic college professor, as he tries to understand how to be loved.

metas.name: Ghosts of Modernist Montreal
metas.description: Collage, drawn sound, and double exposure animations on 16mm film explore the temporal disjuncture of Montreal’s urban landscape, haunted by the ghosts of neighbourhoods that were demolished for Expo 67.

metas.name: People Like Ghosts
metas.description: A nighttime montage of strangers drifting through the city, People Like Ghosts is an experimental visual poem exploring modern isolation, silent routines, and the fragile distance between presence and disappearance.

metas.name: Lactar
metas.description: A 62-year-old woman, trapped in a life of empty privilege, becomes pregnant by her driver. Facing rejection from her family and society, she decides to fight to bring to life a baby that seems impossible at her late age, regardless of the consequences.

metas.name: American Soccer Dream - Fußballnation der Zukunft?
Play on Play
metas.description: What do you think the ending of this meeting between "Faker" and "KARINA" will be?

metas.name: MOFO
metas.description: While cleaning their late father's house, Joana and Tomás discover strange videos. As Tomás becomes obsessed with their meaning, subtle tensions arise between the two.

metas.name: In Her Dreams
metas.description: A 21-year-old college student who aspires to make a name for herself in contemporary dance is stuck in a one-day caretaker gig to support her needs. In this mansion, she finds not solace, but existential terror.

metas.name: Аэропорт
metas.description: Nine passengers on the Perm-Antalya flight find themselves locked in the airport's border control zone. It appears that they were gathered there for a reason.

metas.name: The Refund
metas.description: A man desperately tries to get a refund for a train ticket.

metas.name: Prison of Light
metas.description: A man descends into a nightmarish digital world as he struggles desperately for human connection with a mysterious woman.

metas.name: Not Enough
metas.description: A young couple struggles with insecurities and anxiety while on vacation together.

metas.name: Apple Music Live: Lady Gaga MAYHEM Requiem
metas.description: For Apple Music Live, Gaga presents MAYHEM Requiem, a celebration and musical reimagining of MAYHEM.

metas.name: Human Nature
metas.description: During a series of travels and experiences, a young filmmaker records fragments of days marked by doubts, silences, and memories in formation. Between the impulse to record and the need to simply be present, the documentary follows a delicate search for belonging.

metas.name: Cougars
metas.description: Chronicles the journey of notorious criminal Edgar Vaughn and his multiple encounters with the infamous Cougars

metas.name: Excerpts of a Filibustered Friendship
metas.description: Two friends struggle to remain as such amid a radically shifting political landscape.

metas.name: Can't Hurry Love
metas.description: After a tough breakup, Xavier navigates his realationship with his best friend Amy, who obviously has feelings for him.

metas.name: Raxnaquil K’Aslemal: Plenitud de la vida
Inspection
metas.description: A calculated stalker poses as a facility inspector and infiltrates a university to close in on his prey.

metas.name: The Day We Switched
metas.description: Chris and Jamie go through life without dealing with the consequences of their actions; until one day something powerful makes them walk in somebody else's shoes. AKA, a womans.

metas.name: Church Girl
metas.description: A discerning lesbian pretends to be Christian to score a date with the hot choir singer, finding herself at Bushwick’s oldest queer Bible study.

metas.name: Second Responders
metas.description: Second Responders is a short documentary exploring the emotional aftermath of the 2023 Lewiston mass shooting through the perspective of public school teachers. Often overlooked in conversations surrounding tragedy and recovery, educators were forced to become emotional anchors for grieving students while navigating their own fear, trauma, and uncertainty. Through intimate interviews and observational storytelling, the film examines the invisible burden teachers carry in the wake of violence and the quiet resilience required to return to the classroom after a community is forever changed.

metas.name: Mothers Are Mothering
metas.description: Nia, 50, in an abusive marriage navigates a fragmented inner world where desire, memory, and ritual intertwine. A reunion with a former lover reawakens intimacy but exposes the persistence of violence and entrapment. As reality dissolves into hallucination, she reaches for a final, elusive escape.

metas.name: Annisa
metas.description: In a crowded housing complex, Anissa, a blind teenage girl navigates a world mainly shaped by sound. As a neighborhood national day celebration unfolds around her, she finds an unexpected way to be heard, reclaiming her place within the noise that surrounds her.

metas.name: Original Wound
metas.description: After their mother’s death, a brother and sister remain in the house shaped by her control, negotiating conflicting memories of abuse and care. As ritual, body, and memory intertwine, their grief exposes a deeper entrapment, one that persists beyond her absence.

metas.name: Holy Crowd
metas.description: After Ratna rises from the dead during her funeral, her silent body begins performing unexplained healings, turning her husband Arif into the reluctant center of a growing frenzy. As villagers, opportunists, and religious authorities descend, faith and exploitation collide, and the miracle spirals beyond control.

metas.name: Party Girl
metas.description: Two bored teenage girls start killing time with a strange older guy.

metas.name: Just One More
metas.description: A recovering addict, Jess, meets Charles, a dying man praying God will use him "just one more" time. As their lives collide, Jess battles shame, and doubt-discovering faith, forgiveness, and the hope to fight for a future beyond addiction.

metas.name: Eden
metas.description: Eden follows two characters attempting to reconnect with nature as they grow more apart from each other. They attempt to find a place in a world focussed primarily on industrialisation whilst nature is left in the background to degrade. Moments of coexistence are brought to light showing both humanity and nature can exist in tandem and beautiful art can come from this.

metas.name: Balai de Moño
metas.description: For a cash prize and a new home, three displaced Filipino creatures join a reality competition show where they must scare their way to the top for a chance for a new lease on life.

metas.name: Becoming Miku: Notes on Fictosexual Love
metas.description: Shattered by the tragedy of human relationships and seeking a radical path to healing, an artist begins to digitally multiply themself. Searching for their soul in the world of cosplay, they encounter a man who married a hologram. In this liminal space between code and desire, fictosexual love becomes a form of self-care, a rehearsal for a new extreme self.

metas.name: You & Me
metas.description: Dual-screen movie created by two artists where images come into sync and drift apart.

metas.name: Night Plane
metas.description: Local filmmaker Salise Hughes returns with a dream about clouds and lightning and travel.

metas.name: In the Heavenly Cutting Room
metas.description: A woman on her deathbed chastises her creator in this fusion of stop-motion animation and dreamlike live-action video.

metas.name: Thanks for Coming
metas.description: Alain is getting older. For years he has been filming his daily life: his partner Françoise, the people he meets, nature and animals, and life in all its splendour and cruelty. Having devoted his entire life to filmmaking, with the camera as an extension of his arm, he has observed the world with a poetic sense of authenticity and simplicity. Otherness, the approach of death, the power of life and the importance of others intertwine as he looks back on his life as a filmmaker and as a man, concealing nothing, and offering a vision of the universality of the human experience.

metas.name: Detention
metas.description: Open a door. Handle a crisis. Write an incident report. At France’s prison officer academy, hundreds of men and women learn to become prison guards. Their words begin to mirror the institution. Their movements sharpen. What once felt uncertain becomes routine. Doubt slowly fades from their faces.

metas.name: A Secret Heart
metas.description: Over the last 4 years, Lilou left her secret life behind, becoming a 64-year-old woman who enjoys DIY, gardening, cycling and looking after her grandchildren. As I accompanied her through her transformation, I filmed a family healing its wounds and reinventing a place for everyone. This is my family, Lilou is my father.

metas.name: A Very Unlikely Goalkeeper
metas.description: Martín, a humble teenager with extraordinary talent as a goalkeeper, dreams of becoming a professional footballer. Facing rejection and bullying for his singular way of seeing the world, he must rely on his eccentric neighborhood friends to navigate his challenges and seize the one chance he has to turn his dream into reality.

metas.name: NJPW Best of the Super Junior 33 - Day 1
metas.description: The opening night of New Japan Pro Wrestling's annual junior heavyweight round-robin tournament took place on May 14, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

metas.name: EB
metas.description: An ambitious ecologist returning to her childhood home on the Dutch island of Ameland discovers a dangerous drug smuggling route, forcing her to choose between exposing the truth and protecting those she loves.

metas.name: Authentic Games - In the Disconnected Empire
metas.description: After years of ruling an offline world, the Disconnected Empire decides to take revenge. The Emperor plans to kidnap Marco Túlio, creator of Authentic Games, to bring joy to his dark kingdom. Upon entering this universe, Marco Túlio transforms into Authentic, a friendly character, and embarks on a great adventure to rescue the Craft Family and face the Empire. When all seems lost, unexpected help appears in the final confrontation.

metas.name: How Not To Try Again
metas.description: After five years of radio silence, Indigo's best friend waltzes back into her life. With no more than 35p to her name, no job, and an incredibly destructive impulse to make everything too perfect, Indigo battles her final chance to save her friendship.

metas.name: An Eye For An Eye Chart
metas.description: A pregnant woman's warped vision sparks a darkly comedic revenge fantasy exposing the absurdity of medical misogyny.

metas.name: The Traveller
metas.description: A guilt ridden man goes back in time to find and kill the person who he believes ruined his life.

metas.name: Bulgakov. The Secret of The Master
metas.description: "Bulgakov. The Secret of the Master" examines a mystical connection that proves to be stronger than the author's original vision. The film shows how the immortal novel stopped being an author's text and began to dictate its will to the creator, interfering with his love, relationship with the authorities, and even bringing his fateful end closer. The viewer will see how fiction inexplicably turned into reality, and how the book's prophecies materialized in Bulgakov's own life, prompting the question: who really held the pen – the man or his immortal creation?

metas.name: Sacred Way, 21 km
metas.description: The Sacred Way of Athens, once a path of initiation into the Eleusinian Mysteries, prompts the director to search for spiritual meaning along the busy motorway it has now become. Following the traces of the ancient route, the diverse landscape and brief encounters with its current inhabitants reveal the different faces of the world’s oldest Sacred Way.

metas.name: Where Are You Alice?
metas.description: In a "potential" future, the True Purity Act is enacted in the U.S.A. for "societal protection," forcing all declared traitors to be removed from each state and forced into special "rehabilitation" facilities. THIS IS ONE OF THEIR STORIES…

metas.name: Caterpillar
metas.description: Three generations living under one leaky Wellington roof in 2003, all on the brink of transformation. Sixteen-year-old Cassie is all bravado and vulnerability, drifting into risky territory as she searches for validation in all the wrong places. Her mother Maxine, 52, a formidable single-mother filmmaker on the brink of a long-awaited breakthrough, is finally offered a greenlight - if she can just land a star. Holding everything together is Huia, Cassie’s grandmother, 80, whose life has been defined by quiet service to family and a private obsession with raising monarch caterpillars, dreaming of one day witnessing the legendary butterfly migration in Mexico. But when Huia’s mind begins to fail her, the family is thrust into chaos. Can the maternal line hold together while everything is throwing them apart?

metas.name: Sometimes, I Imagine Them All at a Party
metas.description: Soberly and with restraint, the director reconstructs the attempted femicide she survived fourteen years before. Intense conversations with people from her past provide an external perspective on an act subjectively and objectively impossible to grasp.

metas.name: Ray of the Sun
metas.description: At 24 years old, Manny sets foot in the United States for the first time. This short story recounts a pivotal moment when Manny walked into Wildcard Boxing Gym and met legendary trainer Freddie Roach. It marks the beginning of their iconic partnership and chronicles Manny's journey from an unknown fighter to one of boxing's all-time greats.

metas.name: Leo and Tig. The Road to Baikal
metas.description: Leo and Tig set off on a journey to faraway Lake Baikal to bring back home the lost seal pup named Lufi. Along the way, they make new friends with Zhu, a red panda, and Wukong the Monkey King. They also cross paths with the evil chieftain of a horse herd Tengri-Khan, who wants to seize the seal. For whoever brings Lufi home will be granted any wish by the Master of Baikal – the great dragon Lusud.

metas.name: The Lunch: A Letter to America
metas.description: Eduardo, a Mexican cook in a Coney Island diner who crossed the desert two decades ago, becomes the unsuspecting centre of a story unfolding during the last week of the U.S. presidential campaign. Around him swirl fleeting encounters, patriotic hymns, prayers, accidental violence, tenderness, and landscapes of desperate beauty – an America at once raw and poetic.

metas.name: The Talented Mr. F
metas.description: This story sounds too crazy to be true, and yet it is. For three years, Berlin film students Julius and Moritz poured their hearts into their animated short Butty, hoping it would launch their careers. But when a festival disqualifies their film, they make a shocking discovery: Butty is already circulating online under the name of an American filmmaker. As they dig deeper, they uncover the unbelievable rise of a mysterious “Mr. F.”, a man hailed as the next Walt Disney who built his success on a stolen film and a web of lies.

metas.name: Twin Stars
metas.description: The story, set in a rural place, tells in a comic way the difference between the slow pace of the province and the frenetic pace of the capital.

metas.name: Perto do Sol é Mais Claro
metas.description: A touching portrait of Regi, an 85-year-old engineer from Rio de Janeiro, as he deals with the recent loss of his wife. The narrative guides us through his solitary routine, showing the support of his children and his determination to move forward by writing a book and falling in love with a talented actress. The film celebrates life, resilience, and the power of love amid the complexities of aging.

metas.name: Eu Não Te Ouço
metas.description: Two Brazilians meet by chance and embark on a peculiar journey.

metas.name: No Sex
metas.description: A college girl must navigate her unspoken feelings for her best friend — and race to protect her — when a drunken night spirals out of control.

metas.name: Wolves
metas.description: Luana feels trapped; she is frustrated with society, her family, and her job at a crèche. She searches for stability and a sense of belonging, and finds both in the local black metal scene. While accompanying her cousin's band on tour as their social media manager, she falls in love with the charismatic singer, Wiktor. When his more radical views come to light, causing tension within the band, Luana refuses to see the truth and cannot let him go.

metas.name: Athiradi
metas.description: Energetic student Samkutty revives a banned college festival, igniting a fierce rivalry that transforms celebration into chaos.

metas.name: The Cowboy
metas.description: Ten years in the life of young cowboy Crowley as he comes of age in the vastness of Colorado. On his rocky path, he endures loss, separation, and shattered dreams.

metas.name: Flying Scents – of Plants and People
metas.description: A female-led research team embarks on a quest to uncover the chemical secrets that make plants bloom instantly.

metas.name: A Life, A Manifesto
metas.description: The life of Michèle Firk — a trailblazing French journalist, film critic, aspiring director and communist activist involved in various liberation struggles in the second half of the 20th century — as told by narrator Alice Diop, modern day French director.

metas.name: Full Accountability
metas.description: In 2013, Alice and Helena create a fake profile to spy on their schoolmates, but end up attracting the attention of Raquel, the mother of one of the students. What begins as a prank turns into a dangerous game of identity and online exposure.

metas.name: Mommy Down to the Ride
metas.description: A strict physics teacher tries to talk her teenage son out of dropping out of school and becoming a professional skateboarder. She makes a bet with him that if she competes in a major skateboarding competition, he will stay in school. Under the tutorship of one of her poorest pupils, she learns to skate, unaware that she's putting her career and reputation at stake.

metas.name: Antartica - Quasi una fiaba
metas.description: A small group of scientists, unreachable for eight months, explores the future of humanity. Maria Medri, a foreign genius, arrives in Antarctica, challenging Fulvio Cadorna's plans. They are similar but conflicting, as everyone desires their own. This scientific, ideological, and emotional conflict unfolds.

metas.name: Conni and the Mystery of the Crane
metas.description: While her parents are traveling, Conni experiences an exciting adventure at home with cat Mau, her friends, Grandpa Willi, a stuffy neighbor – and an injured crane, who urgently needs help. Will Conni and her friends manage to get crane Klaus to fly south with the migrating birds in time?

metas.name: Karuppu
metas.description: In a world where justice falters, guardian deity Vettai Karuppu takes the guise of a lawyer to battle a corrupt legal system preying on the powerless.

metas.name: Alma Negra, do Quilombo ao Baile
I Died
metas.description: By weaving together the stories of three women who share a common fight within the Zapatista movement and their work in coffee production, this narrative explores deeper issues like land ownership, family dynamics, and the layers of intersectional violence they face. Through their experiences, the film sheds light on the broader social, political, and economic challenges in their communities.

metas.name: A Colisão dos Destinos
metas.description: From childhood to the presidency of Brazil, the documentary follows Jair Bolsonaro’s trajectory, tracing his background, military career, and the path that led to his political rise.

metas.name: Ein Münchner im Himmel - Der Tod ist erst der Anfang
metas.description: When cab driver Ludwig “Wiggerl” Brunner, a true Munich bon vivant, is hit by a streetcar and ends up in heaven, there is only one way back to his beloved Bavaria: he has to improve his karma balance as quickly as possible.

metas.name: Children of the Coast
metas.description: The film features a group of Afro-Mexican musicians from the Pacific Coast of Mexico. They live with the shore, speaking through their instruments and microphones about the traditions they cherish and the love of their homeland. Their music provides a space for the film to explore, encompassing both the historical depth and cultural characteristics of the local civilization, and paying homage to the people, the sea, and the land that exists here. Here, music not only flows with sheer beauty and passion, but is also the language that unites people.

metas.name: Mambembe
metas.description: Ruy, a solitary surveyor, travels the harsh Pernambuco. His life is transformed when he meets three women from a mambembe circus, Madrinha, Jéssica and Diadorim. Through the history of these four characters, "Mambembe" deals with chance while reflecting on artistic construction.

metas.name: Gepellte Haut
metas.description: Four young people from Berlin decide to spend their summer in Portugal. They throw away their smart phones, open up their relationships and try to free themselves from any social norms. But just as their utopia comes true, a devastating forest fire breaks out around them.

metas.name: Parallel Tales
metas.description: In search of inspiration for her new novel, Sylvie spies on her neighbors in the building across the street using a telescope. When she hires young Adam to help her with her daily routine, she has no idea that he will turn her life and her work upside down, until the fiction she had imagined surpasses the reality of them all.

metas.name: me me me
metas.description: "me me me" is/are the word/s you see everywhere in a thing called a diary.  a brown bathtub (in which only clean water is visible) surrounded by elements of the same color (in which the reflection of the observer is visible at all times) = a space of constant reflection (isn't that what a diary is for?) from which you should leave clean, but how can you be sure of that?

metas.name: i before c
metas.description: A woman cuts off her braids and finds relief in her natural hair.

metas.name: Leather Dreams
metas.description: A solitary character is at peace until something suddenly alerts them, thrusting them into a series of scenarios where reality and the unreal become indistinguishable. Confused, the character moves forward through a dystopian atmosphere where strange, unexplained events unfold.

metas.name: Soon to be Dead
metas.description: Tobys stag-do takes a turn when the group are kidnapped and forced to play a deadly card game. Through the tense twists and turns of the game, the group must fight to survive or face the hitman.

metas.name: Tunggu Sekejap
metas.description: Two people meet for the first time.

metas.name: AIDS – In Times of Love
metas.description: In early 1980s East Berlin, painter Heiko Zolchow and actor Dirk Nawrocki fall in love. Seeking freedom, they leave the GDR for West Berlin in 1984. There, they immerse themselves in the theater scene and nightlife, forming a romantic trio with a student named Nikolaus. Meanwhile, the political systems handle the rising HIV crisis differently: East Germany suppresses information, while panic grows in the West. Just as Heiko reaches a professional peak, he receives an AIDS diagnosis. This isolates him from his children left behind in the East due to the Berlin Wall. Heiko passes away from complications in 1987. The final chapter follows his loved ones and Dirk navigating overwhelming grief, societal stigma, and the constant fear of infection. The story tracks their lives through the fall of the Wall until Dirk’s own death in 1994, capturing how the epidemic shattered their envisioned futures during a period of massive geopolitical change.

metas.name: The Golden Age
metas.description: Fictional silent film star Jack Valentine struggles to make the transition to talking pictures during the golden age of Hollywood.

metas.name: Hell Vanguard
metas.description: After a guerrilla attack kills the dictator's advisor,Milad declares war. forces retaliate with a brutal night raid on the resistance's jungle outpost, leading to a clash that alters the revolution forever.

metas.name: It's Cold!
metas.description: Two girls go swimming!

metas.name: Don't Doubt
metas.description: Five strangers. Five impossible beliefs. One chain reaction that proves they all have enough hope. except one… don’t doubt.

metas.name: Flou
metas.description: As they live through their teen years, three friends will experience how love can destroy them.

metas.name: Narration in Motion
metas.description: The film critic and historian Ahmed Bedjaoui recounts how Algeria became a global centre for militant cinema after the country achieved independence from France in 1962.  Zineb Sedira connects these histories to ideas of oral storytelling and collective memory in African culture. Sedira presents her film from a recreation of a mobile cinema.

metas.name: WHEN CINEMA SPEAKS...
metas.description: Zineb Sedira pays tribute to the history of African Cinema and the filmmakers who had inspired her.

metas.name: Sonder
metas.description: Taking place in the same apartment complex, three individual stories explore the perspectives of three different stages of life. A young college girl who has just moved into the complex, a couple balancing life together, and an older woman whose son is helping her move out of the complex after the death of her husband.

metas.name: Neel Deyaler Ghor
metas.description: “Neel Deyaler Ghor” is an emotional story centered around a house that holds memories, relationships, and untold feelings. Through moments of love, misunderstandings, and hope, the story unfolds beautifully, making it a touching Eid special drama for the audience.

metas.name: Rabbitfoot
metas.description: In the midst of the Vietnam War, four friends are convinced they’re safe from the draft. But, there’s one final wrench in the works… and it takes the form of a letter.

metas.name: Snail Mail
metas.description: A snail embarks on a long journey to deliver the mail.

metas.name: I'm Fine
metas.description: When her friend calls to check in, Tori is asked a simple question. We hear everything she would say: the anxiety, the feeling of being trapped inside her own mind and body, the exhaustion of it all. But when the moment comes, she says nothing. She never does.

metas.name: Allt Snurrar
metas.description: The film depicts a discussion about sexual abuse/trauma in the stage were you are recovering from what you been through. The film focus lays with the first hook-up after the main character, Simon, has been sexually used by his ex. His relation to intimacy and closeness has changed a lot, something that once felt more obvious now bears an uncertainty. The film, through visual language and dialogue, shows his attempt to navigate through everything that has happened and everything that is still living within him.

metas.name: Kidnapped by My Mum
metas.description: At 11 years old, Alex Batty vanished on what was supposed to be a short family holiday with his mother and grandfather. An international missing persons investigation was launched, but years passed without a trace.  Then, six years later, a teenager appeared on the side of a road in the French Pyrenees and told a passing driver that he'd been kidnapped.  Alex, now aged 20, is ready to tell the full story about his abduction and his life on the run. For the first time, he retraces the route of his disappearance across Spain and France, uncovering not just how he was hidden but the belief system that kept him there. Each revelation builds a chilling picture of how easy it was for a child to disappear in plain sight.

metas.name: The Tales of Mission and Zaalbar
Carl Craig B2B Seth Troxler @ Nuits Sonores 2026
metas.description: Lyon’s Nuit Sonores festival welcomes two living legends of Detroit techno to the party: Carl Craig, a towering figure in electronic music since the 1980s and Seth Troxler, one of the world’s most popular DJs according to Resident Advisor.

metas.name: Trapped in a Comic Book
metas.description: Our main fella awakes, but when he does he is no longer in his normal world. He is confined to a comic book. He must confront his past to make it out and right his wrongs, before the darker side of him takes over. A story told in two parts four years apart, in which throughout the years he gains perspective to help him defeat the darkness once and for all. Like Mega Strathdene, but if he was cool. Theres cool shit and explosions though.

metas.name: Bite Back
metas.description: At the end of their first date, Lexie tries to let Tristan down easy. Unable to handle the rejection, Tristan kidnaps Lexie to “teach her a lesson” with the help of his friends Luke and Kyle. However, their arrogance quickly wears off as they realize that they are in over their heads and they kidnapped the wrong girl.

metas.name: Balkan Roma
metas.description: A short documentary depicting a broad historical picture of the Roma - from their origins and journey from India more than a thousand years ago, to their life today in the Balkans and Macedonia.

metas.name: Thank you for the roses, thank you for the thorns.
metas.description: Trapped in their own thoughts, a young person whose life and identity have always been shaped by others must confront their traumas to finally become themselves, detach from their past and finally move forward to be proud of who they truly are.

metas.name: LVLS Agituoja
metas.description: The LVLS Party invites you to vote

metas.name: Su Gimtadieniu, Ponas Prezidente
metas.description: Come one, come all to see Kazys Grinius's 60th birthday party, which is sure to be one for the history books...

metas.name: Vita & Mortem
metas.description: Life and Death have a conversation, as their true intentions emerge, so do visions of a world doomed by time.

metas.name: The Case of the Lipstick Killer
metas.description: Detective Sam Phelps and his partner Henry Vincennes try to solve a case of mysterious murders.  Written and directed by Brennan DeCow, produced by the Davis catalyst center

metas.name: Dance Fight
metas.description: Dance Fight is an action-comedy about a young man with a penchant for dance who enters the tournament of a lifetime against his long-time idol, the greatest dancer in the world!

metas.name: Oru Durooha Saahacharyathil
metas.description: Humble health care worker Sethu lives a quiet life caring for his sick brother — until a mysterious armed fugitive seeks refuge in his home.

metas.name: Pink Ozs
metas.description: Khris, a shy lesbian haunted by a Greek chorus of judgmental church ladies in her head, must silence her internalized shame and confront romantic rivalry at her art gallery job to finally embrace her sexuality and pursue love.

metas.name: Screw Mickiewicz 3
metas.description: Dante struggles to reconcile his dreams with reality, while his relationship with Nel is tested. Then the mysterious Adam appears. In the background: the return of Korek, new feelings for Cegła, and the question of whether loyalty, friendship, and love can survive in the adult world.

metas.name: Far from Maine
metas.description: Haunted by the killing by Israeli police of a Palestinian friend from his youth, an Israeli queer filmmaker embarks on a cinematic dialogue across time — confronting memory, friendship, and the genocide unfolding today.  In this intimate cinematic letter, Israeli filmmaker Roy Cohen addresses his Palestinian friend and fellow peace activist Aseel Aslih, who was murdered by Israeli police in their youth. Cohen tells Aslih of his experiences navigating a growingly genocidal society and seeks Aslih’s moral clarity and resilience in the evocative letters he had written as a teenager.

metas.name: Milk Teeth
metas.description: Romania, 1989. The twilight of Nicolae Ceaușescu’s dictatorship. In a small, isolated town, Maria, a ten-year-old girl, is the last person to witness her sister disappearing before her eyes. Torn apart by the loss, she tries to make sense of a new, terrifying reality. Can she summon the courage to grow up?

metas.name: Made With Love
metas.description: Inside a top-secret government facility, Agent Boro, an intense and serious veteran, along with his partner Agent Maltrax, the dimwitted newbie, question and interrogate Talon Penndle, a disgruntled and laid-back coffee barista who wants to go home after his eight-hour shift. Talon is under fire, however, because he is rumored to have overheard a huge government secret from one of the other agents during their coffee break, which could mean mass panic if it were to get out to the masses.

metas.name: Is God Is
metas.description: Two sisters embark on an epic quest for revenge, confronting a charged family history that pushes them to extraordinary lengths.

metas.name: Boiling Point
metas.description: A bar regular is forced to prove he can drink boiling water, but after a freak accident, he unexpectedly rises to citywide fame as the legendary “Hot Water Master.”

metas.name: The Catcher
metas.description: Robin, a lonely young man, works for the government as a catcher of invisible birds. One day he defies his orders and makes one dangerous choice.

metas.name: Two Mountains Weighing Down My Chest
metas.description: A Chinese misfit ricochets between Berlin’s alternative frenzy and Beijing’s family order, transforming cultural whiplash into an offbeat search for identity and a playful quest for belonging.

metas.name: Brothers Under Fire
metas.description: Captain Jordan Wright's squadron on leave for a wedding in Mexico encounters a murderous cartel. As Jordan tries to lead survivors to safety, war erupts between his squad and the cartel, forcing him into a battle to save his men.

metas.name: Pahaad
metas.description: The story about resilience of people living in the mountains of Nepal, navigating survival and hardship.

metas.name: Whispers in May
metas.description: In the rural Liangshan Mountains, 14-year-old Qihuo and her friends embark on a road trip to find a skirt for her traditional menarche rite of passage.

metas.name: LE SSERAFIM VR CONCERT : INVITATION
metas.description: A virtual reality concert experience featuring LE SSERAFIM, offering an immersive and intimate performance that brings viewers closer than ever to the group through cutting-edge VR technology.

metas.name: Yuki Johnson - Detroit's Vigilante
metas.description: In racially divided Detroit, Yuki Johnson, a biracial teenager, transforms into the Detroit Vigilante after his father, a police officer, is targeted by a menacing gang.

metas.name: Rodin et Michel-Ange, le chant des statues
Phantasm & Elizabeth Kenny @ The Journey of Instruments
metas.description: A direct descendant of the oud, the European lute takes centre stage in this concert by Elizabeth Kenny & Phantasm. With its ‘The Journey of Instruments’ series, the Salle Pierre Boulez in Berlin offers a fascinating musical journey tracing the history of the oud, one of the oldest stringed instruments.

metas.name: Return to the Moon
metas.description: A half-century after American astronauts walked on the Moon, NASA and its international partners are taking the dream of Apollo a giant step further. In the coming years, the Artemis missions – named after Apollo's twin sister in Greek mythology – aim to bring astronauts back to the Moon and establish a lunar space station for scientific and commercial exploration. Follow the four members of the Artemis II crew as they embark on a perilous 10-day journey to orbit the Moon, venturing beyond Earth orbit for the first time since Apollo and farther into the Solar System than any humans have gone before. And get an inside look at the preparations needed to overcome the extreme engineering challenges of human-crewed spaceflight, all the way from launch to splashdown.

metas.name: Kiss and Ride
metas.description: Two lovers drive off in a bit of a hurry. They have a well-filled trunk that forces them to rush.

metas.name: Curious Friend
metas.description: A hedgehog meets a child who has lost a loved one.

metas.name: Inside the Dream: Audemars Piguet
metas.description: A secretive and codified world, Haute Horlogerie rarely invites cameras behind the scenes. For the first time, Audemars Piguet opens its doors, unveiling the creation of a unique timepiece. In the heart of the Vallée de Joux, designers, artisans, watchmakers and engineers come together to push the limits of their craft and bring an exceptional watch to life.

metas.name: OPERA DI MUXARO: Ballante dell’Africana Errante
metas.description: “Opera di Muxaro: Ballata dell’Africana Errante” (Ballad of the Wandering African) is a new short film by British-Nigerian artist Zina Saro-Wiwa shot entirely in Sant’Angelo di Muxaro in the Agrigento region of Sicily. The film, which was conceived, shot and edited in two weeks is about existing in peace during war and existence as war during peace time. The film is about the cognitive and emotional dissonance of surviving societal collapse but finding yourself in an almost problematically beautiful place that suggests sanctuary and maybe even the afterlife.

metas.name: Don't Make Me Bless You
metas.description: Don't Make Me Bless You is a gripping urban drama about Raine, a salon owner who falls for Dre, a charming ex-con rebuilding his life after prison. a dangerous cycle of control and violence, forcing Raine to confront the truth about love.

metas.name: Akik "buffalo" nélkül is megisszák a levét
Orange Peel
metas.description: While walking through a market, a girl’s eye is caught by an orange. However, her whole world unravels when she loses it.

metas.name: Providence
metas.description: Erica Schreiner short.

metas.name: Brad Wenzel: Desperate Times
metas.description: Full stand up special from comedy's own, Brad Wenzel.  Brad Wenzel is a product of the Detroit Comedy scene, spent a 7 year stint in Los Angeles, and over the last 15 years has toured the country performing in 38 states. Wenzel has made 3 stand-up appearances on CONAN and more recently performed on Netflix is a Joke Radio and Don't Tell Comedy. His 2017 debut comedy album Sweet Nothings was released on Jack White’s rock label, Third Man Records and can be heard on SiriusXM. Paste Magazine described Brad’s 2023 special, joke. joke. joke. as “Watching Wenzel feels like hanging out with your funniest, weirdest friend; it's relaxing and utterly enjoyable" Paste also listed joke. joke. joke. as one of the 20 best comedy specials of the year.

metas.name: Little Rock
metas.description: Little Rock, tells the story of Lana, a teenager learning to live with her dad's decline. It's a story about music, memory, and the painful beauty of love that endures, even when recognition begins to fade.

metas.name: Dirty Money: Colston's Legacy
metas.description: A short expository documentary looking at the dividing opinions and legacy of Edward Colston in Bristol

metas.name: ONE SECOND LATE
metas.description: A man races to catch a train for a job interview... but what if one decision could alter his future forever? Two strangers, three realities, one small moment that changes everything.

metas.name: Mother Tongue
metas.description: When a spirited ten-year-old boy is mocked in class for calling "sign language" his mother tongue, he must rediscover pride in his identity, with the quiet support of his grandmother and the love that language can hold beyond words.

metas.name: In Passing
metas.description: Two young romantics, Maya and Alex, navigate life in the same city, their lives unfolding in parallel as they unknowingly cross paths again and again. As they each search for love in their own way, their near encounters hint at something more.

metas.name: 第十六届北京国际电影节开幕式红毯仪式
My Other Half
metas.description: In this tense urban thriller, grief opens the door to danger as Mia becomes the target of a calculated scheme, forcing her to outplay her predators before they finish the job they started.

metas.name: Edinburgh 2026
metas.description: A short home movie documenting a road trip from Liverpool, England to Edinburgh, Scotland, up the M6 and through Hartside Pass - both ways.  A questionable decision, in hindsight.  Featuring questionable navigation, Tesco Clubcard economics, and a surprisingly capable small car.

metas.name: CROSSED
metas.description: A young lady is seemingly going "crazy" while being tormented by and unknown source, when attempting to confide in her boyfriend and friends they slowly withdrawal from her "nonsense"

metas.name: Dragongate USA: The Gate Of Sin City
metas.description: High-speed technical wrestling and legendary tradition collide in the heart of the desert as Dragongate USA presents The Gate Of Sin City, a premier event held at the Horseshoe Las Vegas as part of The Collective 2026.

metas.name: PoderMania~! 2026
metas.description: The ‘Power of Lucha' ignites the Las Vegas Strip as PoderMania~! makes its high-octane debut as part of The Collective 2026. Streaming live on TrillerTV+, this afternoon spectacle at Horseshoe Las Vegas kicks off the Wednesday festivities of The Collective and TrillerTV's Mania Week.

metas.name: Mouthful of Soil
metas.description: Trees, Flowers, Hands and Mirrors. An exercise in movement and focus. Black & White, Silent.

metas.name: The Loud House: European Adventure
metas.description: The Louds are headed to Europe, where they'll attend a knighting ceremony in London, search for the world's best pizza in Italy, spend a night in a creepy castle in Transylvania, ski the Swiss alps, and time-travel to ancient Greece!

metas.name: The Yellow Telephone
metas.description: Take a small bag of popcorn, put the movie on the big screen and turn off the lights, only to realize after 5 minutes you have watched a thriller that would usually take an hour and a half.

metas.name: Sprite and the Pastor
metas.description: Adventist youth from Liepāja made a little short film.

metas.name: Date Night
metas.description: Strange things occur for a couple after their first date...

metas.name: Sorry
metas.description: Jack Mumford stars in the latest music video film as a weirdo with a bowtie, no further questions asked.

metas.name: The Bunny Mask
metas.description: The main character has a completely normal life, until one day a strange bunny mask appears on their bedside table. No matter what they do, this mask will not go away. The mask begins to deteriorate along with the main character's life.

metas.name: Hello
metas.description: A short film

metas.name: Cayetana Everyone's Duchess
metas.description: A documentary that chronicles the luxurious life of the Duchess of Alba, Cayetana Fitz-James Stuart; one of the most significant figures of the Spanish aristocracy of the 20th century

metas.name: Scenes
metas.description: Twelve fragments of various situations.

metas.name: Gen Hoshino presents MAD HOPE MAD MUSIC
metas.description: Celebrating the release of his sixth album, Gen Hoshino takes the stage on his sold-out Gen Hoshino presents MAD HOPE tour in this Netflix-only edit.

metas.name: The Million Dollar Man
metas.description: Two independent hitmen get stuck in a lift while their oblivious bounty waits impatiently outside…

metas.name: Trip Ziggurat
metas.description: A road trip to a Ziggurat in Colorado sparks connection between Arabs in the state. Filmmaker, Usama Alshaibi, embarks on a journey to the Crestone Ziggurat. His personal pilgrimage intertwines with the stories of other Arabs in Boulder who find ways of bringing their homelands to the state.

metas.name: MACAAN
metas.description: When a Somali immigrant joins an adult ESL class, he romantically pursues an uninterested classmate all while navigating the many challenges of the modern immigrant experience.

metas.name: Mors 44 | .556
metas.description: Ella Verneuil Capulet arrives at Jamie Murdock's apartment to borrow their gun.

metas.name: On The Other Side of The Altar
metas.description: A priest leads a double life with no restraint, ignoring the boundaries and the consequences of surpassing them.

metas.name: The Ovvlog
metas.description: Documenting a group of thespians as they traverse NYC, visionary director Ovcharov takes the audience up close and personal as we see their triumphs... and their pitfalls.

metas.name: Umbag
metas.description: Two estranged sisters reunite but a tragedy tears them apart once more. As tensions rise, their struggles lead to the boxing ring, where their fight for redemption, forgiveness, and the true meaning of family takes center stage.

metas.name: Quando Ninguém Vê
metas.description: Ana is a dedicated student who appears to be fine, but she faces constant pressure from school and expectations around her. Little by little, the exhaustion and difficulty in expressing herself begin to show, even if no one notices at first.  When the situation reaches its limit, a moment of listening within the school changes everything. The short film shows how young people’s mental health often goes unnoticed and how spaces for support can be the first step toward change.

metas.name: The Spy Who Tasted Tea
metas.description: Max Bourke (played by Max Bourke) tastes tea in his boost juice, and in an effort to find out why, he has to infiltrate British HQ.

metas.name: Dreams
metas.description: Plagued by stressful dreams and wrestling with grief, an anxious man reaches out for help from a—let’s say—nontraditional mental health provider.

metas.name: Manslayer
metas.description: A female journalist wants to cover the male-targeting killer Manslayer but struggles to find freedom in her sexist office—until Manslayer himself pays it a visit and she has to help him escape with her male co-workers hot on their trail.

metas.name: Self-Rendered
metas.description: Samuel tries to get his essay completed before the deadline.

metas.name: Las almas ni los ojos
metas.description: After fleeing violence at age 15, Pacho spends four decades away from Anserma. Now a photograph sparks a desire to return, and on his journey home —imagined as an interstellar voyage— he searches for what he left behind. The lingering traces of death intertwine with a landscape of rural expressionism, memory, and history

metas.name: Manual para Invocar Fantasmas
metas.description: Between 1950 and 1960, members of Opus Dei arrived in Colombia to expand their influence in Latin America. In 2021, the complaint against this organization by 43 women for trafficking and exploitation reopened the historical wound. In an exercise of imaginative memory, a group of actresses enters an abandoned school to create a play inspired by those silenced lives.

metas.name: The Proctor
metas.description: A 56-year-old man stuck repeating senior year since 1986 gets one last shot at graduation when a new state exam system forces him to face the test he's spent decades avoiding.

metas.name: VAPE SHOW (1-3)
metas.description: A snapshot into the lives of several people living in small town Minnesota.

metas.name: Sandra: The Drift Queen
metas.description: The Drift Queen is a high-octane documentary feature following Sandra Janusauskaite - a fierce and resilient woman carving her path in the male-dominated world of professional drifting. Filmed across Europe - from Spain, Latvia, and Lithuania to Hungary, Germany, Estonia, Greece, and Cyprus - the film captures the sport's intense physical and technical demands, along with the emotional and psychological toll it takes. Through Sandra's eyes, we witness the grit behind the glamour: the podiums, the breakdowns, the comebacks, and the relentless pursuit of speed. It's more than a racing story - it's a raw, cinematic journey into passion, identity, and what it takes to lead in a world that rarely hands over the keys.

metas.name: Woven
metas.description: A portrait of 99-year-old polish textile artist Krystyna-Wojtyna Drouet in her day-to-day life in a small studio in Warsaw. Her hands weave wool threads on the loom, intertwining with verses of her poetry, memories, photos from travels and recipes for natural dyes, revealing a sensorial and poetic glimpse into her inner world.

metas.name: A Person of the Forest
metas.description: In this ghostly tale, Pennell turns her forensic eye to the history of the Dutch “cultivation system” in Indonesia. “I am a ghost returned to tell the tale from the place where the end began”, says the narrator, a stand-in for the many primates violently extracted from their jungle habitats to be exhibited in museums and fairs in Europe.

metas.name: Orgullo y Prejuicio
metas.description: The shoot of an adaptation of the Jane Austen classic set in contemporary Mar del Plata.

metas.name: The Black Bart of Taco King #17
metas.description: A suave larcenist searches for a new partner at a dive bar and finds the perfect Bonnie to his Clyde. He takes her to dinner to put her to the test, yet she has all the answers... and more.

metas.name: Confession
metas.description: Two friends, Alex and Jordan, reflect on their past, one last time.

metas.name: CINE SEXO JUEGO
metas.description: A documentary portrait that encapsulates the ten lives of Gonzalo García Pelayo, producer, film director and gaming professional, in eight dizzying minutes.

metas.name: Clay
metas.description: Chaired by the city’s mayor, Rodick Bobo, a relative of the filmmaker’s, motions are moved, seconded and voted on. Pay rises for city employees, permits for food trucks, and other matters of municipal governance are discussed in view of the camera’s fixed frame. Against a wider backdrop of decrepit democratic systems in the country, a portrait of an attempt at earnest, accountable politics in the USA emerges.

metas.name: Películas
metas.description: Two friends sketch the horizon somewhere in the Basque country, where the sky meets the mountain and the sea. Later, in a dark room, film reels from a previous project (8 topaketa) are projected onto a body that acts as screen

metas.name: Know Who You Are At Every Age
metas.description: An excerpt from a dream

metas.name: Crónico- Nicolás de Tracy
metas.description: Nicolas De Tracy's Stand-Up Comedy Special

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Run Run
metas.description: While the apocalypse is approaching, Elia, tormented by his desire to love and be loved, and his best friend Milo, tormented by the thought to be nothing but rage, are eager to make their short existence remarkable, so they desperately try to fix their personal torments before it all ends. The quest leads them to face some unspoken issues in their relationship.

metas.name: Dear Juhee
metas.description: After recovering from leukemia, Jang Juhee, who once dreamed of becoming a filmmaker, begins working at a center for independent living for people with disabilities. There, she meets documentary director Bu Seongpil, disabled and bedridden Seon Cheol-gyu, and In-sook, who lost a family member in the Sewol ferry tragedy. Shaped by childhood memories of domestic violence and years of illness-induced isolation, Jang’s gaze and inner world begin to expand through these individuals.

metas.name: Have You Seen the Land of the Red?
metas.description: Nicknamed the ‘heart of conservatives,’ Gyeongsangbuk-do (North Gyeongsang Province) is the conservative stronghold of Korean politics, having not elected a single liberal Democratic Party member to the National Assembly in the past 30 years. From the 2022 local elections to the 2024 general election, TV-writer-turned-filmmaker Hong Youngah documents the uphill battle of Democratic Party candidates, clad in signature blue jackets, in this ‘land of the red.’

metas.name: Affection Affection
metas.description: In the winter on the French Riviera, a teenage girl goes missing on her birthday. Géraldine, an employee in the mayor's office, takes on the role of detective. Versions of the truth rapidly multiply as she struggles not to be overwhelmed by all the gossip and theories.

metas.name: The Mad Dog of Europe
metas.description: A documentary exploring the 1933 screenplay of the same name by Citizen Kane co-writer Herman Mankiewicz, which warned of Adolf Hitler's rise to power, but was rejected by Hollywood studios at the time.

metas.name: Toaster
