metas.description: Murder and chaos erupt when a miser becomes obsessed with a toaster he gave as a wedding gift.

metas.name: Death of a Seagull
metas.description: An upcoming short film starring and written & directed by Ainaz Azarhoush.

metas.name: Just an Illusion
metas.description: 1985. Vincent, almost 13, lives in the suburbs of Paris in a middle-class family, between a distant older brother and parents in constant conflict. Although he is no longer a child and not yet an adult, the film follows his reflections and doubts about identity, friendship, family, and his questions about religion, desire, and love.

metas.name: The Yeast
metas.description: Da-seul, an outstanding student both in personality and academics, is eighteen this year. However, she has an unusual quirk—she loves makgeolli (Korean rice wine) so much that she secretly sips it even at school, carrying it in empty cosmetic bottles. Her family took over a traditional makgeolli brewery when they moved to their current town during her childhood. The brewery is known for sticking to the old-fashioned method of using only yeast, rice, and water, and its flavor is highly praised among the locals. The secret to its taste lies in a mysterious yeast that had been in the brewery since they took over.

metas.name: Istanbul Calling
metas.description: Deniz, a woman from Marseille whose parents kept her away from her roots, discovers the existence of Alev, her paternal great aunt, through an anonymous package. In the Istanbul of the 1960s, a detective investigated this young woman, who was mysteriously erased from familial memory. This is the debut feature by Alexandre Büyükodabaş, inspired by Chris Marker’ın La Jetée.

metas.name: Truly Naked
metas.description: An introverted teen, who has only ever experienced sex through the lens while working for his father’s pornography business, must step out from behind the camera when a feisty classmate challenges him to embrace a real connection.

metas.name: Une fille en or
metas.description: On the day Clémence realizes that no one has ever admired her, her father dies. Lulled by the illusions of the remnants of a complicated childhood, Clémence has no choice but to rebuild her self-esteem, which she never thought could be so low. When fate brings her together with a certain Paul, whom everyone nicknames Paul Pot because of his strong tendency toward tyranny, Clémence asks herself the only question that matters: is this the right person?

metas.name: Balls Up
metas.description: Two marketing executives go "balls out" and pitch a bold full‑coverage condom sponsorship with the World Cup. After their drunken celebration in Brazil sparks a global scandal, they must outrun furious fans, criminals, and power-hungry officials to salvage their careers and make it home alive.

metas.name: Pallichattambi
metas.description: Set in the politically turbulent late 1950s, Krishnan Pillai, a playful ruffian chosen by the Church to lead a defensive force, the Christopher Sena. His mission to resist the Communist government takes a detour when he experiences an ideological awakening and falls in love with a comrade, sparking an epic tale of rebellion against feudal power and oppression.

metas.name: Artemis: To the Moon and Back
metas.description: The inside story of the Artemis II mission - filmed over three and a half years at NASA. How did four astronauts travel to the moon, going deeper into space than ever before?

metas.name: 11 Men and 1 Bus
metas.description: Eight men, on their way to a film set, get stranded on a random road when the bus they were on breaks down. Each reacts to the event in a different way. Interpersonal conflicts dictate how and when they will manage to escape the situation.

metas.name: Heard
metas.description: HEARD profiles Hard of Hearing (HoH) creatives across BC who use their hearing loss to further their practice as artists and creatives. Guided by HoH filmmaker Brian Ceci, the film visually explores the everyday lived experiences in a dramatic and comedic way, contextualizing for the audience what it's truly like to live with hearing loss.

metas.name: STRANGER/GYAMBO
metas.description: Stranger is a short narrative film produced for Esports IITR that explores themes of identity, loss, and resurrection. Through the journey of a competitive athlete struggling with failure and self-doubt, the film captures the feeling of becoming a stranger to oneself and the strength it takes to return. Told through atmospheric visuals and raw emotion, Stranger is a story about falling apart, rebuilding, and rising once more.

metas.name: The Straight & Narrow
metas.description: A young man realizes that post-graduation life isn't all it's cracked up to be. As he struggles to adjust to the mundane nature of the 9-5, he questions life's true meaning and the value of a dollar over one's goals and dreams.

metas.name: The Happiest Time
metas.description: A man looks back on his childhood.

metas.name: Notes?
metas.description: A young boy still has his lovers old notes.

metas.name: Suspension
metas.description: A magical cabeceo in a tango ballroom takes two passionate souls on an intimate journey. Their words flow seamlessly through a dreamlike dance, revealing the heart of their bond as they navigate desire, fear, and love left unfolded.

metas.name: Betting On A Dead Man
metas.description: Benny Grimm is a well-renowned mafia boss who runs the streets of Gilbert. But one night, everything changes.

metas.name: Murabi
metas.description: In every family, there is a guiding force, the Murabi. This Odia feature film explores the collision and convergence of two contrasting philosophies: one rooted in discipline and control, the other in joy and freedom. As life brings these worlds together, the story unfolds into a heartwarming journey that challenges, inspires, and ultimately redefines the true meaning of family, love, and togetherness.

metas.name: the wrong witness
metas.description: After his father's murder, Eyal is kidnapped by a group of criminals who believe he knows where tapes related to his father's investigation are hidden.

metas.name: Delirium
metas.description: Jude, tormented by a relentless dream, has each night stolen by fear everyday consumed by exhaustion. His avoidance then search for understanding descends him into madness.

metas.name: The Bible. So What?
metas.description: The Bible. So What? aims to provoke and address the kinds of questions a spectator might have about the Bible, which, although frequently overlooked, has shaped the moral, legal and cultural foundation of the Western world for the past 1,600 years.  I aim to challenge the postmodern relativist impulse to find new meanings as I try to reorient the spectator towards the ‘grand narrative’ of the Bible. By reading it themselves, viewers may discover a deeper sense of meaning, purpose, personal significance, direction and ultimate truth in the Christian gospel, a personally meaningful metanarrative grounded in history, tradition and revelation.  Although I present a single perspective due to the time constraints of my brief, the counterargument to my film is already present, as misrepresentations of the Christian faith frequently obscure and corrupt public impressions of the Bible. Therefore, I want to draw the focus back to the Bible, what it says, and show that it is worth reading.

metas.name: Dual Citizen
metas.description: In 2012, the Haitian government amended the country’s constitution to allow dual citizenship. Filmmaker Rachelle Salnave is eager to reclaim her Haitian citizenship, but the process is far from simple: To do so, her father, Edouard, must reclaim his first before she can. Edouard, a New York Republican who has not set foot in Haiti in more than 50 years, reluctantly agrees to help his daughter, which means engaging with a country and government he has kept at arm’s length since his family’s political exile in the 1960s. This humorous and heartfelt documentary is both a father-daughter road trip and a meditation on what it means to hold two national identities.

metas.name: Capio
metas.description: An amateur astronomer discovers a strange new star in the sky that leads him into the heart of a dark conspiracy to control humanity by exploiting its addiction to technology.

metas.name: Tag! You’re It!
metas.description: One night in an art museum, Sunny and Pippin, two girls living inside of the paintings, play a game of tag spanning the history of human art.

metas.name: The Hollywood Rabbi
metas.description: How does the child of immigrants, raised on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, become Frank Sinatra’s personal rabbi, win two Academy Awards, mingle with four kings, three popes, eight presidents and a who’s who of Hollywood royalty while dedicating his life to healing the world through tolerance?

metas.name: Odessa
metas.description: In the wake of WWII, a devoted father guides his fleeing family across the Dolomites. He is gentle with his son. And running for a reason.

metas.name: Fly
metas.description: A queer coming-of-age romance about Skylar, a young Black ballet prodigy navigating the cost of perfection. A scholarship student at an elite ballet academy, Skylar channels fear and the weight of expectation into absolute discipline. When their mother falls behind on tuition, and the academy announces a paid professional apprenticeship, Skylar’s pursuit of excellence becomes a matter of survival. Their carefully controlled world is disrupted by Jay’ko, a gifted classmate whose free-spirited artistry contrasts sharply with Skylar’s precision. What begins as rivalry slowly deepens into intimacy, challenging Skylar’s belief that greatness comes from control alone. As the final audition approaches, Skylar must decide whether to cling to perfection or risk vulnerability in pursuit of artistic freedom.

metas.name: A Homecoming
metas.description: Doug, a newly transitioning trans woman, has yet to take a new name. When she returns home with her pregnant partner for her parents’ 40th Anniversary, her mother unexpectedly struggles. Recognizing the fear behind the resistance, Doug extends to her mother an extraordinary gesture of grace.

metas.name: DOG
metas.description: A short documentary about multidisciplinary artist Kirill Kukushkin, who specializes in working with natural materials. The film shows his work on a dog's head on the Hrazdan Bridge in Yerevan.

metas.name: Wǒmen - I followed a stranger to China
metas.description: Saying yes to a stranger who writes to you to suggest that you follow in the footsteps of her childhood in China... This is the crazy challenge that Louanne took on by accepting Laura's proposal. On one condition: travel by train.

metas.name: The neighbor
metas.description: Alice sneaks into her neighbor's apartment that almost caught fire. Wracked by anxiety, then loneliness, she returns more than once to his place and crosses certain boundaries.

metas.name: The Connection
metas.description: When three roommates discover their everyday items start going missing, they each try to figure out the source of the mystery.

metas.name: Lost In Thought
metas.description: After finding a photo of a girl in the pocket of a vintage Coat, Charlie introduces himself to the love of his life. As he dates the love of his life, Hope, he must decide whether a relationship with her is reality, or is it all in his head.

metas.name: COACH
metas.description: After receiving some tough news from her upset mother, Ellie gains a mentor in the midst of trouble.

metas.name: Mein Leben nach dem Notenschnitt
metas.description: What next after secondary school? Before they finish school, Sven, Florina and Mara need to figure out what’s right for them. It’s not that easy. In the 2021 SRF DOK documentary “Mein Leben und der Notenschnitt”, they were grappling with their school grades in Year 6. Today, they are no longer children and face new questions: What do I want? What am I capable of? What do my parents think? An emotional rollercoaster ride in search of their own path.

metas.name: Helena & Demetrius, Act 2 Scene 1
metas.description: Helena and Demetrius reckon with their friendship and romance in the woods. Based on William Shakespeare's 'A Midsummer Night's Dream,' Act 2 Scene 1.

metas.name: Lousy connection
metas.description: A young wolf from southern China discovers a new world through his screen, but is he losing his identity? This boundary pushing experimental short film is the hottest thing this summer!

metas.name: Copper Oxidizing
metas.description: The gradual transformation of copper through oxidation reflects the spirit of deconstruction, turning material change into a metaphor.

metas.name: The Climate Change Volumes: Fall
metas.description: Following the changing seasons of the Mountain West, The Climate Change Volumes: Fall ponders fall’s delay as warmer summers extend and keep this transitory season from occurring during its normal time on our calendars.

metas.name: what does it feel like to live inside of a pomegranate?
metas.description: A young woman discovers a giant pomegranate in the middle of the forest and decides to live inside it.

metas.name: SJOR | Rise of the North
metas.description: In a distant future, an ancient artifact falls into the hands of a young girl, making her the only thing standing between an ambitious emperor and divine power.  SJOR is a fully CG-animated short film and the foundation of a much larger world.

metas.name: Stay Until You Can’t
metas.description: Two women must navigate a growing relationship and a zombie outbreak that turned only straight people.

metas.name: Kenopsia
metas.description: After falling into the strange liminal world of her own canvas, struggling artist Alex must revisit her past and confront her fears in order to find her way home.  Inspired by liminal spaces and The Backrooms, Kenopsia was written to explore the phenomenon of liminality and what happens when we go through stages of liminal space in our real lives. Liminal space isn't just physical, we enter periods of liminality in our lives whenever we transition from one life stage to the next, e.g. graduation, coming of age/adolescence, breaking up, marriage, pregnancy, moving house, grief. Liminality is something we will all experience at some point or another in our lifetime, and as such it's important to know how to navigate and grow from the experience. After all, you wouldn't want to be stuck in limbo forever would you?

metas.name: Three Angles
metas.description: On the night before the Final Four, a rising college basketball star relives the same dream across shifting timelines. Trapped between past, present, and potential, he must overcome his deepest fear before it costs him everything. This non-linear psychological drama explores identity, trauma and the silent struggle with mental health in the athlete community.

metas.name: Dreaming Ecosystems
metas.description: A collaborative botanicollage film poem by participants in the festival workshop, Dreaming Ecosystems, led by poet Mita Mahato and filmmaker Caryn Cline.

metas.name: Joe Dombrowski: Dad on Arrival
metas.description: In his latest special, Joe Dombrowski steps into his biggest role yet...Dad.  Filmed live at Olsen Run Comedy Club in Eugene, Oregon, the hour captures Joe on the brink of fatherhood as he and his husband prepare for their first child, while realizing he may be wildly unprepared. With his signature sharp wit, Joe dives into the chaos of IVF, the shock of how little he knows about the female anatomy, and the trend of babies being given names better suited for retirement communities. He also hilariously tackles the question every gay couple hears: “So... who’s the dad?”

metas.name: Medium Rare
metas.description: Medium Rare is a story of a man who prepares a piece of meat in the usual way: seasoning it, cooking it, and finally enjoying it.

metas.name: Ruins Within Ruins
metas.description: A group of dancers positions themselves between the ancient and modern ruins of the island of Crete, Greece.

metas.name: Grandpa's Graveyard
metas.description: After the death of his father, a young TV writer must face his family’s trauma head on with the help of his new assistant, Gary the Horse.

metas.name: Coming Back Home
metas.description: A short documentary that reveals the background to the historic restoration of Money from Home.

metas.name: Luces Artificiales
metas.description: An introspective short film about loneliness and how it can affect a person. Explores what a person does to use loneliness to clear his mind, aware that giving too much power to that feeling can be dangerous.

metas.name: Epilepsja
metas.description: A young man is fulfilling his dreams by playing a few levels of Geometry Dash, easy demon level.

metas.name: Put Your Records On
metas.description: Put Your Records on is a student documentary about the state of physical media in our modern digital world. Diving deep into our personal relationships with physical media.

metas.name: NOTHING WILL COME OF NOTHING
metas.description: Nurture, nature, voicemails, photographs.

metas.name: I Am Looking for An Apartment In Hamburg
metas.description: Affordable housing is scarce in Hamburg.

metas.name: 12 Angry Men
metas.description: A juror attempts to convince the other 11 jurors to question the guilt of a 16 year old boy accused of killing his father.

metas.name: Intérêt de vie
metas.description: A young man in the midst of an existential and identity crisis, returns to his native region following the oppression he feels in the city. He will begin to ask questions about the meaning of his life, affecting him even more mentally.

metas.name: Halina Ni Aliya
metas.description: Get an exclusive look at VMX star Aliya Raymundo’s irresistible charm and the roles that made her shine. Don’t miss these sizzling sneak peeks that will turn up the heat and make your summer even hotter.

metas.name: The House of the Wind
metas.description: In this expressive and community-centered work, Wayuú director Marbel Vanegas Jusayu documents the social, spiritual, and environmental impacts of the installation of a wind farm in Apotnojushi, a historically marginalized community that remains committed to its sovereignty. Women leaders such as Ana Rosa Jusayu, the director’s mother, work to strengthen the social fabric, activate historical memory, and assert their right to determine their future. Through the voices and living portraits of community members, the piece reflects in its vignettes the community’s deep connection to its ancestral territory.

metas.name: Suite Intercontinental
metas.description: From the 30th floor of a glass tower, the city of Cali, gripped by tension, bubbles beneath Margot’s gaze. Blinded by the tropical sun, Margot wanders through the city, oblivious to it all. Far from others and her surroundings, her fantasies merge with reality. Her gaze meets that of a man on the street, his chest bare and his eyes piercing. Every day, Margot follows the young man, slowly drawing closer to the object of her desire.

metas.name: Nos cœurs sur la main
metas.description: A meeting of media, director, and artist, Nos coeurs sur la main is a musical adventure following Ino Casablanca. The project captures a day-long performance blurring the lines between music and fiction, retracing the live recording of a discography in perpetual motion, all within a race against time orchestrated by a peculiar producer, Franck. Across over an hour of music, director Toxine fictionalizes Ino Casablanca's repertoire while upholding the rapper's core values: playing from the heart, unity, and sharing. It serves as a powerful reminder that every musical journey is, at its core, a collective one.

metas.name: Oscar Perez:: The Movie
metas.description: Óscar Pérez, an elite police officer, accuses Nicolás Maduro and his cabinet of running Venezuela as a narco-terrorist enterprise and embarks on a mission to bring them to international justice. The regime hunts him down and executes him in front of the entire nation.  Through his own voice, testimonies from his mother, family members, colleagues, and allies, and an archive of evidence comprised of citizen footage, official documents, and expert reports, the documentary traces the journey of this operation to its execution at the hands of state security forces, revealing the true cost of freedom.

metas.name: Caught in the Crackdown
metas.description: FRONTLINE and ProPublica trace the violence, protests and arrests stemming from federal immigration sweeps across the United States. The documentary examines the tactics, legal cases and impact — from Los Angeles to Chicago to Minneapolis.

metas.name: GW:s mord – Skultunamordet
metas.description: The morning calm is broken in Skultuna and Rönnby in Västerås when a VMA is sent out and residents are asked to stay indoors. The police are hunting a 38-year-old suspect after two brutal violent crimes. A child calls 112 and says that his mother is being attacked. Shortly afterwards, a woman is found dead in her home. Leif GW Persson examines the case and the legal process.

metas.name: The Colours I Can't See
metas.description: A series of tableaus about living in Australia.

metas.name: The Story of the Cricket Queen
metas.description: The “Story of The Cricket Queen” recreates digital media tropes, trends, and aesthetics with analog film techniques.

metas.name: Vaivén
metas.description: Vaivén follows three generations of beachgoers from sunrise to sunset in Barcelona - a study of patterns, rhythm, and the natural cadence of a day at the beach.

metas.name: Modern Art
metas.description: A withdrawn security guard drifts through life until an encounter with an artist sparks a quiet awakening, leading him to begin exploring where his own sense of art might lie.

metas.name: RN 72, à la conquête de l'Ouest
metas.description: As the 2027 presidential election approaches, this documentary follows the National Rally's year-long effort to establish itself in western France. Led by close allies of Marine Le Pen, the strategy culminates in several municipal victories in 2026, including the party's historic first win in the western town of La Flèche.

metas.name: Cha Gorom
metas.description: After completing her MBBS, Irin unexpectedly arrives at a remote, network-less tea estate in Sylhet, where healthcare depends mostly on paracetamol. Her friend Mithu, an aspiring artist and architecture student, joins her from Dhaka. There, they discover the harsh realities of tea workers’ lives and meet Nandini, a bright girl who dreams of becoming a doctor. Together, they help her chase that dream.

metas.name: Cuando surgen los monstruos. Conocer y confrontar el fascismo en el siglo XXI
Tanaru
metas.description: The Tanaru Indigenous Territory holds the memory and story of the 'Man of the Hole.' As the sole survivor of his people, he outlived the massacre that ravaged Rondônia during the 1990s.

metas.name: Não Existe Ninja de Pele Preta
metas.description: In the cosplay world, where anything can be adapted, a simple change in a character’s skin color still meets resistance. Amid challenges such as racial and gender prejudice, cosplayer Kami Júpiter shows that everyone can see themselves in the characters they love and that Black ninjas do exist.

metas.name: O Dia em que Minha Avó Fugiu de Casa
Proust Palimpsesto: Pastiches e Misturas
metas.description: "Proust Palimpsesto: Pastiches e Misturas" (2026) is a Brazilian film essay directed by Carlos Adriano. The film, which explores the impossibility of filming Marcel Proust's "In Search of Time That Flew", is presented as a collage of archival images and theories.

metas.name: Natureza Morta
metas.description: Upon seeing a news report about an accident involving a delivery motorcyclist, Lucas, a transmasculine photographer, thinks he recognizes João, someone he was in love with during his adolescence. Overcome by memories, he revisits images of Cohab 1 in the East Zone of São Paulo.

metas.name: The Birthday Gift
metas.description: In this playful, cross cultural family drama, an unexpected guest upends the lives of an Argentine mother and daughter over the course of an intimate birthday dinner one icy Chicago night.

metas.name: Florence is for Lovers
metas.description: A fragmented encounter on a Tuscan train leads to an unsettling meditation on intimacy, violence, and communication in this part-travelogue, part-city symphony.

metas.name: En otra Palestina
metas.description: In a remote village between mountains and the Jordan River, near a district called Jerusalem, everyday life appears to unfold in deceptive calm.

metas.name: Untold: Jail Blazers
metas.description: Volatile players. Criminal charges. National headlines. Portland's championship-caliber NBA team implodes spectacularly in this unflinching documentary.

metas.name: Alteration
metas.description: After a software developer completes a task assigned by a new superior, abnormalities occur during his journey home.

metas.name: High Noon
metas.description: A group of teens execute a robbery -- and then it hits them...

metas.name: Tumi Ami Shudhu
metas.description: Love, emotions, and the beauty of unspoken connections — Tumi Ami Shudhu brings a heartfelt romantic journey that feels real, warm, and deeply relatable.﻿

metas.name: what does it feel like to live inside a pomegranate?
metas.description: In ‘what does it feel like to live inside a pomegranate?’ Iranian-American filmmaker Kamyar Mohsenin transforms a giant pomegranate into a portal. The protagonist ambiguously consumes the fruit in interludes, reflecting the tension between nourishment and the discomfort of engaging with one’s cultural heritage.

metas.name: Portrait of Granny
metas.description: A love letter to grannies. Aina is an 88-year old retiree. Yes, health issues lay at the core of her life, but her view on life, however, is full of understanding, ease and humour. Five different phrases used by her daily reflect her personality and constitute the structure of the film.

metas.name: Special Op: Rent-a-Cop
metas.description: After falling in love and leaving Special Ops, special agent Brock Belfry finds himself working security in a small town and ends up escorting a van full of senior citizens to Las Vegas for their summer trip. But the trip will not go smoothly as he realizes that his archenemies have tracked him down and plot to take him out.

metas.name: HVAC
metas.description: In a blue-collar Missouri town, a 13-year-old HVAC apprentice grappling with confusing desires becomes entangled in a surreal, dangerous encounter at the local theatre—where longing and innocence bleed together in one irreversible night.

metas.name: A State Film
metas.description: Through rare archive footage, the documentary traces the forty years of Enver Hoxha's communist regime in Albania, revealing cinema as a weapon of power.

metas.name: First Date Conversations
metas.description: Zoe and Scott's first date is upended when she receives a difficult phone call about her estranged father. As the two delve into questions of morality, family, and conviction, the night becomes a self examination of choices and old wounds.

metas.name: A Year in London
metas.description: A sheltered Italian fashion student in London for the first time forms a intense, intimate bond with her brilliant mentor after they survive a violent robbery—forcing them to choose between ambition, boundaries, and the love they’re afraid to name.

metas.name: The Highest Stakes
metas.description: Five strangers are invited to a luxurious hotel for a high-stakes poker game. What begins as a contest for fortune quickly spirals into something far more dangerous. As tensions rise and secrets surface, the players realize the stakes aren’t just about money—they’re about survival. In a night of escalating peril, trust becomes a weapon, and every choice could seal their fate.

metas.name: The Eternal Red
metas.description: A disillusioned veteran finds himself at a war photo exhibition, where everybody else sees art, while he relives his past.

metas.name: Once a Week for Life
metas.description: NYPD Lt. Adam Galanis leads the Fugitive Task Force as he tumbles through a merciless life while balancing on a razors edge. Adam fights personal demons and addictions when he's forced to take revenge on plotting traitors and the mafia who are trying to kill him.

metas.name: SO36
metas.description: Agatha, a reserved but curious young woman, leads a peaceful life. One evening, after a movie screening, a simple drink with friends leads her into an unexpected adventure. She finds herself in a mysterious club but above all confronted with herself.  Plunged into a chaotic and fascinating night, she experiences mystical events and disconcerting encounters that push her to explore unsuspected facets of her identity.

metas.name: Cagüeira
metas.description: After committing an act of revenge, Katya experiences the first symptoms of her transformation.

metas.name: The Botanist
metas.description: Set in a remote village in Xinjiang, China, a young Kazakh boy named Arsin, who finds solace in the company of plants, meets Meiyu, a spirited Han girl whose unpredictable nature reminds him of a rare, otherworldly plant. As their friendship blossoms, it deepens into a delicate, dreamlike allegory that blurs the lines between reality and the enchanting world of botany.

metas.name: Hansel and Gretel
metas.description: A comedic music take on the classic Grimm’s fairytale.

metas.name: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
metas.description: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

metas.name: retablos
metas.description: Icon painter Ilya Khodyrev receives an unusual commission: a family portrait inspired by Mexican retablos. His initial enthusiasm soon gives way to the tedious task of traveling in search of the materials he needs. He sets out with his girlfriend, Venera, and her son. As the journey unfolds, it gradually becomes clear that the painting he is creating reflects his own life.

metas.name: Hearts
metas.description: A mob boss casino owner and his apprehensive daughter have a deadly conversation over a game of Hearts in this student produced 1920s drama.

metas.name: All Roads Lead Back
metas.description: A fragmented reflection on memory, love, and emotional limbo, unfolding through fleeting images and a drifting voice that questions their reliability.

metas.name: Blue Girl
metas.description: A queer coming of age film, that follows a girl named Olivia as she struggles to hide her relationship from her mother Carrie.

metas.name: Double-Edged Dagger
metas.description: A 1-minute short animation about “time for a change,” where a dagger becomes a symbol of transformation, shifting from a tool of violence into something meaningful for someone you care about. As time passes, the story unfolds through changing seasons, evolving aspect ratios, and shifting colour and tone, transitioning from a sense of mystery into a more emotional and dramatic narrative.

metas.name: Hope
metas.description: Narrated by Javi, the only family member able to cross the border, Hope revisits his parents' migration story and the difficult reality that keeps them from returning home.

metas.name: Treasure Reboot
metas.description: Lincoln and his friends go on an adventure to find his grandpas hidden treasure.

metas.name: Queer Blue Sky
metas.description: After realizing many of the best parts of their relationship were maybe kind of queer, Beth and Chris decide to break up in a queer way too.

metas.name: Charmain and the Prophet
metas.description: A documentary series investigating the mysterious 2015 death of Charmain Speirs, a Scottish woman who married Ghanaian preacher Eric Adusah. After a whirlwind romance, Charmain was found dead in a hotel bathtub in Ghana six months post-wedding. While Adusah was briefly arrested for her murder, he denied involvement and was released; the investigation reveals significant gaps in his story.

metas.name: 德云社张鹤伦郎鹤炎相声专场呼和浩特站
Hand
metas.description: Trapped between duty and despair, an undocumented Chinese cook begins to question the cost of survival in a country that sees him as invisible as anti-Asian aggression rises outside his kitchen walls.

metas.name: The Great City
metas.description: "Inspired by Friedrich Nietzsche's seminal work 'Thus Spoke Zarathustra', THE GREAT CITY is a profound cinematic inquiry into the ontology of truth within the digital ruins of the modern world. The film navigates the psychological landscape of the 'Last Man', exploring the encroaching desert of the soul and the 'blind point' of human consciousness. Through a minimalist and melancholic visual language, it challenges the viewer to confront the illusions of contemporary existence and the search for authentic meaning in an era of absolute spiritual void."

metas.name: For You
metas.description: Jordan (Demarcus Jackson) enters a time loop after a masked man breaks into his house, sending him on a trip backwards in time.

metas.name: in search of the blue light
Sudden Death
metas.description: Obsessive film professor Charlie is one long-take away from realizing his magnum opus film, SUDDEN DEATH. As problems spring up left and right, Charlie begins to put into question his legitmacy as a director and person.

metas.name: Bite marks
metas.description: Short poetry film showcasing the difficulties of growing up.

metas.name: Brandie Posey - Milk Job
metas.description: Brandie Posey's debut comedy special

metas.name: এক চিলতে ছোঁয়া | Ek Chilte Chowa
metas.description: A touching romantic drama where a small moment of affection grows into a life-changing bond between two hearts.

metas.name: The canticles of a ghost,
metas.description: In a single, unbroken drift through the night, a solitary figure moves between fragments of life—intimacy, conflict, and celebration—never quite entering any of them.

metas.name: Five Stages Until
metas.description: When her husband chooses to stop treatment, a grieving woman leans on dance to survive the silence, while her daughter struggles to bridge the gulf between denial and acceptance.

metas.name: The Last Hand
metas.description: Down on his luck, a single father stumbles into a casino in hopes of winning big to support his daughter. Things take a dark turn when he follows a mysterious dealer deeper into the casino...

metas.name: The Best (o melhor)
metas.description: The winner of the Racso award arrives home after the ceremony. What he didn't expect was that the statuette would haunt him.

metas.name: epitaph
metas.description: An avant-garde depiction of the Greek Good Friday.

metas.name: Apes Together Strong
metas.description: When a handwritten will surfaces, two estranged brothers must decide whether to sign away their inheritance or each other as debts, secrets, and a pushy family lawyer force them to confront the cost of loyalty.

metas.name: The LandLords
metas.description: The LandLords

metas.name: TSCHERNOBYL 86
metas.description: Forty years since Chernobyl. Volker Heise’s new film recounts the 1986 nuclear disaster for the first time from the perspectives of both East and West Germany and Ukraine, using archive footage only. TSCHERNOBYL 86 is a gripping political thriller featuring previously unseen archive material which brings the events of that time into an unsettlingly present-day context.​

metas.name: Operation Maduro
metas.description: The American government prepares for a covert operation to kidnap the Venezuelan president. The fate of global trade and potential military consequences rest in the hands of Admiral and secret agent Ralph Mitchels. Follow the story of this stealthy soldier and the worldwide repercussions that unfold throughout the course of the mission.

metas.name: La Scala: Cosi Fan Tutte
metas.description: Opera buffa in two acts (1790) New Production! A top-flight cast features in a new staging of Mozart and Da Ponte’s comic masterpiece of love, trust and the fickleness of human behaviour from acclaimed director Robert Carsen. As part of a bet with Don Alfonso (Gerald Finley), Ferrando and Guglielmo (Giovanni Sala and Luca Micheletti) must try to seduce each other’s fiancées, Fiordiligi and Dorabella (Elsa Dreisig and Nina van Essen). When both yield, and the ruse is revealed, all four must reckon with the fallout.

metas.name: Baby Cigarette
metas.description: for anyone who's ever been a baby... or a cigarette

metas.name: The Gold Trail
metas.description: Fafner, a mercenary anti-hero, descends upon a city torn by conflict, relentlessly tracking a trail of coins that will lead him toward his inevitable fate.

metas.name: Miriam Margolyes Made Me Me
metas.description: Director Simon Draper sets out to make a podcast with actress Miriam Margolyes, but the project soon becomes sidetracked as Simon is drawn ever deeper into her orbit. The podcast becomes a chaotic, joyful road trip, revealing Miriam’s true legacy isn’t just her work but the lives she’s quietly transformed, beginning with Simon.

metas.name: Forgive You
metas.description: Since the death of his wife, Marla, Henry just can’t seem to find life funny anymore. And yet, he must come to terms with the reality of a life even God himself seems to be laughing at.

metas.name: Ghermez Yavash
metas.description: The story is about a Russian girl who travels to Iran after her father goes missing, but in the meantime, her acquaintance with a boy in the south of Tehran gets her involved in a new adventure.

metas.name: Sympathy
metas.description: A man tries to come to terms with a crime he committed

metas.name: Evanescent
metas.description: A boy living in constant black and white finds a coloured flower whilst embarking on his walk. Upon picking the flower, his world gains diversity and colour, but how long will this phenomenon last?

metas.name: My Letter to the South
metas.description: This wasn’t meant to be a documentary. I’d always had an appreciation for the American South, but I’d never actually experienced it for myself. Aotearoa/New Zealand has always had a deep respect for Black American culture especially Southern Black American culture and I wanted to show people back home the things we don’t always get to see or fully understand. So I went. "My Letter to the South" is about the journey that followed, something I never expected.  There was no script. No plan. Just two Kiwi fellas exploring a place we have always loved that we are seeing for the first time.

metas.name: the road where i go to die
metas.description: A short abstract visual poem of a film about the grief a guy experiences driving through the road his best friend lived on before committing suicide.

metas.name: The Forest of Oscar Geppetto
metas.description: A further exploration of how Oscar Geppetto views music and reality. A sequence cut from the original film.

metas.name: VLOG AXELOU : LA DESCENTE AUX ENFERS
The Truths Of Robloxia
metas.description: A quiet, introspective short film about navigating the fragile space between grief and growing up. learn that grief isn’t something to “get over,” but something that reshapes you. this film can be watched on the youtube channel @Fatimafilmproductions

metas.name: shoemotion
metas.description: comprised of over 1600 photos, this short films follows a converse on an adventure

metas.name: Dolovia
metas.description: A film By Behailu Engida

metas.name: If You Really Love Me, Outlive Me
metas.description: The colourful life of Texas honky-tonk hero Dale Watson and his wife, Celine Lee - a Miami-born ex-playboy bunny turned singer. Stars of their very own southern fairytale, Dale and Celine formed a magnetic bond that went beyond their love for the rockabilly scene and inserted itself into the mic between them, launching a life of lyrical adventure. Across a landscape where Americana roots defy commercial trends and keep the soul of country music alive, we travel with the electric duo from Texas dancehalls to Memphis landmarks, meeting the characters and communities that shape their unapologetically free life.

metas.name: Riding the Rails with Geoffrey Baer
metas.description: For generations, seemingly all paths led through Chicago as trains carrying passengers, livestock, and freight crisscrossed the country. In a new WTTW special and companion website, Riding the Rails, lifelong train enthusiast Geoffrey Baer hops aboard all kinds of trains to tell the story of this essential mode of transport and how it shaped our city. Along the way, he uncovers clues all around us to railroads of the past, recalls the colorful characters who built them and the unsung workers who toiled on them, and reveals why our current rail system is just as vital to Chicago’s existence today.

metas.name: The Falicornia Institute of the Rats
metas.description: Four ambitious acting students hone their crafts at the prestigious Falicornia Institute of the Rats.

metas.name: The Clock Maker
metas.description: Upon the glade, the Clock Maker confronts the Time Thief after hunting him for a very long time.

metas.name: Stood Up
metas.description: An exploration of fears that come with dating and finding a relationship. A continuation of the planned 'love trilogy' which began with 'In My life'.

metas.name: L'homme qui a fait de Gaulle
The Heartbreak Kid: Becoming Shawn Michaels
metas.description: Follows the life and career of WWE performer Shawn Michaels, tracing his rise, personal struggles, and eventual comeback with an unfiltered look at his journey.

metas.name: Beyond 1.5
metas.description: 2033. Barcelona. Heatwave in December. Nana lives with her mother and is unemployed. Her luck finally seems to change when a powerful multinational takes an interest in her. However, she will soon discover that getting the job means sacrificing more than she ever imagined.

metas.name: Stay for the Q&A
metas.description: Following a feature film premiere, at a prestigious film festival, a routine Q&A devolves into a familiar and unhinged experience.

metas.name: Hungy Ghost
metas.description: 'Hungy Ghost' is an emotionally unhinged comedy set in Earth's last botanical garden starring a ghost who is prone to bouts of world-destroying imposter syndrome every time he tries to prove his worth to others.

metas.name: Clean Slate
metas.description: A woman confesses her biggest secret to the man she loves at the most inopportune time.

metas.name: She Finds You Funny
metas.description: In a polyamorous relationship, Aaron and Steve question who their partner Rose may prefer more, especially when Aaron brings up Steve’s ability to effortlessly make her laugh.

metas.name: Embrace
metas.description: When a bar bathroom hookup takes an otherworldly turn, two men must work through their problems to move forward.

metas.name: The Daoxian Incident
metas.description: The result of years of fieldwork and research, "The Daoxian Incident" examines the causes of armed struggle and mass killings in Dao County, Hunan, at the height of the Cultural Revolution. Between August 13 and October 17, 1967, 7,696 people were killed and 1,397 were forced to commit suicide. An additional 2,146 were permanently injured or disabled. Most of the victims were labeled “class enemies” and belonged to the so-called “Five Black Categories,” while at least 14,000 people participated in the killings. Through interviews with survivors, participants, and family members, this documentary reconstructs the complex sequence of political campaigns that culminated in one of the bloodiest episodes in the PRC's history.

metas.name: Loss
metas.description: Amy is having the worst day of her life. Her 16-year-old daughter, Emma, is finally undergoing a heart transplant after waiting over two years. As Emma fights for her life, Amy sits alone in the hospital waiting room, overwhelmed by fear, exhaustion, and a deep anger towards God. She tries to pray but can’t find the words, consumed by rage at the unfairness of it all.

metas.name: Wasteland Cop
metas.description: After avenging the death of his family, an ex-soldier wanders through a post-apocalyptic landscape fending off nomadic tribes that prey upon outsiders. During his travels he meets an odd group of survivors, who convince him to become the law in a land where there is no law.

metas.name: Henry
metas.description: Montana and Henry have broken up, but now it's October and they are trying something new.

metas.name: Pontifex - Un ponte tra la misericordia e la speranza
The Devil's Valley
metas.description: In this week's show: Sinos River Valley, Southern Brazil, 19th century. An unholy name spreads across the German settlements, preceded by terror and followed by tragedy... Who was the “Devil Kid”? Find out the facts on Fabão's Sunday Show!

metas.name: Roommates
metas.description: When shy college freshman Devon asks cool-girl Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship quickly spirals into a war of passive aggression.

metas.name: A Royal Romance in Ibiza
metas.description: After a painful breakup with her ex-business partner, Dylan Harper, a talented American developer, is determined to prove herself on her next big contract - creating a luxury wellness hotel for His Royal Highness King Edward on the breathtaking island of Ibiza. The opportunity is a dream come true for Dylan - until she comes face to face with the king's son, Prince Nicholas, a dashing bachelor with his own ideas on how to execute the hotel project.

metas.name: Boris Is Dead
metas.description: A struggling actor, working as a waiter, unwittingly becomes involved in a violent heist gone wrong, where his boss—deep in debt—has been stealing from employees and running the restaurant as a front for the mob.

metas.name: Slowburn Shoot: An Indie Wrestling Story
metas.description: Documentary that goes behind the curtain, exploring the intimate relationships and untold stories that shape the pro wrestling industry.

metas.name: Deep in My Heart is a Song
metas.description: An aging country musician who's struggling to make ends meet receives an offer for an unusual private gig. Based on the life of cowboy singer Johnny Bencomo, who plays himself in the film.

metas.name: Be-cut: Deleted/Existing
metas.description: On film sets in Berlin and Seoul, rehearsals repeat as scenes are performed, interrupted, and restarted. Amid repetition, interruption, failure, and waiting, questions of migration, belonging, and identity remain deferred.

metas.name: The Patchwright
metas.description: In the sprawling slag heaps of NiiroCradle, a fugitive android visits the Patchwright, an unlicensed body mechanic, begging him to trace a fragment of a childhood memory.

metas.name: Wheels Under Citylights
metas.description: A documentary that is a record of a moment of the current scenes of skateboarding in Mumbai. Filmed to see how well skateboard culture stays under the citylights of Mumbai.

metas.name: XG WORLD TOUR: THE CORE - Tokyo
metas.description: XG WORLD TOUR: THE CORE is the second world tour by XG. It started on February 6, 2026. This release is from their performance on April 12, 2026 at Yoyogi National Stadium 1st Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan.

metas.name: Face-Off
metas.description: A frigid night blankets a neighborhood skating rink. Théo, 14, skates alone in endless circles, as if trying to escape something that haunts him. Then, a presence emerges. His father. Words are exchanged, glances meet. But beneath the surface, what unfolds goes far beyond appearances: regrets, silences, a need for answers. Not far off, Gabriel, his friend, watches the scene alongside his grandfather Paul — a silent witness to a moment that feels larger than life.  Face-Off is an intimate drama brought to life through a minimalist and restrained direction, where the ice becomes a mental space — a place of inner confrontation. Through this open-air chamber piece, the film explores isolation, and the visceral need to speak what was never said. Hovering between realism and disquiet, Face-Off intentionally keeps the viewer in a hazy in-between — where emotion takes over reason, and absence becomes almost tangible.

metas.name: Our Song
metas.description: Through the highs and lows of life, Hank and Sarah's love story is forever tied to their special song. What begins as a tune that sparked their love becomes a bittersweet echo of what was. Some songs never end - even when love does.

metas.name: So Glad We Never Met
metas.description: Cheeto dust is just the surface of this dark satire... while the name Bentin Barantino may seem familiar to you, Flossie, a young female film student, knows him all too well.

metas.name: Приобретённая глухота
metas.description: Teenager Nikita lost his hearing as a child, and his father, Dmitry, tries to help his son return to a normal life. However, their ideas of "normality" diverge. Dmitry wants Nikita to attend a mainstream school and restore his hearing with an implant. But the teenager refuses the operation and defends his right to a unique approach to learning and hobbies. A misunderstanding between father and son leads to conflict, which leads Nikita to run away from home. This story explores the importance of listening to each other, forgiving ourselves, and finding compromises in difficult situations.

metas.name: This Is Private
metas.description: A stripper cunningly decides to use her private dances as therapy sessions in order to prevail in her collegiate psychology class.

metas.name: Hridoye Tumi
metas.description: A heartbroken young man who no longer believes in love rejects a sincere girl because of his painful past, but wounded by the rejection, the determined girl makes it her mission to make him fall in love with her.

metas.name: The Hunt for the Last Nazis
metas.description: With exclusive access to never-seen-before classified government files and explosive video and audio recordings, this is the scandalous story of how thousands of alleged Nazi war criminals hid in Australia after WWII and managed to evade justice – despite a government-sanctioned Special Investigations Unit desperate to prosecute them.

metas.name: Stonehenge: The Final Mystery Revealed
metas.description: New research is transforming the story of Stonehenge. This documentary uncovers evidence suggesting its origins may trace back to Scotland's rugged landscapes.

metas.name: Jaylah
metas.description: After receiving a text from her crush, a naive 17-year-old must choose between looking after her grandmother and losing her virginity.

metas.name: The Wand'rin' Stars
metas.description: This musical romantic comedy tells the story of a man and a woman born into different social classes who meet by chance and overcome conflicts and obstacles as they build their relationship.

metas.name: Where is Zhu?
metas.description: Zhu is Chinese. She recently came to Russia to learn Russian and gain admission to a university. Every day, she attends language courses for foreigners. She spends most of her time alone. Out of boredom and a longing to ease her melancholy, Zhu decides to go on a date with a stranger.

metas.name: Marco Melani - The Man With The Golden Eye : Scheggia dall'ultima versione
Kitchen/Swink
metas.description: A second remake of the vignette chamber piece "Kitchen/Sink".

metas.name: 60 Minutes Australia - Clavicular
metas.description: Content creator Clavicular agrees to sit down with 60 Minutes to talk about how the social media phenomenon looksmaxxing has changed his life. The world's most prominent looksmaxxer happily shares some aspects of this internet subculture, including his drug intake, the controversial bone-smashing and his views on women, but does not take it well when asked about his relationship with Andrew Tate and his association with the incel community.

metas.name: The Despicable Speeder-Man
metas.description: A masked vigilante saves the day, and nothing bad ever happens.

metas.name: Brad Williams: Live on Short Street
metas.description: Brad Williams is back with his fourth stand-up comedy special LIVE ON SHORT STREET!  A fearless, high-energy hour packed with outrageous true stories, brutally honest observations, and nonstop laughs from one of the most electrifying comedians in the world.  Filmed live in front of a sold-out crowd in Lexington, KY, Brad dives into everything from relationships, marriage, and fatherhood to disability, sex, therapy, and the absurd realities of modern life. With razor-sharp punchlines and explosive storytelling, this special proves why Brad continues to sell out theaters around the globe.

metas.name: Paid For
metas.description: A woman pays for an hour in a hotel room, but not for what you’d expect. What unfolds between two sisters is a confrontation neither of them is ready for.

metas.name: Andrey Ayrapetov: Pick-Me Nihilism
metas.description: “Pick-Me Nihilism” was originally meant to be a mixtape of jokes that just wouldn’t fit into another special, but it turned into a very cohesive, solid, and funny piece of work!  Vibe-wise, it’s closer to “40 Minutes of Sex With Yourself” — which is my favorite special of all time. Same relaxed feel, sometimes silly, no pretensions — just jokes on all kinds of topics. I also like that some of the material here is downright stupid or gross, with no attempts at turning it into theater, orchestras, or high drama. No Tarkovsky — just pure stand-up!

metas.name: Johnny Bronson
metas.description: A rage-bait streamer is reached out to by next-door neighbor, forcing him to confront his views on humanity. Also he's an alien from outer space sent to get humanity to destroy itself, so conflict is inevitable.

metas.name: Low on Fuel
metas.description: A tumultuous meeting between supposed friends leads Mike on a path of self discovery that lands him in the wrong place at the wrong time.

metas.name: Rosamunde Pilcher: Wo Liebe aufhört und wo sie beginnt
metas.description: Kate loves working at the small café she runs with her friend Polly. Her big dream is to open her own literary café. But out of love for her husband, she puts that dream on hold.

metas.name: 8th Street
metas.description: Late at night in a quiet place, three lives intersect — a weary stranger, a silent old man, and a tired waiter. Through glances, gestures, and fragments of conversation, their fragile interactions unravel hidden tensions and unspoken histories. What begins as routine slowly transforms into a haunting exploration of loneliness, memory, and the search for meaning.

metas.name: Reach The Stars
metas.description: Riley, a young girl fascinated by the stars, wants to take after her former-astronaut grandfather and soar through space. Will she get there?

metas.name: The Grossfarken and the Boy
metas.description: Despite stories of a monster upstream, a young village boy ventures into the creek and discovers the truth behind his town's lore.

metas.name: Structural Changes
metas.description: A camera moves through the architecture of the renowned private art school, California Institute of the Arts, while a man touches up paint on the neglected exterior. Somewhere inside, the upper administration drafts increasingly dire emails to send to its faculty and staff.

metas.name: Exquisite Corpse
metas.description: Inspired by the surrealist game of "exquisite corpse," the film pieces together the story of a Harris mud crab who is a new species in the waters of the Baltic Sea since 2011. The film unfolds a layered story of "invasive species," disrupted ecosystems, and the questions they raise about human values in a world of constant environmental flux.

metas.name: Chew This!
metas.description: Influenced by Yoko Ono's 1964 performance "Cut Piece," the film is an explosion of energy, anger, and spirit that explores sexual exploitation and violence against female/femme bodies. Short, fast, and sweet like an angry spitfire punk song, blink and you'll miss the show!

metas.name: My Structuralist Film
metas.description: How shall I cater best to your desire for me to be visible? Set up as a confessional-cum-guided meditation, My Structuralist Film uses performance artist Tehching Hsieh's One Year Performance (“Time Clock Piece”) as a framework to illustrate the filmmaker's (presumable) insides. How thoroughly should a trans body want or need to be visible? On what terms is the filmmaker obligated to narrativize, perform, or even fabricate visibility for the sake of an audience? Considering the limits and limitations of disclosure, this project positions the act of looking not as an offering or an exchange, but as an unyielding neoliberal, capitalist thirst to consume.

metas.name: A is for Apple
metas.description: A semantically unstable encounter with objects, images, and words.

metas.name: Void
metas.description: Because of the constant rumbling of his stomach, Baran becomes estranged from his social circle and loses his job. When he returns to see the doctor, Havin takes a close interest in the sounds coming from his stomach, and the story begins to unfold in entirely unexpected directions.

metas.name: Bloom
metas.description: A man stumbles upon some flowers that remind him of someone.

metas.name: Celeb High Drama
metas.description: In a prestigous celebrity high school, a group of lonely souls search for love. But will everybody get a happy ending?

metas.name: I Feel At Peace Thinking Of Today
metas.description: After going through a painful period, ceramicist Heloisa Guedes underwent a transformation that came from the inside out. She left behind the hectic pace of the city for a new life in São Luiz do Paraitinga, in search of a reconnection with her own needs. Little by little, she began to live in alignment with what felt meaningful to her: self-care, artistic expression and being close to nature.

metas.name: faces/places
metas.description: The faces/places project comprises 559 videos spanning from 2018 to date, providing a short window into the daily routines of "everyday people." Most of the collection was filmed in Budapest, with some additions from other European metropolises. The project’s main focus is to explore the sensation of loneliness within a crowd or a social setting.

metas.name: Zombies Become Generals 2
metas.description: Late Qing era. Reporter Dai Xue uncovers a ring using zombies to traffic young girls. The mastermind is the Seventh Princess, a Ming descendant raising funds to restore her fallen dynasty. She turns General Habu into a zombie weapon. After the plot is exposed, she unleashes the vampire William. Habu regains his mind and fights back. At the critical moment, senior brother Shi Gandang arrives, and together they bring down the princess and William.

metas.name: The Following Day
metas.description: It's a sweltering summer in New York. Morgan, a soft-spoken young woman prone to daydreaming, finds refuge inside the cinema where the boundaries between fantasy and reality blur, on screen and off.

metas.name: A Taste of Loyalty
metas.description: Easter Sunday, 14 April 1471. Barnet, just north of London. England. The kingdom is in the grips of a civil war. King Edward IV, driven from his realm the previous year, has returned to reclaim his crown. His youngest brother, Richard, Duke of Gloucester, at 18 years of age prepares for his first taste of battle. Through the mist, he knows the mighty Earl of Warwick awaits them. Forced to decide between his brother and his mentor, Richard has made his choice. He has chosen loyalty… but at what cost?  Exploring King Richard III as a young man, shaped by loyalty, conflict, and the price of power. Rather than viewing him as the famous villainous king, we meet Richard as he takes his first leap into the brutal world of medieval politics!

metas.name: Their Safe Haven
metas.description: A man takes his new face out for a spin. A car park security guard is sprung into action. A man recounts the loss of his friend. A band plays their swan song.

metas.name: Betty St. Clair
metas.description: When an anxious Chinese American drag queen hosts an all-AAPI showcase for an unconventional audience, a surprise guest sends her spiraling into self-doubt. Meanwhile, backstage shenanigans from her chaotic drag family threaten to derail the whole show.

metas.name: Kit
metas.description: A teenager with dwarfism is hidden away from an unforgiving world by his superficial mother but discovers that his talent for drawing can set him free.

metas.name: Cleaned Out
metas.description: In this twisty comedy, a maid who works for a mob boss must stand up for herself when he refuses to pay the money he owes her.

metas.name: The Eye
metas.description: In this sly comic zinger from Director Deanne Bray, a hearing Hollywood casting agent is having no luck casting a Deaf role authentically. When an actor named Frank (played by John Maucere) walks in, however, the casting agent gets more than she bargained for.

metas.name: MAINTAINED
metas.description: A maintenance worker goes deep into an overgrown forest to inspect an abandoned watchtower site. As he dutifully records his findings, he is surprised when the forest seems to start sending him messages.

metas.name: Fluent
metas.description: A quirky new hearing employee joins a Deaf-owned business and quickly begins to drive her boss crazy.

metas.name: Medal Chase
metas.description: Meet Rudolfs Stupans, one of the top Deaf competitive swimmers in the world. This exhilarating film follows Rudolfs as he gives us a glimpse of his training routine and what drives him to push forward to the top of his game.

metas.name: From Invisible To Invincible
metas.description: This upbeat self-portrait chronicles the personal journey of Donald M. Falls. Born Deaf and raised without adequate support, Donald transforms into a confident young man with pride and purpose.

metas.name: The Power of Goodbye
metas.description: Margot is a woman whose health is slowly degenerating from ALS. When she asks her mother Christiane to help her end her life on her own terms with dignity, Christiane is forced to confront a profound challenge to her maternal love.

metas.name: Wait and Remain
metas.description: Eddie Reyes wakes in an unfamiliar room with no memory of how he got there. Guided by an unnerving presence, he's drawn through fragments of his life in a space that defies explanation. As reality fractures, Eddie must face who he's been, and who he might become.

metas.name: Choral Music, from Dutilleux to Poulenc Featuring Birds on a Wire and the Théâtre de Chaillot
metas.description: The Maîtrise de Radio takes us on a journey through three hundred years of choral music. From Bach to Jean-Benoît Dunkel, including a world premiere by Fabien Waksman, this richly varied concert is punctuated by the dance-infused collaboration of the Théâtre de Chaillot

metas.name: Yuzuru Hanyu “REALIVE” an ICE STORY project
metas.description: Since turning professional, Yuzuru Hanyu has continued to deepen his skating while building a rich body of stories and expressions through his ICE STORY series.  The first installment, “Yuzuru Hanyu ICE STORY 2023 ‘GIFT,’” was staged at Tokyo Dome, where an ice rink was specially constructed in what became a world-first scale venue for a figure skating performance. The second installment, “Yuzuru Hanyu ICE STORY 2nd ‘RE_PRAY’ TOUR,” explored the theme of “living,” while the third installment, “Yuzuru Hanyu ICE STORY 3rd ‘Echoes of Life’ TOUR,” presented a narrative and programs centered on the question of “life.”  Now, the ICE STORY team where “the stories written by Hanyu” merge with “skating, music, visuals, and lighting” launches a new project: “REALIVE. ”Through “REALIVE,” the programs Hanyu has created so far will be brought back to the stage once again as “living entities” in a one-day-only live performance.

metas.name: The Farm
metas.description: After the sudden loss of her parents, 12-year-old İrem moves in with her estranged grandmother on a semi-industrial dairy farm. As she witnesses the routine separation of newborn calves from their mothers, İrem becomes increasingly troubled by the quiet violence embedded in everyday practice to gain more milk. This unsettling realization leads her to make a small but radical decision: to free the pregnant cows from the farm, with the help of Halid, an orphan apprenticed to the farm’s veterinarian.

metas.name: Magician's Bird
metas.description: A man named Jerry Cheeseburger attempts to decipher a mysterious and nonsensical book for a potential unknown prize.

metas.name: Scout’s Honor
metas.description: Desperate to attend the concert of their dreams before heading off to college, two friends join the legions of a fake girl scout troop in hopes of earning the money in time.

metas.name: S22
metas.description: Gero and Cris, two young filmmakers, have the opportunity to pitch their idea to an important producer. But minutes before, Gero receives a call from work demanding that he return immediately, forcing him to choose between securing his present or risking it all for his future.

metas.name: The Axe Forgets
metas.description: Inspired by a true a story. In 1888 James S. Jameson, heir to the Jameson Whiskey dynasty, returns to Ireland after a year long expedition to the Congo. Things start to unravel as he attempts a return to normality. Will he choose to face the truth? Or will he choose the axe once more?

metas.name: Unfinished Work
metas.description: Eric Chavez has a heart of gold, a magnetic personality, and a knack for telling stories–but the young artist and his vibrant family are haunted by the shadow of a past tragedy in this dreamlike, observational documentary that was filmed over 12 years.

metas.name: MLW & NJPW Present CMLL Fantastica Mania USA 2026
metas.description: Fantastica Mania USA 2026 was a professional event co-produced by American promotion Major League Wrestling (MLW), Japanese promotion New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) and Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial De Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on April 12, 2026 at Festival Hall in Charleston, South Carolina, USA.

metas.name: Vermilion
metas.description: Haunted by the memory of his mother's death and suffocated by his father's controlling grip, an obsessive painter ventures to the brink of madness in his pursuit of artistic perfection.

metas.name: Ten Thousand Reasons for Revenge
metas.description: After a struggling single mom's daughter takes money from a dying bank robber, the two become entangled in a tense investigation that threatens everything they love.

metas.name: After Words
metas.description: An ambitious actress and a disillusioned writer meet by chance, igniting a fragile romance that forces them to confront jealousy, insecurity, and the sacrifices love demands.

metas.name: AEW Dynasty 2026
metas.description: Dynasty 2026 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on April 12, 2026, at Rogers Arena in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The show was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Kenny Omega for the AEW World Championship, dubbed "The Devil vs. The God of Pro Wrestling."

metas.name: Jerry the Ginger Eater
metas.description: A man who eats red-headed women befriends a sex worker in hopes to eat her red-headed lady pimp.

metas.name: Legends of the Lost Ark
metas.description: Chronicles archaeologist Dr. Chris McKinny’s search for the Ark of the Covenant. Supported by insights from scientists, historians, and biblical scholars, he explores three ancient legends pointing to final resting place of the iconic relic.

metas.name: Winter Hymns
metas.description: A palliative care doctor meets with a series of dying patients.

metas.name: Private Browser
metas.description: Jane questions her boyfriend's attraction to her after seeing porn on his phone.

metas.name: Hollis
metas.description: After leaving New York City behind, Hollis checks into a quiet roadside motel where she meets Adam, a young male escort she’s hired—not for sex, but for something stranger. As the night unfolds, Hollis guides Adam through an unsettling, intimate experiment that blurs emotional and psychological boundaries. But just as she returns to her routine, a sudden, senseless act of violence shatters the illusion of control she tried to reclaim.

metas.name: Crudo
metas.description: A year after her dismissal from a Michelin-starred restaurant, Chef Grace Collins, now managing a more modest eatery, has an unsavory encounter with the critic responsible for her firing.

metas.name: Pig(s)
metas.description: A less than innocent young woman gets pulled over by a cop and his strange partner.

metas.name: Shaggy's Big Break
metas.description: Reality, fiction, and performance overlap when an employee asks his boss for a two-week vacation.

metas.name: Ghost Town
metas.description: Man learns to love his new home and is moved to song.

metas.name: Time Life Volume 9. Life Model
metas.description: The mechanical gaze of a book scanner becomes a hyper-speed collage of anatomy.

metas.name: Foil and Doo: A Tale of Two Jokers
metas.description: Foil and Doo are two clowns working a dead-end job in a supermarket. One day, they decide to branch out and go to Clowns Anonymous, where the leader is secretly working for the Clown Bureau of Investigation and recruits the two clowns.

metas.name: Lone Shark 5
metas.description: A Cartel out for revenge. An Agency out for justice. A shark caught in the crossfire.

metas.name: My 7 Grandmas
metas.description: 17-year-old Gigi (Kate Larson) moves with her mom (Candace Kirkpatrick) from California to small-town Minnesota, where she cleverly plots to help her Grandpa (comedian Jeff Allen) get his life back on track after the loss of his wife.

metas.name: The Long Cuban Night
metas.description: Captured entirely on phone footage, a group of Cuban artists risk everything to document their uprising against a government trying to silence them.

metas.name: Six Feet
metas.description: When Cassie, a woman struggling with her sexuality, is unexpectedly pulled back from the edge of a bridge by her openly gay ex-boyfriend, the pair are forced to confront past trauma, their sexualities, and the truth.

metas.name: I Fly When No One’s Watching
metas.description: A shy girl walking home alone takes to the sky to shake off her loneliness. Her ability to use magic is a secret from her classmates.

metas.name: 旅館に嫁いだ女 若女将の残り香
Dlize
metas.description: A satire of the film world, a film crew tries at all costs to make an advertisement for an emerging beverage brand, "Dlize". Between a lack of talent and professionalism, a director who doesn't know what he's doing, a star actor who has succumbed to alcohol and a bad lifestyle, and an entire crew on the verge of despair, Hélder, the assistant director, and his production assistants Maurício and Emanuel, try to keep the ship on course and manage to film the advertisement.

Thousands flock to Austurvöllur, where the future of Iceland's independence hangs in the balance. Emotions run high and firm beliefs simmer beneath the surface. When opposing ideologies collide outside the Parliament building, chaos erupts into violent clashes. This is the story of the riots of March 30, 1949.

metas.name: HOT!
metas.description: A mother penguin and her daughter are driving under the scorching summer sun to an amusement park. When they start fighting over the air conditioning, they end up breaking it, turning the ride into a little adventure.

metas.name: Double act
metas.description: Two acts take place at once.

metas.name: Gold leaf
metas.description: Glinting surface washed up on the shore.

metas.name: Bottle highlight
metas.description: Fluid finds its way around a bottle.

metas.name: On tape
metas.description: The final bit of tape billows about as Locky holds the roll.

metas.name: Silver roll
metas.description: Reflective garbage walks along the beach.

metas.name: Toe poke
metas.description: A toe pokes a container full of liquid.

metas.name: Nobody Knows Me
metas.description: Nobody knows me nobody knows me nobody knows me like you know me

The journey of Bayu, a final-semester university student whose days are usually filled with laughter alongside Rizki and Rizal, slowly begins to change as the hope of seeing his beloved team win the championship fades away. In the midst of isolation, he faces emotional and spiritual struggles, until he finally realizes that there is something far more valuable than anything else.

metas.name: Never to Return
metas.description: After being forcibly removed from his university class, Daniel faces an obstinate investigator threatening to expose him if he does not comply with a little-known, Lavender Scare inquisition. Daniel must choose whether to name names, including betraying his former lover, or face the consequences of being outed in 1950s Florida.

metas.name: The Man Milker
metas.description: A man must face his greatest fear.

metas.name: Bleeding Edge
metas.description: A young Korean-American figure skater must bear the tough-love parenting of her mother, the mind games of her coach, and her own insidious self-doubt as she recovers from an injury.

metas.name: Mentir, jouer et devenir François Périer
When We Dream Of Rockets
metas.description: An experimental film about the morality of space travel, based on a child’s dream

metas.name: aespa - 2026 Live Tour SYNK：aexis LINE in JAPAN - SPECIAL EDITION DOME TOUR
metas.description: aespa's third concert tour, 'SYNK : aeXIS LINE', concludes its massive run with a 'Special Edition' at the Tokyo Dome.

metas.name: Bruno Mars: The romantic tour live
metas.description: Bruno Mars Romantic tour breaking all records

metas.name: ROB
metas.description: ROB, a young LA native, moves to Portland for school, only to drop out almost immediately and settle into a comfortable routine of doing absolutely nothing. What follows is a mostly self-inflicted journey through failure, small awakenings, and the long road to becoming a barely functional adult.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

metas.name: Pageant Panic
metas.description: At a local pageant, two determined contestants let their rivalry get out of hand while an overwhelmed assistant attempts to maintain order.

metas.name: KILLAS
metas.description: This documentary offers an intimate look at a recreational basketball team competing in a local league over the course of a single season. Filmed and created by one of the team’s own players, the project blends on-court action with candid moments off the court, capturing game footage, locker-room conversations, and personal reflections from the athletes themselves.

metas.name: 德云社岳云鹏孙越相声专场大连站 2026
Gangster’s Daughter 5
metas.description: After a crushing loss, Kadisha cannot grieve before a new threat emerges, turning friends into foes in a world where nothing is as it seems.

metas.name: 4.7 Seconds: For the Championship
metas.description: The greatest title game ending in the history of March Madness

metas.name: A História de Penélope
metas.description: The film pays tribute to Penélope Melgar Mantelli, recreating moments from before her birth to after the robotics competition she took part in.

metas.name: Chris Parker: Stop Being So Dramatic
metas.description: Chris Parker explores the intense relationship with intrusive thoughts and memories of a dramatic childhood in community theater.

metas.name: In the heart of la 15
metas.description: The film about Real Madrid's path to winning the 15th Champions League in its history

metas.name: Storm Warning
metas.description: MADE IN USA MARCH 15, 2026

metas.name: Investigating the Supernatural: Angels & Demons
metas.description: Investigative journalist Billy Hallowell travels across America to uncover the evidence for the spiritual realm, angels, and demons.

metas.name: The Man with a Hat
metas.description: A Bounty Hunter is trying to get revenge on thieves who are stealing people's lands, while being hunted down by most dangerous western gang boss.

metas.name: Burden of Other People's Dreams: Chapter One – Ganymede
metas.description: A surreal, abstract memoir of Joe Bini's life as a film editor and storyteller, presented as a live cinema experience for one audience member at a time.

metas.name: Billie & Carl
metas.description: In 1960s Paris, Billie and Carl, a tight-knit brother and sister duo, survive on small-time thefts. But when a high-society gala offers a once-in-a-lifetime prize, their biggest heist may force them to choose between freedom… and loyalty.

metas.name: Last Save Point
metas.description: In a scorched, post-apocalyptic world, survival is fragile and trust is dangerous. When a hardened loner discovers a naive man with the mind of a child, the two form an uneasy alliance, their journey colliding with a sinister school where the once students (now adults) are still ruled by the authority figures of the past. Fear, secrets, and the threats prevent them from exploring whats beyond their gated community.

metas.name: GI, your helicopters fall from the sky like broken birds
metas.description: GI, your helicopters fall from the sky like broken birds examines the visual culture of war games and the ideological ease with which conflict is converted into spectacle. With a documentary inflection, the film isolates the recurrent devices of the military videogame and turns them into objects of analysis. Its central concern is distance. Interfaces, crosshairs, surveillance views, and elevated perspectives reorganise destruction into something clean, legible, and remote. Romanello, Madrussa, and Mennella make visible the visual regime through which war is formatted in advance for command, abstraction, and consumption.

metas.name: Mirai (The Abyss)
metas.description: Mirai (The Abyss) draws on the world of Ghost of Tsushima to shape a brief, concentrated meditation on conscience under pressure. Beginning with a textual intervention, the film turns toward habituation, moral fatigue, and the threshold where violence stops appearing as rupture and sinks into the texture of experience. De Simone counters the game’s dramatic momentum with a quieter dissonance, redirecting attention to ethical aftertone, the residue produced when repetition dulls the force of response. Its restraint is what gives the work its edge. Mirai (The Abyss) follows the normalisation of the intolerable, showing how exposure reorders feeling before crisis fully declares itself.

metas.name: The Last Harvest
metas.description: Set within the ravaged world of Pathologic Classic HD, The Last Harvest unfolds across a landscape marked by disease, exhaustion, and slow attrition. Cocco works through the game as an atmospheric field saturated with depletion, where every sound, surface, and bodily trace carries the weight of a world wearing down. Barren streets and exposed figures accumulate with quiet insistence. Falling leaves, distant cattle, the tolling of a bell, and the persistent signals of the game interface acquire unusual pressure, no longer incidental details but elements in a visual rhetoric of fragility. What the film records is a condition of survival stripped of heroism and reward.
