The Last Harvest stays with what endures after renewal has withdrawn, when the world continues in a diminished state, poised between persistence and abandonment.

metas.name: The Road to Tehran
metas.description: The Road to Tehran is a short documentary looking at the US' strategy in Iran, the economic and political constraints which have shaped it and the inevitability of the war's spread. In doing so it shows how the US' assault on Venezuela, Cuba, Greenland and Iran are inexorably linked.

metas.name: Landscapes in White: Elephant Point, 2025
metas.description: Three archaeologists from the Landscapes in White/ArqueoAntar project (LEACH–UFMG) scan archaeological sites left by 19th-century marine mammal hunters at Elephant Point, Antarctica. During the expedition, they are struck by an unexpectedly green landscape, contrasting with research records from a decade earlier, while TerrAntar scientists collect fungi increasingly present in the polar environment. Soon, successive storms erase the green, revealing a landscape in unstable transformation.

metas.name: Blaiklock: The Refuge in Need of Rescue
metas.description: On this rare glimpse into a season of conservation with UK Antarctic Heritage Trust, we follow a team of specialists as they journey to remote Blaiklock Island, Antarctica. Here, they undertake a mission to save this remarkable historic refuge as it battles a changing climate in an environment of extremes.

metas.name: Arctic Shifts
metas.description: "Arctic Shifts" is an art-science animation that combines scientific climate simulations and speculative storytelling to reveal how our human activity is connected to the ecosystem and environmental changes occurring in the rapidly warming Arctic. The animation was created by artist Anna Lindemann and scientist Dr. Alice DuVivier, a polar climate modeler at U.S. National Science Foundation National Center for Atmospheric Research (NSF NCAR).

metas.name: Les Copains et le Japon
metas.description: Five friends embark on a memorable adventure in Japan, from Fukuoka to Sapporo.

metas.name: PEN
metas.description: Two journalists' journey of their ambition which later takes a sharp turn.

metas.name: Eclosió. Escenes del debut operístic de Ros-Marbà
Inside the Rage Machine
metas.description: New whistleblowers and insiders from social media companies speak out to reveal how algorithms designed to connect people have been helping to tear them apart. With new testimony and documents, they expose a machine thriving on outrage and division as part of a business model, with radicalisation, real-world violence and fractured societies some of the consequences of a system built to shape how users think, feel and see the world.

metas.name: Tara Yummy's: Mindset Tour Documentary 2026
metas.description: A documentary of Tara Yummy's Mindset tour across the USA and Vancouver

metas.name: Madwoman's Game
metas.description: Follows the journey of a young Latina chess enthusiast, Bianca Mitchell-Avila, as she explores life's lessons through the lens of the game.

metas.name: Yolk
metas.description: A university professor finds his romantic relationship with one of his students increasingly difficult to manage in the wake of a promotion.

metas.name: Don’t Plan B — Our Only Planet
metas.description: Don't Plan B: Our Only Planet follows scientists working in Antarctica to understand the effects of human-driven pollution and avian influenza on the continent’s fragile ecosystems. The film shows how global environmental challenges are reaching even the most remote corners of the planet.

metas.name: Black
metas.description: Fragments of a boy's last day before his death.

metas.name: Screentime
metas.description: A troubled middle school student lives his days in school while his phone gets confiscated for a week.

metas.name: En el corazón de la Decimoquinta
The Last Street Interview
metas.description: Two TikTokers attempt to film a series of street interviews when a chance encounter changes the course of their lives forever.

metas.name: The Power of Pickleball
metas.description: "The Power of Pickleball" tells the story of a humble game that spread into a cultural phenomenon by bringing people together across generations, backgrounds, and walks of life. Centered on the passionate individuals who helped build the sport from the ground up, the film celebrates pickleball's unique ability to create community, spark joy, and change lives in unexpected ways.

metas.name: Rain Bomb
metas.description: A documentary investigating a dangerous weather phenomenon involving the sudden formation of violent ‘downburst’ storms.

metas.name: They (no longer) remember
metas.description: A silent visual poem dedicated to the artist's grandfather, who seeks answers and finds new questions in the organic surroundings.

metas.name: Ti y l tt e dr ps ff sp c
metas.description: Field recordings of the Atacama desert of Chile and analogue 8mm images explore the grainy, silent textures of sand, dust and noise.

metas.name: Boy Cried Wolf
metas.description: Max Göran, the artist or director or performer, walks into a tunnel that doubles as a film set, or maybe just itself. She tests out a story told by a friend: a Finnish scientis once smeared his face with blood and let wolves lick it, to prove they weren’t dangerous. But the storyline slips.

metas.name: Aerial
metas.description: A ritualistic audio-visual poem, following singer Lei Lowe on an eruptous pilgrimage through ancient Sicilian landscapes where she communes with the Earth in search of emancipation.

metas.name: Ain't No Party
metas.description: A guy attempts to stop his best friend from making a huge mistake.

metas.name: Her Empty Chair
metas.description: After the sudden loss of someone close to him, a young man returns to the places they once shared together. As he moves through quiet streets and empty rooms, memories begin to surface in fragments, laughter, conversations, and small moments that once felt ordinary. With one chair left empty, he is forced to confront the weight of absence and the lingering presence of the person he lost. *Her Empty Chair* is a quiet, reflective short film about grief, memory, and learning to live with what remains.

metas.name: The Plastic Detox
metas.description: This eye-opening documentary follows six couples with unexplained infertility as they lower their exposure to plastics in hopes it helps them conceive.

metas.name: A Message to My Younger Self
metas.description: When Phoebe has the chance to talk to her teenage self, she decides to give the advice she wishes someone would've told her years ago...

metas.name: Hell's Army
metas.description: A dissident Russian journalist chases the world’s most feared mercenary army, Wagner, across the globe—Ukraine, Syria, the Central African Republic, and beyond. Her team faces death threats and three of her colleagues are murdered as they race to unmask a new model of violence that is transforming the world for all of us.

metas.name: Beautiful Chaos
metas.description: A charismatic street musician stands on the threshold of success, when an unexpected revelation brings his mysterious past crashing back into his life. Caught in the grip of a dark and manipulative network within the music industry, he is dragged into a world of power and deception, forced to walk a fragile line between his art and the chaos that threatens to consume him.

metas.name: The Debt Collectors Son
metas.description: A debt collector brings his son, an aspiring artist, along on a job in the hopes of making a man out of him.

metas.name: Basic
metas.description: Gloria and Nick go through a painful breakup. Gloria then spirals through Nick’s past dating history, untangling his web of ex-girlfriends until she discovers the reason for all their issues: Kaylinn, the hottest, most basic ex-girlfriend to ever exist, who not only just took Gloria’s boyfriend, but is about to take her entire story from her, too. Based on Devantez's award-winning 2020 short of the same name.

metas.name: L'irréparable - 1995, le discours du Vel d'Hiv
Amazomania
metas.description: In 1996, a Brazilian official and a Swedish journalist ventured into the Amazon to document the isolated Korubo tribe caught in escalating land conflicts. Initially hailed as a heroic breakthrough, the footage now demands to be reexamined. Uncovering the hidden costs of “discovery,” the film confronts the colonial legacy and exposes the long-term repercussions for the Korubo.

metas.name: The Pirate King
metas.description: A Marine veteran struggling with PTSD and addiction finds unexpected redemption when he joins a group of pirate reenactors, giving him a chance to fight for custody of his daughter and rebuild the life he thought was lost forever.

metas.name: Noah Kahan: Out of Body
metas.description: After rocketing to global fame, singer-songwriter Noah Kahan returns to his Vermont roots to get back in tune with himself.

metas.name: Love Language
metas.description: Following a failed engagement, Lou discovers she has a talent for writing other people’s wedding vows. Word spreads across Chicago’s wedding scene and Lou’s services are in high demand. She even has a new admirer in Dash. But everything changes when she’s asked to write vows for Olivia, who’s marrying Warren, Lou’s old college flame.

metas.name: He Bled Neon
metas.description: After learning his brother’s death may be murder, Ethan returns to Las Vegas to uncover the truth, and confront the violent past he buried. Once a street kid, he’s now living the good life in L.A., engaged to his dream girl and working for her father’s real estate firm. But when he gets a text saying his brother overdosed, the promise he made to never return home shatters, pulling him back into the world he thought he’d escaped.

metas.name: Sleepwalkers
metas.description: A mother and daughter both sleepwalk, and one night, they come face-to-face.

metas.name: THAUMATROPE
metas.description: A bird is caged for being too happy and energetic.

metas.name: Sea of thoughts
metas.description: Documentary about Famous Singer and Songwriter Otar Ramishvili.

metas.name: 2026 ZEROBASEONE WORLD TOUR [HERE&NOW] ENCORE at KSPO DOME
metas.description: The ZEROBASEONE [HERE&NOW] ENCORE concert can be described as a highly emotional, cinematic grand finale that marked the conclusion of the group's journey as a full nine-member act.

metas.name: Çift Terapisi
metas.description: Şelale, who views therapy more as a current trend than a necessity, brings her husband İhsan to couples therapy. The real therapy takes place during the conversation in the waiting area, before the therapist calls them in.

metas.name: Il Suono Del Silenzio
metas.description: A father tries to push his religion onto his son who denies his will. The story explores the fragile line between guidance and control and the consequences of forcing belief upon a child

metas.name: Generation Y Punk – Update of a subculture
metas.description: In three parts this DIY-documentary focuses on the lives and times of german punks of the generation Y.

metas.name: Secret Sins
metas.description: After the death of his father, a pastor's son takes the lead, but a power-hungry deacon plots his ruin in a tale of faith, ambition, and betrayal.

metas.name: Meurtres à Epinal
metas.description: At the Imagerie d’Épinal, the lifeless body of the museum’s artistic director is found trapped in a lithographic press, his hands severed and his tongue torn out. The killer has placed an Épinal print from a triptych—the centerpiece of the exhibition currently on display at the Imagerie museum—on top of the body.  The investigation is entrusted to Captain Alice Fournier and Commander Émile Cabat. While Alice, a native of Épinal, knows the Imagerie inside and out—her father ran it—Émile, who has transferred from the customs office in Pointe-à-Pitre to be closer to his daughter, will have to get used to local customs and traditions. Between the two of them, the chemistry is electric. But they’ll have to set aside their differences if they want to solve this case.

metas.name: Pretend Play
metas.description: Pretend Play follows a young content creator documenting his mother’s fractured memory, transforming personal pain into educational and emotional online content in pursuit of visibility and digital relevance.

metas.name: Round and Round
metas.description: One autumn afternoon, Sana and Asa meet again in the park where they used to play.  Their time together, beginning with light-hearted conversation, sets in motion memories that had been frozen for ten years.  A story of two people and two ‘confessions’, told through a single, fixed-angle shot.

metas.name: The Script of Light
metas.description: David, Gondes, and Pak Sulap (Mr. Magic) discover an ancestral legacy in the form of an ancient spell manuscript. However, the manuscript can only be unlocked if one dares to change-to abandon one's arrogance and learn from their ancestors' culture. Their short journey reveals the secret that success lies not in mere magical power, but in the courage to uphold one's heritage with humility.

metas.name: el escama - ESSE É MEU ÚLTIMO DISCO
In The Shadow Of The Heron
metas.description: On a beautiful rainy day, a frog wanders along its water lily pad. Along the water, it encounters a heron. The wading bird has decided it will make short work of the amphibian. Thus begins a duel in the heart of the marsh.

metas.name: Let Them Eat Cake
metas.description: A documentary detailing the effects of how corporations in which the food industry as a specific example, involve in global climate change, man-induced destruction of the nature for profits onto the public.

metas.name: Hädanfärd
metas.description: A blind man is confronted by a mysterious figure, whom he seems to know the presence of from before.

metas.name: Zoners
metas.description: Brothers, flatmates and polar opposites Samir and Nikhil find themselves on an adventure when they accidentally steal a package from their maniac neighbour Ivan.

metas.name: Versprechen für die Ewigkeit - Die Paderborner Vincentinnerinnen im Wandel der Zeit
Lab 1
metas.description: Inside a nest, white glowing neon. Then the darkness comes.

metas.name: 2:14 PM
metas.description: Five high school students try to break free and search for happiness by any means necessary: carving their bodies, pretending to be blind, reshaping their image on social media, diving into drugs. Their intertwined journeys lead them to glimpse a ray of hope—until everything falls apart at 2:14PM.

metas.name: Cecilie Bau - Når du mest venter det
Labuk Jabuk
metas.description: A kid wants to have fun in ride during Mela, against his family's restrictive nature.... will he be able to enjoy the ride?

metas.name: Famous
metas.description: A young woman desperate for social media fame exploits her father's death to go viral. But the volatile world of internet stardom pushes her to the edge. Famous explores how our craving for validation clashes with the false promises and distorted reality of social media.

metas.name: Eshaan Akbar: Fool Moon
metas.description: Eshaan Akbar performs his second comedy special 'Fool Moon' at the Top Secret Comedy Club, London, 2026.

metas.name: Balls & Chains
metas.description: In a barren cell, two dogs endure the silence—one restless, the other distracted. A sudden figure at the door upends the balance, triggering a surreal transformation that blurs the line between animal and the unknown. When the door opens, only one leaves; the other is left in shock.

metas.name: Not So Public Spaces
metas.description: Teenagers reclaim public spaces as their playground—until their joy collides with the vision of an angry capitalist. Through his power, the spaces are transformed, shifting from places of freedom into a manufactured “paradise.”

metas.name: I Take
metas.description: When six-year-old Otto writes his very first story, words come to life as images. As he reads aloud, his imaginative world unfolds in an animation lovingly created by his mother.

metas.name: APEX
metas.description: A grizzly moves effortlessly through a vast landscape, as others flee from an unseen threat. Meanwhile, a human, driven by his own instincts, navigates the same terrain. Both apex predators dominate the top of the food chain, but their worlds collide when they cross paths.

metas.name: Trouble in Mind
metas.description: Lucille, a 14-year-old alligator, finally gets to spend the summer with her estranged father Bill, a blues guitarist. She joins him and his band on tour to help out as a roadie and looks forward to spending time with him. She hopes playing the guitar together and learning to play his hit-song: Cold Blooded Woman will help build a better relationship. On stage Bill is charming, but getting close to Bill is not what she expected as she discovers the true meaning behind his music.

metas.name: Leif Elggren – livet, döden, konsten, makten
Musti Kusti - Black Humor
metas.description: In this stand-up show, Musti Kusti observes Turkey from both an insider’s and an outsider’s perspective, covering topics such as Anatolian grandmothers, city uncles, the Aegean dialect, patriotism, the white T-shirt worn at night, and much more.

metas.name: Reversion
metas.description: A man's brain is shrinking.

metas.name: Prince Hamlet
metas.description: The ghost of the King of Denmark tells his son Hamlet to avenge his murder by killing the new king, Hamlet's uncle.  Will Hamlet be able to achieve justice for his father?

metas.name: To Let in a Wolf
metas.description: Two men have sheltered in a remote bunker. When a stranger comes seeking refuge, their fragile coexistence unravels.

metas.name: Spectral Tranquility
metas.description: Mirroring The Distance Between Natural Surroundings And Internal Separation. Duel Vision Within A Deepened State Of Dissociation. Nature And Psychosis Side By Side, Thinly Divided And Relentlessly Oppressive. Moments Which Could Not Last, Captured Briefly Alongside Their Reckoning.

metas.name: CREPUSCULO
metas.description: Tritanomaly, an illness invisible to the world.  Within her, blue dissolves and rose blossoms.  Then, solitude becomes an inner landscape.

metas.name: Church of Glass
metas.description: The life of filmmaker Matthijs Vuijk's grandmother Coby is turned upside down when the community church she has attended all her life in the small Zeelandic village Kortgene is forced to close. Fortunately, preacher and entrepreneur Ruben van Zwieten, buys the church and aims to transform the faith community to be ready for the 21st Century, by attracting young people, but with all bills paid. Church of Glass explores the confrontation between the small aging faith community of Kortgene and the slick neo-theological entrepreneurship of Ruben van Zwieten transformational vision.

metas.name: The Pavilion
metas.description: Canada, WWII. Two young girls take inspiration from a magical storybook to help their ailing mother.

metas.name: Anywhere but Here as Long as I Don't Have to Leave the Comfort of Home
metas.description: A man travels out of town to visit a friend.

metas.name: The Podcast
metas.description: A university attempts to create a podcast yet things do not go to plan.

metas.name: Fargo Theatre: The First 100 Years
metas.description: In celebration of the Theatre’s centennial, we take a look back at the first hundred years of movies, pipe organs, concerts, festivals, popcorn, architecture, smoking lounges, and, very briefly, farm animals.

metas.name: Heartbreakers
metas.description: A heartbroken Adam Smith, unable to get over his ex-girlfriend, turns to Will Harvard and The Breaker Twins to get her back. Adam quickly discovers that they view love in a very different way than most.

metas.name: 5ections
metas.description: Ignacio seems like an ordinary vlogger—until his video takes an unsettling turn as he becomes obsessed with a solitary man he spots on the street.

metas.name: BABYMETAL - Live at Intuit Dome
metas.description: BABYMETAL - Live at Intuit Dome was a special headline show by BABYMETAL held at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles on November 1st 2025. Celebrating their 15th anniversary, and as part of their 2025/2026 world tour, BABYMETAL made history as the first Japanese group to hold a one-man live show and sell out said show at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles!

metas.name: Apples & Pears
metas.description: Sofia, a reserved and bookish 18 year old, is on the cusp of graduating high school when her free-spirited sister Joan dies in a tragic accident. Wracked with guilt, Sofia decides to take the European adventure that Joan had planned but would never complete. She sets out with Joan’s backpack and itinerary, drifting from city to city, encountering strangers and unfamiliar experiences, in search of something she cannot yet name

metas.name: Good Time
metas.description: An old friend comes back after a long time. They spend good time together like nothing ever changed, watching TV, playing games, drinking beer, listening to music, and talking about life. For a moment, it feels like the good old days again. But when the friend leaves something feels different.

metas.name: Searching
metas.description: An old re-edit I made of The Searchers (1956). One of my favorite movies.

metas.name: A Short Film About Suicide
metas.description: A young cinema student investigates the suicide of his friend’s aunt. As he watches the footage she filmed in Gülhane Park after losing her husband and son, and reads through her diary, he begins to uncover a hidden relationship from her past.

metas.name: Monument
metas.description: The military statue is absent, yet its presence reigns; it seems like an open wound. With each turn, more buds of time bloom. There are multiple rhythms and points of view in a brief, eternal moment. An exercise in the effect of speed and its personal interplay with the viewer. Photos taken at the scene on October 18, 2024, the fifth anniversary of the 2019 Social Uprising. 35mm B&W Still Photography. Silent. Flickering Lights.

metas.name: Baking Soda
metas.description: Two clueless friends discover a mysterious white powder packet and believe they’ve struck gold. Armed with nothing but confidence and bad judgment, they dive into a plan that slowly spirals out of control.

metas.name: Women Out of Order
metas.description: The stories of four women, each at a different stage of life and facing different challenges, yet all haunted by the oppressive sense that the meaninglessness around them is becoming ever more overwhelming. In conflict with age, femininity, love, and pain, they long for change – radical, painful, yet life-giving. Don't worry too much about them. They are women, and they can bear the consequences of every mistake they make – even those caused by others.

metas.name: Sunday Sunset
metas.description: Five reunited high school friends grapple with alarming news reports citing a fifty percent chance that the world will end within two years.

metas.name: Radio Gwen
metas.description: Radio Gwendalyn is facing a crucial challenge: professionalization. It is the first community radio station in the Italian-speaking part of Switzerland to obtain the status of a complementary non-profit radio station.  Through this story, the documentary explores the broader context in which the station operates: a network of often invisible yet deeply interconnected realities. It is also a journey into the lives of the people who keep the radio alive, their stories, daily challenges, and the motivations that drive them forward.  The film follows the Radio Gwen community through a year of transformation: from the complete renovation of the studios in Chiasso to a new internal organization and the launch of a renewed programming schedule.  This recognition defines the station’s mission: to fill the gaps left by commercial and public broadcasters, offering an authentic service rooted in the local community.

metas.name: Mary the Widow
metas.description: An aging widow begrudgingly goes to a speed-dating event at her daughter’s request. Among a string of dud dates, one gentle stranger lingers in her mind. Mary the Widow is a tender look at love, memory, and the echoes of what we’ve lost.

metas.name: The Seemingly Perfect Family
metas.description: Inspired by true events. When 18-year-old Lexi ages out of the foster care system and lies to get an au pair job, the dream family she is working for turns out to be a nightmare as she uncovers their twisted secrets. Rylee Reagan stars.

metas.name: Eigengrau
metas.description: The protagonist works at a warehouse with his mentor and friend. Very much unlike each other, they nevertheless keep together, learning each other's past. Having lost his family, the protagonist feels more affinity with his colleagues. Later he meets a girl and senses the birth of a new life.

metas.name: Songs of the Moon King
metas.description: After a mystic ceremony in the forest the girl wakes up in a house without windows, where a cult, isolated from the sun, resides. Their only source of light is the sacred icon windows producing artificial light. The protagonist will undergo the rite of initiation and meet their dying king to escape from the house.

metas.name: Der Moment in dem ich dich ins Herz schloss
Marigold Spring Victory Series 2026 ~ Day 3: Chika Goto Homecoming
metas.description: Marigold Spring Victory Series 2026 ~ Day 3: Chika Goto Homecoming was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold. It took place on March 15, 2026 at Sunpearl Arakawa in Tokyo, Japan.

metas.name: Stardom Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Finals~
metas.description: Cinderella Tournament 2026 ~Finals~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on March 15, 2026, at the Yokohama Budokan in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan. It primarily focused on the semi-final and final matches for the company's annual single-elimination tournament, as well as other featured bouts.

metas.name: Click Ceremony
metas.description: It is a story of an aged photographer Sansar Nath who gets entangled in the crisis of two young couples. He is unable to cope up with the changing times. Now he must accept the truth or fight for deliverance in his solitude.

metas.name: No Room For Love
metas.description: The Santiagos are a Filipino-American family of seven crammed into one tiny Los Angeles apartment, all chasing distant showbiz dreams. Bound by love and constant bickering, they navigate a turbulent year: isolation in spring, betrayal in summer, disaster at a fall party, and eviction in winter. No Room For Love is a comedy about big dreams, small spaces, and artists doing their best to survive poverty, bad luck, and each other - without ever giving up.

metas.name: TJPW Grand Princess '26: Fate in Ryōgoku
metas.description: TJPW Grand Princess '26: Fate in Ryōgoku was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW). It was held on March 15, 2026 at Ryōgoku KFC Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

metas.name: Japantown: What is Lost, What Remains
metas.description: A man fights to preserve what remains of Salt Lake City’s erased Japantown.

metas.name: Let Our Mountains Live
metas.description: Sami reindeer herders win a Supreme Court victory against Europe’s largest wind farm - but when the state refuses to act, their fight reveals a deeper crisis of justice and trust.

metas.name: NJPW New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 9
metas.description: The ninth night of New Japan Cup 2026 took place on March 15, 2026, at Aimesse Yamanashi in Kofu, Yamanashi, Japan and featured two quarterfinal matches.

metas.name: The Way We Move
metas.description: Amber Galloway, a trailblazer in ASL interpretation, takes us on a journey into the deep bond between the Deaf world and music. We follow her as she teaches struggling recruits who she hopes will have what it takes to join her at ACL music festival.

metas.name: Мэхээлэчээн Булчут
metas.description: The wise hunter Mekhelecheen, living in harmony with nature, is concerned about his grandson Mishuk. The boy, spoiled by life, doesn't appreciate the legacy of his ancestors and doesn't understand the beauty of the harsh taiga. To pass on ancient knowledge to his grandson, his grandfather takes him into the dense forest. However, the journey turns into unexpected trials: Mishuk and his faithful dog, Sergekh, become lost in the forest. In despair, they encounter a magical deer—the guardian of the taiga—who grants the boy the amazing ability to understand the language of all living things. Together with his grandfather, he fights poachers to save the Spirit of the Taiga.

metas.name: The 13th Annual On Cinema Oscar Special
metas.description: Host and HEI Network CEO New Heidecker has sworn his departure from On Cinema at the Cinema, but frequent Guest Expert Gregg Turkington wants the show to go on... Will this be the last Oscar Special ever? Only one way to find out!

metas.name: Road To L'Etape Du Tour
metas.description: Facing a turning point in her life, a woman with a congenital heart defect embarks on a journey to train for a stage of the Tour de France.

metas.name: The Silo and Us
metas.description: In a tiny Danish town, an abandoned grain silo is to become an artistic landmark with an observation tower and international art center, aiming to revitalize the town which is caught in a downward spiral of depopulation and store closures. But not everyone shares the enthusiasm. "The Silo and Us" a warm portrait of the urbane and the provincial, of highbrow and low key, of horn-rimmed glasses and flannel shirts. And everything in between.

metas.name: A Voyage to Cuba
metas.description: After 30 years of dreaming to sail around the world alone, a humble Romanian sailor starts a 1,200-mile journey with unexpected turns and challenges.

metas.name: 40 Years of Fuckin' Up
metas.description: The Truth Behind The Insanity of The Iconic Punk Band NOFX

metas.name: AEW Revolution 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Revolution was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on March 15, 2026, at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California, and was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Adam Page in a Texas Death Match for the AEW World Championship.

metas.name: Open My Mind
metas.description: Filmmaker Marcel Wyss explores the potential of psychoactive substances in mental health treatment, blending documentary and animation to navigate personal demons, scientific breakthroughs, and the shifting landscape of therapy.

metas.name: Paris Opera Ballet: Le Parc
metas.description: Ballet in three acts (1994) Encore Screenings! ‘What has become of love today?’ asked Angelin Preljocaj in 1994, when he created Le Parc for the Paris Opera Ballet. Thirty years later, the world has changed again, but his timeless ballet has travelled around the world. In a French-style garden, the choreography draws us into the seduction games of the Grand Siècle and the Age of Enlightenment, appealing to our classical musical and literary imagination: famous works by Mozart, the Map of Tendre, Dangerous Liaisons. But Preljocaj breaks with tradition by introducing a contemporary soundtrack and a choreographic language composed of broken lines and sensual movements. Like the final pas de deux, where the bodies whirl around for a languorous kiss: a moment of grace that has become the signature of this ballet.

metas.name: Party USA
metas.description: When Taylor can't get her party store shift covered after her dad dies, she makes a deadly mistake that sparks a downward spiral of red, white and blue-collared chaos.

metas.name: The Fertilizer Home
metas.description: In a rural village, a strange phenomenon arises in which people are driven to kill the one they love most. Mi-jo, the village's most powerful figure, steps forward in the name of the greater good. But as the truth is revealed, she comes face-to-face with her own desires—and unveils her bloodstained nature.

metas.name: Give It Up
metas.description: When washed up stand-up comedian Mortimer Baldwin (Gareth Reynolds) is replaced on his popular podcast by a viral sensation 9-year-old, his manager (Jake Johnson) sends him out on a tour to reclaim his career and film his comeback comedy special - but what's so funny?

metas.name: GUTS: A Female Expedition Through Africa
metas.description: Patrizia and Marie left everything behind and embarked on a five-month, 20,000 km off-road journey from France to Guinea-Bissau—with nothing but an old car, four surfboards, and a mission: to capture the stories of inspiring women redefining their place in society across Northwest Africa. What happened on that long and dusty road was pure magic. From the first female mountain guide of Morocco to the women’s rights activist in Nouakchott, or the young surf collective in Dakar, they all showed that when women dare to break free from conventions and listen to their own voice, a revolution begins—not just for them, but for their communities, their countries, and the world.

metas.name: Young Female Playwright
metas.description: When 26-year-old Millie lands a career-making debut as playwright at Canada’s National Theatre, celebration quickly turns to scrutiny after a press release describes her play as a “deeply personal story”. Millie is sure that the dark, family-drama is a work of fiction; but her family is concerned, especially her Uncle Mark, a school teacher and recovered alcoholic. Through bright lights, and dark comedy, Young Female Playwright asks who gets to tell what story, and what it costs for a woman to be believed.

metas.name: Greatness of Absence
metas.description: What does an actor leave behind? That is the question that Alla Demidova asks herself, the audience, the eternity. She went and lived through the tragedies by Shakespeare, Electra, Phaedra, Medea. Where can one go henceforth? If only become a phantom, an image, something eternal, an enduring reflection of this world in the mirror. This film is a journey away from our reality to an imaginary universe, to reflections, images, phantoms. It starts with an exposition devoted to Alla Demidova at the St. Petersburg Museum of Theatre and Music Art. But it does not only document the space; thanks to Demidova's speech it turns into a retrospective of her work, the parts she played, an explication of her approach to acting.

metas.name: The Oligarch and the Art Dealer
metas.description: When the Swiss art dealer Yves Bouvier meets the Russian oligarch Dmitry Rybolovlev, he quickly rises through the ranks. From a role as a discreet adviser, he becomes a global power broker and manager of Rybolovlev’s investments in one of the world’s most closed and enigmatic markets: the part of the art world where the sums are staggering and the value of artworks is something agreed upon by a narrow elite of connoisseurs and ultrarich tycoons. This version edited the 3 episode miniseries down to 2 hours and presented as a feature film.

metas.name: This Tempting Madness
metas.description: A young woman awakens from a coma grievously injured, memory fractured, her husband arrested. But as she puts together the pieces of her past, she starts to question her own actions — and her perception of reality.

metas.name: The Boy with the Dinosaur Head
metas.description: A troubled first-grader is convinced he's a dinosaur, much to the chagrin of the teacher tasked with bringing him back down to earth. What passes between them, though fragile and brief, is enough to change how both will remember this day.

metas.name: Dynamite Som - O Futuro é Lamento Negro
The Shepherd Code: Lapierre
metas.description: Lewis enlists his top agent, Alex Lapierre - aka "The Shepherd" - for a mission that's as high-stakes as it is dangerous: eliminate a list of targets for Tania Edwards, a powerful and enigmatic woman tangled in a massive scandal. But things quickly take an unexpected turn. A mysterious bounty hunter, known only as "The Ghost," enters the picture with a very different agenda: to take out both Tania and Alex, but on whose behalf? Caught between the conflicting demands of his superiors and his own growing doubts, Alex faces a tough decision: follow orders and remain the loyal soldier he's trained to be, or be swayed by Tania's allure and question everything he believes in.

metas.name: In a Few Words
metas.description: A man's cure for loneliness lies at the other end of an automated answering service.

metas.name: Estela and the Cosmic Path: Origins
metas.description: In 2095, amidst a future ravaged by the effects of climate change and excessive resource exploitation, Estela, a Afro-Indigenous heroine is plagued by flashbacks of a past which refuses to fade away. In her pursuit of justice, she senses that some ancient and mysterious force seeks to communicate with her.

metas.name: Venenus
metas.description: Fisheress, beware not to catch in your nets the sulfurous Seranha! The malefic Venenus, from her mouth injected, will inflame your sleeping ecstasy and transform you forever…

metas.name: Paper Parts
metas.description: After a Paper character rearranges his body to become fashionable in a paper world of fast fashion, he gets confronted by the parts he left behind...

metas.name: Comedy Family Style
metas.description: In Comedy Family Style, stand-up comic Helen brings her son to Beijing to connect with their roots. He wants Wi-Fi and boba—she wants gratitude. Between culture clashes and punchlines, they confront the gap between love and perception, asking: How do we know we matter to the people we love.

metas.name: Repu Udayam 10 Gantalaku
metas.description: A deadly countdown begins when strangers receive an ultimatum: escape before 10 a.m. tomorrow or face catastrophic consequences. With hours ticking away, survival depends on outrunning an escalating threat.

metas.name: The Perfectionist
metas.description: A man spends so long trying to get his tie perfect that he misses the very meeting he was dressing for.

metas.name: Error: Connection Lost
metas.description: An autobiographical story that portrays the quiet, disorienting experience of a child shaped by migration’s instability. Centered on a brother and sister growing up in Ukraine in the early 2000s, the film follows their move to the Netherlands and the way they eventually drift apart.

metas.name: Love Letter to Texas
metas.description: A cinematic tribute to the spirit and landscape of Texas, following a lone character who travels across its vast terrain in search of a life that better fits who he is.

metas.name: Rhode Goes To Hollywood
metas.description: The village of Rhode takes to the big screen for an event like no other. Watch as some of the community's brightest personalities take on some of cinema's biggest characters. Films such as The Young Offenders, A Few Good Men, The Field, Sister Act, One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest, Derry Girls and The Snapper. Watch all of them on the Rhode GAA YouTube channel!

metas.name: Driving Europe
metas.description: More and more goods are being transported on Europe's roads, yet work conditions for truck drivers are getting worse and worse. Exploitative dependency and wage dumping. A broken system! The film relentlessly exposes how disenfranchisement has become the norm.

metas.name: I'm Looking for Mr. Laser
metas.description: Have you heard of this guy who broke the laws of gravity and shot mosquitoes with an intelligent laser? Even though I was in touch with him, he never wanted to show himself. I decided to find him.

metas.name: Around the void
metas.description: A young woman hides herself from her bad memories underneath her umbrella.

metas.name: Pembe & Eflatun
metas.description: Pembe & Eflatun is an ecofeminist short sand animation, following the innkeeper couple, Pembe and Eflatun, who open doors to a group of stranded refugee women and children. As the refugees settle in, a series of secrets begin to surface about how the couple has been managing this ex-prison, now inn.

metas.name: Singgah
metas.description: A woman returns to her old home after feeling that her life has failed. Every month, she mysteriously finds a white chrysanthemum in her mailbox, which brings back memories of someone she has never truly moved on from. As she searches for the person behind the flowers, she is forced to face her past and learn to accept loss in order to continue living her life.

metas.name: BKFC Fight Night Newcastle 2026: Mick Terrill vs Jay McFarlane
metas.description: In the main event, the BKFC UK Heavyweight Championship is on the line as former champion Mick Terrill faces hard-hitting contender Jay McFarlane.

metas.name: Birth Is for P*ssies
metas.description: A rookie doula is thrust into her first birth with a mother she's never met. After a rocky start, she quickly learns supporting women through labor is messier, funnier, and more profound than any training could have prepared her for.

metas.name: Billiards
metas.description: John John, and Seth play an intense game of billiards where the winner takes it all

metas.name: Half Step
metas.description: A closeted songwriter suffers from anxiety and creative block while hiding her true feelings for her bandmate. As tension builds and boundaries break, her private lyrics expose her struggle with sexuality and acceptance. Forcing confrontation within the band.

metas.name: Chappell Roan: Lollapalooza Argentina 2026
metas.description: The queen shined as the headliner on Saturday night with a mega iconic show. Between glitter, aesthetics and hits like Good Luck, Babe!, she created a party full of freedom and attitude.

metas.name: AAA Rey De Reyes 2026
metas.description: The first match was Flammer's open challenge for the AAA Reina de Reinas Championship, which was answered by Bayley from WWE's Raw brand. The Rey de Reyes tournament final featuring "The Original" El Grande Americano, El Grande Americano, La Parka, and Santos Escobar followed. Next, Domink Mysterio defended the AAA Mega Championship against El Hijo Del Vikingo in a Lucha de Apuestas No Disqualification match.

metas.name: Kintsugi
metas.description: Kintsugi (金継) is a Japanese practice of repairing broken pottery with gold. The breaks and repairs are thus made visible, displayed rather than hidden. Human relationships aren't like pottery; perhaps they're more complex than simply repairing a plate. However, there's a certain parallel between our reunion and this ancient technique. Undoubtedly, there are wounds that were exposed by the distance that separated us for over a month. This isn't something to be ignored or hidden. However, that doesn't mean these emotional wounds can't be repaired. On the contrary, they become the foundation upon which we can build a strong bond. And that's what I want; I want to reclaim what was taken from us, our relationship. Ana Martes, I love you like I've never loved anyone before.

metas.name: Confession
metas.description: A man driven to crime by economic turmoil, must confront his actions after violence escalates.

metas.name: Study Session
metas.description: When three students find the answers to the final exam they struggle to study for they enter a Mexican standoff to hopefully pass the test

metas.name: What a Guy Wants
metas.description: The CEO of a company that offers dating advice meets his match when a new client appears on the scene.

metas.name: Mystery Wrestling #22
metas.description: Mystery Wrestling #22 took place on Twitch,TV on March 14 2026

metas.name: Island
metas.description: an experimental short film showing a short trip to Iceland, accompanied by images and a poem by the director

metas.name: An Unlikely Friendship
metas.description: A bubbly barista tries to make friends with a grumpy old man, but it's harder than it looks...

metas.name: Miraculous Leaf
metas.description: Through the six major categories of Chinese tea, the film traces the historical origins of famous tea-producing regions and explores the lives of generations who have lived with and for tea. It celebrates craftsmanship, explores lesser-known tea-making techniques, and honors the wisdom, dedication, and philosophy of Chinese tea artisans — revealing a deep respect for nature and an unwavering commitment to cultural heritage.

metas.name: Monday
metas.description: Anxious for a date, a teenage boy spends the day with a friend.

metas.name: You ain't nothing but a hand, dog
In the Beginning
metas.description: A spaceprobe called Beresheet, legless birds of paradise, hamster cull and humanity trying to make the world make sense.

metas.name: Superglue
metas.description: Art assistant Ryan wants to leave Crispin’s crew and something personal of Freddy’s goes missing.

metas.name: Flow
metas.description: When an aspiring dancer tells her boyfriend that she is leaving for an academy, she's met with resistance from him. How will she make him understand?

metas.name: Physical Touch
metas.description: When his wife is kidnapped by his ex-best friend, agent Dixon Butts must face his twisted nemesis in a deadly dance of fists, feelings, and frosting.

metas.name: How to Catch a Butterfly
metas.description: In 2021, 21-year-old Robert Aaron Long kills 6 Asian women in massage parlors in Atlanta, Georgia as a way to suppress his uncontrollable sexual desire. Dutch-Japanese filmmaker Kiriko Mechanicus writes letters to the young murderer to find out what his killings have to do with her sexual life. What do our racial fetishes tell us about our hidden human desires?

metas.name: Running on Waves
metas.description: As Yorgos Papalios trains for the Athens Marathon, his remarkable life unfolds – from shipping dynasties and revolutionary Cuba to the shaping of Greek cinema and cultural policy – revealing a personal journey that echoes the modern history of Greece.

metas.name: Echoes of Beneath
metas.description: After a motorbike accident left him paralyzed from the waist down, Antonis Tsapatakis turns to swimming and becomes a Paralympic athlete. Through training, family, and everyday moments, the film observes the slow process of redefining identity, resilience, and freedom after irrevocable changes of life.

metas.name: ... One Road the Sea
metas.description: Far away is where you don’t want to go, ERT3 captures the offering of the Aegean Team to the border islands. There, where the sea connects and volunteering becomes a journey of life. 450 nautical miles, 5,525 medical examinations, 18 specialties, 132 volunteers. There, at the edges, where the scream of the islands meets the whisper of humanity. There, between need and the human being… a road to the sea!

metas.name: Soap Fever
metas.description: With the Soviet Union’s dissolution dragging down the economy of neighboring Finland, the Scandinavian country was plunged in a period of protracted recession. And with no recovery in sight, a soap opera offered Finns a respite from the grim reality; the debut of The Bold and the Beautiful on television quickly amassed a vast and dedicated following, whereas the arrival of American idols in the country, on tour, elicited unprecedented frenzy.

metas.name: Jeremiah: The Jilling Koke
metas.description: The sequel to 2024's Jeremiah: The Killing Joke

metas.name: Belleville Kitchen
metas.description: A fifth-grade teacher in Belleville turns her classroom into a kitchen, guiding students to explore culture, identity, and community through cooking, family recipes, and connections that foster empathy and understanding.

metas.name: Алмаз «Сердце Персии»
metas.description: The Cyrus the Great Diamond is stolen from an excavation site in Iran and falls into the hands of a Russian boy vacationing at the seaside with his family.

metas.name: Sonhos Da Isah: Final De Ano
The Weight of Cherries
metas.description: Yuna and her best friend are inseparable. But when she suddenly moves away, Yuna is left behind alone. To escape the loneliness, she imagines a mysterious boy named Emil. Can Yuna overcome her grief with his help?

metas.name: Eclipse
metas.description: 1960. There's an outbreak of smallpox in Moscow. This incurable deadly disease was considered conquered in the USSR. To fight the possible epidemic the KGB assigns colonel Shilov. He dives into the struggle at once because he has an old account to settle with smallpox. The task is to locate all those infected and stop the spread of the virus. But it is not an easy mission. The infection has spread to the underworld of the capital. Shilov must look for answers in the depths of the criminal world, unearthing its inhabitants and secrets.

metas.name: In the Mountains. He
metas.description: Albert and Eldar are members of a music label engaged in preserving folk music traditions. Their new mission takes them to a mountain village to record the last performer of an old Kabardian song. In the village they learn that the old man has gone into the mountains to die. This message marks the start of a journey, both the outer through hard country, and inner, that of overcoming, of meeting traditions, quietness and oneself.

metas.name: Beyond the Pages
metas.description: While reading Aarav's diary, Vanya finds herself drawn back to a quiet afternoon in college and a classmate who carried more silence than words. Through a diary and a conversation about fathers and absence, she begins to understand that love often hides behind fear, and that some calls remain unanswered long after they are made.

metas.name: Snooze
metas.description: After snoozing his alarm, a teenager drifts back into sleep, descending through a maze of time and reality. As the dream deepens, the line between the waking world and the sleeping specter begins to bleed and blur, until reality melts into a trance.

metas.name: Marigold Spring Victory Series 2026 ~ Day 2
metas.description: Marigold Spring Victory Series 2026 ~ Day 2 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold. It took place on March 14, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

metas.name: Restauration (I emigrantenes kjølvann)
metas.description: On July 4, 1825, the sailing ship Restoration set sail from Stavanger with 52 passengers on board. The destination was New York and a new and better life in America. The dramatic journey would prove to be the start of a massive emigration from Norway over the years that followed. To mark the 200th anniversary of the emigration, Restoration is once again heading west towards New York. This time, film footage is being made on board to document the crossing and give us an insight into life on a small sailing ship on its way across the Atlantic. What it must have been like for the crew and passengers in 1825. This documentary film depicts the environment and experiences of the participants as they travel to America through sunshine, storms and rain.

metas.name: Land of the Unexpected
metas.description: Kyrre Waag abandons his economics studies, waves goodbye to all prospects of a predictable future, and decides instead to pursue an unlikely dream: Building a global music career from his native Norway. When his band, Naked Koala, releases the song “Right with Me,” an unexpected audience emerges. An outpouring of heartfelt messages arrives from Papua New Guinea. The documentary Land of the Unexpected follows Kyrre’s journey into the unknown, and his dream of playing a stadium concert in the capitol of the island nation where he unexpectedly became a superstar. It is a wild and beautiful story about unexpected life paths, human connection, and, most of all, the universal language of music

metas.name: Are You Okay?
metas.description: A young boy struggling through mental difficulties who just needs some help.

metas.name: Journeys of a Gentle Southern Man
metas.description: An animated hybrid documentary detailing the life of author Jackie K. Cooper.

metas.name: The Boy with My Son's Face
metas.description: Susan's baby dies, and she is convicted for a crime she doesn’t even remember committing. Years later, out on parole and fighting to start over, Susan sees a photograph that stops her cold.

metas.name: Strophische Gedichten
metas.description: In the Flemish countryside, Hadewijch of Brabant experiences a transcendent vision of God.

metas.name: Jason's Box
metas.description: What happens when an experienced climate scientist becomes an activist? In Greenland, scientist Jason Box and his local colleagues are launching a radical project to raise global awareness.

metas.name: Bauhaus Forever.
metas.description: A cinematic essay on perception and the afterlife of ideas - told through a place in transition. A film of magnificent intellectual scope and uncompromising formal integrity.

metas.name: HALFway
metas.description: Living with half a body and longing to become whole, Bani, a half-girl, sets out to find her other half. She keeps the secret that one of the half-bodies must die to truly become one person.

metas.name: Adult Diary
metas.description: Adult Diary explores how new media can shape gender and identity through nine virtual alter-egos. Starting from a diary of how a non-human becomes human, I created cinemagraphs of self-portraits and let one AI infer prompts, then passed them to another AI for expansion—like a back-and-forth game with the machine. The video, blending V8 camcorder texture and 360° language, unfolds in nine roles: a thought abortionist, a gender designer, a blockchain pet-communicator, and more. It reflects on identity, gender politics, and AI ethics beyond life and death.

metas.name: Marked By The Walk
metas.description: An aspiring model overcoming her anxiety in order to perform on the runway.

metas.name: Woodstockers
metas.description: When his marriage collapses and his best friend dies, an aging hippie who went to Woodstock in 1969 and never left must finally reckon with a life shaped by peace, love, and too much weed.

metas.name: The Liars of Black Mountain Road
metas.description: When a couple runs over a stranger's dog, they compete for the moral high ground at any cost.

metas.name: He's Out There
metas.description: Years ago, Devin, who has special needs, became enthralled by Bigfoot after watching the long-running reality TV series Mountain Monsters. When his mom took the opportunity to foster her son’s passion, daily hunts for Sasquatch grew into something more than a pastime. He’s Out There tells the story of—in Devin’s words—the proudest week of his life.

metas.name: I Got My Brother
metas.description: Jarrett Harper and his younger brother Baylon share raw memories of abuse in LA's foster system, their unshakeable bond tested when the elder takes violent revenge on their abuser and faces life behind bars.

metas.name: Tell Me When You Get Home
metas.description: Fifteen year-old Honest Cardamom hasn’t seen her mother since she was four, but at a crowded family party she begins to feel her presence in ways she can’t explain. When Honest senses the presence of her mother she finds the courage to ask her uncle about the woman she barely remembers and, in doing so, begins to uncover pieces of herself.  Set in the space between Honest and her Uncle O, Tell Me When You Get Home unfolds as a long conversation between two people who have both lost a loved one. This short animated film is a testament to love and a testament to family.

metas.name: Divorce Resort
metas.description: After 8 years separated in the Philippines where divorce is illegal, Butch Meily, 72, travels to Guam for a quick divorce through residency laws. During his week-long stay, he reflects on his marriage while awaiting the final papers.

metas.name: A New Inferno
metas.description: Filmed during the hottest days of Phoenix, Arizona’s summer heatwave, A New Inferno follows paramedics as they race to save the lives of heatstroke victims using a radical new treatment: ice immersion therapy.

metas.name: In the Morning Sun
metas.description: In a quiet Toronto apartment, an immigrant mother finds comfort in her Alexa—weather updates, love songs, and the time back home become a lifeline to the Philippines, reminding her of the family she left behind. In the Morning Sun is a gentle portrait of aging, migration, and memory.

metas.name: A Wolf in the Suburbs
metas.description: Welcome to Mississauga where lawns are clipped, neighbors are watchful and no blade of grass dares misbehave. Except at Wolf Ruck’s place. His lawn grows wild, and so does the trouble.

metas.name: Eructation
metas.description: Kaylee is an insanely loud burper. The world record for loudest female burp is currently set at 107.3 decibels, which is louder than a hair dryer, a lawn mower, and a leaf blower. But it's a number that Kaylee routinely beats on her own—her loudest belch to date is 110 decibels as recorded on her decibel reader app. In this documentary short, we follow her as she prepares to go for the record.

metas.name: Mother Creature
metas.description: A daughter attempts to pull the monster of her childhood out from under the bed in an original, deeply personal and creative film about her mother's mental illness.

metas.name: The Mother Age
metas.description: Inspired by Ursula K. Le Guin and other female thinkers, a Norwegian filmmaker invites us on a sensual and richly philosophical journey of (re)discovery in the deep Finnish forests.

metas.name: NJPW New Japan Cup 2026 - Day 8
metas.description: The eighth night of New Japan Cup 2026 took place on March 14, 2026, at Nagoya Kinjo Pier Arena in Nagoya, Aichi, Japan and featured two second-round matches.

metas.name: Where Music Grows
metas.description: On a farm south of Copenhagen, young elite musicians practice the difficult art of classical music. A beautiful and life-affirming film full of wonderful music.

metas.name: 96 Pounds of Dynamite
metas.description: Diagnosed at birth with a rare condition that was expected to kill him, Chad "Shorty" McDaniel embraces humor, grit, and a competitive spirit to live the life others said he would never have and shatter assumptions about disability.

metas.name: Summer of '94
metas.description: When the World Cup landed in the U.S. in 1994, it arrived in a country with no league, no culture, and no clue. A ragtag group of players faced an impossible task: don't embarrass their nation in front of the entire world.

metas.name: Drift
metas.description: Isaac “Drift” Wright, a self-taught photographer and Army veteran haunted by trauma, finds healing through breathtaking, illegal climbs of the world’s tallest structures. But his pursuit of art sparks a high-stakes battle with law enforcement in this intimate portrait of risk, resilience, and freedom in modern America.

metas.name: Summer 2000: The X-Cetra Story
metas.description: Four friends reunite when the album they made as pre-teens becomes a cult hit on the internet and scores a record deal twenty years later. Together, they revisit their friendship and early 2000s girlhood.

metas.name: Mallory's Ghost
metas.description: Mallory, tormented by a fear of being insignificant, accompanies her playwright boyfriend Sam to a retreat on the coast of Maine. She learns that he once took his glamorous ex-girlfriend there. She is overcome by an obsessive curiosity.

metas.name: SNOT ROCKET: Eine Bohemian Schnapsidee
metas.description: Two Irish immigrants in Berlin plan a robbery on an old bookstore as "That is where all the money is these days"  Unable to come to terms with his own sexuality, TONY (Sean Gormley) plans to take his own life, when he is interrupted by GLEN (Andrew Kingston) a recently redundant hair transplant salesman. As they plan a heist on local German bookshop a feeling of unsaid truths lie just below the surface.

metas.name: Glacier's Requiem
metas.description: Glacier’s Requiem follows Nigerian-born, Los Angeles-based modular synthesis artist Colloboh during a period of self-imposed isolation on Iceland’s Snæfellsnes Peninsula. There, he transforms near-imperceptible field recordings of a dying glacier and the ocean into evolving sonic compositions. As his work unfolds, a dialogue between ice and sea emerges – reshaping his understanding of consciousness, ecological collapse, and humanity’s place within both.

metas.name: Nelly Knows Mysteries: All Manners of Murder
metas.description: Nelly and Detective Michael set out to solve the  murder of a guest while at a lavish dinner.

metas.name: A Song Without Home
metas.description: After 11 years confined to her family home, Adelina, a young trans woman, flees a Georgian village for Vienna in search of the freedom to be herself. As she builds her new life, she faces the past that refuses to let her go. Through immersive imagery and the mother-daughter bond, A Song Without Home paints a layered portrait of belonging and the complexity of freedom beyond physical liberation.

metas.name: And Her Body Was Never Found
metas.description: A couple treks deep into the wilderness to make a movie about their troubled relationship, but takes the opportunity to kill each other instead.

metas.name: The Last Critic
metas.description: Sixty years & a million records ago, Robert Christgau invented Rock music criticism. Anyone who has ever read or written a Pop music review has been influenced by Christgau, who canonized legends from The Ramones to Public Enemy & infuriated icons from Lou Reed to Billy Joel. Now in his eighties, Bob is still at it—amazingly with the same vigor, wit, concision and craft that has defined his expansive career. But in a world where albums are irrelevant, where print is dead & where algorithms have eclipsed critics we are forced to ask: What happens next—for Bob, but also for all music criticism? Is this the end of something? Is Robert Christgau the last critic?

metas.name: A Stable Marriage
metas.description: A woman's sexual fantasy is fulfilled - with surprising ramifications.

metas.name: The Man with the Big Hat
metas.description: An unsung pioneer of 1970s Texas Progressive Country, Steven Fromholz had a knack for snatching defeat from the jaws of victory. Revered by legends like Willie Nelson, Lyle Lovett & John Denver, he remained commercially unknown. He sought redemption on the Rio Grande as a river guide until a debilitating stroke erased his musical memory, stripping Fromholz of his artistic identity.  With an almost obsessive persistence bolstered by newly discovered archives as well as never-before-heard recordings, this intimate and impressionistic portrayal unveils the evolution of Fromholz, and reshapes the notion of success and artistic fortitude.

metas.name: HORSE
metas.description: Two guys play a game of HORSE

metas.name: Stockholm
metas.description: A young woman’s exploration of BDSM takes a dangerous turn when she’s abducted, forcing her to confront the boundaries between desire, consent and control.

metas.name: Smokers
metas.description: Smokers (Los Fumadores) is a drama about two Cuban exiles living in Miami, Rita and Gustavo, and their day-to-day lives. After tragedy occurs, Rita's estranged son Manuel arrives to spend time with her. He soon becomes obsessed over a family secret regarding his deceased sister. He attempts to come to terms with this secret while reconciling with his mother.

metas.name: When Pigs Fly
metas.description: Hearts are being grown in pigs to save human lives—blurring the boundaries between the two species. Could this be the impetus for a fundamental change in the relationship between humans and pigs?

metas.name: Everest
metas.description: As a promising beginning at Rehnbjerg Academy unravels, day student Daniel's encounter with the charismatic boarding student August unleashes forbidden emotions in a toxic culture, leading them to a perilous crossroads.

metas.name: HAG
metas.description: Our story begins with our heroine breaking up with her obnoxious boyfriend; what should be a moment of liberation instead transforms her from a regular thirty-something into a hag with snakes for hair. Hag battles society pressures, inner longings, and the tick of her own biological clock. She searches for love and meaning in a hellscape of waning fertility, dating apps and the rotten stench of the patriarchy. In this surreal South London, Hag's journey becomes mythical as her despair crystallises into a quest for answers, and she must face the ultimate test! In a world where being true to yourself makes you monstrous, what is the cost of compromise and repressing your authentic self?

metas.name: Ceremony
metas.description: When the Nuxalk trace the vanished ooligan to a land claim filed the very day smallpox arrived, their radio station becomes courtroom, confessional and conjuring ground; an older law insists: the fish return when the people do.

metas.name: The Way of Seeing Life
metas.description: Christian, an old painter, decides that if he wants to continue living with the memories of the ones he loves, and not lose a part of himself, he has to leave through unconventional means. A bittersweet story told in 4 chapters, each depicting a different perspective… on life

metas.name: The Realm of Invitation
metas.description: HE and LOVER return home with a mirror they use for their photography sessions. Through his gestures, HE seduces LOVER into making love. While HE is getting ready in the bathroom, an incident outside happened to LOVER. What follows is HE’s tried to be by the side of LOVER, another of their countless photo shoots, or their final act of intimacy. The sequences merge into one another, breaking the flow of time - memory, the ongoing moment, and the future. Every action is a way to find the answer to the question: "We are so happy when together, what will we do when one of us is absent?"

metas.name: Son of a Bikram
metas.description: Raag, an obsessive hot yoga practitioner faces a crisis when his idol is accused of sexual assault. On the same day, he loses his mother and discovers a family secret that leads him to desperately search for answers.

metas.name: Out of School
metas.description: In a rocky mountain village cut off from secondary education, siblings Mohammed and Fatima face the abrupt end of school at twelve. Standing at their childhood’s end, they are forced into an uncertain passage toward adult life.

metas.name: American Muscle
metas.description: A desperate mechanic's plan to escape his past unravels when his sister returns home and two violent debt collectors close in.

metas.name: If Both Could Be
metas.description: Faced with a decision about their future in a non-LGBTQ+ affirming church, a young queer Welsh theologian seeks clarity around their calling to Christian ministry.

metas.name: I Heard That They Are Not Going To See Each Other Anymore
metas.description: In Taipei’s dreamscape, Tao’s incomprehensible love for Shin drives her to create painful memories. Meanwhile, Melih, burdened with self-blame, longs to connect with the perpetually drunk Ping.

metas.name: Wild Nights, Tamed Beasts
metas.description: Delves into the realities of an aging society and centers on Ye Xiaolin – a former killer turned caregiver. She infiltrates and kills seniors under the guise of offering care, but her life takes an unexpected turn after a chance encounter with zookeeper Ma Deyong. As their fates become entangled and detective Zhou Ping begins to investigate the string of murders, a gripping story unfolds. The film raises awareness of aging-related societal issues by focusing on the themes of death, family dynamics, and the dignity of aging.

metas.name: Waves Won't Stop
metas.description: An experimental documentary in which the narrator evokes his childhood memories of Cyprus, and his connection to an indelible friendship defined by separation. Through vivid recollections of their lost bond, he explores themes of longing, belonging, and the enduring pull of his homeland that shaped them both. Waves Won’t Stop is an intimate look on a long journey of return.

metas.name: The Birds Tell Me All There Is To Know
metas.description: Two strangers quietly struggle to navigate their changing identities as the summer draws to a close.

metas.name: Brian
metas.description: An acerbic high school student prone to panic attacks runs for class president to get closer to his teacher.

metas.name: Manhood
metas.description: "Manhood" follows Dallas entrepreneur Bill Moore as he attempts to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox. Along the way, an OnlyFans star and a father of five put their bodies—and their insecurities—on the line. Blending dark humor with unexpected empathy, "Manhood" examines shame, addiction, and the fragile myths of American masculinity.

metas.name: Plan C
metas.description: Siblings Clare and Danny find themselves fugitives after a bungled robbery, leading them on a perilous journey filled with high-speed pursuits, moral dilemmas, and shocking revelations in the crime thriller "Plan C."

metas.name: Sender
metas.description: After receiving a series of packages containing unnervingly personal items, a woman tumbles down a paranoid rabbit hole to find her mysterious sender.

metas.name: Mermaid
metas.description: A 10-year-old boy yearning to become a mermaid meets a struggling drag queen consumed by grief. Their unexpected bond grows so strong they'll put everything on the line to preserve it.

metas.name: Di Sudirman
metas.description: A workaholic who was laid off by her boss, went looking for new happiness under the city lights of Jakarta, around Sudirman street.

metas.name: Their Town
metas.description: When Abby’s boyfriend unexpectedly drops out of the high school play, she is forced to help outlier Matt step into the role opposite her. Over the course of a long night wandering their small town, the two examine their futures and unearth surprises from their past.

metas.name: Born to Lose
metas.description: A young biker grapples with his father's troubled legacy and escalating debts to a local gangster. As he races to restore a vintage motorcycle to save himself, he must confront family secrets and forge his own identity.

metas.name: Over Your Dead Body
metas.description: A dysfunctional couple head to a remote cabin to "reconnect", but each has secret intentions to kill the other.

metas.name: Love Supreme
metas.description: Arakami, an animation director who was unjustly detained and imprisoned, is suddenly granted bail. His release comes with a catch: he must now create a film praising China's Xi Jinping.

metas.name: The Peril at Pincer Point
metas.description: On a quest to prove his competency, an inept sound recordist finds himself entangled in a nautical prophecy on the spectral island of Pincer Point.

metas.name: A Table For Two
metas.description: Their separate worlds converge when a restaurant owner suggests they "share a table" during overlapping lunch breaks. What starts as awkward silence evolves into tacit understanding over shared noodles, leading them to explore Shanghai's culinary scene together .

metas.name: Stormbound
metas.description: An intimate look at Jeff Gammons, a chronically ill man who finds peace and beauty chasing the world's largest hurricanes.

metas.name: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
metas.description: Two gangsters and the woman they love try to survive the most dangerous night of their lives. As if that wasn’t enough, there’s one wild ingredient added to the mix: a time machine.

metas.name: I Saw You in the Flood
metas.description: Kai, a genderqueer Chinese-American, and their mother, Li, deal with the effects of a heavy storm on their basement apartment in Queens. Zhou, Kai’s grandfather, is dying in Northeast China. During this sleepless night, a familiar spirit visits Kai and mistakes them for Li.

metas.name: Can I Put You On Hold
metas.description: Matthew and his girlfriend Dangmo dream of starting a life together in the U.S., but when her visa is unexpectedly denied, their future is thrown into limbo. Struggling with the cold reality of immigration barriers, Matthew seeks help from his lawyer, only to be left “on hold” as his world unravels. Blending grounded drama with surreal visual storytelling, Can I Put You On Hold explores the pressures of long-distance love, the excessive weight of bureaucracy, and the sacrifices people make to be together.

metas.name: Vomit
metas.description: Wildcard addict on the run from trouble shows up bloodied and battered at the door of his home health aide ex-girlfriend, turning both their lives upside down in this super dark comedy about love, death, drugs, and ferrets.

metas.name: Visitors
metas.description: A young woman in the throes of early pregnancy starts to question her own reality when strange things begin to happen to the people closest to her.

metas.name: We Were Here
metas.description: In a crumbling Indian town, three retired men stage a protest against machines taking over human jobs, by pretending to be household appliances.

metas.name: Talk Me
metas.description: Pedro, an outsider trapped in a passionless marriage, secretly escapes through music. When he meets Kira, another outsider who shares his yearning for true intimacy, they begin a risky conversational affair.

metas.name: Lightbulb
metas.description: What if a lightbulb has emotions? Short with a deep, sweet message.

metas.name: The Suit Heist
metas.description: When a trans male student, who wants to wear a suit for the school prom, is gifted an expensive pink dress by his mum, he has to decide between pleasing his mum or being himself.

metas.name: 观音旅馆 / 觀音旅館
Promyana
metas.description: Jolie is an aspiring breakdancer ready to conquer the city and Pierre is a burned-out office worker who is ready to give up on it. We see how two strangers from two different worlds constantly cross paths and have their morals challenged.

metas.name: Глина
metas.description: A story about a couple whose autistic son, Bozhidar, disappears into the forest—just after his mother, Maria, in a moment of emotional breakdown, wishes he would vanish. Тhe parents as they face their greatest challenge, not only with their child, but with each other and themselves.

metas.name: Queerjoy
metas.description: Made up of amateur footage recorded by young LGBT people during a trip to an event significant to the queer community, Queerjoy is a documentary that captures these same youths reflecting on what it means to belong to this community, to seek spaces of free expression, and to live in a society that still carries many prejudices about the way they live.

metas.name: My Mother: Artist and Teacher
metas.description: My Mother: Artist and Teacher is for us as a collaboration, as an opportunity to contact our mother heart, our father heart, our own heart. Sing along, hum, vibrate with moans, tears, laughter, or silence! It's free therapy!!!

metas.name: Birthing Godot
metas.description: ‘Birthing Godot’ pairs footage of the artist birthing her son with fragments of the Anglican Eucharistic prayer narrated by her three-year-old daughter.

metas.name: Promenade
metas.description: ‘Promenade’ combines footage of Myra Hess performing her transcription of JS Bach’s ‘Jesu Joy of Man’s Desiring’ (popularised through her National Gallery wartime concerts) with Sissy Spacek’s post-apocalyptic journey in ‘Carrie’.

metas.name: Liggetid
metas.description: Short film about the misadventures of a young single dad.

metas.name: Keith
metas.description: Kate has been running her child modelling agency for 25 years and prides herself on being unshakeable. But when interview day hits, Kate and her assistant Jeffrey are thrown into a parade of hopeful parents, and unpredictable children.

metas.name: Vespers
metas.description: This short video is a consideration of awe put to language inspired by a lineage of Tarkovskian musings that occurred whilst underwater and poetry of the New York School.

metas.name: insufferable / rare honor / noself, em / where is here / placevid72, dreamt someone was holding me tightly by the ribcage 4
metas.description: ‘insufferable / rare honor / noself, em / where is here / placevid72, dreamt someone was holding me tightly by the ribcage 4’ is made from original video footage, field and synthesizer recordings, screenshots and recordings of still images and digital art works, and collaborative dance pieces.

metas.name: Fog is coming
metas.description: The modern architecture of the airport aims to control bodies in motion through the denial of location. The spatial channeling of consumerism functions as distraction from the immense environmental damage caused by kerosene. I carried a silicone doll through the terminals, and it was harder than I had expected. I was sweating and nervous.

metas.name: Holding Shards
metas.description: Holding Shards is a performance to camera video work. It was filmed in a burnt, regrowing woodland in Kent; a desecrated church in Swansea; and a stream in the Gower Peninsula. The work builds on a live performance made in the village of Walsingham, Norfolk (Messenger’s Lament) which examined that place’s history of image-breaking and the pilgrimage of childless believers. The protagonist of both works is a smashed stained-glass saint, who laments unanswered prayer.

metas.name: margins of unfinished self
metas.description: ‘margins of unfinished self’ is a work that explores the shifting boundaries of the self. It draws on micro narratives and sonic fragments that move through grief’s reshaping of time and identity – moments where scepticism sits alongside yearning, where the mystical brushes up against the everyday, and where multiplicity begins to feel like a condition of being.

metas.name: A Body of Objects
metas.description: A Body of Objects is a single channel video piece cataloguing handmade instruments and found non-musical sound objects. By weaving together disparate sounds created by each instrument and sound object, A Body of Objects exalts the objecthood of these invented instruments and found items while disrupting ideas of linear listening. Each object has its own agency. Player and instrument work together to create a soundscape that invites listeners to think about sound and object as an encounter as opposed to the sequence they see; the instrument is played but as the video unfolds, it is increasingly difficult to place the action to the sound. The sound is mediated through the listeners’ perception and bodily attention, creating a unique subjective sonic experience that resists the hierarchy of linear compositions placed upon sound and engages in dialectical listening.

metas.name: Pain Re-synthesised
metas.description: Pain Re-synthesised is a meditation on the subjective nature of pain. Exploring the disorienting, debilitating nature of pain, while also reflecting on its potential to generate something new – to create texture, detail, temporal dimensions, divinity and beauty that didn’t exist before. A process of re-synthesis takes place as a groan is broken up, warped, re-pitched and transformed again and again through SPEAR – a spectral analysis program that visualises sound frequencies as fragmented grey lines.

metas.name: Light Body / Shadow Body
metas.description: Light Body / Shadow Body was originally created as an audience interactive durational performance installation for Emersions production company in Asheville NC USA - December 2017.  ‘Acting Like Humans’ was an immersive environment of about twenty simultaneously running performance installations that audience members could visit and interact with. The premise of ‘Acting Like Humans’ was an experiment to program a group of Robots with the artificial intelligence to understand the human experience.
