Each Robot had a specific human scenario to enact.

metas.name: Animal I Am
metas.description: "A visualization and acceptance of my inevitable animal nature, as demonstrated by the duality of mankind and the wilderness which we departed." — Caleb Logue.  A person remains trapped in a confusing cycle of quiet reflection on their purpose and direction in life in spite of their animal nature.

metas.name: The End of the World
metas.description: Cuatica, a lonely and odd teenage girl, decides to put an end to her isolation in an unusual way: she creates a club at her high school to prepare for the end of the world, using it as an excuse to make friends.  The problem? No one wants to join… except for one girl: Inostroza, who ends up in the club’s classroom by mistake, and Cuatica won’t let this opportunity slip away.

metas.name: In The World You Will Have Tribulation, But Take Heart; I Have Overcome The World (Short)
metas.description: A saint prepares to perform a miracle in celebration of her 33rd birthday.

metas.name: Talking in Your Sleep
metas.description: A conversation between two characters in their sleep.

metas.name: I WANT MAKE A FILM
metas.description: Short film that explores the inner struggle of an aspiring filmmaker trying to create despite obstacles, revealing the depth of the creative process, his passion for cinema, and his search for artistic identity.

metas.name: The Gay Agenda 37
metas.description: In this series of shorts, the phrase "Gay Agenda" is reclaimed from the religious right and transformed into a celebration of gay culture. Sit back and enjoy "Cock N' Bull," "Brother," and "Burn Bridge."

metas.name: En la orilla de ninguna parte
Love in Winter
metas.description: He falls in love with her, and she reciprocates. But she disappears from his life forever, as if she never existed. This story repeats itself, albeit in reverse, with those involved in the film. And in the end, it's not she who disappears, but he. What remains as a lasting memory of this brief moment of happiness?

metas.name: Asia - Live in England
metas.description: Asia are back and roaring in their new, exhilarating line-up! Recorded live on the first of three unforgettable nights at Trading Boundaries in Sussex, in April 2025, this release captures the band performing their iconic 1982 debut album ASIA in full, along with a selection of their greatest hits.  Featuring Geoff Downes (keys), Virgil Donati (drums – ex-Planet X), John Mitchell (guitars – Arena, It Bites etc.) and the astonishing Harry Whitley (on bass and vocals), this fresh incarnation of Asia brings both reverence for the classics and a thrilling new energy to the stage. The setlist includes fan favorites like Heat of the Moment, Only Time Will Tell, Sole Survivor, One Step Closer and Time Again, alongside video-era and bonus tracks such as Ride Easy, Video Killed the Radio Star, The Heat Goes On and Daylight (video exclusive).

metas.name: If We Were Ants
metas.description: A short film about two individuals navigating their own interpretations of love, offering an intimate look at emotions, connection, and perception.

metas.name: 80º Norte, donde el tiempo se congela
Venus of Ossabaw
metas.description: A young woman, newly-escaped from Georgia’s Ossabaw Island, navigates the swamps of Spanish East Florida on the way to a free life in Catholic St. Augustine when she discovers that in order to survive, she must both battle and befriend a volatile landscape.

metas.name: Who's The Boss?
metas.description: A cruel boss and a Gen Z low-ranking employee wake up in each other's bodies and must pretend to be the other as they find the solution to their problem.

metas.name: Panic Attack
metas.description: Mia has to retake her work ID photo and is running late but the only thing in her way is herself.

metas.name: Dukan
metas.description: A social work student visiting Kamathipura for her research becomes an unexpected witness to a bizarre dilemma when a local pimp and several sex workers struggle to perform the last rites of an unknown elderly sex worker because no one knows her caste or religion.

metas.name: Portraits
metas.description: The story follows Raghav, a troubled artist living in isolation after personal loss and betrayal. His life gradually intertwines with several other wounded souls, each carrying their own struggles and emotions. Through their connected lives, the narrative explores the complexities of the human mind and the search for inner peace.

metas.name: Katseye: Lollapalooza Argentina 2026
metas.description: The multinational female K-pop group Katseye impressed and captivated the crowd with their hit song Gabriela.

metas.name: Ricciolidò
metas.description: Ricciolidò is a miniature woman who lives in a world structured on different proportions. Even the simplest everyday gestures are, for her, an opportunity to challenge her own limits. In this story, the female body of a small woman becomes a physical metaphor for the struggle that many are forced to face in order to assert themselves in a society structured to suit men.

metas.name: Lost Dream
metas.description: The documentary "Kadunud unistus" (“Lost Dream”), directed by Sergei Zjuganov, is the filmmaker’s debut feature. It takes viewers to Estonia in the 1990s - a period when newly regained freedom, the influence of Western car culture, and a rapidly changing society shaped the identity and dreams of an entire generation.

metas.name: Life Life Balance
metas.description: Paula (32) is living her dream: a life of idleness. She enjoys people-watching in the park, riding the subway just forfun, and letting her imagination roam free. It could all be so wonderful if her surroundings weren't shiftingbetween misunderstanding, envy, and anger. When her job center counselor finally loses patience and forces herto start applying for jobs, her dream seems to be coming to an end.

metas.name: Nose Job
metas.description: Kira and her brother Lino, with stockings over their heads and pepper spray in their hands, ambush a notorious loan shark, the Viennese, in the back alley of a rundown gambling hall. The stick-up succeeds, but Lino's nose breaks. To make matters worse, the Viennese and his colleague, the Butcher, are on their way to the far-off hotel to retrieve what rightfully belongs to the Austrian crime syndicate.

metas.name: She Was Here
metas.description: A reflective tale about love, loss, and the invisible ways the people we cherish continue to shape our lives.

metas.name: a guilt so profound
metas.description: A young woman sits in a church, alone and guilty, or so she thought. Beginning with the unraveling and recounting from when this guilt began, she descends into a spiritual psychosis. Russians, Victor Hugo, God, her mother, and a past mania flit in and out of her consciousness. A film which treads in the murky waters of our inner worlds-- being unable to discriminate between the real and the imagined, the sane and the psychotic.

metas.name: Unscripted: The Ghostrunners Documentary
metas.description: The Ghostrunners Podcast, hosted by Brad Ellis and Jake Triplett, consists of lighthearted, relatable, and hilarious banter between two best friends who love to find the humor in everyday life. This documentary tells the story of how two guys randomly starting a podcast unexpectedly led to a passionate fanbase and community surrounding it.

metas.name: Solo Mission
metas.description: Deep beneath the earth, a lone operative infiltrates a decaying Cold War bunker on a final seek-and-destroy mission. Cut off from command and low on ammo, he fights through ruthless guards to trigger the facility’s self-destruct. As alarms scream, a calm, waiting adversary blocks his escape. What follows is a brutal confrontation between two men, trapped by ideology and time, as the countdown to annihilation begins...

metas.name: With Love, Death
metas.description: Death is a weird but likable guy loving art and a good sip of wine. He is very conscientious concerning his work, following "the plan" strictly. One day he finds himself next to a frozen lake, where there is a young woman, Leonie, figure skating. As he realizes that she is going to fall into the ice, he shouts her name and saves her life. He now has to figure out how to deal with it and goes to the bar to convince his friend Tom to help him.

metas.name: Tandem
metas.description: Jan supports his best friend Lukas, a passionate swimmer who became blind after an accident. Jan feels responsible for Lukas’s blindness. When Lukas plans to move to Bilbao for an Erasmus program, Jan realizes how dependent he is on him. During a nighttime confrontation by the lake, Jan falls into the water and is saved by Lukas at the last moment. Jan understands that he must let Lukas go and face his own fears.

metas.name: Blind
metas.description: On her way to school, Emma comes across the memorial of a classmate who took his own life.She remembers their last encounter, where she recognized his distress but looked away. Fragmented flashbacks show her everyday life-dancing, putting on makeup, her relationship with the boy who bullied him. In the end, Emma stands before the memorial and asks: Why did you do it?

metas.name: In the Green
metas.description: Young Lotta joins her dad on a therapeutic painting class that he originally booked for her depressive mom. What was supposed to be a last-ditch effort to save the parents' broken marriage now becomes an ultimate test for the father-daughter relationship. In the end, there's not only a marriage at stake, but also the bond between father and daughter.

metas.name: Mira Lunet
metas.description: A visual EP. The second volume of Katia Krow's space-inspired serial. "Music for Bleary-Eyed Stars."  About wishes, madness, gravitas, dots, love, ghosts, etc...

metas.name: Como todo mortal
metas.description: On a distant planet, a robot searches for minerals and signs of life. Light-years away, in an ancient mine, its inhabitants live surrounded by mineral waste, while astrobiologists investigate a hidden biosphere. Like Any Other Mortal weaves together documentary, flamenco and science fiction, questioning the boundaries between the living and the non-living.

metas.name: Ramyaa
metas.description: A compelling crime drama that explores human emotions, relationships, and the struggles of individuals trying to find their place in society, unfolding through an intense and engaging narrative.

metas.name: Long Distance
metas.description: When Ian and Elle start college, they must combat the difficulties that come with a Long Distance relationship.

metas.name: Wait Is All I Have
metas.description: The film is about Muthu, a 60-year-old man, who reminisces about his family  and how they slowly became strangers under the same sky.

metas.name: Daughter of Nectar
metas.description: Daughter of Nectar, a gracefully carved marble nude from 1921 by Huang Tu-shui, Taiwan's inaugural modern sculptor, encapsulates a complex century of Taiwanese history, spanning from Japanese colonisation to Chiang Kai-shek's authoritarian rule and the White Terror era. This sculpture, both delicate and resilient, stands as a silent sentinel, mirroring the enduring struggles, suppressed voices, and profound cultural transformations of its homeland.

metas.name: Night King
metas.description: The once-glamourous Club EJ suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club’s manager, despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades. To make matters worse, the new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife.

metas.name: Sandiwara
metas.description: In a night market, five characters recount their own unique story and represent a facet of Malaysian culture rarely explored.

metas.name: The Swedish Connection
metas.description: Swedish Foreign Ministry bureaucrat Gösta Engzell, overlooked during WWII, rescued thousands while turning supposedly neutral Sweden into a moral force. His efforts challenged the status quo and left a lasting humanitarian legacy.

metas.name: Hellfire
metas.description: A drifter with a mysterious past arrives in a small town and finds the residents in the grip of a ruthless crime boss and realizes he has to help them.

metas.name: The Dangers in My Heart: The Movie
metas.description: Kyotaro Ichikawa is a painfully awkward middle school boy deep in the throes of eighth-grader syndrome, spending his days obsessed reading morbid books. His quiet, isolated world is suddenly turned upside down when Anna Yamada, the classroom star, unexpectedly steps into his life. And before he knows it, she is occupying his every day thoughts.

metas.name: Never Stand Down: The Quraishi Family
metas.description: This warm and thought-provoking film offers a lens into the Asian familial ways of love and acceptance. For Indian Pakistani American Khalid Quraishi, his daughter Zunaira’s announcement that she was ready to marry the woman of her dreams was a joyous, even miraculous, occasion. Having lived through the Partition, persecution, and the harrowing threat of nearly losing Zunaira to cancer, Khalid never once doubted what his Muslim faith had taught him to believe was most important of all: his love for his family.

metas.name: Love Sick Rebourne
metas.description: Can Samantha Anderson survive the worst night of her life, or will the weapon of mass destruction she was made to be, take over?

metas.name: Külqala
metas.description: A tough silent man sets out to find a mysterious bass guitarist to escape with her from a gloomy metropolis to his native village.

metas.name: Running Late
metas.description: A short and sweet film about a couple running late to their wedding. Made with love! For love!

metas.name: See Me
metas.description: Oscar experiences love at first sight when he meets Kristian, but also a dilemma. Kristian is in a relationship with his best friend, Caroline, and Oscar needs to make a decision whether to act on his feelings or not.

metas.name: The Chirp of Men
metas.description: A lonely customer service agent seeks fleeting moments of connection through anonymous cruising in a local park. These wordless encounters are choreographed like the courtship dances of birds, providing a stark contrast to his isolated life.

metas.name: 德云社乙巳年封箱庆典 2025
Meong!
metas.description: Meong, a stray cat in campus who spends its daily life by playing around and occasionally causing a bit of mischief. One day, Meong meets a college student who is overwhelmed with stress while working on her final thesis. Over time, the interactions between the student and Meong grow deeper. How will the dynamics of this unlikely friendship between a cat and a university student unfold?

metas.name: Dior: Anatomy of an Haute Couture Collection
metas.description: The House of Dior opens its ateliers to us for Jonathan Anderson's first Dior Haute Couture collection! Jonathan Anderson takes you behind the scenes, onto to the runway and into the ateliers to explain his vision, silhouette by silhouette, embroidery by embroidery! Are you ready for his first wedding dress?

metas.name: Just Friends
metas.description: Natalie connects with Isaac after a series of bad dates, but navigating the blurry lines between friendship and romance proves messier than expected.

metas.name: Prisoners of Conscience
metas.description: Kaleidoscopic omnibus film with 11 documentaries about Georgian political prisoners: from animation and archive work to letters from the heroes and podcast with their friends.

metas.name: Sol de Setembro
metas.description: After missing the last bus that would take them to the city, two friends decide to make the most of their final day while they wait for the September sun.

metas.name: The Oracle
metas.description: Teenage tarot reader Celine has always idolized her mother, Mara - a magically unique woman convinced she possesses real supernatural gifts. But when Mara disappears from their home, Celine’s search for answers pulls her beyond the comfort of her tarot deck into something much darker.

metas.name: The Letter
metas.description: A one-minute short where a piece of news changes the relationship between two best friends forever.

metas.name: Sketti.
metas.description: Two friends video chat to talk, but one refuses to turn his camera on...again

metas.name: Kleine liefde
metas.description: Three couples were observed by Jort Ploos van Amstel and Ilse Lenstra in their most personal setting. The observations and conversations that took place in their homes form the basis for the short, theatrical film scenes in which the couples—without acting experience—play themselves in an ode to everyday conflicts and moments of joy that connect couples.

metas.name: Treagens' Black Shadows
metas.description: Treagen Kiers' Black Shadows is a chilling triptych thriller that dissects the fragile morality of the modern world through three visceral chapters wrapped into one provocative film.

metas.name: The Space Between Us
metas.description: A messy house party and a tense cleanup. Three friends struggle to come to terms with a hard hitting truth that weighs on them all.

metas.name: Five Minutes Away
metas.description: A woman walks through town, carrying her bouquet of flowers, her boyfriend is only five minutes away...

metas.name: Incessant
metas.description: Haunted by what she believes is her husband's spirit, a grieving widow embarks on a time-traveling journey through her memories in a desperate attempt to change the past.

metas.name: Kintsugi
metas.description: Carla and Patrick navigate the raw aftermath of their breakup over one evening. This intimate portrayal explores the beauty and flaws of their relationship.

metas.name: Moana Jr: The Ranches Academy School Performance
metas.description: Live Recording of the Ranches Academy School Performance of "Disney’s Moana JR", a musical adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film, bringing the adventures of Moana and her village of Motunui to life onstage. Moana JR. features all the beloved songs from the film, written by Tony®, GRAMMY, Emmy, and Pulitzer Prize-winning composer Lin-Manuel Miranda, Opetaia Foa’i, and Mark Mancina, including “How Far I’ll Go,” “Shiny,” and “You’re Welcome.”  This thrilling and heartwarming coming-of-age story follows the strong-willed Moana as she sets sail across the Pacific to save her village and discover the truth about her heritage. Moana and the legendary demigod Maui embark on an epic journey of self-discovery and camaraderie as both learn to harness the power that lies within. With empowering messages of bravery and selflessness, Moana JR. is sure to bring out the hero within each of us.

metas.name: LipLock
metas.description: Liplock explores modern relationships, misunderstandings, and second chances.

metas.name: KIRAC 29: Whore Dialectics
metas.description: While Ben Lunato awaits his day in court, we embark with him on a journey through the world of whores. We traverse bizarre mental landscapes and arrive in Los Angeles, where we meet our friend, the art dealer Stefan Simchowitz, and, of course, whores. Endlessly many whores.  In Los Angeles, walking through the warehouses that store Stefan Simchowitz’s vast collection of contemporary African art, a promising discovery emerges concerning whores and fetishized Africans. In this film these figures appear to merge into an affirmative horizon, beyond woke ideology and politics, toward a new art, reaching back to reestablish a link with modernist symbolism as represented by Picasso’s Demoiselles d’Avignon.

metas.name: XOXO
metas.description: Love's mirror

metas.name: The Wrong Drink
metas.description: In a dusty saloon somewhere in the American West, a quiet afternoon of poker and whiskey is interrupted when a bounty hunter named Annie Baker walks in searching for answers. She believes someone in the room knows who stole her weapons — and she’s not leaving without a name.  What begins as an uneasy reunion with an old acquaintance quickly spirals into chaos when a drink meant for celebration turns deadly. As suspicion spreads across the saloon, every patron becomes a potential culprit, and the tension rises with every passing second.  With guns drawn and trust evaporating, Annie forces the room into a brutal game of truth, where one wrong move could mean death.

metas.name: Make Up Sex
metas.description: After a year of dating, a young couple explores the boundaries of what Make Up Sex can do for their relationship. Jeremy, not looking for confrontation, agrees to give it a try as they gear up to start that one fight worth making up over.

metas.name: 德云社乙巳年封箱庆典
Sambahin Ang Ngalan Mo
metas.description: On the eve of Christmas, two lovers confront faith and forbidden love, deciding whether devotion means obedience or choosing each other.

metas.name: Kino
metas.description: Kino by Marta Szewczyk and Andrea Jarales tells the story of a woman whose daily routine begins to blur as her obsession with a local cinema grows. Visionary hallucinations and fleeting moments of wonder weave through her life, mixing with the monotony of everyday existence. Each scene — from empty streets to the chaos in her apartment — reflects the protagonist’s inner disarray, showing how the line between reality and imagination becomes increasingly thin.

metas.name: Season's Greetings
metas.description: At a Christmas party, a girl seeks closure from her ex, only to get answers she doesn’t want.

metas.name: The Last Reel
metas.description: Vinu and Thommen, often run into trouble at school. One day, things slip out of hand and they both get tangled in a mess.

metas.name: Tayr shalwa
metas.description: Amidst the silent aisles and book-lined walls of the library, Asser finds himself alone, confronting a critical gap in documentation. He faces an inner struggle: cling to hope, or surrender to the permanent loss of his father's legacy? That is, until an unexpected opportunity arises, shifting the entire course of his search.

metas.name: Bi-Rista
metas.description: Leslie, an awkward queer woman, tries to work up the courage to ask out the cute barista at her local coffee shop.

metas.name: One Night in Belgrade
metas.description: One night. One city. Two strangers crossing paths in Belgrade. A musician and a photographer meet by chance and spend a night talking about life, work, and what it means to be an artist.  “One Night In Belgrade” is a romance short film about chance encounters, real conversations, and the feeling that a single evening can stay with you long after it ends.

metas.name: Short Sharp Scares: Valentine
metas.description: Passion and obsession collide this Valentine's Day.

metas.name: I Just Shit My Pants
metas.description: On Valentine's Day, a man shits his pants while proposing to his girlfriend.

metas.name: Lali - Cosquín Rock 2026
metas.description: A new edition of the festival that gathers the best argentinian and international artists.

metas.name: Fátima - A Filipe La Féria Opera Rock
metas.description: Fátima - Ópera-Rock is not just a show; it is a profound reflection on Portugal, its history, and the cultural, spiritual, and human dimensions that project our country onto the world stage, touching people from every continent and religion.  Inspired by the events of 1917 in Cova da Iria, where three children were at the center of a phenomenon that resonated universally, Filipe La Féria created a script and musical score that will remain in the memory of Portuguese theater.

metas.name: Tender: Aerin Frankel & Gwyneth Philips
metas.description: "Tender" is a tribute to the care, responsibility, and quiet eccentricity of the goaltending position – exploring a lesser-seen side of some of the fiercest competitors in a brutal sport. Told through the intertwined careers of Team USA goaltenders Aerin Frankel & Gwyneth Philips, this short documentary highlights the talents, habits, and quirks that make both athletes individually elite at their craft, while allowing their distinct personalities to shine through. It also examines the unique bond between goalie partners – a relationship defined by mutual trust and respect, forged over years as both teammates and opponents.

metas.name: Pencil & Doodles
metas.description: On the eve of her departure, a citywide blackout traps two childhood best friends in an apartment, forcing them to face the conversation about love they can no longer avoid.

metas.name: Calabash
metas.description: When two families with distinct traditions, expectations, and unspoken agendas come together for a celebration meant to unite them, anxiety-fueled scenarios quickly spiral.

metas.name: Träume und andere Realitäten: Rückblick auf 30 Jahre junge Welt
2026河南春晚 马蹄升升朝前跃
Lully :  LE CARNAVAL, MASCARADE ROYALE
metas.description: The first modern-day world premiere of Lully's last ballet-comedy.

metas.name: My Hero
metas.description: On their way to Comic-Con, a timid guy in an ill-fitting Spider-Man freezes as two bullies humiliate his girlfriend.

metas.name: The Northeastern Bro 3: Never Alone Again
The Amazing Bulk: Re-Bulked
metas.description: The greatest mockbuster of all time has been reimagined and reinterpreted by nearly 100 people.

metas.name: Homewreckers
metas.description: With his friends constantly crashing at his house and straining his relationship with his girlfriend, James must choose between his friends and his girlfriend.

metas.name: Sam Darnold's Redemption
metas.description: Sam Darnold's journey from early career setbacks to Super Bowl stardom with the Seattle Seahawks is chronicled. NFL Films follows the player's path through multiple teams, showcasing both struggles and triumphs.

metas.name: For The Love of Film
metas.description: A heartbroken film student is pulled out of his slump by his colleague and rediscovers passion for cinema. When a major movie podcast invites him to join an episode, he sees a chance to finally move forward as he steps into a moment that could change everything.

metas.name: "Bad News"
metas.description: A man is having a Good Day until he receives some Bad News.

metas.name: D RATING
metas.description: After anonymously purchasing a service from his favorite OnlyFans model, a young man must confront his choices when meeting this woman in the real world.

metas.name: Take 37
metas.description: In the sweltering heat of a indie film set, Molly, a dedicated young actress, endures a relentless barrage of misogynistic slights from her domineering director co-stars and ex love interest. As subtle condescension—dismissive comments, unwanted touches, and endless “adjustments” to her performance—escalates,  the grueling shoot drags on take after take. The air grows thicker, bodies slick.  Pushed to her absolute limit, Molly snaps. In a raw, explosive outburst, she unleashes the feral rage she’s bottled up for too long—shattering the facade of polite tolerance that women are expected to maintain. Chaos erupts on set, but in the aftermath, Molly stands unapologetic, reclaiming her power and proving a searing truth: a woman’s fury doesn’t diminish her humanity—it affirms it. This unflinching drama exposes the toxic underbelly of an industry built on silencing women, delivering a cathartic reckoning that lingers long after the credits roll.

metas.name: Bloated
metas.description: Billy, a queer college student and hopeless romantic, gets swept into what seems like a romantic connection with a kind man. From a light and cheesy beginning, Billy gradually confronts the pain of unreciprocated feelings and blurred boundaries. In the end, he learns that love does not have to come from romance to be real — and that, for now, choosing himself is enough.

metas.name: Tinseltown in Time
metas.description: Worried about his grieving partner Amelia, Shane orchestrates a date night, virtually taking her all the way across the world to experience a moment of serenity under the Tinseltown skyline.

metas.name: Party of the Past
metas.description: A man waits for guests who may arrive from another time.

metas.name: Window Service Only
metas.description: A new customer can’t decide if he wants the single or the double.

metas.name: Two Guys and a Time Machine
metas.description: Two roommates find out how to control time what could go wrong? (answer: everything)

metas.name: Ghosted In Love
metas.description: At a Halloween party, a reclusive English major, Will, falls in love with the mysterious Ghost Girl. But before he can get her name, she vanishes. It is up to Will and his best friend Marty to find Ghost Girl before she is lost forever.

metas.name: Interview With Robert Starr
metas.description: On May 9, 2003, a TV station, equipped with a journalist and a cameraman, went to the home of former film and music star Robert Starr to conduct an interview about his personal life after fame. This resulted in one of the biggest interviews in the history of Brazilian television.

metas.name: Cactus and flower
metas.description: One day, a sad and alone cactus meets a beautiful flower.

metas.name: Heatwave Over Flowers 5 ~The Only Sauna in the World~
metas.description: Heatwave Over Flowers 5 ~The Only Sauna in the World~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by DDT Pro-Wrestling (DDT), primarily focused on the stable The37KAMIINA. It took place on February 14, 2026, at Shinjuku FACE in Tokyo, Japan.

metas.name: Cupid
metas.description: Follow Cupid and her new client Neha as they race the clock to find her a date for Valentine's Day. Will she find a perfect match? Or has it been there all along...?

metas.name: The Prodigy
metas.description: Roger Sportsmans comes to Bellingham to escape his crime-riddled past when he stumbles on an underground foosball ring.

metas.name: How to Kill a Mermaid: The Linnea Mills Story
metas.description: A heart-wrenching true-crime documentary exploring the death of 18-year-old Linnea Mills during a 2020 cold-water scuba dive in Montana’s Glacier National Park. Using never-before-seen footage, it reexamines the fatal dive and investigation, offering an intimate portrait of a life cut short.

metas.name: Wild Asia: Life at Extremes
metas.description: Atop the world’s tallest peaks of the Himalayas, get an intimate look at elusive Snow Leopards and Tiger moms in Nepal raising their young. Witness a Tibetan Fox ‘hide-and-seek hunting’ amongst yaks on an ancient plateau, catch glimpses of the secretive red panda in its remote forest stronghold, meet the remarkable long-eared jumping Jerboa in the harsh Gobi Desert, and fly alongside beautiful songbirds feeding on “sapcicles” in northern Japan. In the world’s richest coral seas of the Pacific, discover the cute-yet-deadly Sea Bunny and be immersed in an unbelievable shark feeding frenzy, that’s never been filmed before. Each story reveals the incredible ways in which wildlife has adapted to thrive in these challenging habitats.

metas.name: Never Alone Again
metas.description: In 1990s Ha City, Xu Tie, a recently released ex-con and Bailing, a dancer, hiding her pain find love against social prejudice, family pressure, and danger, and must risk everything to protect each other and earn a future together.

metas.name: The Butterfly Lab
metas.description: At Oregon’s only women’s prison, incarcerated women raise an endangered butterfly. In the Lab, eggs are collected and caterpillars are fed by hand, each life stage carefully nurtured.  As metamorphosis nears, the film reflects on captivity, purpose, care, and the natural world.

metas.name: Love Hurts
metas.description: After kidnapping a Valentine’s Day icon, local mob boss Frank Deeno learns the hard way that love hurts like hell.

metas.name: Back To The Past Plus+
metas.description: Wrongly imprisoned after Hong Siu-lung’s time-traveling disappearance, Ken was wrongly imprisoned and lost everything. After his release, he leads his daughter Galie and a team to steal the Cme machine. Equipped with a face-duplication device, Ken plans to pose as the Qin Emperor and realize his dream of being king as his way of making up for everything he lost. Meanwhile, in the Qin Dynasty, Hong Siu-lung has been living in seclusion in the countryside with his wives Kam Ching and Ting-fong, his son Bowie, and his blood brother. Life looks peaceful on the surface, but the family are closely watched by the Qin Emperor. Ken launches an ambush on the Qin Emperor, but the emperor manages to escape. Meanwhile, Hong knows that as the only person who knows that the Qin Emperor is actually impersonated his disciple, he will be worthless once the Qin unites the warring states. To protect his family, Hong decides to uproot his family.

metas.name: Love Notes
metas.description: A couple diagnoses and dissects their relationship through thoughts and notes.

metas.name: AEW Grand Slam Australia 2026
metas.description: Grand Slam Australia 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on February 14, 2026 at Qudos Bank Arena in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia, and was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Brody King for the AEW World Championship.

metas.name: Creation Story: A First Date
metas.description: A middle-aged woman embarks on a first date.

metas.name: Osculum Infame: The Shameful Kiss
metas.description: A Catholic college student wants to join a coven, so she goes to a chapel and performs a ritual in hopes of summoning the devil. Where she can then perform the Osculum Infame and be initiated!

metas.name: The Last Egg
metas.description: After the passing of her last living relative, an astronaut travels across a sterile universe to a hostile planet believed to have a psionic egg with the ability to restore life. However, the closer she gets the more aggressive the egg and the planet become.

metas.name: TJPW The 6th "Futari wa Princess" Max Heart Tournament ~ Finals
metas.description: The 6th "Futari wa Princess" Max Heart Tournament ~ Finals was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW). It was held on February 14, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, featuring the finals for the 2026 edition of the promotion's annual tag team tournament.

metas.name: Kiss Me
metas.description: Desperate for affection, Hazel unravels while grappling with the lack of intimacy and fulfillment in her life.

metas.name: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
metas.description: A divorcee reenters the dating pool by creating an online profile, but when her match displays unsettling behavior and a series of women from the same dating site go missing, she must save herself from becoming the next victim.

metas.name: Ball or Beast?
metas.description: 10-year-old Lars explores his identity through his various hobbies.

metas.name: Dad = (not) Bad
metas.description: Alias is a small figure who dares to ask big questions. He is brought to life by a boy using scissors, glue and a lot of imagination. The boy wants to tell his story, but without others knowing who he is. His dad did something wrong and is in prison. Together, Alias and the boy go in search of answers. Is dad a crook? Is feeling sorry enough? And when will dad come home?

metas.name: In Between Waves
metas.description: A six-week surf therapy programme sets schoolgirl Sana free.

metas.name: Practice Makes Perfect
metas.description: When best friends Rory and Lola arrive at Lola's crush's party, they don't expect anything to happen. Let alone for the crush to ask Lola if she wants to 'go somewhere quieter?'. Now panicking in a bathroom, Rory has to comfort Lola while pushing down growing feelings of her own.

metas.name: The Same Frame
metas.description: While writing a screenplay for successful film producer Sally Kimmer, twin brothers Austin and Lee learn of their true sibling rivalry. As tensions rise, Sally finds herself having to prove herself worthy to her pushy boss Mr. Williams.

metas.name: Cesarean Weekend
metas.description: The mood in the summer villa in northern Iran, near the Caspian Sea, is exuberant. Milad and Armin gather with friends for a weekend shaped by effortless closeness. The news that Bita is pregnant by Milad adds to the fragility of their relationship. The next morning, the hosts’ fathers arrive, each carrying their own fractures

metas.name: Forest up in the Mountain
metas.description: In 2017, young Mapuche Rafael Nahuel was killed by police in the Patagonian forest. Site visits, court proceedings – the film unites the elements involved in solving the crime. Meticulously observed: the struggle for civil rights and narrating history.

metas.name: Joy Boy: A Tribute to Julius Eastman
metas.description: African American composer Julius Eastman’s music and voice take turns. Sparked by colonial and life history. Raw, radical, crystal clear. A multipart, flashy, transnational-collective performance by six artists. An homage.

metas.name: Katabasis
metas.description: In a cave situated between the ridges of a human fingerprint, a primordial encounter with matter, light and sound unfolds.

metas.name: Nursery Rhymes. (Holy) Water
metas.description: “Rock, water, fire, air…” – the rhythmic singing of a children’s song echoes on. This film intertwines play and the memory of the forced baptism of three African girls in 1855 Bruneck, Tyrol, into acts of resistance.

metas.name: In Sum
metas.description: Corroded pixels struggle to form an image as they move through Cold War promises of development in rural Thailand, haunted by archival voices.

metas.name: This Desirable Device
metas.description: Exploring the power that comes with language itself, the worth of the device, not the meaning, an artist considers the actual price of emigrating into a “better life”, while working in a restrictive political climate.

metas.name: Safe Exit
metas.description: Samaan, a young Christian man, works as a security guard in a residential building in downtown Cairo. Quiet and introspective, he spends his nights writing stories and chasing his dream of publishing his first novel. Beneath his calm surface, Samaan carries deep wounds—the lasting effects of chronic PTSD, rooted in the traumatic loss of his father, who was killed in a terrorist attack in Libya during Samaan’s childhood. One day, amid the noise and routine of the city, Samaan crosses paths with Fatima, a young Muslim woman. What begins as a simple encounter soon blossoms into an extraordinary friendship—one that slowly begins to break down the walls Samaan has built around his trauma.

metas.name: Enjoy Your Stay
metas.description: To avoid losing custody of her six-year-old daughter in Manila, Luz, an undocumented Filipina cleaner working in a luxury Swiss ski resort, must earn money at any cost – even if it means transgressing her own moral limits.

metas.name: Around Paradise
metas.description: In Caazapá, the “city of magic and legends”, two Paraguayan students are searching for happiness, gold and a magic bird. Their European dropout neighbours are hoping for freedom, healing and salvation from Armageddon. Everything has its price.

metas.name: Lali
metas.description: Bound by love and haunted by fate, Zeba and Sajawal spiral through feelings of desire, superstition and fear in Lali, a darkly comic tale where the living share a restless world with the ghosts.

metas.name: Not a Hero
metas.description: Exiled from city comforts to his ancestral village, Mivan meets his embittered aunt, befriends a horse and joins the local kids on wild adventures, discovering the beauty of life and a courage he never knew he had.

metas.name: Shanghai Daughter
metas.description: A Shanghai woman journeys alone to a rubber plantation in southwest China, where her late father was sent during the Cultural Revolution. As she searches for a mysterious woman, some strangers unexpectedly drift into her path.

metas.name: Yuragim
metas.description: Saida moves between the roles of teacher, daughter, translator and fixer like a train on its tracks. As her boss looms closer, she must decide whether to continue supporting the system or vanish into a world of her own making.

metas.name: Someday a Child
metas.description: A boy with extraordinary powers lives with his uncle in a Lebanese village where the noise of warplanes is a daily occurrence. As his uncle tries to train him to appear “normal”, the boy’s gift becomes impossible to contain.

metas.name: Unidentified Nonflying Objects (UNO)
metas.description: However permanent and stable any order may seem, it may eventually crumble when reality outside of the system creeps in, growing like organic matter through the boundaries that the order has imposed. An animated odyssey.

metas.name: Souls of Fouta
metas.description: Dembe died of an overdose in the distant metropolis of Dakar. His father refuses to bury him in the family graveyard in the village, believing that his soul has become “impure”. Dembe’s mother decides to take matters into her own hands.

metas.name: Les juifs riches
metas.description: In English, we say “rich, richer, the richest”. In Yiddish, we say “Rach (which means rich), Miè Guizoukt (which means: may it happen to me), A Ganèf (what a thief!)”. According to the director, this film will almost make you Jewish.

metas.name: With a Kind Regard
metas.description: More than 400 dusty job application letters in an abandoned GDR factory tell of the personal circumstances and memories of a generation. Wishes and fears are laid bare in the effort to find a place in the free market economy.

metas.name: Shot Reverse Shot
metas.description: During the 1980s, the American journalist Edward Serotta documented the harsh realities and Jewish life in socialist Romania. The secret services clandestinely accompanied him on his journey. A photo essay from opposing perspectives.

metas.name: Taxi moto
metas.description: A filmmaker's film shoot is canceled, and he sets off in search of what remains of it, elsewhere, accompanied by another actor. What they seek together is no longer just a film, but a reflection on the stories that are forbidden and those that are reclaimed.  Through their exchanges, the boundary between cinema and life blurs, and the film becomes a space of intimate resistance, where thinking, desiring, and speaking are one and the same.

metas.name: Chuuraa
metas.description: In the remote Siberian Arctic, an Indigenous Sakha scientist descends into the depths of the melting permafrost. Searching for an ancient creature, he makes his way through the dangerous, claustrophobic caves to the mythical realm of the Underworld.

metas.name: An Accident
metas.description: In the microcosm of a small village, paths and fates cross. A car is burning at the roadside, pigs are dying in their sties and a man is lying on a park bench. Is he dead? Who is to blame, who is responsible and when did the playful mood turn sour?

metas.name: Flim Flam
metas.description: A visual and acoustic reflection about perception, deception, truth and the medium of film itself. Between visibility, irritation, structure and dissolution, a space arises for one’s own vision. An experimental film that wants to be experienced.

metas.name: Graft Versus Host
metas.description: In this speculative video essay, the filmmaker connects his medical history with the shifts in post-Cold War geopolitics and their impact on contemporary politics.

metas.name: Henry Is a Girl Who Likes to Sleep
metas.description: The filmmaker writes a letter to her cat, Henry. She is looking for a soft and tender place to inhabit – a quiet refuge of warmth to retreat into when the world becomes too loud. An ode to our captive pets and the intimate worlds we build together.

metas.name: Kontrewers
metas.description: The ghost of a possessed girl, trapped for centuries within a stone, encounters the director’s 102-year-old grandmother. What begins as a haunting becomes a tender dialogue, as archival, staged and documentary footage blur.

metas.name: A Woman's Place Is Everywhere
metas.description: After the sudden death of their mother, identical twin sisters face eviction from the Williamsburg, Brooklyn loft they’ve called home for more than three decades.

metas.name: Love Go Go Go!
metas.description: A spendthrift seeking emotional comfort and a cautious saver searching for security are drawn into an unlikely relationship that begins with constant clashes. As playful tension turns into real feelings, misunderstandings threaten to pull them apart, forcing both to confront what truly matters in love and life.

metas.name: Forged in Fire
metas.description: During youth fire brigade training, Mila and Amélie’s friendship grows.

metas.name: Because of Cupid
metas.description: Best friends Naomi and Marcus participate in a Valentine's Day mocktail competition but things go awry when Cupid interferes with a love potion that affects Marcus and several of their friends.

metas.name: Beyond the Screen : Reality of Indonesia Film Industry
metas.description: This documentary explores how familiar formulas, particularly in the horror genre, continue to dominate Indonesian cinema, raising questions about originality, diversity, and the future of storytelling in a culturally rich nation.

metas.name: In Search of a Rhino
metas.description: Introverted student Ira tries to find and take photos of all the mysterious graffiti rhinos in the city, while in reality she is desperately trying to find love. Her friends start a mission to help her find her true love.

metas.name: Love, Eventually
metas.description: Two middle-agers – a dreamy fisherman and an emotionally guarded architect — are lured into five dates by their scheming adult children, only to discover through a series of awkward situations that it’s never too late to fall in love.

metas.name: Light Pillar
metas.description: The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A lonely janitor tends the grounds of a dilapidated bankrupt film studio with only a former cat actor for company until he embarks on a romantic journey with a female player in a beautiful virtual world.

metas.name: Stallion and a Crystal Ball
metas.description: In his dark, silent room, a secluded teenager sick with a burning desire casts a spell. As violent visions warp his reality, a bubble threatens to burst; something must break.

metas.name: Cosmonauts
metas.description: On an intergalactic cruise for singles, lonely souls chase a kiss, a caress, or just a glimpse of love among the stars.

metas.name: Everyone's Sorry Nowadays
metas.description: On a sweltering summer day, Bianca feels unseen by her parents. Then an unexpected encounter with her favourite female actor, Billie King, helps her to find herself. A tender, imaginative tale about dreams and carving out a space for yourself in life.

metas.name: Bucks Harbor
metas.description: Boys in Downeast Maine are shaped by the brutal winters, their harvesting of the ocean’s bounty and the rigid codes of their fathers. Bucks Harbor explores growing up in a community where a man’s worth is often defined by the strength of his back.

metas.name: Battle For Giant Cake the movies
metas.description: One time there was a family of Phones. Phone was one time playing on the road and found Battery. They became friends and Phone asked his family to accept Battery into the Phones family. Everyone accepted but Battery started becoming more greedy... (No more spoilers)

metas.name: Together
metas.description: “Together” follows a quiet young man who finds comfort in the gentle rituals of a café, where love blooms in silence and familiarity. In the warmth of repeated moments, he holds on to a presence that feels real, even if the world around him never sees it. It’s a tender story of longing, memory, and the kind of love that lives deeply inside — whether shared or not.

metas.name: Somewhere Between
metas.description: Kaveen and Liya navigating love, connection, and the moments that shape their relationship. As their bond grows, they discover what lies somewhere between companionship and vulnerability.

metas.name: Seetha Payanam
metas.description: Chef Seetha survives an accident and seeks to thank her saviors. She falls for stranger Abhishek, who hides a secret. When truth surfaces, she must choose between love, honesty, and her future.

metas.name: Mole Dream
metas.description: An experimental lo-fi odyssey about an inspector of leather chairs who must prove their creativity to the agency that oversees dreams in order to have a chance at experiencing their mole dream again.

metas.name: Love Is on the Way
metas.description: A "lying flat" youth exposes a loan shark, falls in love with a "super striver," and their turbulent romance overcomes various scams and financial disasters.

metas.name: On Our Own
metas.description: Growing up without her parents, who had gone to work in the West, Flavia became a tough but distant teenager. The routine that keeps her safe and emotionally isolated is disrupted when two young children who have run away from home seek shelter with her.

metas.name: Just Shy of Love
metas.description: A story of boy meets girl.

metas.name: Haye Hukku Haye Hukku Haaye Haaye Haaye
metas.description: Daksh and Insha Are Close Friends Who Have Never Seen Each Other Romantically, But Their Families Misinterpret Their Bond And Arrange Their Engagement  Desperate To Escape , They Make A Dramatic Announcement - Daksh Declares That He Is Gay, While Insha A Lesbian - And The Engagement Is Immediately Called Off Leaving Their Families In Shock , What Begins As A Silly Plan To Avoid Marriage Slowly Backfires When Daksh And Insha, Spending More Time Together Amidst The Chaos , Begin To Develop Real Feelings Now Trapped By Their Own Lie , They Must Find The Courage To Confess Both The Truth And Their Love Turning The Raita They Created Into A Happily-Ever-After

metas.name: Cigar Box
metas.description: A high schooler gives his girlfriend a cigar box, but she rejects it. Throughout the years, as their paths cross, he takes each opportunity to ask her why.

metas.name: Back Then
metas.description: Haneul greets his parents and heads to college. While in a taxi to New York, a diminishing past memory is brought up — through one old, crumbled Leche Frita wrapper.

metas.name: Cope
metas.description: A depressed teenage girl leads a monotonous life, which is shaken up by a painful accident and a chance encounter she never would've expected.

metas.name: Atlas of the Universe
metas.description: After mistakenly buying two right-footed shoes, a ten-year-old boy sets off across the countryside to find the missing left one. An unexpected journey of courage, friendship and self-discovery.

metas.name: Another Half Heart
metas.description: A man wearing Yellow shorts and a man wearing Blue shorts are faced with the situation that they are dating the same woman.

metas.name: Where the Light Fades
metas.description: A Farmer struggling to move on from a past relationship finds comfort in a life draining entity

metas.name: More Than Monogamy
metas.description: Sexuality is complex. Sexuality is diverse. Sexuality is More Than Monogamy.  "The Lifestyle" is a massive umbrella term that encompasses swinging, polyamory, kink...and so much more; this documentary is all about highlighting and explaining why it might be perfect for your relationship and maybe why it won't.  Designed to be both educational and entertaining, let's look at why there can be so much more to a relationship than monogamy.

metas.name: Scenario
metas.description: Altmark is located in the northern part of the German region of Saxony-Anhalt. This area of the country is sparsely populated and rural, and is mostly defined by agriculture and a rather frugal architecture reminiscent of that of the Hanseatic cities. It's here that an extensive military site was built in the 1930s. It is used as a training area for the German army and also includes a garrison town, in which parts of the military corps reside. The site covers a surface area of 323 square kilometres. It is the third-biggest military area in Germany and the most modern in Europe.

metas.name: The Last Tram
metas.description: A mysterious man rides the last midnight tram, visiting women with gold coins and false promises. As desire, illusion, and greed collide, he loses the one who loved him truly-and becomes trapped in his own haunting game.

metas.name: Maggi Pusthaka
metas.description: Maggi Pusthaka is a four-dimensional Novel based cinema inspired by true events, thought-provoking and poignant film that addresses several critical issues surrounding the education system during the pandemic year.

metas.name: Juniors Journey
metas.description: Follows an aspiring civil servant who arrives in Malayalam a quiet village to prepare for the IAS exam, but his disciplined world collides with an unexpected local mystery.

metas.name: Harry Kane: Against the Odds
metas.description: From a quiet academy hopeful to one of football's most prolific strikers, this documentary traces Harry Kane's determined rise through setbacks, loan spells, and relentless self-belief. Blending personal interviews, unseen training-ground moments, and career-defining matches, it reveals how discipline, mentality, and leadership transformed him from an underestimated youngster into a global sporting icon.

metas.name: a photo of her
metas.description: Feliks takes a photo of a random girl on the street. The fascinating picture impacts his life in a way he couldn't have had predicted.

metas.name: Where's Urmila?
metas.description: What begins online doesn’t stay there. Where’s Urmilla? is a reflection on the emotional weight of cyberbullying, especially for queer and trans people, whose visibility often comes with a cost.

metas.name: The Gaymaker
metas.description: Desperate to win over his straight roommate, a young man hires the "Gaymaker", a mysterious woman rumored to convert heterosexual men.

metas.name: Singh & Sinha
metas.description: Singh and Sinha are two soulmates sharing a blissful, inseparable bond for a year and a half. Their happiness abruptly shatters when one partner suddenly passes away, leaving the survivor trapped in overwhelming grief. The tragedy deepens when the protagonist discovers the cause of death: complications from AIDS. Shortly after, his own medical tests confirm that he is also HIV positive. Confronted with mortality and isolation, he undergoes a painful emotional journey. The narrative transforms absolute loss into a testament to human strength, showing his struggle to find hope, heal, and rebuild his life despite the illness.

metas.name: Ramen for Two
metas.description: A young chef is getting ready to make some ramen for a date, but the discovery of a photo of her ex-girlfriend sends her on a journey through their shared past. A film that explores themes like memory and new opportunities. Surprising for the mature way it approaches relationships and captivating thanks to its evocative pictorial art aesthetic. Ingredients that will leave audiences with the lingering taste of something between nostalgia and hope.

metas.name: Nice to Meet You
metas.description: Emilio and Mikas are two men in their 30s who have never known true love or embrace from their parents as children. One night in a park, when Mikas is on the verge of taking his life, Emilio sees him and intervenes in an impulsive act. This becomes the starting point of their first meeting. During that night, as they share their wounded memories, an unlikely and deep connection develops between them. They explore their feelings and desires, leading to an unexpectedly intimate experience. When they wake up the next day, they face questions about their feelings and how this night will affect their lives going forward

metas.name: Forbidden Soul
metas.description: The inner spiritual feelings and emotions of transgender are considered forbidden in the eyes of society. This story is based on transgender Act 2018 when a decision by the Islamic court declared such lewd feelings un Islamic.

metas.name: Boys of a Feather
metas.description: Tomás is nervously waiting for a job interview in an office lobby, when his childhood best friend Jamal walks in. But... does Jamal recognize Tomás? Tomás must decide whether or not to summon up the courage to seize this happenstance meeting in hopes of rekindling their friendship and maybe something more.

metas.name: Afterwords
metas.description: Lost in a disintegrating marriage, Kate travels to Provincetown to confront a love from her past who might be the key to her finding herself.

metas.name: Sing! Dance! Altaria!
metas.description: A Swablu lives in the forest an discovers a passion for singing after quelling an argument between a Houndour and a Panpour. As it practices singing and makes friends in the forest, it attracts the attention of Rene and her Audino who give it a special ribbon that contained Alatrianite to wear.

metas.name: Because of You
metas.description: Brayden, a young 17 year old boy, faces conflict and self doubt as he navigates the complexities of one's first love. Supported by many, he remains in question and fear until crossing paths with the one who changes everything - Thomas.

metas.name: Old Ned
metas.description: An oral history of the creation, performance, and legacy of the locally beloved guise beast Old Ned, and his role in the revived tradition of May Horns held annually in Penzance, Cornwall.

metas.name: The Mexico City incident
metas.description: Three friends reunite after a long time to play Europolis, their favorite game. But it’s precisely this game that will put their friendship to the test.

metas.name: Spooder-Kid Shattered World
metas.description: Full movie version of series.  Its been a few months since Spooder-Kid has defeated the Bubbler. Its winter time. The boys are well adjusted to their new lives. But when a new villain who goes by the name of Octavius creates a dangerous machine to  make infinite energy and finish what the Bubbler started , Spooder-Kid intervenes. Will he save his town from this new unwanted threat?

metas.name: Étienne de Crécy @ L'Ososphère 2026
metas.description: Étienne de Crécy is a pioneering figure of French Touch. Over 30 years, he's released major albums and remixed for Kraftwerk, Air, Moby, and Lil'Louis. His 1997 cult album Super Discount embodied the elegance and boldness of French electronic music. From punk bassist to sound engineer, Crécy has always embraced experimentation across projects and collaborations. A passionate DJ known for intense live performances, he electrified audiences at the 2026 Ososphère event, where Strasbourg train station became a monumental dancefloor. Lights, tension, energy: his set captivated the crowd. Filmed February 13, 2026, at Strasbourg station, France.

metas.name: Olchu Ta
metas.description: A young man moves through a series of rooms, routines, and his past, where voices linger longer than people and small objects seem to carry a memory he can’t fully grasp. As fragments of a childhood game resurface, the line between what is lived and what is remembered begins to blur.

metas.name: Naalppathukalile Pranayam
metas.description: The movie revolves around a woman writer who, after going through a divorce, finds love again with a publisher who intends to marry her.

metas.name: Karimlan
metas.description: Behind closed doors, a child growing up amidst nightly screams and broken silence counts down the hours as her world slowly crumbles. Outside, elders repeatedly ignore her cries for help. At home, she struggles to pretend that everything is fine, no matter how hard her mother tries. In truth, darkness is slowly engulfing their family, until one night of darkness comes that will change everything.

metas.name: COMPLICIT
metas.description: A Young, Alienated teen with an affinity recorded video, goes through his weekly routines with emotional distance and emptiness, but after an encounter with someone, he soon develops a fascination that could turn dangerous.

metas.name: The Call
metas.description: Through a series of increasingly desperate phone calls, a mother's world unravels as her gay son is pursued and harassed by his former school bullies.

metas.name: Finding Orson
metas.description: Andrew Callaghan helps find a lost parrot

metas.name: 劇場版 ほんとうにあった怖い話～ゾク変な間取り～
Gangster’s Daughter 4
metas.description: Kadisha Spencer continues to run her father’s brutal empire while matching wits with Detective Steel and meticulously eliminating her enemies.

metas.name: Working in Progress
metas.description: Working in Progress is a quirky, offbeat mockumentary that hilariously captures the bizarre and absurd day-to-day operations of Scorbsackeg, a company with a purpose no one can quite figure out. Founded and run by the delusional and self-obsessed CEO James Brownlee, the company operates out of his sister Janet's home in the small town of Progress, Delaware. Despite its lack of clear direction, James believes the business is destined for greatness. He's so convinced, in fact, that he hires a film crew to capture his "rise to success," planning to sell the documentary alongside his autobiography when he makes it big.

metas.name: Bas Ek Pal
metas.description: Love is contagious wherever you are.

metas.name: Living in the Cemetery
metas.description: A mother haunted by trauma becomes overprotective of her daughter, but when the daughter falls in love, their bond fractures. As buried secrets emerge, both must confront whether forgiveness can heal old wounds before it's too late.

metas.name: Last 1%
metas.description: Last 1% follows Aariz, a young student living away from home, whose life suddenly turns tense after receiving an urgent message about his mother. With only 1% battery left on his phone, he rushes through the city trying to reach home while facing unexpected situations and people along the way. As time keeps slipping away, Aariz must make difficult choices that test his emotions, patience, and humanity.  The film is a gripping emotional journey about time, decisions, and the moments that can change a life forever.

metas.name: 임영웅 IM HERO TOUR 2025 서울 (KSPO DOME)
Georgia Peach
metas.description: A nurse in recovery from alcoholism must confront her past and her brother's growing demands, risking everything she's worked for to reclaim her life or lose it all to her inner demons.

metas.name: Body Of Nurses
metas.description: A doctor is led into a web of betrayal by his nurses on a fateful night shift at a mysterious hospital.

metas.name: Evaporation
metas.description: Two strangers bond through fleeting moments of smoking, but beneath their connection lie a gut wrenching emptiness they can't escape.

metas.name: Big Scouse
metas.description: Big Scouse follows Terry O’Neill’s journey from Merseyside to Richmond, Virginia and the impact he had on the city's football culture with his legendary pub Penny Lane and what makes it the best football bar in America.

metas.name: Seal: Purpose
metas.description: The Grammy Award-winning British soul icon performs a celebratory concert at The Venetian in Las Vegas three decades after the release of his self-titled album Seal and eponymous follow up Seal II. Joined by longtime producer Trevor Horn, he performs a set highlighted by classic chart-topping anthems Crazy, Future Love Paradise, Killer and Kiss From a Rose, as well as a few surprises. Directed by Keirda Bahruth (Hardcore Devo) and with intimate interviews interspersed throughout, it’s a stunning film that shows this extraordinary artist at the top of his performance game.

metas.name: Feigning Tennis
metas.description: An amateur tennis player must keep up the facade of being a pro to delay her wedding to a man she’s fallen out of love with. If her career takes off, she can excuse herself from the relationship with the promise of bigger and better things, even though it might reveal she was leading him on, but if she fails, she’d rather be in a one-sided marriage than completely alone. How far will she feign tennis success before the truth comes out?

metas.name: Nilave
metas.description: Nilave traces the journey of Arjun, a lonely and emotionally anxious young man searching for companionship. In a world of fleeting connections, he discovers a magical love and goes to extraordinary lengths to make it eternal.

metas.name: Sunny Di Honey
metas.description: A shy young man living under his overprotective father's shadow finally dares to fall in love with his confident colleague. When his father sabotages the relationship by creating a love triangle with another man, chaos follows. Caught between rivalry, misunderstandings, and self-doubt, he must find the courage to stand up for his love, confront his fears, and claim his own identity.

metas.name: Mohor
metas.description: A heartfelt, emotionally driven short story about love and heartbreak, following a young woman navigating loss of faith in love and the slow mending of her heart.

metas.name: Level Up
metas.description: A teenager who loves play with his video games is suddenly burglarized. He then uses a surprising way to cope with his problems.

metas.name: Le Mop Deux
metas.description: Le Mop and Brycen have just fallen in love. Suddenly, a gang of thugs from a rival store kidnaps Brycen. Le Mop must train to fight for her love and get him back.

metas.name: Caught Slippin
metas.description: Three couples-Shawn and Chelsea, Mack and Ciara, and Jen and Mike-go on a weekend getaway to Joshua Tree. The trip takes a dark turn when Mack goes missing after the first day. As tensions rise and secrets come to light, the friends must confront their deepest fears and suspicions, unraveling a mystery that threatens to change their lives forever.

metas.name: Out in the Wilderness
metas.description: A group of friends try to set off on a camping trip. After a series of mistakes leaves the group stranded in the woods, they find themselves needing to go to lengths never before imagined in order to get out alive.

metas.name: DSP Dev 2
metas.description: A disgraced cop gets one last shot at redemption by busting a major black money ring. The twist? His targets aren't typical criminals but women and children concealing something far more sinister than financial crimes.

metas.name: Torture Culture
metas.description: Torture in Russian captivity is systematic. In a new documentary, The Kyiv Independent’s War Crimes Investigations Unit uncovers the torture of Ukrainian civilians held by Russian forces and traces the roots of these practices through Russian history. The documentary features civilians from different regions and backgrounds who were detained in occupied Ukrainian territories and in Russia itself. Despite being held at different times and in different locations, their testimonies describe strikingly similar patterns of abuse. By combining firsthand accounts with historical research, the investigation shows how torture has persisted across generations and continues to shape Russia’s war against Ukraine.

metas.name: The Supplement
metas.description: Desperate to outdo his muscular roommate, a broke and insecure young man takes an extreme shortcut in his quest for muscle and self-worth.

metas.name: Ukraine's Killzone
metas.description: Follow Devin Woodall as he travels around the frontline communities of the Kostyantynivka axis of the front. Working with charity Crystal Hearts, we see the work of Ukrainian military engineers as they install netting across roadways, the impact of Russian attacks on fire stations, and the evacuation of civilians from an active warzone.

metas.name: Sakari Orama conducts Saariaho and Mahler With Verneri Pohjola
metas.description: The Orchestre Philharmonique de Radio France and Finnish conductor Sakari Oramo celebrate the memory of composer Kaija Saariaho with a performance of one of her last works as well as Mahler's Symphony No. 5.

metas.name: Seal – Purpose: Celebrating 30 Years of the Classic Albums Seal and Seal II (2025/2026)
metas.description: The Grammy Award-winning British soul icon performs a celebratory concert at The Venetian in Las Vegas three decades after the release of his self-titled album Seal and eponymous follow-up Seal II. Joined by longtime producer Trevor Horn, he performs a set highlighted by classic chart-topping anthems “Crazy,” “Future Love Paradise,” “Killer,” and “Kiss From a Rose,” as well as a few surprises. Directed by Keirda Bahruth (Hardcore Devo) and with intimate interviews interspersed throughout, it’s a stunning film that shows this extraordinary artist at the top of his performance game.

metas.name: Keep It Going
metas.description: This film, which follows Xavier on his first-ever headlining tour, captures a young rapper at an inflection point in his career: he's the biggest he's ever been and needs to make a decision of where to go next. With a dedicated fanbase keeping up with his every move, Xavier is still working to make his most basic ends meet. "I'm homeless right now. We trying to get a crib right now," he admits at one point during our doc. "We still got a long way to go."

metas.name: HORSEBOTTOM
metas.description: Langely Horsebottom is an aspiring basketball player and showcases his talents on film.

metas.name: Who Killed These Women? (The Tinley Park 5)
metas.description: An examination into the largest unsolved mass shooting in modern day America today. On Feb 2, 2008 a killer executed 5 women inside a Lane Bryant department store in suburban Chicago.

metas.name: Confessions of a Girl
metas.description: She has something to say.....and you better listen.

metas.name: Punha Ekda Sade Made 3
metas.description: Three eccentric brothers maintain their "no women, no marriage" rule at their garage, but a return sparks fresh chaos. As old habits clash with new troubles, the iconic trio finds their world hilariously spiraling out of control.

metas.name: Violent Bastards
metas.description: A disillusioned teenager embraces violence as a means to truly fight for ideologies, drawing his estranged brother into a bloody confrontation that will leave both scarred.

metas.name: Bankzitters: Ziggo Dome 2026 (Mini Docu)
metas.description: In this video, we take you behind the scenes of our five Ziggo Dome shows and the days leading up to them. No filter, no script, just plenty of chaos and stress.

metas.name: Non Scriptus Manet
metas.description: From Manet's painting – Le Déjeuner sur l'herbe – two women and two men slip from the timelessness of the museum into our present day. They have come to picnic and enjoy a pleasant swim in the river. The men approach them and, with little attempt to conceal their aggressive libidinous intentions, threaten the happiness of the moment, the serenity of the place, and the integrity of the bathers. This fragment of Eden and everything around it is inhabited by a naturalized social violence...

metas.name: Soberman
metas.description: After waking up from his first hangover, Waylon Stone experiences a life‑changing cinematic event that makes him rethink his weekend drinking habits.

metas.name: Prostsjön
metas.description: A short film made with a Nikon Coolpix 3200, showcasing places Hugo associated with special moments with his girlfriend.

metas.name: Les visages de la guerre
metas.description: At the Vynnyky Medical Center, located in the suburbs of Lviv, Ukraine, the staff treats exclusively war casualties: amputees and those who have been disfigured. An internationally renowned surgeon, Chloé Bertolus is one of the leading specialists in facial reconstruction. Several times a year, she visits the wounded to repair tissue damaged by bullets and shrapnel from the Russian army.

metas.name: Au Sommet
metas.description: Théo Lellois, a popular actor, is beginning to succumb to the pressure of his status.

metas.name: Starry Eyed
metas.description: 'A struggling actor and burnt-out painter find themselves torn between passion, love, and day jobs over a magical night at the movies.'

metas.name: The Trap
metas.description: Viktor Orbán was given a rare opportunity in 2010. He won a supermajority in parliament, giving him a strong mandate to put Hungary on a path to development.  He also received external assistance for this. The global economy boomed in the 2010s, and Hungary received an unprecedented amount of funding from the European Union, on a scale unseen in over a century.  What did Viktor Orbán do with these unprecedented opportunities? To what extent did he keep the promises he made 16 years ago?  This film tells that story.

metas.name: Angel Flight THE MOVIE
metas.description: The hit series about final goodbyes between the dead and the living across borders comes to the big screen. Angel Hearse receives a wave of international repatriation requests: a couple in Mexico in a movie-like romance, a baby, a man in a wheelchair on a world journey, an American star and his secret love, and Nami, who heads to Mexico after news her lover is alive. Will miracle reunions await?

metas.name: The Constant Dawn
metas.description: Who are we, when our origins no longer protect us, yet continue to live within us? This short unfolds as a passage without destination, offering neither answers nor salvation. It's not a return to the origin nor a path toward redemption, but a state of permanence: the experience of inhabiting places, memories, and beliefs without ever feeling fully 'at home'.

metas.name: Vanaveera
metas.description: A descendant of the Vanara clan is pushed into conflict when a modern-day Ravana seizes his only bike for an election rally. What starts as a petty injustice soon erupts into a fierce fight for self-respect and dignity.

metas.name: DERRICK
metas.description: A drag performer with sadness marked by his scar tries to find himself through people he envies

metas.name: Marvelous Mio 10th Anniversary
metas.description: Mio 10th Anniversary was a professional wrestling event promoted by Marvelous That's Women Pro Wrestling, commemorating the tenth anniversary of company star Mio Momono's in-ring debut. It took place on February 13, 2026, at Shin-Kiba 1st RING in Tokyo, Japan.

metas.name: Marigold New Years Golden Garden 2026 ~ Day 9
metas.description: Marigold New Years Golden Garden 2026 ~ Day 9 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Dream Star★Fighting Marigold. It took place on February 13, 2026 at Shinjuku FACE in Tokyo, Japan.

metas.name: Sips
metas.description: Two teenagers, Tom and Mac, are pulled and chased around Brisbane city as they argue about drugs, kickons and their life ambitions.

metas.name: The Wrong Baby Daddy
metas.description: Lila’s life finally feels complete when she starts a dream job with her close friend Robin, falls into a promising romance with Mark, and discovers she’s pregnant. But everything shifts when Julia, Mark’s ex-wife, reappears the moment she learns about the baby. At first, Julia’s involvement seems harmless, even polite, until she begins showing up uninvited, inserting herself into every corner of Lila’s new life. As Julia’s presence grows more intrusive and her intentions more unsettling, Lila realizes she may be fighting to protect far more than just her future. Soon, what began as a perfect new chapter becomes a tense battle of boundaries, obsession, and survival.

metas.name: Yiker Bay
metas.description: A Film by Zekarias Wondifraw

metas.name: Milk, Two Sugars (A Jamie Powell Film)
metas.description: A man struggling with the loss of his wife, is startled by a knock at his front door from  an unusual visitor

metas.name: The Blind Date
metas.description: When a young woman is set up on a blind date in New York City, she realizes quickly her date is her ex-girlfriend and must decide whether to stay or go.

metas.name: Spider Fairy
metas.description: After cultivating for a thousand years, the Cold Soul Spider, Zhu'er, was enlightened by Buddha and transformed into human form, descending to the mortal realm as a demon hunter. She joins forces with Ganlu, Zhicao, and Changfeng to vanquish demons and protect the righteous path. Zhu'er is deeply in love with Ganlu, but the incompatibility of their human and demonic paths plunges her into suffering. The sect leader, Wuxu, is consumed by demonic power and attempts to seize his cultivation. To save everyone, Zhu'er sacrifices three thousand years of cultivation to destroy the demon, ultimately realizing that her true love lies with Zhicao.

metas.name: Zitai
metas.description: There are personalities who, by their very presence, bring people together to revive and nurture the memory and identity of a nation. Zita Kelmickaitė was one such person. This is a journey to Lithuania in the 1980s and 1990s, when the revival of folk songs became a silent weapon and an important part of the road to independence. Using previously unseen archival material and the voice of Zita Kelmickaitė herself, the film reveals not only the phenomenon of her personality, but also the history of an entire generation that cherished national identity.

metas.name: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 Feb.
metas.description: Stardom Nighter in Korakuen 2026 Feb. was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on February 13, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

metas.name: Bara Badhu
metas.description: Two friends plot their way out of unemployment and despair, only to become pawns in village power games. Their quest for a better life becomes a harrowing test of loyalty and resilience.

metas.name: Dream Girl
metas.description: He Falls in Love With an Angel Who Appears in His Dreams. That Love Ends in Heartbreak. Yet The Same Emotions Continue in Real Life Without Changing a Single Frame. The Story Follows How the Hero, Carrying the Same Love in His Heart, Finds a Way to Reclaim the Angel He Lost in His Dream, This Time in Reality

metas.name: For the Love of Strippers
metas.description: An intimate portrait of two L.A. strippers and activists fighting to protect their art, safety, and livelihoods during a critical inflection point for the industry and their own lives.

metas.name: Discipline
metas.description: The film examines girlhood as inherited performance-costumes worn before identity forms. Mona frames femininity as simultaneous nurture and constraint, exploring how intimacy between girls and garments becomes predetermined theatre. Clothing functions as ritual and control, dictating movement before self-knowledge arrives.

metas.name: Red Flags
metas.description: After hundreds of bad dates, a chance meeting brings two people, in the same boat, together.

metas.name: Sweety Naughty Crazy
metas.description: Shiva, a charming college student juggling three different relationships. As he tries to keep them secret, love, lust, and chaos collide in a playful mix of adult humor, romance, and comedy.

metas.name: BYU's Resident Cougar
metas.description: A documentary crew follows Ella Gible, a BYU student for 20 years, who refuses to graduate until she finds a husband.

metas.name: Powerwolf - Wildlive (Live at Olympiahalle)
metas.description: Powerwolf are back - louder, more epic and more impressive than ever before!  Recorded at the breathtaking final concert of the Wolfsnächte Tour 2024 in Munich's sold-out Olympiahalle, WILDLIVE is far more than just another live recording - it's a grandiose, cinematic experience full of fire, emotion and boundless creativity.

metas.name: Love & New Notes
metas.description: A couple expecting a child makes the drastic decision to attempt a robbery, finding themselves out of their depth with the homeowners they try to steal from.

metas.name: Josh Groban: An Intimate Evening at The Union Chapel
